review_headline: Adorable Giraffe Printed Backpack Has Tons Of Room For All Back To School Needs!  Pockets & Storage Galore!
review_body:
This Backpack by BTOOP is awesome! It is very sturdy and I noticed right away that all of the stitching is even and tight. It comes in blue and pink, but the blue would be fine for a girl, too because of the adorable little giraffe print all over it. There is a zippered pouch on the back and deep, slender pockets on each side. The straps have a very comfortable and supportive neoprene like material in the lining which keeps it from cutting in on the shoulders. The straps are also adjustable and there is a large loop at the top to hang it in a locker or on a storage rack at home. The zipper pulls are large and easy to find and they and the bottom are made of tan leather.

Once you unzip it and open it up, there is a large, lined pocket to keep a tablet or other electronic device. It opens wide for deep storage of books and there are also two small pockets on the inside to hold plenty of other items. I am quite impressed with the high quality and design of this bookbag. It far exceeded my expectations and is perfect for back to school! I am so glad I was chosen to receive this as a sample, in exchange for my honest, unbiased opinion and feedback. I definitely recommend this backpack and I wish I had one like this when I was in school.

product_title: Wrangler Men's Long Sleeve Plaid Fleece Shirt
review_body:
Update 12/2016: My husband loves this shirt so much we bought the blue version too - it seems a smidge smaller than the red version but still fits great. He wears this as a sweatshirt/light jacket year round. It has been thru the wash countless times now & still looks great. I bought a couple more for Christmas gifts. These are wonderful!

Original Review:
This is a very good fleece shirt; not too heavy, not too lightweight. It's not the high quality "Polartec" fleece - it's the usual inexpensive fleece that is sold everywhere these days. 100% polyester so very easy to care for. Just throw in the wash & hang dry. If you want to fluff it up, let it go in the dryer for 10 minutes & then hang dry. It's warm & cuddly & has classic style.

The cut is loose, plenty of room for a t-shirt underneath - at least on my slim husband. He is 6 feet tall & has long arms/long torso; the sleeves are plenty long. The buttons seem to be sewn on well & there is polyester fabric backing on the buttonhole placket, pocket placket, cuffs, collar & around the neckline. There is no back yolk; has a straight back. Perfect shirt for cool weather weekends.

review_headline: Knocked My Socks Off So Cute!
review_body:
I received Buttons and Pleats Sheep as a sample to review.

These are so cute, I couldn't resist putting them on right away. I found them to be very soft and the cotton nicely combed, reminding me of cashmere and cotton blends. These are not thick boot socks, they are a lighter weight that are more in form to wear with clogs, loafers or athletics without stretching your shoes out. I found that they fit my son, a Youth Size 3, and me, a Women's 10, equally well. I did not experience any tightness around the toe area and nothing snagged on the skin or nails, as some socks can do. They were stretchy but didn't have the lycra look or feel and stayed up without being constricting. Interestingly, they stayed up both on my son and on me, even with my sprained ankle swelling. I think they should fit well for just about any size foot and/or leg.

With machine washing and drying, these have been easy to care for and hard not to love. They definitely feel good and look adorable.

product_title: LUOUSE Classy Vintage Audrey Hepburn Style 1950's Rockabilly Swing Evening Dress
review_headline: Awesome! Get one in every color!
review_body:
I didn't go into this purchase with high expectations, so for me to say that this dress far exceeded my expectations isn't necessarily saying much. With that in mind, I am perfectly aware that I'm a bigger girl (dress size 20) and was terrified of looking like a beached whale wearing polka dots.

This dress fits like a dream, is decent fabric (not the super best quality ever but also not as thin and "awful" as I've seen reviews for) and is comfortable enough to wear for an entire day at work or a full evening out. I immediately ordered the same dress in black and another by the same company in a different style. All of them are in the regular rotation of my wardrobe now, and I feel pretty in them.

Points to be aware of: My copious cleavage was handled just fine in the dress. If you're a big girl with a smaller chest, this might not be the style for you - check out the buttoned ones with smaller dots, because this dress would likely gap uncomfortably.

The stretch fabric in the back is lovely, but I had to adjust it from time to time when moving a lot.

With a shrug, this dress is perfect for office work and then you can remove the shrug and go to a dinner party! It's awesome! Perfect for pinup styles.

All in all, I'd say grab this dress - at this price, the quality can't be beat!

product_title: Motherhood Bump In The Night(tm) Relaxed Fit Nursing Nightgown
review_headline: Love it for the coverage and softness
review_body:
I love this nightgown. I ordered the navy blue with cream lace. It is very soft and has great coverage. I looked for a more modest nursing nightgown for a long time, because I am having a C-section and I wanted to make sure to have one I'm comfortable in with my friends and family around helping. So many of them were really short or see through...this has excellent bra area coverage with very thick lining like a padded bra. The lace part does not touch the skin at all so it's still soft even under the lace.

Things to consider:
I tried on the Large (my usual top size) at the store, and it was too small. I ordered the XL here from Amazon and it fits, but because it has good bra support the area where the lace is I feel is a tad tight even though it has a lot of give. I guess when you want good coverage you have to have it a little more snug. It isn't anywhere close to where my incision will be, so for me this is fine. If I were you I'd consider ordering a size up from what you usually wear.

When this nightgown arrived it had an awful smell, like a very strong sizing smell, it wasn't just my pregnancy nose, my husband noticed it, too. I washed it three times and dried it with Febreze, so now now it smells great, but when I took it out of the box I was surprised. Just know it will wash out, and once it's gone this is a great nightgown.

product_title: Women's Elastic Waist White Outline Active Lounge Shorts
review_body:
These shorts are cute and VERY comfortable for wearing around the house, but I probably will never wear them in public. I'm 5'3", ~110lbs, and I have a pretty big butt for someone my size. Unfortunately, these shorts do NOT cover all of it! Despite the fact that I ordered a size up on recommendation of other reviewers and got a S instead of XS, I can still feel a real breeze on my cheeks even when I have the waistband pulled just below the top of my hip bones. And forget pulling them closer to my natural waist, they cover even less.

To make matters worse, I got the yellow pair they are fairly see through! I imagine most of the lighter colors will be, also. You'll have to wear nude undies under these or everyone will see that cute polka-dotted butt. Seriously. Black underwear is the worst idea.

So if you're looking for something to lounge around the house in, these are fantastic. If you're looking to be in public with them and your butt isn't very there, you might get away with the darker colors. But if your butt is fairly prominent and you need them for outdoor activities, skip these altogether.

I took off one star for the fact that they are definitely not 100% opaque, and 1 star because despite the fact that they're fairly tall, most of the length is in the stomach area and not the leg area (which makes for less than describable booty coverage).

product_title: Winkine Vintage Women PU Backpack - Fashion College School - Travel Bag Handbag (Small)
review_headline: If you are looking for smaller backpack, this is the one you may want to check it out.
review_body:
I have multiple backpacks, some I still own and some I gave it away as a gift to families.

When first opened the package, I saw this backpack was bit smaller than typical backpacks that I owned. The size of the backpack is approx. 11x14. It’s also made in P.U leather. It’s very soft, but I am not sure how durable it would be for rough handling. Because of the size and its materials, I think this would be a good backpack for someone who doesn’t have to carry a lots of items like heavy books and gym shoes, etc. It would be good for light items.

It looks pretty. It’s PU leather, but not shiny, so it resembled real leather at first look. It comes with duster for the bag.

I checked straps and it has extra fabric (not sure of material – similar to mesh nylon type fabric) backing to reinforce durability. The stitching throughout the bag is securely stitched and evenly spaced. So workmanship is excellent.

The color is black, so it can be used by anyone, not limited to age or gender specific.

It has small zippered compartment and buckled compartment (it snaps on/off easily) for small items. Inside of main storage area also has pockets and zippered compartment as well, so that it can be used for lose items.

This backpack was sent to me at free of charge for a review. Overall, it is good backpack that looks good. I like the act that it's smaller than typical backpack, but it has multiple compartments for organizing items for easy access. I personally preferred buckles used in this backpack to be silver/chrome color, rather than brass (it's on the bag right now), but brass buckled/accessories doesn't look bad on black backpack.

review_headline: Well made breathable garment that helps hold in belly bulge; minimizes a beer belly
review_body:
Free product provided for evaluation and review.
We received size XXL in the color white.

The XXL fit my son, who often wears a size XL with a bit of room to spare in the belly area. This garment is more for men with a more noticeable bulge or beer belly, than for a fairly fit man with just a few extra pounds to lose.

He loved the way it was made in the back, and said that he found the back very comfortable. It is a bit supportive and encourages good posture.

The actual belt had many hooks, and he did not like them. He felt the garment was too bulky at the front where the hook and eye closures came together, and felt that velcro at the sides might have been a better choice for men. Because the lines does go up the midriff, it looked funny under a t-shirt. The only shirts that it really seemed to look nice with were button up, dressier shirts. They covered up that center line. I’m taking off a star because the garment does not lay very smooth in the front.

The compression panel is nice and strong, and it does a good job holding in a bulge.
My spouse, who normally wears a Large or Extra Large, has a bigger belly, and it appeared slimming on him especially at the top of his belly.

Overall, it is a well made garment that helps hold in a belly bulge. It encourages good posture and looks good primarily under looser sweaters and button up shirts.

These bras are very pretty, and very comfortable, too. They are black satin, and they have an adjustable hook and eye closure in the back. I don't normally wear underwire bras, but these are very comfortable. There are all black, and they have three different colors of lace trim - blue, teal, and fuchsia. The lace goes along the top edge of the cups, and there is a cute little matching bow in between the cups. I received mine at a discount in exchange for my honest and unbiased review.

I like that the cups are lightly padded, for a little extra protection and comfort, but not so much that they squish up my breasts and make them uncomfortable. I am all about comfort, and I usually only purchase bras that look comfortable. If I was not going to review these, I most likely never would have chosen them, but I am honestly glad I bought them to try! I really like how great they look on me, and how comfortable they are.

The straps are pretty stretchy, and don't dig in to my shoulders, but one thing I don't like about them is that they don't feel like they stretch too much. That is why I gave them four stars instead of five.

review_headline: ... wear a size 9 in flared or boot cut pretty comfortably. Based on the size chart
review_body:
Let me start off by saying that I usually wear a size 9 in flared or boot cut pretty comfortably. Based on the size chart, I determined that a size 11 would be the best fit for me since these are skinny jeans. I am so glad I went that route. Since different brands all fit differently it's usually really hard to determine what size is going to fit you properly when ordering online. This size chart is right on.

The jeans themselves are a nice material with a little bit of stretch to them. The wait goes to about the middle of my belly button and has three buttons to fasten them.

I'm 5' 3" and the pant legs were slightly long for me, but since I usually wear boots with skinnies, that's not a problem for me. They can be rolled up a little if I decide to wear heels or flats. the material moves well and isn't stiff. They fit really nice. I'm not entirely sure I have the right body for gray (or light) colored jeans. I usually purchase dark denim so this was my first time trying out a lighter color. Overall, I love the fit and feel of these jeans. Highly recommend this brand!

product_title: Dickies Boys' Short Sleeve Performance Polo
review_body:
"Wow! " I couldn't help exclaiming when I saw my middle grandson prance out in his new navy blue polo. I suspect part of the surprise was that navy blue is so seldom used for children -- and I don't know why. After all, it's a practical color for an active child, and it's a knock-out color for John's glossy black hair and dark eyes (thank you, daughter-in-law!!).

This is a BEAUTIFUL shirt!! And I'm not exaggerating.

At first, John was a little resistant to the fabric's texture since he has primarily worn the typical cotton/polyester jersey pullovers all children grow up in. A couple of washings have softened it somewhat, however. And speaking of washing, there was no discernible shrinkage or fading, so he should get many more months of wear. product_title: SHINES™ Men's USB Heated Half & Full Finger Winter Warm Hand Gloves
review_headline: Nice, but not large enough for a man's hand.
review_body:
I don't usually buy items that have no reviews whatsoever to go on; however, I took a chance over the winter and bought these because my fingers would get ice cold while I was using my laptop.

I have to say that they do work. They are basically just a pair of fingerless mittens (with the flap to cover up your fingertips) with a heated pad inside. The pad wraps around your wrist and palm and resembles a tiny heated blanket. It is fastened in place with velcro and can be removed.

My only two complaints are that these are supposed to be for men, but I don't see how that could be. I have small hands, and these are slightly tight around my fingers. Not unpleasantly tight, but snug. I can't imagine that a man's hands would be comfortable in these. Also, the thumb is not removable. I know most fingerless gloves don't have flip off thumbs, but I found a pair once that did and I loved them.

At any rate, I am going to order another pair because I think I can retrofit the heating pad into a pair of winter socks for use on my boyfriend's snowmobile. Heated boots and socks for the snowmobile are very expensive. The removable pad in these things could be used for a variety of things and you would still have an attractive pair of gloves left over. Just don't buy them if you have large hands. They would probably cut off the circulation to your fingers.

Free sample sent for evaluation and review.

I got size XL.
It measures- 30 inches at the waist, unstretched; and 42\\" fully stretched to the max
36\\" at the hips, unstretched; and 48\\" fully stretched to the max
The waistband is nice- it's 3\\" so it will stay up well, and it accentuates the waist.
The total length on the skirt is 24\\"

It's a very nice garment that can easily go from professional to sexy depending on what it is worn with. It is a basic wardrobe piece that will really stretch a wardrobe. I love it.

product_title: Pack of 4,HOEREV Men's Bamboo Fiber Briefs Underwear
review_headline: A little bit smaller than I expected, but very soft and comfortable
review_body:
I just got them, so this review is based on my impressions on my first try on for only a few minutes (instructions say that this is NEW and should be washed before wearing. I understand that Bamboo gets even softer the more you wash it...and that's why I wanted to try Bamboo underwear.

I ordered the XXL size (largest size available) and I am on the larger end of the XXL size range. They seem a bit small,but they stretch to fit snugly without being too tight or constricting...more of a gentile hug ...I just hope they don't shrink very much since I'm sure I won't shrink...LOL..
The the leg length in the photo makes them appear to be more of a short Boxer Brief, but they are definitely a Brief. The only other issue is the lack of a front fly opening? I have never encountered any men's brief/underwear without a front fly opening and simply assumed that these briefs would have a front fly opening? I will see how well I adapt to this missing element.

The good points are that these briefs are very light weight (I ordered them for traveling light) and appear as though I could wash them and they should easily dry over-night. The bamboo material is incredibly soft, smooth and comfortable to wear. I hope that means they won't create friction or cause any irritation or discomfort on long airplane trips.

As soon as I wash them and wear them for a day, I will post an update.

UPDATE: I washed them last night (cold water wash, tumble dry with air only - no heat) and tried on a pair this morning....It appears that they may have shrunk a bit, which I was hoping would not happen since they seemed a bit small to begin with. I wore them for about 3-4 hours and had to take them off. They were not necessarily uncomfortable, but they did tend to ride up, I am accustomed to wearing Boxer/Briefs so I do not like boxers that ride up and become briefs. I think these would be great for someone who is used to briefs and can purchase one size larger.

So my final verdict is that they are super soft but a bit undersized, and the short leg length did not fit my body-type. I will try some other brands with longer leg lengths (true Boxer Briefs) and perhaps in a larger size

product_title: Camellias Double Steel Boned Long Line Edwardian Underbust Waist Training Corset
review_body:
This is the second corset I've ordered from this seller, and I'm extremely impressed. The first one I bought was the "Camellias Black Brocade Waist Training Corset with 16pc High Density Steel Bones", in a size 36" and I loved it so much I decided to go with this one.

I ordered this in a size 34" (since my waist shrunk from 40" to 36", thanks to the previous corset). I wanted it because it was long, and I needed it to cover my tummy and not just squish it out on the bottom. For me, the length is perfect. I'm 5'4" and roughly 195 lbs, but I have a long torso.

Getting it on was a little tricky, but pretty painless. The material is sturdy and all of the boning is steel (magnet tested). The lace is made of strong shoe string type, although I prefer the lace that came on my previous corset (a wider, flatter shoe string type) because it was easier to tighten. I noticed that not matter how hard I tried, I couldn't get the top part of the corset (under the bust and around the ribs) to tighten enough. There was basically a gap between my skin and the corset for about the top 2" . Still, it held the rest of me together, including my tummy, and gave me a really nice shape.

I wore it to work the first day I got it for about 10 hours. I don't recommend doing it for that long, especially if you're just starting out. It's not very safe, from what I hear, to wear it for more than 6-8 hours. Anyway, I received tons of compliments and people asking me how I've been losing so much weight. It really boosts your confidence!

All in all I'd say this is a great buy. The only thing I'd change is the type of lacing that is used. The length didn't bother me (I actually really love it) but it may seem too long to people who aren't used to wearing corsets. I'm very satisfied and will continue to buy from this seller in the future.

product_title: Blush Women's Victory Longline Padded Balcoinette Bra
review_body:
In every way! This long line bra by Blush was well worth the time it took to seek it out on the website. The bra states that it is 'padded' but it's rather just a nice lining, not 'padding' as one would expect. I am very impressed with the construction and design-if you wear your bras as they are meant to fit, you will appreciate this. The sizing is not forgiving; if you are a 36D, do not order a 34D and expect it to fit. If you are on the fence, size up. Expect this bra to last-satin double-rolled straps (notice flesh-colored, not black straps) sewn well into lining. No plastic gizmos fitted into thin strap that will wear out long before the bra does! Excellent support and shaping-three part cup with balconnette style gives an excellent lift and fullness; if your shape is not perfect it will be after donning this piece! Flesh colored lining with beautifully applied black lace adorns the cups. If you are into long-line bras like I am you will love this bra! I would have loved another but the price had doubled by the time the bra was delivered to me (two days Prime)...perhaps, like me-others discovered this diamond in the rough and demand outpaced supply???
Beautifully designed, well-made and fitted bra...

product_title: Landing Leathers Navy Men's G-1 Distressed Leather Flight Bomber Jacket (Regular & Tall)
review_body:
This is a great jacket. It is a very nice quality leather with straight, tight, even stitching. It is an accurate, generous fit. My son is tall and slim (6’2”) with broad shoulders and long arms. He sometimes has trouble with sleeve length, but this jacket fits well. It has a generous cut around the shoulders, long enough sleeves, and a slim fit through the waist. It is made of a lighter weight leather (almost suede weight) so it is very soft and flexible, but it has a warm lining. This makes the coat warm enough for cool weather without being too bulky. The collar detaches if you don’t like that fur collar look. The jacket looks even better in real life than in the photos. The only (slight) negative is that the pockets are on the small side. It’s not really a big deal in an otherwise perfect jacket, but I wanted to mention it.

Edit: I bought this jacket in December 2014 as a Christmas gift for my tall, thin son. He has worn it for two winters now and it is still in fabulous condition. Because it was made from a ‘distressed’ leather, it shows little to no sign of wear and tear. The stitching is still intact, the waistband is still stretchy, and there are no problems whatsoever with the zipper. This was great purchase and a well loved gift. This is still my son’s go to coat for most of the cooler weather months. I was obviously very happy with this coat when I bought it 18 months ago and this purchase has stood the test of time. A+

review_headline: Nice Card holder, not a full wallet replacement. Small but huge problem for me
review_body:
When I received this wallet, i was both impressed and a little confused.

I was really impressed with the build quality. The hinges and latch, while plastic, feels very sturdy, and i do not their longevity. Obviously sharkk is also confident in them as well, given the lifetime warranty.

The confusion, came in when i started trying to load this up with the things from my wallet.
Now perhaps i have more in my wallet than most between 4 credit cards, 2 club cards, license, address update, a gift card or 2, 2 insurance cards, and a store card or 2, And every once in a great while, a couple of bills of cash.
I had never really thought much of my wallet being too full, until trying to make this all fit.

Looking closer at the description i see it says 7 slots and seems to hint more as a credit card holder with the rf shield. I found that 1 card per slot not a problem, problem is even without cash, i have about the equivalent of 13 (store cards are the keychain type)
PLUS cash. I can actually fit most of the cards in there, roughly 10, and while it is a little harder to close it does close and latch flat and securely.

My big complaint is the cash issue. Just because of size, You have to fold the bills in quarters (in half and half again) to make it fit. While they will then fit. Just testing the 3 bills i currently have in my wallet, adds A whole lot of thickness. leaving a lot less forgiveness for extra cards.

My current wallet is on its way out and i had been considering one of these for awhile and i had been really considering one like this for a while. I'm not sure if this is an issue with all makes of this type of wallet, or just this specific sharkk wallet.
But this is not going to work for me. I will certainly not carry 2 wallets, just to protect a couple of credit cards.

In conclusion, I knock this only one star. Looking at the description it doesn't really claim to be a whole wallet replacement, more of a rf shield for your credit cards to protect them from being scanned. Kinda like a tin foil hat to protect your head from mind reading aliens, governments and such. The loss of a star comes in with the word wallet in the description. I was expecting to be able to fully replace my failing veteran wallet. Not the case.

Would like to see a little thicker, and maybe a clip or at least space in the end to hold some cash and such.

product_title: Jessie G. Women's "Nicole" Faux Leather Trimmed Puffer Down Coat - S
review_headline: Relatively flattering for a down coat
review_body: I hunted for down coats on Amazon for longer than I'd like to admit. I found this and risked it even though there weren't many reviews. I felt compelled to write one for future viewers.    I was shopping for a coat that wasn't a total marshmallow on my body and looked relatively chic. This coat seems to fit the bill. It's certainly not form-fitting, but on the same token it does allow some room to layer. I couldn't figure out sizing based on reviews from other Jessie G. coats, so I just followed the sizing chart.    Fit:  I purchased a Small. For reference, I am 5'5\\", 128 lbs, 34D (27\\" waist 35\\" hip). The coat is extremely roomy in the hip area but still looks okay. The waist area is also a bit roomy but there is an elastic cinch on the inside of the coat, which helps to give the coat more shape. The chest area is just right- any well-endowed ladies might want a size up. As for the shoulder fit, it feels similar to any peacoat or suit jacket- it will have movement restrictions with arms going above your shoulders, but comfortable otherwise. The arm length is perfect, even a tad long which I really like. The length of the coat is basically as pictured, covering most of your thighs. My only complaint with the fit is the hood. It is very large and does not stay on in even the slightest breeze.    Quality:  As far as I can tell in the first week I've worn it, the coat is made pretty well. I can't speak to the water resistance but I don't plan on wearing it in wet conditions. It blocks the wind but not as well as a ski shell. Not a feather to be seen so far, even at the seams. The pockets are well enforced and roomy enough for our big smartphones. I've had zero problems with zippers and buttons so far. The hood has a zipper to remove it but I leave it on because I don't like half of a zipper showing.    Warmth:  I live near the Canadian-US border so I've tested some pretty cold temps. I'd say this coat would be warm enough with a shirt and sweater down to 0°F for 30 mins outdoors. I haven't gotten cold yet but the down is not very thick, so I wouldn't get it if you're taking long walks in windy cold temps. The pockets are lined with a flannel-like material so my hands are always toasty. I chose the length of this coat because it keeps my hip area warm too.    Overall I do like this coat even though it could be a little more flattering. The styling is nice and it is keeping me warm. I wish the hood and hip area were smaller. I don't think I'll find something much better. Luxury Lane, the seller, had hassle-free returns for a BGSD coat that was too large (it was like wearing a sleeping bag!).

review_body:
I bought this corset direct from the Corset Story site, not off Amazon, but it's awesome. I got it in the sale section, so sizes were limited, and I ordered a size 6 (small). I *probably* could have gone up a size and been fine as well, but this works--although it doesn't lace up the back as shown. Corsets are not meant to close entirely, and mine has about 4 inches of open back. I didn't use the ribbon that ships with the product, because I prefer stronger cord for corsets. So, I went out and bought two 72" boot laces and did a double cord corset tie in back so it will be more secure than a ribbon. I am 5'4" and about 125-130 lbs. I'm 130 in the following photos, and have a D-cup bra size. Normally I fall between small and medium. The material is heavy and seems durable--I told a friend I feel like I'm wearing a tapestry (which is good). The boning is acrylic rather than steel, so it's a fashion piece more than a waist training item, but makes it easier to hand wash if you need to. I bought it for sexy time with my partner, so didn't really need the full steel boning. Wearing it for looks, not practical use.

product_title: Women's 3 Pack Fleece Lined Leggings
review_headline: Great fit and colors, but unfortunately, a malodorous product
review_body:
I purchased these to wear under my jeans during our trip to the Sequoias during the winter for extra warmth, and they fit the bill. They're more comfortable and far warmer than the traditional waffle-weave long underwear available at most stores. They weren't tight around the waist, and the length was generous instead of being too short. The colors are gorgeous, the price is great, and overall, they did what they were supposed to do.

However, I'd also love to wear these with tunics, long sweaters, and boots during the cooler months to work, but haven't been able to due to an issue with the odor they give off. They do smell odd, like some sort of petroleum-based product (e.g., a gasoline-type chemical odor). I did wash them, which lessened the odor, however, that is definitely an issue for me.

Clothing should not give off any kind of odor at all. It scares me that something that smells that strong could potentially hurt me, not to mention, reek while being worn and become irritating to myself and others. (I mean, why should something smell like that?!)

While I was able to wear them during my trip without any issues, I'm hoping that this odor goes away completely the more I wash them because I'd love to wear them more often. The colors and fit are great!

I'm going to try line-drying them in the sun in hopes of removing that odor altogether. It's really disappointing to receive something that's great in every aspect, but to have to put them aside due to the way they smell!

All I can say right now is that they served their initial purpose, and that's all.

I was hesitant to buy these, because generally you get what you pay for, and they're so cheap. But...These are now my go-to tights! They're great for layering under my nylon pants to keep warm. I also use them alone as workout tights. They wick sweat, they look great. They are opaque- no visible panty problem. I love the high waist, to keep my low back warm, but they fold down very well if you want them lower.

They say"hand wash-cold" but...I've washed them twice in the machine (inside-out, gentle cycle) and it worked great. The color did not run, they didn't snag or stretch. Can't say how long they'll last, but I can say that so far, they are as sturdy and attractive as tights costing much more.

LOVE these! I am ordering them in several more colors.

To the other reviewers who do not like the unhemmed thing- it SAYS unhemmed. There's just not supposed to BE a hem, but it should not be a surprise. If you don't like something you ordered, you can return it easily in the same packing it came in.
Anyway, nope, it isn't hemmed. However, even if it ravels at the edge over time, and I'm not sure it ever will, it is such a comfy flattering drape-y fit, that the lack of hem makes no difference to me at all. I wish for more colors! I have a red and a blue one so far.
I ordered mine about 2 sizes larger than I usually do, and I am glad I did because no matter how big it is, it still fits nicely. The sleeves are long on me. I am only 5' tall and not an ape. But the sleeves can be rolled up, like everything else I wear.
A simple design that can be dressed up with accessories or go over jeans and leggings. I have a perfect black scarf-front blazer that feels like the same fabric, and it looks so so fantastic over these.
Anybody who likes dressing exotically needs this!

review_headline: Go for it, but do follow size chart!
review_body: I was hesitant to buy this for a long time and I finally bit the bullet and did it. I'm a size 18-20 pant, 2-3x top, I was going to order the 6x but read another review of a gal, also size 20 who went with the 5x. So I got the 5x. The shipping was EXTREMELY fast and packaging is good as well. So, as for the fit - for me I had to loosen the strings to the max, so completely open in the back (gap), in order for this to fit me...and I still had to struggle (and I do mean struggle) to get the latches together, but eventually I did. You can see in the pic the latches are hanging on for dear life, so if you are on the fuller side of 3x, size 20, do go with the 6x. I think the 6x would have gone on much easier and had a smaller gap in the back, but I'm trying to lose weight so I think eventually this one will have a smaller gap and I can still tighten as I lose. The strings feel kind of flimsy, but the material feels nice, soft. Then there's the thong...and it's kind of just...there, doubt I'll wear it. Overall for the price I think it is a good buy, and I would recommend and buy again.

product_title: Paramour by Felina Women's Plus-Size Captivate Bra
review_headline: scratchy, but otherwise just about perfect!
review_body:
Started pregnancy as a 36D, at about 26 weeks I was overflowing the cups of my favorite bras in a 38DD, which is about the largest size-38 I can easily find locally. Ordered this and one other bra here in the 38DDD size, and this one fit exactly perfect! Unlike other reviews, I have found the support to be quite good, although as the 'girls' growth is quite recent I don't have a lot of sag to deal with either!

I've been wearing a BellyBra overtop of my regular bra, and the first time I wore that combination with this bra, it really caused the ends of the wires to dig in under my arms. That has resolved with a couple more wearings and a washing, so I think it was just a new-bra problem rather than a fit or construction issue.

The only thing that continues to bother me slightly, is the mesh lining fabric (the hot-pink layer) is a bit scratchy, and gets a bit old by the end of an 8-hour workday. I continue to wear it about every other day, however, as it fits much better than the other I ordered - besides the fact that hubby loves how it looks on me!

review_headline: Please don't buy fur items from China!
review_body: If it fur (or even faux/fake fur) & is made in China, it is almost certain that the fur is from a Raccoon Dog, a small animal native to Asia. They are not killed humanely. They are SKINNED ALIVE, and usually after being beaten, solely for the purpose of putting real animal fur on cheaply made clothing. If you think I'm making this up or spewing undocumented propaganda, just Google 'Raccoon Dog' like I did. The cruelty bestowed upon those poor animals is nothing short of barbaric. There aren't just pictures to go with articles, there's at least one video out there too...and you can't Photoshop a video. Please do not give the Chinese fur farmers any reason to continue this horrific practice of skinning these animals alive - don't buy anything with fur on it from China...even if it's listed as "faux fur", because most likely, it isn't faux at all. No demand, no supply. Simple. If you really want/need fur, buy something made in the USA or Canada where laws regulate the humane treatment of animals.

product_title: 32Degrees Weatherproof Men's Packable Down Puffer Jacket
review_headline: Warm enough for Chicago in February
review_body:
I'll start off by countering some of what I've been reading: as far as my jacket goes, the stitching seems to be just fine. I don't know if it will hold off in the long run, but I already used the jacket a few times and it's in perfect shape. If anything, the stitching was a little shoddy on the pouch that comes with the jacket, but nothing worth complaining about. Maybe other buyers got bad eggs, or maybe the brand ramped up its quality control. Either way, my jacket looks fine to me.

As for actual use: I bought this jacket because I had to go on a three-day trip to Chicago, from Georgia, in February. Obviously it's a bit chilly in Georgia at that time of year, but it is absolutely freezing in Chicago. I didn't want to carry my usual winter coat because it's an unruly gigantic parka, so the packable aspect was very appealing to me.

I took a very thick sweater, this jacket, and a peacoat to wear over the jacket. In Georgia, I was wearing just the peacoat, and when I landed, I added the extra layers.

I was exaggerating when it came to these layers. I could have gotten away with a lighter sweater, and maybe even without the peacoat (though I think it probably helped me against the wind). This jacket was way warmer than I expected it to be, and the price didn't break the bank either.

The only thing I noticed in another review that I agree with is regarding the sleeves. I do wish they were a little slimmer, both for matters of style as well as comfort, but that's far from being a deal-breaker, especially considering how warm this jacket is.

product_title: SkylineWears Men's Fashion Onesie Jumpsuit one Piece non Footed Pajamas
review_body:
It's nice and warm, but it's fleece, so it's often TOO warm. If I'm just sitting at my desk or laying on the couch not generating too much heat, it's fine, but the material isn't very breathable, so I tend to start getting sweaty in it if I do much work around the apartment or any sustained physical activity. This is more a problem of these synthetic fleece blends than the onesie itself.

Still, if I'm being still and lounging, it's nice and warm. I was pleasantly surprised by the fabric quality and build quality for the price. The hood is nice, the elastic and the cuffs are nice, the pockets are solid. It remains to be seen how well it holds up to repeated washings, but my first impressions are very good for what I paid.

I also own a flannel footed onesie. The flannel is a more comfortable material, but not as warm, so I wanted a second onesie for those really cold days when flannel doesn't cut it. The footies have neither pockets nor a hood, both of which are great additions to a onesie. The pockets especially, otherwise where will you put your phone? I'd also recommend non-feeted pajamas like these over ones with footies. It's a great novelty, but the reality is, as soon as you go to the bathroom or kitchen and there's a puddle on the floor and you step in it, you have to deal with the dampness or take off the whole onesie. Plus the feet get dirty faster than the rest of the PJs, and wear out faster too. You're better off with non-footed and wool socks.

The zipper is also a drawback. It's cold when you put it on, and you have to unzip it all the way to use the bathroom (as a guy). I also expect that if the material shrinks unevenly when washed, it will cause problems around the zipper. By contrast, the buttons on my other PJs are a much better solution, and suffer none of those issues.

I'm 6'1, 150lbs- a tall, skinny guy with sorta broader shoulders. The large fit me just fine. It looks good, it feels good, overall I'm happy with the purchase.od, overall I'm happy with the purchase.

product_title: HB Men's Bikers DuPont™ Kevlar® Jeans - Motorcycle Motorbike Jeans
review_headline: which fit me just fine. Here are my measurements
review_body: I'll cut to the chase. I normally wear a 31 x 32 and ordered the 32 x 32, which fit me just fine. Here are my measurements: 5'11", 170 lbs, and slim. These jeans are cut very similar to Levi's 501's, so they have a slim and tapered fit. I would recommend ordering one size larger than you normally wear and you should be close. However, If you normally wear relaxed fit or loose fit jeans then I would not recommend these. The legs run much longer than normal jeans and are closer to 34 inches in length. I don't mind because when I sat on my R6 the pants still covered my boots. Note: Again, these are tapered fit, so if you have larger/taller boots you may not be able to fit the bottom of the jeans over them. In that case, you'd have to tuck them in. The pair I received were much darker than the ones pictured, and the lining for the armor and inside of the pant pockets have black/red checkered material. Once again, the picture is not accurate. Also, the hip armor is different from what is pictured. What are the care instructions? Well, these jeans have no tags for the care instructions and no info showing where they were manufactured. When I did a Google search, there was little to no information on these jeans. When I sat on my bike, the knee pads were up a little too high exposing the bottom of my knees. The knee pockets allow for a little adjustment up/down, but not much. I adjusted the knees pads as far down as possible, but it didn't help much. For the price, these are pretty nice jeans and I was surprised about the quality. Definitely a step up from regular jeans because of the hip/knee armor and kevlar reinforcement. But, maybe I should have put the $69 towards a pair of textile riding pants. These are much nicer than the Bilt or Icon jeans I've tried on, but not as beefy as the Draggin' jeans. I'm a bit concerned with the black/red checkered material throughout these jeans. It seems they ran out of the material that was pictured and decided to use whatever was available at the time. The armor pockets will probably cause perspiration because they are not mesh and will not breathe. Maybe I'm being too picky and expected more, but I for the price I should be satisfied.available at the time. product_title: 2 Pack Active Basic Women's Long Cami w/ Built in Bra Large Red, H Pink
review_headline: Affordable & Comfortable (see 2nd-3rd purchase experience for update)
review_body: Soft, well fitting & comfortable. Lightweight for summer to wear alone or under a tee-shirt. Spaghetti straps are thin & will roll but not as bad as the Zenana brand that I tried before & they stay put pretty well in comparison. As stated in original ad they are long so you can layer them easily for a bit of color peeking out at the waist. Price very affordable & I would buy again.  Update: October 2015- 3rd purchase (2nd with seller Lucky21.) This is the third time I’ve bought the Active Basic Cami’s w/Built-in Shelf Bra through Amazon. The first time was a 2-pak through the seller Lucky 21. They were perfect so I ordered a 4-pak but the 4-pak was only available through one seller DiamondKit-I figured it would be a consistent match as they were titled the same Active Basic Long Cami’s in Large w/ Built-in Shelf Bra. Boy, was that a wrong assumption. They weren’t even Active Basic brand but DiamondKit’s own & they didn’t have a shelf bra but two foam pads sewn in a sling that after one washing was a wadded up mess. So being a PollyAnna trooper I tried again this time I made sure it was through Lucky 21 & I got a 2-pak exactly the same size & listing as the first time I bought them. They fit great & all was well until my back began to hurt from a scratching chaff. Turns out on comparing these to the first ones I bought, these have the elastic straps sewn in backwards so the scratchy heavy duty thread that binds the straps to the halter in back along with the tacked down material rubs against the shoulder blades. The first ones  bought have the straps tacked down facing the halter away from the skin. I don’t know why consistency is a problem but I can’t seem to get proper Active Basic Cami’s. I’m going to shop around for another brand & hope for a better product.

product_title: DJT Womens Soft Elastic Waistband Fitness Yoga Herem Cropped Pants S-XL Dark Grey
review_headline: Good Deal!  Cute/soft/comfy and tush flattering!!
review_body:
Shipping took a while, but, hey, it is Prime eligible and therefore free, so I was OK with that. The seller includes little cards that detail the return procedures and 30 day product satisfaction policy. (nice touch, DJT!) If you look at the picture, the waist band/yoke looks like it is elastic material but it is the same soft/flowy fabric as the rest of the garment. There is a 1" no roll elastic band and it is sewn into the side seam. I also have an ankle length pair in black. I have washed them twice-warm wash, I think...with the rest of my workout stuff. So far, the black pair does not show signs of shrinking, misshaping, or pilling, and the waist band is not all screwed up. The black pair is a size medium, these gray ones are a large. Between the two, not a huge difference in size, but I am liking the L. I wear them about 2' below my belly button and the black pair is just a little snug giving a slight mini muffin top effect....but that is not the garments fault...know what I am saying??
These cute pants are very soft, comfy and very flattering for your tush! Wear them before, during or after yoga, for lounging or sleeping. Who knows, maybe with some cute shoes and little top, you can rock them anytime. I think you should order them too!!

product_title: London Fog Women's Chevron Packable Down Jacket
review_body:
I almost didn't buy this jacket because there are so few details online and there were no reviews when I placed my order. First let me say that I am 5'4" and weigh around 125 lbs. and bought the size medium. That works well as I can wear a heavy sweater underneath. Sleeve length was perfect.

The jacket shell and lining are 100% nylon and it is machine washable and then tumble dry. I have not washed it yet but those are the instructions. The jacket is made in China.

The filling says it is 90% down and 10% water fowl feathers. The hood is 100% polyester filling.

We just returned from an area where it was in the 40s and 50s in the mornings and at night. The jacket was perfect. I'm not sure how comfortable it would keep you if the weather was colder but I'm not used to cold weather and it worked for me to be out walking in temps that low.

The word packable is a perfect description of this item. It comes in a little bag and takes up hardly any more room than your underwear does in a suitcase. No wrinkles at all when it comes out of the bag and there is hardly any weight to it.

The rock grey color works well with black, brown, blue, grey, etc. You can't go wrong with the color.

review_headline: Ridiculous. Not length that was noted. 85", not 104"
review_body:
I am always looking for interesting layers, and saw this in several different colors by different vendors. I compared the lengths and this one was noted to be the longest of all the choices. Since it was the longest and a neutral color, I chose this one. I realize that the model is probably the size of a 10-year old, but was expecting to at least be able to get a good cowl effect out of it with full comfortable coverage on upper back and shoulders.

It is SIGNIFICANTLY shorter than it states, (by 19") which limits its wrapability - it just doesn't really sit correctly. I'd be pulling at it and adjusting it all day. I also would have preferred one of the other colors, but chose this for its supposed added length. I should also note that I am a size 16, to give you a reference (I wish more reviewers would state their size!). That additional 19" would have made this a very versatile and interesting layering piece, and the fact that it could be worn with a sleeveless top really appealed to me for stylish layering and quick "hot flash" removal. ;)

It is well-made, I will give it that. Just a slight bit itchy. I am considering handing it over to a friend who knits and hiring her to re-make me one at the correct length.

product_title: Basico 12-pair Nylon/spandex Girdle Brief panties w/ Large Hidden Pocket
review_headline: Not sexy, but gets the job done
review_body:
I bought these with the intention of using the pocket to hold my insulin pump. For this purpose, this underwear works pretty well.

They're very sturdy and well-made. Definitely not sexy, but as other reviewers have said, more like a full-coverage girdle. Based on other reviews, I ordered a size up, but would order my true size next time as the style is pretty big already and ordering a larger size just meant they go way up over my bellybutton. They're very comfortable to wear, with no riding up or pulling.

As for the pocket, my insulin pump fits in it, but it would fit better if the pocket were a bit lower. If you have a belly, the pump kind of sticks out and can be seen if wearing leggings or a dress that is flat across the stomach. A loose dress fits perfectly without showing anything, so I'm really happy about that.

As the majority of customers will likely be using this underwear to hold money, passport, ID, etc, these work great. Anything flat fits in the pocket and can't be seen. The zipper is also flat, so there's no issue with it snagging clothes. And the colors are bright and fun. You can't go wrong with 12 pairs.

review_headline: Sizing is spot on but cups too big for smaller chests.
review_body: I am 5'2" 120lb and normally wear a sz4 on bottom, sz2 on top. I ordered the Medium because there wasn't a Small available. However, a Small would have been perfect. I ordered Small in another print and it fit much better on bottom and top. There is a stitch ripping sound when trying to get over the hips but no damage. Bottoms were too baggy in front on Medium but in Small no issues. As others have stated the top is spread in front. If the cups were sewn together then it would be a much better fit. However, if you are small chested like I am (34A), then the cups are pretty big. It takes a lot of tightening with the straps and I will need to sew the cups together to keep my girls from falling out. The cups on the Medium and Small really were not different. Cups are lined as well as the front of the bottoms. However, the back of the bottoms seemed pretty consistent with other suits I have had. For the price it is a great suit. I wasn't a big fan of the cut on the bottoms but this was my first time trying this style and it accentuates the saddlebags, which have always been a problem for me. Does a great job of hiding flaws on the waist and the top also hides the spill over effect from under the armpits.

review_headline: very soft but not high quality
review_body:
I was looking for a quality loose fit v-neck t-shirt, and I checked reviews elsewhere because it is a pricey t-shirt that has not been on sale. I was glad to find XS and S sizes were not sold out on Amazon like they were elsewhere.

I can agree with everyone who has reviewed the top as a nice weight, semi-sheer, good drape and very soft, however the quality of the material is questionable. product_title: Hanes Men's 3 Pack Ultimate X-Temp Performance Long Leg Boxer Brief
review_headline: I might not perform better but I feel better!
review_body:
I never bought any sort of \\"performance\\" underwear before but then there in the gold box deals was this other brand [[ASIN:B001M0MN16 ExOfficio Men's GiveNGo Boxer Brief]]. After seeing how well they seemed to solve an issue I jumped at the chance to give these a try and I'm glad I did.

Ive never reviewed any sort of underwear before so I'm going to try to be as honest as possible while still trying not to be gross so bear with me.

I do many physical activities at times of the day where a shower right after isnt realistic. I take my dog for runs while I bike at least once a day and workout at any time of the day I have time. Physical activity tends to cause sweat.....down there. It cant be just me? Well these make a noticeable difference in letting that area air out so its isn't as humid. Its solved a problem, I just wish I had them all summer.

They do feel thinner than normal pairs but they don't feel abnormal while wearing. They also fit tighter than the normal. They aren't lycra but the best way I can describe how the fit is lycra. They maintain that fit through the day unlike my normal boxer briefs that start tight yet sort of stretch out during the day.

I know they are performance briefs but I will use them daily because like I said I do some sort of physical activity daily. They aren't too much more than a decent regular style of boxer-brief and compared to many others they are ridiculously cheap. Maybe they don't work as well but Im not buying a $20 pair of underwear unless it has wifi (at least Bluetooth). Even if they don't perform as well as the more expensive I guarantee they wear better than more basic briefs.

The only unknown is longevity and that will only show with time. 4 stars just because they do fit tight,not horribly but if you have larger than average legs like I do they get pretty tight on the thighs. If you've never tried performance briefs before you wont risk a lot trying these out and you might end up a convert like I am!

product_title: Cocoship Hollow Vintage High Waisted Bikini Engraving Swimsuits Swimwear (FBA)
review_body:
After buying Cocoship's Retro High Waisted Bikini (black and white polka dot), I loved it so much I decided to buy another one. This one isn't as flattering on, especially the top. The top fits weird and isn't flattering at all, both loose and tight at the same time. How they managed that is still a mystery to me. The bottoms are super cute, so you could just pair it with a different top. The other bikini that I bought ran large and I had to buy a medium (and it's still a little loose), so I ordered the medium again thinking that it would fit. It does, but it's kind of tight. I'm really at the limit here with this one. How is their sizing so disparate? You'd think that the medium in one model would be similar if not equal to the medium in another model, but I guess that's not the case. I usually wear a dress size 10 and I'm 5'3". I'm not busty, but the top does not fit correctly. So, if you're busty, you should have a back up top.

On the plus side, it's cheap but not too cheaply made and the model and color are very cute. I'm keeping it, but I should have ordered the large.

review_headline: Two diff styles/ rip easy/ uncomfortable/ way over priced for what you're getting as far as quality goes. Do not buy.
review_body:
I ended up getting two diff styles of pants. I ordered 4 pairs of pants total, 2 being size 32, the other 2 were size 34. The size 32 were one style and the 34's were another. As you pick your diff sizes the picture will change. One style was way to tight in the legs and crotch but loose in the waist if you can picture that. Both pairs of these style ripped so fast, Like 1st or second time worn fast. Throwing my leg over my bike ripped the crotch of one pair. They suck and I should have returned them. The other style of pants are really cool, I like them a bunch. The material is really thin and low quality tho. One pair of those has a rip in them already too.

All in all I would stay away from this product. You don't really know what you're getting till you get it. Is it gonna be this style or that one? One style is uncomfortable and will rip easy. The other style's rad as hell, very comfortable but will rip easy. They both are very poor quality and are worth no more than 10-15 dollars at best. 3 out of 4 pairs ripped very early on in their life. I didn't get to wear any of them more than 4-5 times.

product_title: Hawke & Co Men's Packable Down Puffer Jacket II
review_body:
By now, you have already seen that I have given this product 5 stars. This is because it fits well, looks nice, and is extremely functional. Read on. I bought a medium size, and it fits snugly. Almost too snug, but this is a thin coat - so it works. After wearing this everyday for the past week, let me give you some detailed thoughts.

The first day I wore it home from the office. It was in the 50s outside, but raining and a bit windy. The water beaded up and didn't seem to get through the coat on my 5 mins walk outside. I was wearing a thin dress shirt directly underneath the coat. At no point was I cold, nor could I feel the wind cut through its fabric. I pocketed my cold bare hands in the coat to find the inner lining (the lining separating my hand from my shirt) to be impossibly thin and not really for warming. The point here is to have your hands warmed by the heat your body makes ,which is captured by the coat's thinker outside lining.

The next day, I wore a t shirt to the office (relaxed office). The inside gets hot at the office in the winter because the building is old and the heat is pumping! Anyway, on my walk to and fro - I felt much warmer wearing only a t shirt. This leads me to believe that the coat's warming technology works better on the basis of using convectional heating.

The bottom has a nice elastic fit - as well as the end of each sleeve. This keeps all that warmth in like a burrito. The coat also held up against the sharpish claws of my Jack Russel-Beagle mix guy. He is 5 and has energy to spare. I wasn't even thinking about the coat when he greeted me by jumping up and down when I first arrived at home. Good thing the material is well made. Not a scratch. It also folds up into its own pocket for convenient travel. I personally haven't tried this - but I may give it a go just to see it in action.

I've gotten several compliments on the coat. One person thought it was a Patagonia coat, but he is kind of a brand w#0rE. I would purchase another if the coat ever was lost. product_title: Va Bien Strapless Low Back Slimming Bodysuit 1509
review_body:
I purchased this to wear with my wedding gown, which has a very low back. The back on this bra is almost low enough to not show in my gown. The seamstress will still need to cut down the back of this bra, but I don't feel like the 1 1/2 inches that she will end up taking off will impact the support at all.

The cups are a nice shape. The are lined, but not "formed" or padded. When you're buying a 36E, the last thing you need is a bunch of foam padding. I like that the cups are deep enough, without feeling like they are gaping.

The torso on this product seems long to me. I don't think of myself as having a short torso, and I have other bodysuits that don't have this issue (I'm 5'6"). I'm still going to keep the product, but I wish it wasn't quite so long. Also, if you're using this as a "slimmer" you might be disappointed. The compression on the midsection is pretty light. I'm okay with that, as I was looking for a low back bra versus a slimmer, but it's just something to be aware of.

Something to note: in the product description it states that it comes with two sets of removable straps. When I received mine, there weren't any straps included. I've contacted the seller, so hopefully that will be resolved.

product_title: KRISP Women's Fashion Simple Casual Stretch Polka Dot Summer Dress
review_body:
The fabric isn't the highest quality, but that doesn't detract from the overall look of the dress. My version of the dress didn't have the same problem of the hole in the front as other reviewers mentioned, so that was a relief. One thing I noticed is that the fabric seam of the skirt runs right down the center of the front, so you'll see polka dots being cut off right in the middle of the dress. It's not that noticeable since the natural folds of the skirt hide it somewhat, but if you're someone who pays close attention to that sort of thing...

I'm 5'4" and typically wear a size 8 dress (US size) when I want something to be tight/fitted and a 10 when I want it to be on the loose/blouse-y side. For this dress, I ordered a size 12 after reading some of the reviews. The dress definitely fits the way an 8 US would fit on me but is stretchy enough to not give that "overstuffed sausage" look. Not sure what it will be like after putting it in the dryer...!

The polka dots are screen painted on, hoping they don't fade too quickly.

I suspect these are either irregulars that did not pass quality control or they are fake Lucky Brand.

product_title: Cocomelody Womens Sweetheart Knee Length Ivory Lace Prom Wedding Dress
review_body:
[[VIDEOID:325ed3180d2ecf7a02dd63806cdf2b56]] So, I direct theatre plays, which is why I was excited o review this dress. I went with the sizing for the girl in the play I am currently directing. The waist fits her perfectly, however, the bust is a touch big. It is a simple fix in the theatre to do a small dart on each side. The company that makes these dresses will fit them to your custom sizing, which I recommend if you are purchasing this dress. Going by standard sizes, you would need to use the waist as a priority, which could leave the bust loose. The size chart seems to be out of touch with women's shapes. There is a big gap between the bust and waist sizes.

I wanted this dress to use in my theatre and work for more than one girl. I am directing West Side Story, this will be perfect for Maria and her I feel pretty number. I tried to go with a size that could work for both my lead and her understudy. That is why I did not do custom sizing. The girls have a different bust size and it will be easy to take the darts out if my lead can not go on for some reason. I will say the bust is loose on both girls, so that seems to be an issue all around. However, that should not be an issue if you take their offer to custom size the dress.

I love the detail on this dress. The intricate beading is going to help my actress really shine on stage. The lace top is great for my purposes. Being a separate piece allows more movement for her in dance numbers. While I really like the ribbon sash. the actress does not, she thinks it takes away from the detail of the dress. We are going to have to try it both ways on stage to see what works.

Overall, this is a terrific dress. Although, it is much longer than expected. I thought it was above the knee, but this length is cute. I can easily work with this on stage and off.

product_title: Calvin Klein Jeans Men's Modern Boot Cut Jean
review_headline: Looks good, feels good, a little stretchy
review_body:
I like these a lot. They look and feel good. They also seem to run a little large in the waist, which makes me feel better :)

I prefer thick and stiff jeans. My wife hates it, but it's what I like. Normally I wear Levi 550 or 527 jeans. I like that they are thicker and feel more substantial. However, the last several pairs of Levis I have purchased have varied widely in fit and quality. Amazingly, the same model of 34x30s can either fit well, or too tight to even button. Further, I have blown out the crotch of several pairs in the last couple years, just because of the way I was kneeling or lifting something.

My wife ordered me a couple pairs of these Calvin Klein jeans to keep nice for when I have to ... not have holes in my jeans. They feel much different than the "cowboy" Levis jeans. They are much thinner and have quite a bit of stretch to them. It's not what I prefer for "work" jeans, but they do look great. They also feel like they will hold up better because of the stretchiness in the fabric.

Another thing that drives me nuts about some jeans is when the cuff slides over the back of my shoes so that I step on them. It's so frustrating. Whenever I try on a pair of jeans, I do this thing my wife calls "the shaky leg test" where I try to shake the cuff enough that it would slide over my shoes. If it happens, I don't buy them. SO FAR, these pass that test, although they look like they're always right on the verge of potentially failing. Hopefully they will continue to stay up, but if not, I might need to make modifications.

review_headline: Make sure to order your  "normal" U.K. size or it will not fit right.
review_body: Based on other reviews I ordered up a band size and down a cup size from my normal size in U.K. measurement bras.  Unfortunately, the band is too loose, so I must wear it on the tightest hook.  Had I ordered my normal size I believe it would have fit correctly.  Also, as I am short, the cups come up very high in front and are visible in any shirt other than a crew neck or high-button type collar.  The side panels are also a bit too stretchy and stick out a little from my body, but that might be due to the large band size.  It is well constructed and not stiff or scratchy' the underwire doesn't poke into/rub my chest' the armpit stays do not poke into my underarms.  It is comfortable enough and does provide good overall support  so I will use it as a secondary every day bra.  The j-hook feature to change it to a racer back bra helps to control the size issue a little and does increase the overall support of the bra.

review_headline: Not completely what I expected but lovely all the same.

I normally wear a 2X but adhering to the junior plus sizes I purchased a 3X. In most ways this dress was wonderful, though the cinching stitch around the waist was kind of loose, so it wasn't as form fitting around the waist as I would have liked. Also, I didn't expect their to be a texture to the material, which there is. This isn't a bad thing, just something worth mentioning.

Overall, this is a very nice dress. The length was fantastic. It hits just above my knee, and is very cute but still manages to be a little modest. I was worried that the placement and thickness of the straps would look a little awkward, but wearing it, it looks very nice, and the bow on the back is a great accent. The flower pattern is very pretty, the material has a nice stretch and is very comfortable. I would definitely recommend this dress to others, it's flowy, adorable and perfect for dates and summer outings!

product_title: Hanes Men's Long Sleeve Cool Dri T-Shirt UPF 50+ (Pack of 2)
review_headline: Awesome top - - I want a pair of bottoms that's just as good.
review_body:
I'm in the range when some brands fit in size medium and some fit in large. So I bought a pair in size medium and a pair in size large with the expectation that I'd return one set. I use them for two very different activities, and it turns out that both they are perfect for one of them. I wear the large in public - - when I want a little bit of slack in the fit (eg, when I'm working in the yard). I wear the medium when a close fit is desirable (eg, under the pfd when I'm canoeing or when I'm swimming).

After a few run-ins with thorns (yardwork, so size large) and with chlorine (size medium) I'm very happy with the durability. I'm going to get another pair -- I simply haven't decided yet whether they should be loose or tight.

The t-shirt is so awesome, that I wish they'd offer a loose-fitting pant with a drawstring closure (like my judo gi pants) so I could wear them on the beach or in my canoe. Hey Hanes: product idea here!

product_title: Coolibar UPF 50+ Men's Convertible ZnO T-Shirt - Sun Protection
review_headline: Comfortable, fits well, good sun protection
review_body:
I now have three of these. I change into them before leaving my office as I have a 4 mile walk home from the train station, most of which is in the sun most of the year. They're light enough that I don't overheat and don't get heavy (like normal all-cotton shirts) as I sweat but also solid enough that they provide some warmth as it gets cooler. Two of them have been through several wash cycles and have held up well. Admittedly, I usually hang them up to dry, but the couple of times I've run them through the dryer, they've come out fine.

I wear a size large and it fits well. Not tight like a rash guard. I'm normally proportioned, about 6 feet tall, and the sleeves can be pulled down to cover at least half of my hands, which I like.

My skin burns easily and quickly but since I've been wearing these, I haven't had a single sunburn or even reddening of my arms.

review_headline: This shirt does make it look like you have some real tats that are fading to ...
review_body:
This shirt is a bit short...you might have to tuck it inside your underwear or something to keep it down. If you're taller than 5'9" or have a long torso, I could see some definite potential problems with the shortness. I wear medium size most of the time. I prefer slightly, smallish medium shirts.

This shirt does make it look like you have some real tats that are fading to that typical, unripe greenish/black in time. I think I will wear this sometimes as a shirt occasionally during the summer. If you're fat/chubby and don't have pecs, don't buy this shirt. If you're under 20% body fat, this shirt will work for you.

This shirt is supposed to be tight in order to be realistic. I plan to buy some tank tops or sheer mesh type shirts to make this seem more realistic. This is a fun shirt. It's worth $20-30 IMO. I got it from Uxcell for $8.54. It took 15 days to receive it from China.

product_title: Star Vixen Women's Short Sleeve Twist Front Maxi Dress, Black Solid
review_body:
I'm 5' 1" and getting a well-cut maxi dress that doesn't require hemming can be a real pain, which is a shame as they're pretty much a summer staple piece for me now. For the price I paid I wasn't expecting much, so I was really pleased with what I got! The draping around the bust is a nice detail, and the V neck is not indecently low. Best of all, the dress stops just above the floor! I ordered a small and it fit just about right- I'm usually a US 4-6. It was delivered very quickly and came out of the packing with no wrinkles, so this would be ideal to cram in a suitcase or overnight bag,
Some things to bear in mind: this is a fairly straight-cut column shape, so if you have wider hips (as I do) it won't hang perfectly straight. The fabric is drapey enough that I personally don't mind. Secondly, this is a cut that favors a more ample bust- the twist looks better with something to fill it out. So if you're short with narrow hips and a larger chest this could be your perfect dress! The fabric also has some fairly specific care advice- hand wash cold and dry flat, so it's probably going to require some additional care to remain in good condition. Still, for the price you are getting a bargain.

review_body: I was a bit hesitant to order pajamas online, but I'm glad that I did. They arrived in just a day or two. They were packaged appropriately. However, I only change into my pajamas for bed and don't wear them around the house as evening clothes, so I don't need any pockets. Also, others have complained about no open fly. product_title: Distil Union - Slim, Minimalist Leather Bifold Wallets with Money Clip, Credit Card Holder
review_headline: Could have been perfect with another 1/8" width.
review_body: ***UPDATE after 9 months and another lost star.  I would not buy this wallet again.  It has held up well with daily use.  But the small size is not all good.  When I wear slacks to work, the wallet will turn sideways in my pocket and then can require a lot of fumbling to get it where I can get it back out of pocket which can be a little embarrassing waiting in line to pay for something.  Also, the biggest complaint I have is that it just can be really hard to push your cards back into the wallet at times.  It's like the little ribbons you use to pull them out get bound up in the hole they pass through and you push harder and wallet starts collapsing on you and the cashier is trying to hand you your receipt and your change and you are standing that futzing with your wallet.  I will probably bear it out until something starts falling apart but I am not going to be buying another one.***  This is so close to being a great wallet.  It is made well.  But it has a couple of easily fixable issues that I just can't understand.  First and foremost, it is about 1/8" too narrow, seriously.  It is so narrow, in my slacks I wear at work which have looser back pockets than say jeans, it can turn sideways and be hard to get out.  It is tight to get a credit card in the pockets and wallet photos which of course don't have any stiffness to them are a little too wide (I'm talking the professional photographer type, not the cheap school ones).  The wallet isn't even wide enough for the money that fits in the money clip.  It sticks out maybe a millimeter or so.  This I really don't like because it is very easy to see how big a wad of cash you have when you pull the wallet out in public.  It's very hard for me to get my head wrapped around why they didn't just make it an 1/8" wider, just 2-3 mm, and it would have easily fixed both of these issues while adding very little bulk.  The second issue is, this wallet just can't hold a lot of stuff.  If you have a fat wallet, you eitheraren't going to be able to use this or are going to have to really pare down what you carry.  Finally, as I sort of eluded to before, it is hard to push soft things into the credit card holder pockets, like pictures, SS card, my car insurance card, my health insurance card that aren't stiff like credit cards.  That said, I'm keeping it.  I do like the small size, but an 1/8" guys, come on, that is all it needs to be much closer to perfect.

product_title: Champion Women's Shape Too Sports Bra
review_headline: *RACERBACK...*INSTRUCTIONS to get it on - straps are NOT too short
review_body: I only wear Champion sports bras for activities I need or want full support (running, weight lifting, yoga, etc).  I lost a significant amount of weight and my previous Champion sports bras were too big.  I bought the previous style at the outlet mall but the store closed and I have been unable to find it anywhere - even Amazon doesn't have it.  In my quest to find a different style that was at the very least comparable, I came across this one.  There were several negative reviews about the straps too short to convert the bra to *RACERBACK for wearing.  I thought long and hard about this and decided to take a chance (I have Amazon Prime, so worst case I return it problem free and full refund).  A sports bra *RACERBACK is extremely important to me because it adds extra support and compression.  It arrived and I tried to fasten it...this was rather difficult to do and it took a lot of effort (though to be fair, I had tweaked a muscle or ligament in my hand down to my elbow and did not have the strength or mobility to really grip the bra to fasten it).  I took it off and *CROSSED the straps *TO *RACERBACK to see how that would fit.  At first look, the straps at full length looked too short to fit and I was perplexed how Champion would design a bra with such a huge flaw.  I tried to put it on over my head and I could not pull it down - I began thinking of the reviews, "straps too short" to fit.  I took it off.  I looked at it and thought there has to be a way to get this on...  *RACERBACK (X straps)...HOW I get it on -> DIRECTIONS: 1 - put your head through 2 - put one arm through 3 - pull it down some 4 - put the other arm through 5 - pull it down some 6 - reach back, grab RACERBACK straps (Left strap with left hand, Right strap with right hand) 7 - pull straps away & down from each other (out & down towards your shoulder blades) 8 - pull the front down some & lift each breast up (simultaneously lift left breast with right hand while left hand is pulling left cup down * repeat for right side) 9 - repeat steps 6, 7 & 8 until your breasts are in the cups of the bra 10- fasten the hooks 11- if additional adjustment is needed: repeat steps 6 & 7  I absolutely love this bra - my new favorite (Champion) sports bra.  I bought 3 more.  PROS: Great support (36C) Convertible straps *to RACERBACK (maximum support) Underwire Neat colors Comfortable Easy to take off Becomes easier to put on after a few times (practice makes perfect) *Purchase your size - do NOT need to go down a size for perfect sports bra fit  CONS: Hard to put on (until you get the hang of it) *Inconsistent sizing (not all my 36C bras are the exact same size => quality control issue)  ************* UPDATED REVIEW:  I originally gave this product 5 stars and I realize that due to the sizing inconsistencies in all my bras in this same style in different colors, removes one star.  I have at least 7 of these bras and some of my 36C fit smaller than others and this is based on the brand new bras on the very first time wearing them. Also, at least 2 of these bras ran so small I was unable to comfortably wear them as RACERBACK and had to wear them regular - which I don't like (RACERBACK is my preference for the best support).  The learning curve and time necessary to put it on as a RACERBACK removes another star.  I love the support I get and RACERBACK gives the ultimate support, not that the regular way doesn't give noteworthy support because it does...I prefer RACERBACK.  I workout 6x/week and these bras get a lot of use and washing.  I wash them in lingerie bags on delicate/hand wash and I hang them to dry.  They have held up very well and are still in fantastic condition.  I have so many because I workout so much and because I don't want to wash them everyday/every other day and because I love all the different colors.    In my original review I did change a few things but there is an * asterisk to denote this (mainly I changed X back to RACERBACK).

And even if I did, the length was now just barely long enough to touch my ankles.  At least one of my three pairs had wood splinters stuck through the weave of the pants; that same pair tore the rear seam the first time I wore them.  I'll keep them since they're still wearable and they were really inexpensive, but I'm definitely disappointed.  If you're taller than 5'4", I'd think these probably aren't the pants for you.
