product_title: ALASKA BEAR - Classic Cash Money Clip Credit Card Holder
review_body:
The two prior reviews nail the key features of this clip, so I will explain why I loved the review sample I received so much that I awarded it five stars.

First, the design is very clever. No hinges or locking mechanisms - this is a piece of spring steel with a brushed, stainless finish that has a small lip. The lip is sufficiently rounded to give you comfortable leverage to pry the clip open. You can insert bills, cards, or identification and the clip holds them firmly.

The second thing I love about this clip is it's slimmer and shorter than many that I have used. I appreciate those features because when I am on stage performing I want as few things in my pockets as possible. For one thing wallets and the such can deform clothes, and the other, much of my stage time is sitting and a wallet stuffed into a back pocket can become irritating in a hurry.

This clip allows me to carry the bare essentials - a few bucks, a debit card and a driver's license securely and in comfort. No fuss, no ostentatious clip, and no problem inserting or removing money, cards and the like. Those reasons are worth five stars any day in my book.

review_headline: The thong string is a nonissue -- it feels like it isn't even there when you wear it
review_body: I am trans and use this as a harness for my soft pack. It does the job well. The thong string is a nonissue -- it feels like it isn't even there when you wear it. The waist string is surprisingly hardy and strong. The hole is a little snug, which can be annoying since most soft packs are pretty floppy. However, the fabric is soft and elastic, and you don't need to fear it causing the type of tearing on the shaft that O-rings in regular dildo harnesses cause.  Note that if you use this with a Cyberskin packer (like the Mr Limpy, Packer Gear, Masho, etc.), you NEED to have some barrier in between you and the open back of the thong. Cyberskin cannot be sterilized, and tends to get sticky. You don't want Cyberskin lying directly against your junk.  A good option is to put on a regular jock first, then put the thong, with the packer already secured in the hole, over it.  Many people have complained about sizing. A small fits an extra small Mr Limpy and small Packer Gear (3.5 and 5 inches, respectively). Bigger packers, heavier packers, and 2- or 3-in-1 designs that include more functionality should go for a medium or large to accommodate everything.

product_title: Faconnable Men's Windowpane Checked Sportshirt
review_body:
I love this shirt. I'm not usually so excited about a piece of clothing that I'd write a review, but this is truly exceptional. It's obviously a high quality shirt.

First, I'm a pretty big guy. My wife says I don't look fat, but carry my weight well with my large frame. That's the nice way of saying it. Yes, I'm fairly tall, but I have no illusions about the flab I'm sporting. I work out regularly and have a fair amount of muscle that helps my fat disperse well. However, finding flattering clothing is difficult, particularly when it comes to dress shirts.

So many dress shirts go for the fitted or trim cut, that I have difficulty finding shirts that are flattering. They tend to either squeeze around my belly and/or chest. For example, trying on dress shirts at Nordstrom, I went all the way to a 2XL in some brands that still squeezed around my chest. However, this shirt fits great in a standard X-Large. For me, it's the difference between the extra layer of fat making the statement and a nice fit that actually accents my better qualities.

I was lucky in getting this on a lightening deal for $59.99. I draw the line around $75 for a dress shirt. So, I don't know if I'll get anymore of these unless I stumble upon a great deal again. But, for those who don't mind the splurge, I highly recommend the Faconnable Men's Sportshirt.

product_title: Cole Haan Women's Down Maxi Coat with Oversized Collar
review_headline: Ready for ANYTHING kind of Winter Coat!
review_body: Love this coat!  The fit and color are flattering.  The green is more subdued more like a khaki.  Nice standout from the sea of black winter coats.  And the price was perfect as well.  Seen it for 2x this amount elsewhere.  So thank you amazon!  I'd just moved back to the Northeast from the South where the winters are on the whole more temperate.  This has been the perfect transition coat as it could be dressed up for a more formal wear or down for more casual.  It does need to be paired with a sweater for extra warmth.  But the pockets are long enough to fit my Cole Haan clutch wallet; the long collar is great to keep wind off your cheeks; and the long length with closures that goes almost past your calves/shins makes you feel battled down.  The only negative, like another reviewer noted, the material is not water stain resistant.  So after clearing off my car from snow it always looked like I'd spilled coffee down the front! But otherwise, I love the coat and look forward to wearing it for a couple more NE winters.

product_title: 12 Colors Satin Bodice Spring Summer Flower Girl Pageant Tulle Dress: Infant-14
review_headline: Best dress in this price range
review_body:
Let's face it mom's and dads. Our daughters wear their special dresses once, maybe twice- three times if we're lucky. Then they get donated or handed down. We want them to look super cute without spending a fortune. This is a great dress at a terrific price.

I bought the Sage Green version for my toddlers Easter dress. It's a wonderful springy shade of green. I love that there are so many colors of this dress. It seems like everything we buy is pink, or occasionally purple. She looks like a little garden fairy to me in it. The color choices for this dress are great for all kind of holidays, weddings, and parties.

The dress is satin with an organza over skirt. That means it doesn't have any stretch to to. I find that the top is a little bit big. I've attached a photo, since the page doesn't advertise what the dress actually looks like on the baby. (Please excuse my daughter's less-than-lady-like pose.) She's 19 months old and right around the 50th percentile for height and weight. Size large (18 Months) fits her pretty well. It zips up the back and has organza ties in the back that help cinch it down a little and make for a cute bow. The dress comes down to about mid calf on her. It doesn't impede her romping around. She actually loves to spin around in circles in it .

The flowers and ribbons make this dress. They are all pinned in place with safety pins. I know some people don't like that, but it doesn't bother my daughter (who loves to play with the ribbons). We did have one come unpinned at Easter dinner while she was playing. The label says hand-wash only, but if I were to wash it, I'd probably take the flowers and ribbons off and throw it in my HE washer on the gentle cycle. However, since I don't see a special occasion requiring a lovely green dress between now and the time she grows out of it - so I probably will not.

i was very surprised that it comes with a little matching headband. I didn't see that in the product description. It's a scrunchy off-white ribbon with matching flowers on it. It's cute, but my daughter really isn't the headband type.ribbon with matching flowers on it. It's cute, but my daughter really isn't the headband type.

product_title: CordiU Heavy Weight T-Party Fold Over Yoga Pants,Large,2 Pack: Black/Black
review_body:
These are absolutely the best yoga pants I've found on Amazon thus far. I've tried probably 10-12 different brands and now I only buy these. These fit snugly down my legs until about my upper calf and then gently flare. They're quite flattering.

They fit snugly but do start to stretch a bit after repeated wear. If your thighs rub you will eventually wear a hole in the inseam. They don't seem to pill too badly but the fabric will wear thin at the stitching and eventually tear. Until then though (and maybe even after if you wear them at home) you will want to live in them. Great for yoga, for wearing around the house, I even wear these to work.

I have these in multiple colors now. They all fit the same. They are a little more snug than I'd like when first purchased, but after a bit of wear they become perfectly comfortable. I have yet to have a pair that have gotten to that too stretched out point that a lot of cheaper yoga pants seem to get to.

product_title: Sakkas Windsong Tie Dye Two Way Dress
review_headline: I like Sakkas dresses...but this one not my favorite!
review_body: I was surprised to not like this dress as I have many pieces in the Sakkas clothing line and usually love how they fit.  This one is boxy on top and not very flattering.  I know that many have given it excellent reviews, so I'm guessing it may have to do with one's dress size- so I'll try to help others decide whether to buy. I'm a 14/16 (closer to 14) and it fit very well, it just wasn't flattering.  It didn't go in at the waist like the picture (like the model in the picture is pinching the waist fabric behind her to make it more shapely).  I'm 5'7 and length was great, so was the print of the fabric.  I'm also a 38C and although the bust fit fine (its nice and stretchy on top), I thought it looked frumpy and not shapely on top.  So in summary I'm going to guess that this dress may be most flattering (after reading other reviews) for sizes 8-12 only.  One other thing (that I like to put in all my Sakkas reviews): the reason for the reasonable pricing of their line is that even though their colors and prints are gorgeous, these cotton items are VERY fragile to wash (they run, can't be put in dryer, need cold water TLC when washing and a press cloth when ironing, etc).  So if you like 'durable', their line is not it- but if you like clothes/dresses that are: inexpensive, fun, GREAT colors/prints and are cut exceptionally well (usually!) with a lovely forgiving/flattering drape to most of their styles- Sakkas does it very well!  I recommend that you check out many of their other dresses if this is not the one for you!!

product_title: Finejo Womens Front Closure Lace Racerback Push Up Bra Black
review_headline: Sooooo cute but can't make it fit :c
review_body:
So I wear a 36 B, right? I bought the 36 equivalent, and I guess maybe I'm on the smaller side or they don't correspond the cup size to the width around the chest. The cups were massive! DEFINITELY a C cup or bigger, despite the plentiful padding (and there really is a ton of padding in these things)! My poor boobies were swimming in these cups no matter how I tried to adjust it. Finally, I got creative and unhooked the front straps, made little rips in the fabric closer to the center of the bra, and hooked the straps in there. That seemed to work a little better! However, this left me with the part of the bra where the straps originally went sticking out awkwardly, and I figured I'd have to cut that part with scissors which would mess with the seam of the fabric I cut holes into for the straps! Ah! The quality was really nice, though I'd be a little worried about the lace ripping after a couple uses/ washes, the fabric I cut holes into for the straps seemed like it would have held up pretty well and it was only the first layer over the cups.
In essence, it's so stinkin' cute that I did everything in my power to make it work and just concluded it needed more altering than I was capable of. Even with the adjusted straps, the cups were too big and padded for me to be comfortable wearing. It is SO CUTE though!! I'm upset! I never thought I'd be leaving a 'too big' review on an Asian sized product, darn it.

product_title: Intimate Portal Women Under the Bump Maternity Panties Pregnancy Underwear
review_headline: Awesome customer service and product, but ignore the mislabeled tag and order a size up!
review_body: First of all, I love these underwear and they fit better than the other three brands of maternity underwear I have tried. I am in my third trimester, and usually wear a size 0-2 small but ordered a medium and it fits perfectly! The front rides a little low, which nicely tucks under maternity leggings, leggings, and jeans. The back side is generous and covers very well too, so it doesn't move when I stand up and sit down. The material is slightly elastic, which is great for movement and growing, but the material is not such tight elastic that it pinches. True, there is no "support" in these underwear but I found the "support" underwear just caused me pain, so I went this route instead. I have washed them multiple times in cold/room temperature water and they have not shrunk, faded, nor worn out.  Oh, and from a cosmetic point of view, the blue color is a really pretty baby blue that looks much brighter in person than in pictures.  I wrote in the title to ignore the mislabeled tag, because my medium underwear were labeled large on the inside tag BUT the attached sales tag stated medium. I ended up speaking with the company's customer service to ensure I had the right size, and they were very nice, responded same day/next day, and Amazon was great in coordinating the discussions as well. The shipping was fast, as per Amazon Prime.  Bottom line - I am a very happy customer and am about to order my second pair! I recommend these relatively affordable maternity underwear if you are looking for comfortable and fairly attractive maternity underwear (not the support kind).  UPDATE on July 19, 2015:  Since I just posted this review in early 2015, I have worn and washed these underwear several times.  There are in still in great shape, only the lettering has worn a bit.  They still feel awesome, stretchy but still fit snuggly, and I wear them despite being four months postpartum and feel great in them!  I still highly recommend as they are seriously my favoriteunderwear!

product_title: Borgasets RFID Blocking Women's Genuine Leather Wallet Credit Card Holder Zipper Purse
review_headline: Will actually hold over 30 cards! Seriously!
review_body:
I know, it says 18 credit cards, but I have at least 30 in it right now(credit, rewards, membership cards etc.) and it snaps properly and still has room in the zipper pockets and looks great. I read the reviews where everybody was saying that the credit card pockets were really deep and that you kinda loose your cards in them. Everybody was right. They are deep and if you push the cards all the way to the bottom of the pocket you can barely tell there is a card in there. So I figured there would be plenty of room in each pocket for more than one card if you want to do that but what I did is, instead of putting the cards in the slots horizontally the way you are supposed to, I put two cards in each slot vertically except for the card slots on each side at the fold. Those have to be placed in there properly so you can close it, otherwise the card would extend too far and not allow it to bend. Loading it this way allows for more cards and makes it so easy to find the one you need. A little over a quarter of the card extends out of the pocket. Works great!!

The leather is awesome. Looks great and smells great. I got the brown one and it has a dark blue leather snap in the middle. Very well made!! I am seriously thinking of getting another one just because it works so well for me and I have never had anything that holds ALL of my cards that looks great and is still so slim that you barely notice it in your purse when it's up against the side.

I'm a happy Camper and hope that you will be too! :)

product_title: MonsterCloset Short Sleeve Tulip Back w/ Button Detail Top
review_headline: MonsterCloset Short Sleeve Tulip Back w/ Button Detail Top
review_body:
I can't get over how ridiculously inexpensive this top is!. It is actually a cute sheer top that is not quite as 'fitted' as it is in the picture. I think this is in part because I expected the large to fit like a medium so I ordered a large and lo, the large fits like a large. As a result the sleeves droop more than they ought. Despite that the top has a nice drape and I like the tulip back with the faux buttons. The taupe is actually more of a light almost beige-salmon and not really what I consider taupe at all. It certainly is not as dark as it appears on my monitor.

I took away one star because there was a loose thread clearly visible in the chest area. Though I was able to fix it it was frustrating since the material is very sheer. This may not happen to others however I do feel I should caution you have to evaluate whether it is worth the return process if it does happen to you.

Edited 21 Sep 2014
If you are able to look at the images of both the front and the back of this top hopefully you will be able to envision what I mean when I say it looks cute with the buttons in the front. In other words, wearing it backward.

product_title: Baby Phat Hot Skinny Jeans With Back Pocket Zipper Detail (3-24)
review_headline: Not bad, but beware the zippers on the rear
review_body:
I like the Baby Phat brand a lot, so when I saw these jeans for under $30, I grabbed them. I was surprised by a couple of things, however.
1) The exposed zippers in the back are a MAJOR detriment. I tore up netting on a back support, the cloth on my kitchen chairs, the leather on the couch started to show signs and to end it all, I bent over inbetween cars in a parking lot and SCRATCHED THE PAINT on someone else's car! That night, my husband very carefully cut them off (no, they cannot be zipped up the whole way so they are no longer exposed zippers).
2) These are not completely cotton. They are 70% cotton, 28% polyester and 2% elastane. Which means in August, they are HOT and SWEATY to wear.
3) They are skinny jeans, just like the description says (which I missed). So if you are looking for boot cut pants, these do hug the legs all the way to ankle.

I still really like this brand, but these jeans are not my go-to jeans, as I'd hoped they would be. Perhaps fall/winter will be better when being warm is more important.

product_title: Partiss Womens Double-breasted Trench Coat
review_headline: Overall very synthetic and fits large
review_body: "Trench coat" is a misnomer as this coat isn't made of water-proof heavy-duty cloth, the usual trench coat material.  Instead it is made of some synthetic material more resembling of felt than wool.  The lining is also made of some tough synthetic material.  The black frill at the bottom is made of plastic, not anything resembling lace, to add to the cheap appearance, but it is removable.  In the product photos the coat appears to have an A-line shape but the coat that I got is straight down wide with no taper.  Having the right size may help with the shape but the coat fit too large/wide (the medium fits large for my size 8 sister, especially the shoulder width... the shoulder padding doesn't help).  I didn't bother returning or asking for an exchange because of the price.  The only reason I gave a second star is the fact it is really double-breasted as described.

review_headline: On the model in the images these beads are big enough to cover both ends of the plastic bones but in the delivered jacket theses
review_body: I purchased a jacket as a thanksgiving gift for my colleague (which is already arrived). As the first person to write a reviews on this product I'm not inclined to give a negative feedback but to say the delivered product is partially different from the images of the product that I saw on the manufacturer's own website and also on Amazon. For example the fringes are shorter, the braid leather texture is much smaller however sewing line of the fringes in the chest area is obviously noticeable, but the weakest point is that the beads at both ends of the plastic bones are completely different from the ones in the presented images. On the model in the images these beads are big enough to cover both ends of the plastic bones but in the delivered jacket theses beads are totally different and are much smaller and are so tiny that can't support the bones and this causes the whole thing looks very loose and badly positioned and to make it worse it's colored in gold instead of silver as I originally saw in the ads images. Though I contacted the representative in Canada and the support staff member named Max was diligent and very helpful and the fact that they made another customized jacket within 48 hours without any further questions and even requesting the immediate retrieval of the product, really stands out for this vendor and they also send pictures of the replacement to me, unfortunately the new jacket is the same as the delivered one with some changes in color of beads (and not even the shape and size of beads). However that's not a great practice that the delivered good is much different from the one that's advertised but it's noticeable that the manufacturer used abundant suede leather on the jacket which is quite good but after all I'm not overly satisfied with my purchase.

review_headline: Game of Thrown T-shirts a winner but.
review_body: I purchased two shirts (a small and a medium) for my wife and daughter-in-law. Both shirts were far too small so we had to send back the small for a large. The low rating is because we had to pay to return the small shirt. I believe such returns, due to miss-stated facts about the product, should be covered by Amazon or the seller. Amazon should at this point warn customers that the sizes are not accurate. Both larger shirts just fit and could be a bit larger.  An extra-large and extra-extra large might also be in order.  The shirts are of good quality and are proudly warn by both mothers (each have three male dragons).  Game of Thrones enthusiasts enjoy wearing a shirt identifying with a favorite character. My daughter-in-law not only identifies with Khaleesi but her husband, our youngest dragon, wears a Hodor shirt.  When she asks him to do something he responds \\"Hodor'.  Why not feature other favorites.  For example, Jon Snow, Tyrion, Ygritte, Brienne of Tarth for starters as well as less scrupulous characters with outrages quotes . review_headline: Sure it is a little bit smaller than I would have liked but I fit into it without trouble

Something to keep in mind when buying international.

product_title: Stephen Joseph Girls' Rain Coats
review_body:
This raincoat is even cuter in person than in the picture - my husband even commented how cute it was as I was pulling it out of the box.

Some reviews listed under the other style of Stephen Joseph rain coats mentioned that some of the color coating had peeled off because the fabric stuck together when it was folded during storage/shipping. The manufacturer has resolved this problem - when we received it, the sleeves were wrapped in tissue paper before being folded into the coat, so nothing stuck together and nothing peeled off when we unfolded it.

I love how the fabric is a soft, matte finish, not stiff, plastic-y and shiny like some other raincoats. The inside is lined with a soft, thin material, which I prefer over the fleece lining found in some other raincoats since it's sometimes still warm here during rainy season. If it's cold, my daughter can always wear a sweater under the raincoat.

The fit is great. My daughter generally wears size 2T, but I wanted to get something that would last her a couple years so I ordered a 3T instead. My daughter is a little chunky - the coat is nice and roomy, but not so big that it looks ridiculous on her. I can roll the sleeves up just once and it fits great. The only thing I didn't like is I wish the hood was a tad bit bigger - it would be nice if it extended a little bit past her forehead so that rain wouldn't get on her face. That being said, though, my daughter does have a large-ish head and has a lot of curly hair, so if your child has a smaller head, this may not be an issue.

Overall, I'm very happy with this raincoat and highly recommend it. Can't wait for the rainy season!

review_body:
I REALLY LIKE EYELET AND THOUGHT THIS ITEM WOULD BE JUST THE THING TO ADD TO MY WARDROBE. IT WOULD GO WITH ANYTHING AND WHEN THE "SPECIAL" TOP TO A SET OF JEANS WAS DIRTY, THIS WOULD FIT RIGHT IN AND MAKE THE OUTFIT AS LOVELY AS EVER.

I FORGOT TO TAKE INTO ACCOUNT THAT I AM NO LONGER A SVELTE 21 YEAR OLD AND MY POSTERIOR REGION HAS DONE SOME SPREADING TO MAKE SITTING A MORE COMFORTABLE EXERCISE FOR ME. WITH THAT SAID, LOOK CLOSELY AT THE WAY THE TOP IS MADE. IT IS INDEED A LOVELY WHITE EYELET WITH THE WONDERFUL 3/4 LENGTH SLEEVES THAT I PREFER.
DEPENDING UPON YOUR HEIGHT; HOWEVER, THE BOTTOM OF THE SHIRT WILL HIT YOU MID-BUTTOCKS, OR SLIGHTLY BELOW, AND I GUESS IF YOU ARE VERY, VERY TALL, THE BOTTOM WOULD HIT YOU AT HIP LEVEL.

THIS IS GENERALLY NOT THE MOST ATTRACTIVE AREA ON OUR BODIES AND WE DO NOT WANT TO DRAW THE EYES OF OTHERS TO OUR EVER-SPREADING POSTERIORS.

BUT TO ADD SALT TO THE WOUND, JONES NEW YORK ADDED A CONTRASTING LINE IN THE HIP AREA TO DRAW EVEN MORE ATTENTION TO THOSE HIPS. NOW I AM NOT A HUGE PERSON, SIZE 12, BUT I ABSOLUTELY DO NOT NEED MY HIPS ACCENTUATED SO THEY COME TO LOOK LIKE THE LARGEST PART OF MY ANATOMY.

SO, IN AN EFFORT, TO FALL INTO THE BEAUTY IMAGE PARAMETERS SET FOR THE AMERICAN WOMAN, I WILL SEND THIS BACK AND SEE IF SOMETHING ELSE IS AVAILABLE TO FILL IN WHEN A NEEDED, MATCHING TOP IS NOT AVAILABLE...OR I COULD JUST DO WITHOUT A NEW ITEM, AND CONCENTRATE ON DOING THE LAUNDRY. OH WELL.

UNLESS YOU ARE INORDINATELY THIN AND/OR HAVE NO HIP SPREADING ISSUES, I DO NOT RECOMMEND THIS TOP.

product_title: Underworks MagiCotton Sports Bra and Binding Minimizer Bra
review_headline: Great bra with a few flaws
review_body:
I did a lot of research before committing to buying this bra, because it's so expensive and I didn't want to waste my money. So after using it for about a month, here's my review.
1. It compresses excellently. I'm a 36DD, and it squishes them down well enough to where I actually feel skinnier.
2. I read a lot that you should get a size up from what you actually are, so I ordered a 38. There are some ups and downs to this:
Because I'm a 36, the band at the bottom doesn't really sit on my chest at all, it kind of hovers above it. However, that doesn't stop it from doing it's job of compressing, it might just look a little strange with a really tight top.
It is a little narrow, which I will get to in a moment.
It is also a little short. I don't like my boobs to be squished towards the top of the bra because I feel weird, but if I push them too far down I feel like they're about to pop out from the bottom.
3. Which brings me to my next point. I also read a lot of complaints about it giving you the uniboob affect, which I agree with. If you just throw the bra on and go, you will have a uniboob. However, if you take the time to adjust your boobs in the bra, it's not very hard to do. Usually I have to adjust my boobs a couple times a day. This is where the narrowness comes in though. For me, if I push them too far outwards, I get little fat rolls under my arms.
4. It will be quite tight when you first get it, but it'll stretch out and fit well after a couple wears.
5. It does not entirely squish your boobs flat. I wasn't looking for a binder that completely flattened my chest, I just wanted something that would help with the large size, and this definitely does the job. It's more of like a very very good sports bra.
6. I do like the shape of the bra. It does rise prettty high up in the front and the back. The straps are not razorback, which is a huge plus for me. The high rising on the front just looks like a tank top underneath, which I always wear underneath clothes anyways so it doesn't bug me. The back i actually don't mind looking so big. I wear this bra with shirts I've cut the back on and I think it looks good.
My suggestion is when you get the bra, take a little bit of time to mess around with it on. Adjust your boobs and the bra until you find a nice fit that you're happy with how it looks. Once you have that look, remember it so whenever something is off you can adjust it pretty quickly.
I'd definitely recommend this bra, however I'd think about the size when ordering. I will be buying another one some time in the future, but I will be ordering in my size. I think the band size is going to be different for every person, so it's just going to have to be your best judgment call. Like I said, my biggest complaint is that the band underneath the boobs doesn't sit on my chest, more of just sits there. But otherwise, I'd recommend it. I love this bra and wear it almost everyday.

product_title: ROunderbum Women's Roundbum Seamless Bra Top
review_headline: Surprisingly Good Support - Tried Medium - Tight in Band
review_body:
I used to be a dress size 6 but have put on some weight and am more like an 8 right now and most of my bras don't fit me at the moment. Rather than buying a whole new set of expensive Spanx bras (that I so love!), I decided try something comfortable and stretchy that would still fit between sizes until I can get back into shape. (And so I can stop wearing the same two shelf bra camisoles all the time!!!)

I actually have a BA degree in Fashion/Knitwear, which is why I took a chance on this bra without there being a single review. I had a good look at the construction and decided to go for it. It is well-made and the cups are surprisingly supportive for a medium+ breast size! (See sizing notes below...) The fabric is durable but dense and does compress around my ribcage a bit. Not sure if a large would fit more comfortably, but I don't want the cups to go up in size as they are perfect right now. After wearing for a few hours it felt more comfortable but was still equally supportive.

I purchased a medium and I typically wear a 32D but recently am more like a 34D or 32DD. That said, I'm someone who prefers to wear a more fitted band, so others my size might wear a 34C. In case you're unaware about the shift in cup sizes between bands, a 32D is equivalent to 34C is equivalent to 36B. Great chart on that here: http://www.brasize.com/bra-sister-size.html The cups are quite stretchy and would fit a smaller or possibly slightly larger cup.

If you have are more of a pear-shape, you may want to order up a size. The lower part of the band is quite fitted and would potentially created rolls beneath it. I'm just barely sneaking by with it! The back fabric is quite smoothing but there is a lot of it! Somehow feel like more than in the picture. So far it's been pretty comfortable though on an 85-degree, humid day.

Great little boardshorts for the 4th of July! I was a little disturbed that it only has one pocket on the right side leg, but being boardshorts that was more or less expected. I have an awkward sort of body type as I have lost a lot of weight but still have a big butt, so I ordered them as a large, but I think I can now squeeze into a medium, so that was an error on my part.

product_title: Unisex Terry Cloth Robe - 100% Egyptian Cotton Hotel/Spa by ExceptionalSheets
review_body:
I ended up returning this item for the following reasons:

1 - Sizing. Bought this for our guest room, so I ordered a large figuring it would fit most quests. My husband is 5'10" and average weight, but the large was almost to his ankle, which made it a bit awkward to walk in.

2 - Weight: This robe was unreasonably heavy. When I tried it on, I felt the robe weighing down my shoulders. I bought this robe thinking it would be light and fluffy like my egyptian cotton towels, but it was neither and was uncomfortable to wear for more than a few minutes.

3 - Quality: The robe just wasn't soft. I have two regular cotton robes now that are softer. Granted, they've been washed many times over the years, but this robe actually felt a bit rough, and definitely was not as soft as my egyptian cotton towels before their first use. Other reviews noted the robe only got a little softer with washes, so I wasn't willing to take the chance.

All in all, for $60 I think we can find a higher quality product during a good sale. We want our guests to be comfortable when they visit, and we didn't think this robe fit the bill for this purpose, so we sent it back. A+ for customer service, though. eLuxurySupply quickly agreed to a refund, no questions asked, and paid for the return shipping.

product_title: Democracy Women's Woven Printed Maxi Skirt with Elastic Waistband
review_headline: Beware of clothing wrapped in cellophane that you havn't seen full-length first...
review_body: This garment came wrapped up like a pair of stockings.... which, I suppose, is good for shipping, but you don't notice the imperfections until the cellophane was removed.  The cloth felt wonderful and the fit was excellent, but the skirt's patterns, basically cut in two panels, front and back, did not match.  I call this economical cutting, such that the manufacture lay the pattern pieces of the garment on whatever part of the bolt that fit, not pattern to pattern (as one would match wall paper, for example), in a professional manner, as one will generally find in a quality garment.  Maybe this doesn't matter to some people, but I was taught the proper way to cut and sew and mis-matched patterns is not acceptable.  I liked the skirt well enough to ask for an exchange, but got the same irregular cut both times; I returned the skirt twice.  Too bad, 'cause I really liked the skirt.  If pattern-matching is not a sticking point for you, then give this skirt a twirl.  You'll like the feel of it.  Another skirt from this manufacturer in an all-over swirlly pattern might work, too.

product_title: Genuine Leather Wallet Womens Clutch Trifold RFID Blocking
review_headline: Excellent design, card slots excessively tight
review_body: The wallet appears to be well made, and the design is great.  There are numerous card slots, including several that are inside the flap--not only protected by the security lining,  but placed where they couldn't slip out as long as the wallet is folded closed.  The problem, as other reviewers have noted, is that the card slots are far too tight.  After placing some cards in the wallet, I had to use tweezers and tug hard to remove my driver's license from the window slot.  When I'm at the airport and asked to remove my license from the holder, I'm not about to fumble with tweezers.  Another reviewer noted that the slots should loosen with use.  I'd agree if they were merely snug.  These slots are much too tight.  They are only off by a millimeter or two, but that is too tight for me.  In order for the slots to loosen, I'd have to be able to pull the cards out.  Some slots may loosen, eventually, but the window slot for a license is unlikely to loosen enough.  I don't have the patience to break in a wallet.  I'm disappointed, because the wallet design is terrific.  I loved it when I opened it.  But I'm returning it.

So you have a very light colored area matched up with the dark part - not at all like what's pictured in the side view photo. And unfortunately it really emphasizes the side seams. Maybe it's me but just makes the garment seem sort of tacky and of a lower quality.

product_title: PattyBoutik Women's Lace Fringe Hem Pencil Skirt
review_headline: Not your average black pencil skirt!
review_body:
This skirt is gorgeous and unique. I'm 5'3" and about 115, an extra small would've probably been perfect had it been available but it's so beautiful, I'm keeping it anyway! Maybe I'll take it in a little and even if not, it still looks fantastic.

-It is very sexy with the lace on the sides. How it's positioned, seems to accentuate you better than most skirts of a similar cut and gives your thighs/butt great definition from the back and the side.
-It has a great cut and shape. It Clings in all the right places without any oddly bulging or super tight areas.
-The material feels thick and sturdy enough to hold up and perfectly capable of concealing/smoothing your figure, should that be a concern-certainly not an "everything on display" kind of fabric. Although it's got some good weight to it, it still doesn't feel bulky.
-The waist is wide enough and high enough, muffin top mishaps shouldn't be a concern to most. It's double banded for extra comfort and makes for a better transition so any shirt you wear above it should look great without odd lines of demarcation.
-There's a fair amount of stretch and because the skirt can either be pulled up or down at the waist, it can accommodate a few inches depending on the length you want it to be and where you want it to hit your knees. It doesn't really get above my knees but again; 5'3"!

So, just get it already! It's beautiful and definitely not something you'll stumble across all the time.

product_title: SlideBelts "Wild Side" Decal Leather Ratchet Belt - Custom Fit
review_body:
So. Where to start about this belt...

I absolutely love it. It is by far the best belt I have ever used. I purchased this belt specifically because it was a slide belt, but I didn't know about my favorite feature when I bought it: the ability to gently lift the edge of the buckle to loosen the belt. It has a ratchet like mechanism in it so that you can easily either tighten or loosen it without taking the belt off. I love this because, as a big guy, I can loosen the belt without taking it off or having to remove it from holes in the belt. Very, very convenient. It is made from what I would call mid-grade leather, though I wish it were a little thicker though this isn't an issue that affects rating.

I will mention this: I ordered a specific size but the belt arrived in a one-size-fits-all fashion. The back of the belt has marks that you can use to cut the belt to fit it to you, and I actually am glad that the belt came like this as I was a completely different waist size than I thought when I ordered the belt. After you cut the belt you attach the buckle and never see where the cut was made. Genius.

I will never buy another belt from another company again unless this one proves to be horrible, and I do not see that happening anytime soon.

product_title: Disguise Men's Marvel Captain America Classic Muscle Costume
review_headline: the one I tried on fits fine. It's just the extra built in muscle padding ...
review_body:
I bought 2 in preparation for Halloween actually. The first I spent around $55 on, and then the next day it was $40. I haven't even taken the first one out of the box becuase I want to keep it pristine and to make it clear that it has not been removed from it's packaging (iParty would not allow me to return a costume piece after Halloween)... I'm hoping Amazon won't be nearly as stingy cosidering I have no plans to open the package on my first duplicated costume.

ANYWAY, the one I tried on fits fine. It's just the extra built in muscle padding that makes me feel a little foolish. Like I get Cap is a super soldier and he is fairly thick in the movie, but the costume adds so much muscle padding that it just does not look really real and you do kind of achieve the top heavy "Dorrito" look (geek inside joke).

With no padding around the legs, the costume appears that you're more of a Captain America torso who missed leg day and have a half-hazard swim cap for a helmet.

product_title: Kenneth Cole Reaction Women's Plus-Size Ruffle-Licious Tiered Tankini
review_body:
I received the pink version of this tankini top as a birthday present from my friend Lil, (HI LIL!). It arrived as a complete surprise! It came in a soft-plastic waterproof envelope wrapped in a plastic bag.

When opened, it was in perfect condition. No tearing, loose threads. I tried it on immediately!

I read the other lady's review (a DD chest-sized fellow citizen) and I am not sure what exactly happened to her tankini top. I am a 48 DDD, and this shirt currently supports my ....generous top just fine. The straps themselves don't have adjustments, but! They can be removed. And since they can be removed, they can be crossed for extra support--OR if you are creative you can do some sewing fixes to help support a generous bust. I am a big girl all around, and wanted a nice top and bottom to wear instead of a 1 piece and I can definitely say this top is fabu for my big belly and hips.

It hugs my belly, but doesn't ride up over it when I lift my arms. The ruffles actually help slim my hips.

I spent a lot of time in my life feeling self conscious about being overweight. Wearing big, loose tops over any bathing suit. As I am older and getting to the age where I just want to enjoy my life and not give a flappyjack about what people think about me; this is a great break-through tankini top for confidence. I actually took pictures of myself in it and posted them!

It's a very soft, stretchy feel. And you could, with the right bra (if you need one) get away with wearing this out not just for swimming for a time on the town.

DO recommend!

review_body:
I just got my coat in the mail. I was really excited for it. I still like it enough to keep but I am not sure that I like it as much as I hyped myself up to like, based on the overwhelming Amazon positive reviews. The jacket feels like it is good quality. It looks like what is pictured. However, there are a couple discrepancies. I ordered the black colored jacket. It is black on the outside but it is lined in BRIGHT orange on the inside, while some reviews mentioned that the interior may be orange, the photo of the product on the top shows a woman with a black lined jacket. Also, the coat is extremely heavy. I am a petite female. The coat is one of the heaviest coats I have ever worn. I literally felt like I put on 15 lbs. It's good if you want protection against the cold but it is a nuisance to have to wear such a heavy jacket if you have a slight frame. The hoodie is nice and soft. The arms are also a bit narrow. It would be nice if the sleeves were wider opening. I like this product and will update my review if my opinion changes with use. Decent for $84 that I paid for this. I would probably not have gotten it/ taken the risk though if it were more expensive. Right now, there is a Black Friday sale going on for this jacket. So at $79, I would say it is okay to gamble on but not more than this.

PROS:
* feels like quality construction
* looks like quality construction
* variety of zippers
* fairly unique looking for the price (mass produced jackets that are within this price range tend to look generic)
* ships quickly with amazon prime

CONS:
* black one is orange lined interior despite photo
* really heavy for petite people
* narrow sleeves

product_title: Kaftans Poly Silk Peach Kashmir Crewel Embroidered Abaya Caftans
review_body:
First I have to say that I got this caftan very quickly, very much within the timeline of the estimated date of arrival.

The caftan is very pretty. I ordered the peach one with the multi-colored flower embroidery. The embroidery covers the front, the upper portion of the back side, the hem line and parts of the sleeves, if memory serves. The embroidery is precisely why I bought it and what I was looking forward to enjoying as I wore it.

The fabric does have a soft texture of sorts. However, the fact that it is of a poly material is more noticeable from a tactile standpoint than other poly caftans I've purchased from Mogul Interior and other sellers on Amazon. That doesn't bother me however, as the fabric does look dressy, and I love the embroidery.

The problem that I did have with the garment which caused me to send it back -- is that it is so long you'd have to be at least 8 feet tall to be able to wear it. Now I understand that in Arab and Muslim countries where these abaya dresses are typically worn, the preference is for the dresses to cover the shoes so that the feet won't show. That's not a problem for me. I've worn dresses and skirts that are that long, and wearing shoes with a higher heel or lifting them a little bit when wearing them outside took care of any concerns I might've had about them getting wet or dirty. But the length of this particular caftan goes beyond a simple floor length. Neither a higher heeled shoe nor lifting it a bit would've kept a huge portion of the fabric off the floor.

Since the dress has embroidery on the sides and on the hemline itself, cutting it in order to hem it would not have been an appropriate solution to the length issue, as that would have ruined the embroidery design.

I'm really sorry to have had to send back the caftan, as I did like it. But there would've been no point in keeping it if neither I nor anyone else I knew could wear it because of the extremelength.

Perhaps Mogul Interior could have these abayas made in various lengths, and make links on their page for each so that one could choose the length that would be most appropriate for one's height. I didn't see that kind of choice on the page that advertised this garment.

I'd like to thank Mogul Interior for processing the refund for this dress as soon as they received it.

product_title: Karen Neuburger Women's Plus-Size Long Pant Plus
review_body:
These are nice pants for lounging around the house in, but they could definitely be improved upon a bit.

I will say that the fabric is very soft and comfortable. The waist is nice and stretchy and they are great to relax in. They have held up nicely after being washed a lot too, though I have seen a few pills starting to form over the last wash or two.

I found them to run a bit larger than expected, so you may want to consider ordering a size smaller than the size chart suggests. The fabric has some stretch to it, so the pants seem to get bigger the more they have been worn as well. I tried washing them in hot water and putting them in the dryer, but they did not shrink down much for me. I don't mind the bagginess if I am just inside the house though, so I am still able to get use out of them.

I am a bit short at 5ft2, so if you are petite in stature you may end up stepping on the bottom on them. I am used to this with my clothing, but if you are a person who does not care for this, you may need to hem them slightly to make them the correct length.

I enjoy wearing them on my lazy days, but for me I don't think I would leave the house in them.

review_headline: Great Coat for a Very Picky Fella
review_body: I wanted to write a review for this coat as I spent a great deal of time researching coats similar to this one and found that it was difficult making a commitment based on sizes and other user reviews. I was in the hunting for a pea coat for a couple months, but I did not want to spend outrageous amounts of money on one. My searching lead me to this product. At first I was wary because of the odd sizing (Japanese vs. American) due to how some other reviewers claimed that it fit them. I am 6'1 and about 175 pounds. I chose to go with the US Large (XX-L in Japan). I have what I would consider a long torso and I am fairly muscular in my arms and shoulders (I'm no Schwarzenegger but I'm not a skinny twig liable to blow away in the wind either). I've found that the coat fits perfectly. It's not too tight in the shoulders, it's the perfect length to my waist, and the sleeves reach just a smidge past my wrists. I find it to be quite warm - coming from a person living in Upstate New York - and I can fit a sweatshirt underneath if I choose to do so. I'm no expert on material quality, so I can't really comment on that, but it seems suitable enough to last me for a few years. It also looks great, I shouldn't fail to mention that. Overall, I am incredibly pleased with this purchase. Great value.

product_title: K-Way Claude Full Zip Jacket
review_headline: Kway jackets are not waterproof and they think people are confused by the term "waterproof"
review_body:
I've had a surprisingly disappointing experience with Kway and the company's customer service. Did you know that their jackets are not 100% waterproof as they declare? According to Matt Feigin, the president of Kway, there are many definitions of waterproof and much confusion around what waterproof means. Apparently a "100% waterproof" jacket by Kway isn't waterproof if you walk in moderate rain for 12 minutes. It confused the president of Kway that someone would buy waterproof jackets and think that their shoulders wouldn't be drenched after a 12 minute walk in some rain.

Here's the response I got when I told Kway in an email that I was disappointed with my purchase of buying rain jackets for my entire family and would there be any way to resolve my problem:

Hi kathy,

I am very sorry to hear that you had a bad kway experience. The term waterproof is commonly confused. There are many different types of waterproofing and many different levels of waterproof. The classic jacket is treated with 1500 mm's of water proofing. That means that in a 24hour period only 1500 mm of water can fall on the jacket before it starts seeping through the jacket.

Unfortunately there is nothing that we can do for this matter. We can however suggest you a more waterproof jacket and offer you a nice discount on that product.

Thank you in advanced for understanding.

Matt Feigin
K-Way President

product_title: TeeHee Women's Fashion No Show Fun Socks 6 Pairs Packs
review_headline: Clip the floats on inside for a better fit!
review_body:
These are nice stretchy, light weight socks to wear with sandals, slides or tennis shoes and give a whimsical touch to your feet. The reason I did not give the socks a 5 star rating is minor and fixable but should not have happened. I bought 3 orders of these socks and not all of them in each order had this problem but you will know when you go to put the socks on.

You might find that one or both socks of a particular design will not go over the foot because they are too tight! Turn the socks inside out and you will see float threads that have not been cut that cross over some of the bigger designs. Imagine a white sock with blue dots. The white stretchy yarns \\"float\\" over the blue and then pick back up the knitting where the white begins. Take a pair of scissors and run under the white threads and snip. This will release the white floats and allow the sock to stretch like it should. The inside of the sock might look like a hairy mess but don't trim away the thread because they will snag onto each other when washed and keep the socks from unraveling. Problem solved.

Update: 7-14-14
Liked these so much I ordered 3 more packages. BTW, there is no additional charge for shipping if you order several packages at one time which is nice.

product_title: Oakley Glasses 3153 Silver and Black Panel Rectangle Sunglasses
review_body:
These frames get me comments and compliments everywhere, every day. They are hard to pin down in terms of style genre but if pressed I'd probably call them industrial. They are strong to the point of absurdity, made from a lightweight metal alloy that is sometimes called "raw" but in reality is tumbled to a uniform matte finish. They will still reflect a lot of light in photographs though, making the frames seem to jump off your face when photographed with a flash in a darker room. This finish is not a coating but more of a texture so it does not show scratches or nicks like a darker color might. Also the finish cannot flake or peel, which is nice if you keep glasses a long time like I do.

The frames are offered in 2 widths, 53 and 55. I had both frames shipped to a local specialist and tried both sizes before settling on the 55's. Be warned! If the bridge of your nose is narrow you'll probably have trouble keeping these on your face. They have the characteristic Oakley fit, meaning the side rails do not hook over your ears but instead provide an even pressure to the side of your head. Combine that with a narrow nose bridge and this frame will slide down your nose constantly!

If you want a distinctive and bold frame that will draw attention and compliments, these frames will get the job done and last for years to come. Be brave!

product_title: Donna Morgan Women's Strapless Sweetheart Dress with Full Skirt
review_headline: Beautiful dress with one minor issue.
review_body:
This is a beautiful dress but it didn't flatter my figure. I'm a little curvy (size M, about 150 pounds) so maybe it's just meant for someone thinner than me.

The material is somewhat thick, which would be fine except this dress is STRAPLESS. The fabric adds a lot of weight to the dress, and I felt like it was not secured properly on my body (it felt like the weight, which is primarily in the skirt, pushed the dress down). All in all, I think heavy fabric ruins the flirty look this dress is meant to have (just an opinion).

However, the reason I took off one star is because of the underskirt. It's made of rough, scratchy material that causes the skirt to poof out a little too much (again, just a personal opinion). I owned petticoats in the past, which served the purpose of making the skirt full but were also comfy at the same time. So, in this case it seems as though the designer(s) sacrificed the material for function (which is to give the skirt a full look). If I were to keep the dress, I'd most likely take out the underskirt and/or replace it with a simpler (and softer!) petticoat but that's just my personal preference.

Lastly: the length of the dress was much longer on me because I'm shorter than the model (I'm about 5'4"-5'5").

product_title: Levi's Men's Big-Tall Ace Cargo Twill Pant
review_headline: Close replacement for the old Big and Tall Cargos...but not quite the quality...but will work I guess.
review_body:
Overall these are much better than I honestly expected after getting stuck with 2 pairs of black ace cargos that were skinny cut or something and hold lint to the point that they're unwearable. I wore one pair once and haven't been able to de-lint them enough to wear them outside in the sun since. The other pair sit there in the packaging still. Which is insane considering how much I paid for them.

These however are a different animal. I don't know if they're version 2.0 or what but they're much better. No more skinny cut but still not the old comfy loose fit I preferred of the old cargos. I too wish there were more color options. I've become quite known for my khaki cargo pants as they're all I wear because I require the pockets, and they're just so comfortable. I've had people ask if I own just one pair of pants lol...nope I have 4 of them and a few pairs of jeans but I wear the crap out of the khakis. At this point I could probably be talked out of $100 for a new pair of the old cargos especially if the came in different colors.

I'm considering stocking up on these because I'm scared they too will disappear. And at $23 a pair they're hard to beat.

They seem to fit a bit loose in the waist but are a bit roomier to me in the crotch area...much appreciated. While the buttons aren't as nice as the metal ones on the old cargos they're better than the noisy rattling metal snaps on the first iteration of the ACE cargos. I'm not sure if I like the "hidden" back pockets vs. the pockets that were sewn on to the outside of the pants but they may be more durable of a design I had a pair rip there. If you're a big guy like me I'd recommend having an extra layer of material sewn onto the outside of the inner thigh as that's where all my old cargos eventually failed due to thigh rub. It took a long time, but they all eventually fail there. So on my last couple pairs I caught on and ironed on a khaki patch plate there and it seems to be doing the job but sewing works much much better.

In summary, they're close but not the same but good enough until levis decides to remake the old cargos. Especially for the price. Buy them cheap and stack them deep my friends. Hopefully we'll get some more colors.

product_title: GEORGE BRIDE Simple Sexy Strap Chiffon Beach Wedding Dress/Evening Dress
review_body:
I saw this dress online and thought I would give it a try. Even though it didn't have any reviews, the company seemed to have a lot of very positive reviews. I am 5'2" and 120 lbs, my measurements are 34 bust, 28 waist, 39 hips. Since my measurements did not exactly fit into any of the sizes, I ordered a size 8 (36 bust, 28 waist, 38.5 hips). The day after I placed my order I received an email asking for my measurements and giving me an expected shipment date (30 days from the order date). I sent the measurements. The next day I received a confirmation email and a reply from them telling me that this dress is made for someone who is 5'9" and that it wont fit me very well length wise since they can only adjust the measurements by 2 inches. Also, since my measurements did not fit exactly in all categories that they could use my measurements but it would be considered "custom" and I would not be able to return the dress. I told them that I understand that and to make the dress with my measurements and to shorten it by the allowed 2". I figured with the two inches and my heals it couldn't be that bad.

The dress actually shipped about 10 days earlier then they stated in their email and it only took about 5 days to arrive (from China), so I was pretty excited and waited around home all day since the shipment required a signature. After I received it, I tried it on. It fit. But it was VERY Snug around the waist. The zipper is very stiff and hard to use, I even had help and they had a hard time with the zipper. As expected the outer skirt is long and does hit the ground and would be very easy to trip on. As I am looking in the mirror the skirt around my hips seemed out of place, like it was sticking out. So I pulled up the outer skirt to take a closer look and sure enough the seem looks odd and out of place. I am not exactly sure why, but it looks like the seem is fitted perfectly until it gets to the hips and then it sticks out about 2 inches on one side and about an inch or so on the other side. Then as I am looking at the body, there is some pleating/folded material and that seems out of place on one side as well. So as I look closer it seems that maybe it was not stitched down correctly? and last but not least the bust fits loosely.

So, my conclusion is since I am unable to return my "custom" dress I am now having to pay for alterations. The bust will need to be a tad smaller, the waist let out a little bit so I can breath, the pleating needs to be fixed so it lays correctly, the skirt shorted so I do not trip over it, and the hip seems to be smoothed down so they don't stick out. I am hopeful that there is something that can be done with the zipper to make it easier to use. The dress overall seems like the material is of good quality, the dress (other then the mentioned) seems to be well made. The price is reasonable enough so I am not too mad about the alterations, but I am glad that I have enough time to get them done.

My advise would be: Don't order a dress online if you are in a hurry. Expect there to be some sort of alteration that will need to be done and plan your purchase accordingly.

review_body:
I've bought 4 different accordion wallets on Amazon and I prefer the one made by Buxton.
Why?

Credit card slots:
Buxton: 11
Alpine: 6

The credit card slots on the Buxton are slim enough that you can see all of your cards easily. On the Alpine, the slots are so wide and deep that your cards are buried. Yes, you can fit more than one card in each slot on the Alpine, but they're still not as visible as in the Buxton.

The Buxton is smaller and it's shape doesn't malform when you cram a bunch of cards into it and zip it.

2nd Zippered area:
Buxton: 3 slots
Alpine: 2 slots

The zipper on my last Buxton broke after a few years of use, and I bought the Alpine as there were more color choices, but I think the Buxton is a superior product and will buy that on my next wallet purchase.

product_title: NickelFreeBelts Men's Distressed Nickel Free Belt
review_body:
I've ordered belts from this company before, and I've always had good experiences. This belt, however, certainly does not live up to the "no-nickel" hype. Though the belt buckle is nickel-free, the rivets that bind the leather together to create the belt buckle loop (in the leather) do not appear to be nickel-free. How do I know? Because after a couple days wearing this belt, the tell-tale signs of my nickel allergy flared up on my waist and stomach. I could even match the bumps to the three rivets that caused them!

Perhaps I'm more sensitive to nickel than other reviewers. However, it's clear this belt is not nickel-free as the description claims. I typically don't post reviews, good or bad, but I wanted to warn others who are ultra-sensitive to nickel about the rivets.

product_title: FX's Archer Tuxedo Shirt
review_headline: Page Dr. Loggins cuz you're in the DANGER ZOOOOONNNNNEEEEE!!!!!!!!
review_body: Okay so first off this shirt is super dorky. It's not as dorky as the old tuxedo shirts, you know the ones that were white with a little black bowtie at the top. It's not that dorky but this shirt is still dorky and that's why I love it. The shirt looks more like a cartoon than a real suit (which it's supposed too since Archer is an animated tv show) I had wanted one of these for awhile and I saw all the Doctor Who ones but wanted one that was less mainstream (I love doctor who but I see the doctor who suit shirts everywhere). Well I saw this one and since Archer is one of my favorite comedies of all time I had to buy it. First off shipping was amazing, I thought originally that since the shipping was free it would take forever to get here. Nope. I ordered it Wednesday and it got here today (Saturday). The shirt is actually dyed so it's not printed on which I like and it is immensely comfortable. Now however to the cons. The company that makes them is Ripple Junction and since I'm a geek I own a good amount of Ripple Junction items. They don't last long. At all.  The material on the shirt is very thin (see through thin) and not very good quality. Which means take good care of it and don't wear it too often because you might only get 10 maybe 11 washes out of it before it starts to totally fall apart. The shirt is very lightweight and comfortable to wear and it looks cool I'm just warning you that Ripple Junction products don't last long at all. I've never had a ripple junction shirt that I wore regularly last more than a year, and a year is stretching it. Bottom line. The Shirt is dorky but cute and it's Archer I mean c'mon Danger Zone!!!!! Great Shirt and the price is way better here than on the website. The Archer website wants 30 bucks for it, Amazon only wants 18. Great shirt. I love it. Will buy again.

review_body: UPDATED REVIEW  After just one year -- and I *don't* wear them every day, more like once a week -- these are falling apart. I don't expect to replace my entire wardrobe every year, so this lifespan is completely unacceptable IMHO.  I hadn't had them long before I noticed some thin spots in the fabric opening up into holes. Oh well, I thought, maybe I scraped it on something. But now one of the rear pocket's seams have let go. Fortunately I only lost a comb and not my wallet.  Also the legs tend to ride up and I have to keep pulling them back down.  All in all I wouldn't buy another pair now, despite what I said earlier (below).  ORIGINAL REVIEW  When I first tried these on, they were a little tight, especially in the crotch area. In fact there is a label tag attached that says "slim fit".  Oh and if you see "Size Name: 32W x 32L" next to my review, that was put there by Amazon, not me. The size I actually ordered was 34W x 30L -- and the tag on the pants says 34x30 so I didn't accidentally get a too-small size -- but even 34 ran small compared to my other size 34 pants.  But after washing and wearing a couple times they seem OK now. The blue tends a little more to drab grey than I would have liked. Still, I'd buy another pair if they had them in stock -- and if they hadn't raised the price ten bucks.

review_headline: This dress was pretty much perfect!
review_body:
I bought this dress to wear to my company holiday party this year. I wasn't entirely sure what to expect because the dress was so cheap, and I usually have a lot of trouble finding something that fits both my hips and waist, but it was nearly perfect!

The material is a little bit odd, but it looks great and is super comfy. The best I can describe it is that it's similar to a heavier-weight athletic shirt material. It's very soft and has a lot of stretch to it.

The length of this dress is what originally attracted me to it. I'm on the tall side and I have trouble finding dresses that aren't really short, or floor-length. This hit me at the knee, which was perfect.

I highly suggest reading and trusting the size chart. I'm so skeptical of sizing charts because I have an hourglass figure and things never seem to fit across my hips correctly when I buy the right size for my waist. Even though it stretches, buy the size for your largest part. I bought a medium, and if I had had more time between receiving my dress and going to the party, I would have had the waist taken in just a little bit, but it was still fine as it was.

Overall, great dress, especially for the price. It arrived quickly and looked great!

product_title: New Solid Winter Long Beanie - Neon Yellow 1pc
review_headline: Mildew and Neon yellow is much brighter than picture suggests
review_body:
I bought the neon yellow for a costume because I thought gold would be too dark. However the neon is more neon than the picture implies, like highlighter yellow. It will work okay, but if I had time I would have tried to find a replacement. The yarn is that cheap acrylic that's slightly scratchy, but at $4 what do you expect?

The biggest issue is that upon opening the package I was overwhelmed with the smell of mildew. There is no discoloration, but the hat reeks. It is currently in the washing machine (in a delicates bag), as a hand washing was not sufficient to remove the smell. The seems inside the hat are cheap and I'm worried it might come apart. I will update this review if it does.

If you have mold allergies, AVOID THIS SELLER. They obviously have no moisture controls in their warehouse. Also, the packaging was quite cheap and had holes ripped in it. The hat was not even in a clear plastic bag within the outer plastic mailing pocket. Perhaps this is how it became mildewy, as they don't store the hats in individual bags...

product_title: Bell'O TV Stand Contemporary 65" wide Espresso Finish Wood A/V Cabinet High Q...
review_body:
This is a well designed, beautiful piece of furniture.

PRO'S
Very pretty, with a \\"WOW\\" factor.

CON'S
1. I read a lot of reviews before making this purchase. Nowhere has anyone mentioned that the large \\"wood\\" pieces are actually made of Particle board with a veneer. I like everything about wood. I like the way it smells, and feels, and looks and lasts. I wanted solid wood to match all my other furniture. I was extremely disappointed to see it is made of a lot of Particle board.
2. While well designed, it is put together much sloppier than I would have expected. All the exterior surfaces look very nice. But when you look past that, to areas that cannot be seen, you will find sloppy glue joints and staples. In addition, while the doors are adjustable (very nice hinges), the hinges have been so sloppily drilled and installed that you will never get \\"perfection\\" in the door alignment.
3. The wheels. OMG...what were they thinking? The wheels are almost useless. First, they will only allow the cabinet to be moved \\"in and out\\" after getting it directly lined up with where it needs to go. If you try to move this thing sideways you will either destroy the wheels or your floor, or both. Secondly, the wheels are so narrow (about 3/16\\") that they will likely leave a groove in all but the hardest of floors.

I would not buy this again because I love real wood so much, and am willing to pay for it. However it is beautiful, so I guess I will keep it.

If you buy this, turn it over and take the wheels off immediately. I have hardwood floors, so I glued strips of carpet to all the weight points. It now slides easily. If you have carpet, they make \\"sliders\\" that work well.

I gave it 4 stars in spite of my CON's, because it is hard to find quality furniture. And I suspect this is about as good as it gets nowadays.

review_headline: Loved it at first, but then...
review_body:
Love the wallet, perfect size, love the hard shell, the look, etc. But then the little cardholders inside the wallet started to break (right now only 1 is still intact after 2 months), so any time I open it there is a danger of cards sliding out. Usually this wouldn't happen because you'd be holding it upright, but still, it's annoying and the sleeves should be higher quality. It's a solvable problem - if I'm feeling creative one day I might jerry rig some kind of solution out of string to hold it together, or I could be ghetto and use scotch tape - but it's still a bit disappointing since I love the wallet otherwise. A couple of other notes, though - the outside does scratch quite easily (wish they had a matte finish instead!), and everyone is correct in complaining that it explodes and sends your cards flying everywhere if you drop it.

UPDATE: Customer service was very fast to respond to my warranty claim with a replacement wallet! I still can't give it a higher rating, bc I don't want to keep having to have my wallet replaced, but if the sleeves in this one have been improved and stay together I will gladly upgrade to 5 stars.

product_title: Champion Men's Open Bottom Light Weight Jersey pants
review_headline: Waistband not a problem for me:
review_body: The wider elastic waistband is what they put on a lot of women's untailored pants, which, since I'm a woman, is probably why I didn't even notice the change in these pants, and why it doesn't bother me - as a woman, I've come to expect all kinds of \\"innovations\\" in waistbands, some good, most bad.  I use these in a size small for casual around the house and garden stuff, and they fit me fine.  They were long before I washed them, but after one wash and dry, they hit the top of my foot - I'm 5'4\\" and wear a woman's 31\\" inseam - so I guess if you're long legged you'll like these as far as length goes.  My husband wears a medium or large in these and he's 5'11\\" and the inseam is okay for him, too, after washing.  So, as I said, we like these lightweight jersey pants for very casual wear, we find them comfortable, and durable (haven't found any problem with the waistband unraveling).  Like most all clothing nowadays, it's hard to figure out what size you ought to order or what size the clothes will turn out to be after washing - it's a pain in the arse, but as far as these pants go, in our house, they do what we expected them to do, so we're pleased.  It's a crapshoot: you won't know if you'll like them until you try them out for yourself.  Just bear in mind re: the length, they do shrink several inches, not much in width.  Good luck.  Hope you get a good pair, one that you like.

product_title: Hanes Men's 10-Pack Crew Socks
review_headline: Fits and feels as expected so far,however............................

**7/17 update**

Several months later and heavy use, and these Socks stand up to the test of time and hard work they get put through on a daily basis. They may not be sold as heavy duty, or intended as such, but these are heavy duty for me. I know several months does not seem like a long time for Socks, but when you are a heavy aggressive user/wearer like I am, you would understand, that it means a lot to have a sock last a while without any holes and still fit close to the day you 1st bought them.

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

So far these are fitting as expected for the most part. The material seems, or feels anyways, a little too thin. However, I'm not going to cast judgement just yet. I wanted to post up an initial review, as I'm actually satisfied so far and for the purposes of posting longevity and to help or assist others with knowing how long or what they can expect in terms of durability of these over the long term. So basically life expectancy more or less. lol

Example being, how they fit and feel within the 1st 2 weeks versus, 3 - 6 months from now on how they are feeling or holding up.

Also, this is a great deal/steal for the price as well. MUCH better than Wally World, thats for sure.

product_title: Wolf Anime Hood Faux Fur Hat With Warm Mitten Scarfs and Paw Print 3 in 1 Function
review_headline: Slightly dark, droopy eared, but still AWESOME
review_body:
I'm thrilled to have this hood!
The hood I received DID have a button and loop to hook the scarf arms right at my collar bone.
It DID have pockets at the end of the scarf for my hands. The pockets are comfortable, very soft and warm.
My hood DOES has the paw prints and no claws as per the picture.
The lining of the hood and scarf arms is black and very soft. The pads have a nice hairless, rough feel that I find charming.
The outer fur portion is just slightly coarse but still pleasantly cuddly.
The hood looks AMAZING as a scarf and I can't wait for warmer weather so I can wear this everywhere!

That being said:
One of the ears seems to be sewn differently than the other, it's depressingly droopy. A simple stitch to put a kink in the ear should fix the problem and create that perky look I wanted.
There seems to be an EXCESS of hood around the face. Perhaps come winter temps I will appreciate this. At this time however I am contemplating how hard it may be to trim & sew some of the excess material so that my face has a wider opening. I will wait for winter to decide however.
Finally the coloring is not quite what I expected. From the Picture I was expecting more of a black and white for a brighter overall sort of silvery look. What I received was a gray and black for a darker overall gray look.

product_title: Crooks & Castles Men's Sultan Buttondown Shirt
review_headline: Sorry to say but disappointed by quality
review_body:
I ordered this shirt as a splurge for a large New Years Eve party. This has a very bold pattern particularly around the neck. The first one of these I got the very distinctive black collar was off center. Because it is so bold you really notice it. I sent it back for an exchange (this was all handled very professionally) but my replacement came with the same problem. If I spend over $100. on a shirt I expect the pattern to be sewn to perfection. If you look carefully at the model in their online photograph you can see the issue I'm talking about.

This a very bold, dynamic pattern, unfortunately I do not believe there is much going on with quality contra (in my replacement shirt the black collar is 1" wider on the right than on the left). One last thing there are little pattern elements in the black collar that are completely pell mel and if anyone is looking closely also lend to the appearance of a shirt made without much regard to detail.

AX Paris Women's Giant Heart Knit Black Sweater
review_body:
I am 5'6, medium/thin (size 4, usually a small) with wide hips, and I bought a medium/small.
PROS:
Soft, durable, washed perfectly with no shrinking or damage. The sleeves are long enough to pull over my hands but not annoyingly long (perfect for me, and I have decently long arms). Very warm.
CONS:
Not as elegant as I hoped it would be.
It stretches rather quickly and begins to look unflatteringly baggy after a few hours of wearing it.
Because of the thick fabric, you don't get that cute silhouette that hints at a figure beneath- this just puffs out (which can look good on some shapes, but my waist gets totally lost in this since my hips are much wider).
The heart is more of a beige than a white, which makes it look just slightly grungy, but in a stylish way- my point is, I bought a deep red flower necklace to pair with this because I thought the heart was whiter, and that rich color clashes with this. This calls for more subdued pastels, the ones that look more vintage and washed out.

I would buy it again, but this will be a fun lounge-around-the-house kind of cute for me, not something I wear to look fashionable.

review_body: First review I've written here but as someone who always has an issue buying pants I feel compelled to since it seems my search for work pants has finally ended. I went with this style based on reviews. Usually have a problem with pants fitting properly in the legs and waist without it looking like I'm sagging my pants if worn low, or if pants are worn at the waist it just looks really bad if in the back because I have a rather small butt. I'm 5'10 !60 lbs with 30" waist and the 32" 32" fits perfectly all 3 pairs when sitting below the waist which is how they are supposed to sit. There is some flex in the fabric and the cargo pockets sit flat enough to where they are barely noticeable. My job requires me to carry more than I can fit in normal pockets and I need move around alot while looking at least a little professional. They are a little tighter in the thighs then I would normally prefer but the slight stretch in the fabric makes it tolerable. Cell phone pocket fits i phone 5s in otterbox case almost perfectly, anything bigger might be an issue. Wash and dry permanent press setting and they come out wrinkle free. As someone else said if you have any junk in the trunk you may want to look elsewhere. Order for hip size not waist size otherwise I could see fit being an issue. Only reasons I didn't give 5 stars is the ugly dickies tag which removes easily, just cut outer threads with an exacto knife. Only other complaint is that fly is short so you have to unbutton to do your business. If you have a slender build these should work for you. Hell I actually have been complimented on my pants by women when wearing these which has never happened before. Even my girlfriend who has no problems criticizing me for my fashion choices complimented me saying said they looked really good. I never would have  thought a 25 dollar pair of dickies could get that done!
