product_title: Batman "Future Hero" Black 2-Pack Infant Bodysuit Set
review_headline: Warning---Objects in Mirror are much SMALLER than they appear (i.e., 18 months = 3-6 months, maybe)
review_body:
I am writing because I don't want other people to be duped.

This was supposed to be a part of my nephew's Christmas gift. I am disappointed. I followed the recommendation of reviewers that they ran small. Normally, I'd have ordered the next size up from his size, which is 12 months, but I ordered the NEXT larger... the 18 month size is too small...they look to be 3-6 month size. The material is thin, soft but way too small....order up a few sizes. I am going to ask my sister if she wants me to order the 24 month size for my soon to be 4 month "normal-sized" baby nephew. In case you think this one is a fluke, I also ordered the other Batman Bodysuit Set (the one with one long and one short sleeved body suit) in Size 18 months....same thing...same size...too small. So, now I have 4 that are too small.

Wow....Disappointment :( for me....BUT this would be a great item for a Baby Shower or Infant Gift...in that case, I'd give these 5 stars because they are a cute novelty.

I believe in truth in advertising...

PS...I bought the Batman bib set that matches the body suits...CUTE, but the booties are newborn infant size...WARNING. The Batman Bib is cute, but I wish the booties or socks were larger. Great gift for a Baby Shower.

product_title: Nation LTD Violet Women's Evelyn Tee
review_body:
For reference, my bust is around 39 inches, waist is 31 inches. I typically wear a size 10, and this fits wonderfully. This is not a loose fit on me like it is on the model since I'm quite a bit bigger, but it IS a lovely fit. I have proportionally larger arms so the arms border on being a little tight, but elsewhere it fits just right -- not loose but not too tight, just the right amount to accentuate everything for a nice, casual, flattering look. Looks great with jeans or thick winter leggings. I love these one-size Nation LTD tops(previously got the Olivia tee -- http://smile.amazon.com/Nation-Violet-Womens-Olivia-White/dp/B00DYZ9I8S/ref=cm_cr-mr-title), because I know they'll still work as I attempt to lose a few more pounds.

I think in terms of fit, as I said in my review of the Olivia tee, it will probably work for someone who is up to a size 14. Any larger and you will probably have trouble fitting in the arm/bust area, though the waist is very forgiving. Overall, for the price it's absolutely worth a shot.

Do be careful to wash it inside out and hang dry. I had a bad pilling situation with one of the Olivia tees when I wasn't careful about how I washed it. But it's not too much trouble to hang dry, definitely worth it.

product_title: NoeMie Women's Body Silk Comfortably Nursing Bra
review_body: I normally wear a 34 D or DD before pregnancy depending on the brand and model and sometimes do ok with a 36D -although the bands tend to be too big for me in the 36. Based on other reviews of this model and the fact that during pregnancy and with nursing my breast become a little bigger (based on my personal previous experience), I ordered this bra in a 36 D. The band is good for me in a 36, so I guess it is close to true size, slightly on the tighter side like previous reviews of this brand/model have informed. However, the fit of the cup also runs a little small. I wished I had ordered the 36DD because this barely fits in the 36D before the let down and I have questions about how it would fit in a different size too. For sure, this bra in this size will not fit me when my breast get full.  The model/cut is almost a demi (balcony) style, with padding in the inside layer, which doesn't really show well in the picture and is not the most convenient for breast feeding, in my opinion. The bra will not grow or adapt well with the passing of the hours as your breast changes from being empty to being ready to feed again.  The top layer is elastic and soft, but the cup does not have enough room to expand and cover the breast fully. And the padding part may get in the way of a baby latching...I have to explain also that the sizing info in the bra itself do not let me know if they sent the correct size or if they have a problem with the conversion. It shows European/Japanese sizing, saying it's an 80E. Based on some online sources, this seems correct. But, like I said, this is a tight for a 36D, in my opinion, closer to a 36C or even a 34D. And, since it's a nursing bra, you probably want to order it in a little bigger than your regular size. I do not know if I should exchange this bra for another size or order a totally different bra because, although the fabric is soft and model are really cute, I am not sure about how much coverage I will get in the bigger size either. Iam fully busted, so I prefer the fuller coverage, especially when my breast are going to be changing multiple times through the day and getting quite full in a matter of a couple of days. The other issue is related to the shipping. It was hard to estimate when the bra would arrive. After I ordered it I noticed that they had an estimate date range that was quite wide and at least a month after I ordered it! So, I went ahead and ordered a different bra in the meantime, which arrived sooner and its a better fit (a more expensive medela bra). This one ended up arriving a couple of weeks before the delivery estimate shows as  starting date... I am a little disappointed because it is very hard to find nursing bras with wire and no padding (or little) in the bigger sizes and there is something very cute and comfy about this one.  But it does have some padding and it runs a little bit small. So be aware. If your breasts are big and you like the fuller coverage, this bra may not be for you. If you decide to rider ir anyways, maybe sure you go a little bigger in the cup too. The band issue is less of a problem because they also send and extension band for this bra, that I do not need but could come in handy for other people if it's a little too tight.  This is probably a good bra and model for someone with a smaller cup size tan me, and especially if you are going to be pumping more...

review_headline: Descriptions can be deceiving! Read before ordering
review_body:
I am a plus-sized woman and ordered this because the description says it fits up to a 2X. Well, it may fit \\"plus-sized\\" girls where it's manufactured but it does NOT fit plus-sized girls where I come from. I normally wear about a size 22, depending on how the garment is made.
Ordering a cincher or corset can be tricky because they're ALL adjustable to fit nearly any body- even the tiny ones that are intended for very thin women. But that doesn't necessarily mean they're intended to fit larger women; it just means that they *could* fit a larger woman *if* you adjust it enough. If you're a plus-sized woman looking for a pretty cincher that fits properly, this is NOT the cincher for you.
Having said that- I gave it five stars because if you are a thin woman looking for a beautifully made cincher, this one may be for you. The pictures don't do it justice; it really is beautiful. It also came with a matching g-string that wasn't advertised. I ended up giving it to a friend of mine who wears a size 3 and it fits her perfectly.

review_body:
I've been looking through a lot of different "Korean" styled backpacks and eventually settled on this one because it sounded large enough to fit all of my school materials and also, most of the reviews stated that it was pretty sturdy. I'm happy to confirm that and say that I love the canvas-like outer material, it also seems waterproof because when you run things over it (like a notebook sliding over it or even just your hand as you go to unzip a compartment), it definitely sounds and feels like it could be waterproof. I love the padded straps and the two pockets on the outer part of the backpack. Inside there's plenty of room for all my folders and notebooks and I love the dedicated laptop section with the velco strap to keep it in place.

Just as a size reference, I fit my 13" MacBook Pro in the laptop section, a folder, a notebook, the charger, a tin pencil case, another pencil bag, and a Nook HD in it perfectly fine. There was still a little bit of leeway for more items. In the zipper pouch on the outside, I have my thick wallet and a sunglasses case. In the zipper pocket in front of the pouch, I've got my iPod, headphones, transit pass and house keys. The front pocket can get a bit tight when you put thicker items in the pouch, but that's to be expected. The khaki color is a bit darker in person but I love the pop the turquoise gives it. I would definitely recommend this bag for anyone, including students!

review_body:
I'm 6' 2" and 240 pounds. I was mistakenly shipped the STANDARD size, and was worried about the fit as I ordered the X-LARGE. I was happy when I discovered the STANDARD fit was perfect for me. I was worried the standard size fit wouldn't fit my broad torso. I'm not super chubby, just an aging rugby player, but if your tall/thick, the standard size might fit you nicely. I would guess if you're 6' 4" or taller, you're going to have a case of "camel hoof" because when I raise my shoulders up high, my voice goes up an octave.

The quality of the costume far exceeds some of the more budget friendly Chewie costumes. If you comb/brush the fur the wrong way, you it would appear that Chewbacca is losing his hair. This costume sheds a lot too.

Overall, I'm happy with it, especially with the Cyber Monday deal I scored. It looks like it'll be a Star Wars family themed Halloween for years to come.

product_title: Fruit of the Loom Women's Plus-Size Non-Binding Brief Panties
review_body:
Sweet Jeezus, are these amazing. I don't wear underwear. They're just way too uncomfortable, and I wear shorts under everything that isn't pants, so it's a non-issue. But I needed something new for moontime wear, and my microfiber undies were just not working. First of all, the synthetic fabric would break me out. They'd also wear out very easily. That's a big issue, especially since I only wear undies just under one week at a time!

I use cloth, reusable pads. They can bleed through sometimes, and microfiber (polyester) doesn't hold liquid. NIGHTMARE. These, on the other hand, absorb liquid because they're 90% cotton. It gives me time to fill a pad before I need to change everything. It's great.

I've just ordered my second pack. I ordered assorted both times. My first pack was tan, pink, and a really neat pink/white design. It's like Christmas!

product_title: VOBAGA Women's Princess Style Unique Poncho loose Hood Jacket Outerwear
review_body:
A disclaimer first: I bought this poncho from eBay. The product I got, as did the picture that the seller I bought it from was using, matches the pictures shown on Amazon.

For the most part the poncho matches the picture shown (I got the red one). The only difference is the fur around the hat isn't as fluffy or light as the picture (I'm not sure if that will change after washing it however) and the fabric lining the interior is a different type of material and different color. The lining interior is made of a silky type of material (which can be stifling/hot). Also the amount of fabric in the sleeve (not the silky fabric) is only around 3 inches wide, so if you hold your arm in a certain way, the silky fabric shows. Also there is no zipper or hidden buttons to close the poncho, just the two black strings/wooden hook things the picture shows. They look fine, similar to the picture, but they don't really close the front of the poncho very closely. That is if you were to lean forward, what you're wearing underneath ends up showing. Not sure if this applies to the other colors because the blue one shows some hidden buttons.

Now an issue about the sizing. I ended up getting an XL because of my shoulders (they're about 15.5\\" across) and the seller measured the shoulder width about 16.5\\" or so. Because of the seller's disclaimer about sizing, I went ahead and got the XL, although when I got it, the shoulders were about 1\\" too long on both sides. I didn't measure the length or the arm diameter, but I'm 5'5\\" and the XL hits mid-thigh. My suggestion here is to take into consideration the exact measurements that the seller gives (either here or on eBay) and compare it to your own personal measurements to find the appropriate size, rather than picking a size that you would normally fit into.

Similar to what others were saying the material is kind of thin. It's made of a type of felt material so it doesn't look very \\"high quality\\" or whatnot butit still looks nice and cute. It isn't as stiff looking as the pictures show.

Lastly shipping didn't take too long, about 1.5 weeks.

Overall the product matches the pictures pretty closely, measure yourself and compare to the measurements the seller provides to find the right fit, and make sure the seller provides updates on the product (in terms of shipping and estimated date of arrival). Happy shopping!

review_body:
I purchased this corset to wear as part of a queen of hearts costume. For the price, I'm pleased with it. Its higher quality than I expected. Some reviewers have said the zipper is sticky, but mine is fine. The material is very pretty -- shiny with rich color. Its stiff and has boning, and does a great job shaping my midsection, but I wish it offered more support in the bust. The panty that comes with it is a triangle of the same stiff material with some elastic straps; I will never wear it.

Like other people are saying, this ~definitely~ runs small. I'm glad I read the other reviews. I normally wear a medium top and a 34DD bra. I bought this in an XXL and it fits perfect. The laces in the back are quite long, making this very adjustable. Unlike the corset shown in the "how to wear your corset" photo, this one does not have a panel behind the laces, so it will be open in the back if you can't lace it completely tight.

The description says it arrives by epacket. I didn't know what that meant. Mine arrived in an unpadded plastic envelope that the mailman stuffed into my mailbox, which I was unhappy about because this has boning. I would have paid to have it packaged with more care. But it wasn't damaged and arrived a month early, so no complaints.

Overall, its a nice costume piece and a good deal for the price.

review_headline: Nice dress, but not good service for custom made dress
review_body:
We ordered this dress for my wife to use on a wedding on October 4; the order was placed on September 11 and we paid expedited shipping and it still made it late on October 7. She wanted to keep it still, but when she tried it on, the top of the dress was huge (like 4 sizes bigger) and it was too long! We contacted them to try to solve the issue and they said that it was our fault; we measured as indicated in the picture and the rest of the measurements were correct. Their final response was to send it back and we would have to pay shipping back to China and 30% restocking fee. It is unfortunate that they don't have a way to double check the measurements or offer to fix it since it is their fault.

The dress itself is good, but if it the standard size doesn't fit; don't buy the custom made, even if they make a mistake you will lose 30% of the cost and you'll have to pay shipping to china for them to refund your money.

product_title: Eddie Bauer Girls' Sweater (More Styles Available)
review_headline: Expected better quality from Eddie Bauer
review_body:
Years ago, we used to purchase a lot of clothing from Eddie Bauer. It was a little more expensive, but the clothing lasted. I have an EB sweatshirt that must be at least 20 years old and still going strong. This sweater does not live up to that level of quality.

This is a decent sweater with an OK cable knit construction. The price seems commensurate with what you are getting in quality. Starting with the good, I found the general cut of the sweater, zippers, and hood design to be very good. However, the stitching of this product leaves a lot to be desired and calls into question how long it will last. Stitching was crooked in many places, even missing in a few, and otherwise poor quality. I suspect after a few consistent uses over a month or so, portions of the sweater will unravel and require stitching.

Bottom line- you more or less get what you pay for in terms of quality. A decent overall sweater with a few construction (stitching) issues. Bear in mind, this was just my sample and it may not represent the norm.

review_body:
This was my first 'real' chest binder, as I've primarily been using a chest compression wrap and tummy trimmer, which was good enough for what I needed, but not great.
I bought this one because it's cheap and I've heard good things.

I have a rather large chest, and going by the size chart I got an xl. I should have gone for the xxl.
The vest itself fits perfectly, but the binder itself barely covered my breasts, and every time I went to adjust one, the other would slide or something so it looked really lopsided and was very uncomfortable.
It didn't look authentic at all, until I started over, wearing the compression wrap loosely underneath it.

Without the wrap, I could get it to fit on the second row of clasps. With the wrap, I barely got it on the first row.
But after I got it on, I put on my best shirt, and it looks awesome.Flat and realistic.
I even wore my most feminine shirt, girl cut with pink peace signs and rhinestones, and it looks like a guy just put on his little sister's shirt or something.

The material's comfortable and I don't feel any aches in my chest or back. It seems durable enough.

So, if you have a large chest, it's best to go a little bigger than you think you should get, and wear another layer underneath like a sports bra or compression wrap, and it should work.
It seems like it would work perfectly for smaller-chested individuals.

review_headline: The color Mia was the only one that actually had a 32" inseam.  Still a great brand, though.
review_body: *** UPDATE ****  Wallflower charges a restocking fee that was never indicated!!!  And their inconsistent sizing pretty much guarantees there will be a return.   Ordered all three colors and they're VERY different sizing.  The color Mia was the only one true to the claim of 32" inseam, but it was so tight from knee to ankle I could hardly bend my knees.  The other two were loose in the seat and thigh, tighter from the knee down.  I'm OK with that, but unfortunately they're inseam measured less than 31".  An important distinction when your 5'10" (32" is barely acceptable, as it is).   *UPDATE*:  With the wonders of amazon prime & free returns I ordered the same jeans again. The length was better, so I'm happy.  My experience is the sizing remains true within a *specific color name*.  Very strange, but knowing this makes it easier for future orders.  I'm going to rundown the many I've tried for the next time I order, from tightest to loosest fit:  Mia:  The tightest.  Also the longest, I think by design, to scrunch at the ankles.  Medium fade with yellow stitching (standard faded jeans). Kaylee:  A more relaxed fit.  Darker rinse with strategic fading, both yellow and white stitching.  This one has a wide waistband which I like. Bridget:  Loose fit.  Dark blue with white stitching (not my favorite, very 80's). Scarlett:  Very loose fit.  Easily a size larger than Mia.  Standard denim rinse with strategic fading and yellow stitching.  **UPDATE AFTER WEARING* Frustrating.  I chose the Kaylee, but it stretched out so much on the first wearing I had to run home and change.  They would fall farther down with every step I took.  Luckily I was wearing a long top over it.  And this started literally moments after I put the Mia in the return bin.  I'm ordering in a smaller size.

review_headline: Well made with quality material and attention to detail
review_body: Bought this jacket as a lightning deal and was skeptical about construction and material. Received it well packaged by the seller the day after ordering (Thanks Amazon Prime!) instead of two and tried it on. I'm 5'8" and 170lbs on a 47 year old skeleton so, as you might imagine, some of that 170 is right out in front of me now instead of up in my shoulders and upper arms, where it used to be. I ordered a 44 short and it fits me as if it came from a quality tailor shop. I couldn't be more pleased with the fit, just like seersucker should. Of course, I've only had it a few days and only worn it out once, to dinner, but it feels like quality material that should hold up a while. I've received a few compliments on it, and it looks great with a pair of blue cotton or linen trousers and loafers. I don't usually put any stock in the listed retail price of things on Amazon, and this jacket was listed at over $500, which is WAY more than it's worth. I would put it more like $150 at a place like Jos. A Bank or Men's Wearhouse, but at the $60 I paid for it on the lightning deal, it is an absolute steal. I don't really have any complaints about the jacket and will revise my review to 5 stars after I've lived with it a while as long as it holds up.

product_title: Selini  Boxed Fancy 6 pc. Ladies Cotton Handkerchiefs
review_headline: Pretty, but not as thin or comfy as ladies' handkerchiefs of days gone by.
review_body:
(Note: the picture now with this review shows at least a different design, and perhaps a different handkerchief, from the one I"m reviewing.) These are appropriately sized* and pretty, each decorated with an embroidered bouquet of lilies of the valley; but these are not the soft, thin hankies of yesteryear. Compared to the set of everyday handkerchiefs of my aunt's that I'd recently begun using, these are not as comfortable. These use a somewhat thicker and, at least initially, stiffer cotton material -- perhaps necessary to support the fairly large embroidery. Out of the box the material felt reasonably smooth, even though they weren't as thin, as what I was hoping for. Once washed, however--and I confess I don't iron my handkerchiefs--they felt rougher. This didn't bother me too much till I caught a bad cold, at which point I found the older thinner handkerchiefs to be much more soothing. I'm not sure if it's the thickness, the thread count, the manner of manufacturing the fiber, or what, but for at least the first 3 months of use these were not that comfortable on a sore nose. Perhaps they'll soften over the years.
*comparable to the older ladies' handkerchiefs I own.
Edit: After 4 months of use, some are beginning to feel a bit softer

I found these jeans in size 9 at Savers a few years ago. They quickly became my favorite pair! My husband really likes them, too :-).

As I was lamenting their nearing the end of their life to my husband, he helpfully suggested that I look for another pair online.

At $70, they are quite a bit above my budget. But, if you look you might be able to find them for much less on Ebay! My tag says Cruel Girl Slim Jeans - 09 Regular - Style: CB54753001.

product_title: Woolrich Men's Modern Hunt Coat
review_headline: A modern approach to this traditional hunting coat
review_body:
I have had the original Woolrich hunting coat for approximately 8 years. It is the most sturdy and fine looking outdoor jacket I own, but the problem is that it is huge. I'm 5' 8", 175 pounds, 42" chest, 34" waist, I'm very V shaped. My older version is a medium sized and it absolutely drowns me, its to big in the width of the sleeves, and its definitely built for the eventual beer belly if you may. So I was in a dilemma, I loved the coat and wanted to wear it on more than the occasional outdoor excursion, I wanted to wear it on casual days. Should I get it tailored or look into this modern hunting coat?

I'm so glad I ordered this coat to try it out. I ordered a medium in this hunting coat and its a perfect fit, just enough to have good movement, looks like it fits, and the sleeves are less bulky. A wonderful coat, and I can't wait to get years of use out of it. Nice job Woolrich. Sometimes the old standards can use a little updating, and this garment is certainly better for it.

By the way, the color of red is darker than the pictures would have you believe, it is more inline with the look of the older original.

product_title: Sakkas Batik Stripe Sleeveless Caftan Dress
review_headline: Terrible! Toxic odor, dye all over my skin, defects in sewing
review_body:
Except for two concerns, I like this dress a lot.
Pros:
navy-turquoise color and pattern is attractive.
Fabric is soft, flowing.
Seems like cool for summer.
Comfortable for me as overweight and disabled.

Cons:
biggest concern is strong toxic odor. Does anyone know if the smell will go away with soaking and sun?
The pattern in photo shows the bottom V centered with the V-neck. But on my dress the bottom V is off to the side, which looks wrong, defect. So I will return for replacement if others got centered pattern.

FYI, the style in back neck is cut away so that bra straps show. Would need a racer back bra to avoid that.

Why is there no option to ask other customers questions on this product? That would help me decide whether to return this.

Update June 22, 2014: I'm changing my rating to one star. I exchanged this dress due to defect in pattern. The new dress I got had a centered pattern, but one arm hole was twice the size of the other. Well, for cheap price I figured I'd sew it. I soaked the dress in white vinegar and salt and hung in sun and wind to set the dye and get rid of toxic odor. After repeating twice, the odor was gone, so I wore it for a couple days. Then I noticed there was blue dye all over my skin! My entire back and back of legs were covered. It took a lot of scrubbing with a paste of baking soda to get most the dye off my skin. This is totally unacceptable.

They have a good pattern, but their materials and production are terrible! I'm also now wondering how safe are the conditions for the workers who make these dresses. I'm guessing workers are paid by piece so they rush to get as many sewed as fast as possible, thus many defects. Plus no quality control. Are the workers exposed to these toxic fumes from fabric? And to the dyes? I will not buy anything more from this company until I find out how workers are treated. I'd much rather pay twice this price for thedress if workers are safe and the dress is nontoxic.

I don't like how lighter weight cotton skirts feel like they could fly up with the slightest breeze. This dress felt sturdier in that regard. It had a perfect weight and the skirt swished nicely when I walked. It also was NOT see-through like many cotton skirts and didn't need a slip. That makes it great for summer wear. I wore mine with red shoes and accessories like the picture in the advertisement and received many compliments.

I like this dress so much I bought the coral/peach one like it, and two others by the same company. It is SO HARD to find modest dresses for women. I don't like low cuts or short skirts and this dress offers the solution to both those issues. This dress has a fun little ruffle. I think it could be dressed down for summer casual wear or gussied up for a dinner out. I can't wait until my other dresses arrive.

review_headline: Good, but I wish the booties were non-skid
review_body:
I like the set a lot; we had a different hat and the same booties when my daughter was a newborn but they were too small. Based on other reviews saying they run a little small, I ordered the 18 months size for my 14 month old and that was a wise decision. The booties are a perfect fit now and she will likely outgrow them before 18 months. The hat and mittens have much more wiggle room. The mittens are really perfect; we had tried some of the clips but she kept pulling them off and it was ruining her coats and sweaters, so this is a great idea for keeping them together.

My one complaint, and the reason I rated this 4 stars rather than 5, is that the booties don't have any grippy/non-skid surface on them so my daughter can't walk while wearing them inside. They do stay on very well, which has been an issue for us with many shoes, but I wish she could wear them inside too! Overall a good value for three well-made items.

My 12 month old is just starting to fit into his 18 month wardrobe so I thought ordering 18 months would be fine, and maybe even slightly big (18 month pants are still too long on him)...but no, it BARELY fit on the big day!  I was able to get it on him thankfully, but the buttons on the pants (at the calf) had to be undone or it was too tight on his legs...the shirt kept coming untucked because it was too short, and I couldn't get the top button buttoned without choking him so he had to go without the bowtie (which was my main reason for buying it!).  The suspenders are adorable, but not at all functionable.  I kept having to readjust them throughout the day, and they would continue to slide back into the largest setting and end up hanging off of his shoulder...plus at one point he wanted down so I let him slide off my lap and the suspenders ripped my jeans because the teeth had come loose AGAIN!  And these were Citizens :-( so I was pretty upset that a cheap little outfit cost me some very expensive jeans!  I still rate it as a 3 star because it really is VERY adorable, just order it large!  I should have had a 24 month size for my 12 month old.  Oh, also be sure to wash it before wearing!  I wasn't sure how it would wash, so I didn't because I didn't want to shrink or ruin it...what a mistake.  My little guy had a rash from where the collar rubbed for days afterwards.  I felt horrible!  I always wash clothes before wearing, but didn't this 1 time.

product_title: Hanes Men's FreshIQ Tagless Cotton Boxer with ComfortFlex Waistband Briefs
review_headline: Not the same as old Hanes , beware the ride up.
review_body:
First and foremost I bought mine at Wally World not Amazon.

I have been using Hanes boxer briefs for years and loved them when they still had the tag. When they went to this newer version with the comfort band and tagless I was super excited so I bought 12 pairs without even thinking about it (3 - 4 packs).

What is different -
1. these are thicker than older Hanes
2. They run a miniscule amount smaller. Some may not notice, but they don't really break in either. That could be good or bad.
3. They will ride up like no other boxer before them. I spend half may day pulling these things out of where they shouldn't be so much so I can't stand wearing them anymore. The thicker material, combined with a slight change in cut, and the fact they don't tend to relax I think contributes to it. Perhaps if I would have known and sized up my review would have been different. (all be told I am not a small framed guy).
4. the thicker material is not great here in Southwest Florida or for the fact I'm on my feet in the hospital all day. A cooler cut would have been more appreciated. This probably becomes a durability vs function, but the old Hanes were pretty durable.

overall - I am so disappointed mostly because I haven't found another boxer that works like my older Hanes. These are still better than Starter's boxers, but light years behind the big money brands like ExOfficio and Tommy Hilfiger. Each persons experience may vary, but I for one would be ecstatic for them to go back to the old cut.

review_headline: I Have Complaints, But Also Praises.
review_body: Before we get to the awesomeness of this wallet, we must get through the not so awesome stuff: I was a bit disappointed by the texture of this wallet. I understand it's leather, or faux leather, whichever, but it was somewhat wrinkly. Not overly so, to the point of it being a distraction, but me being a perfectionist noticed it right away. The last complaint is the pieces of rubber clinging to the inside of the wallet, and the faint smell of it when opening it the first few times. This is not a big deal, since it takes about a second to remove it, but it was a bit weird seeing it. Anyway, on the great parts: The design. I really love it, because it doesn't make me feel like a small child carrying it around like some other Pony products do. It's simple, but effective, if you will. It seems to me to be very well put together. If you're impatient like me, don't worry, because this product ships extremely fast. I received it today, about two days after ordering it, which is pretty darn incredible. Overall, I'd recommend this to someone who just wants a simple wallet with a fantastic saying on it, but not to someone who carries around a lot of stuff and needs something huge because of it. Great buy, and I'm glad I spent money on it.

product_title: Cosabella Women's Dolce New Push-Up Bra
review_body: I've bought 5 bras on Amazon so far. This being the latest bought.  All these bras are very good - smooth, good feel, fitting, very comfortable & invisible to onlookers.  This soft push-up bra is no exception - comfortable & gives a good push.   To the wearer it is a sight to behold with the workmanship & laces @ the right places. The little extra laces below the cups & at the wings give me an elegant feel. It's so comfortable & I feel as if I were not wearing a bra at all !  To the watchful eyes of the onlookers(incl my bf's), they cannot find a trace of the bra I am wearing. The only place their roaming eyes can have a glimpse of my bra is from my back - when I wear a thin blouse or dress over it.  My bf reported that the slight sight of the wings & their little laces were enticing. The width of the wings is within the range my bf is seeking - not too thick that it looks 'untidy', as if the wearer needs a large & sturdy bra to hold the boobs in place.  Anyway, this is just my 1st impression of this bra. Perhaps after a month or so of wearing it, I will know more about it . As of now, I am giving it a 5 stars or 6 if only there's one !  In the meantime, I wished there were more colors, esp white, of this bra available. O yes, the size is real, fit is good.

product_title: Panache Cleo Marcie Balconnet Bra (6831)
review_headline: Newer fit has more space at top of cup
review_body:
I have an older Cleo Marcie bra in hot pink (from 2014), and just recently (June 2016) ordered another in black, in the same size. I'm not sure when the change happened, but the fit is slightly different now, at least in black--it still fits me, but there is a lot more room at the top of the cup. If you previously found that this style cut in too much at the top, you might consider trying again. For me, I actually prefer the older fit, as the extra space now makes me look a bit deflated. But under clothing it is not noticeable--especially because I'm accustomed to wearing camis over bras of this style anyway to hide the seams.

The new shape doesn't really change my initial 4 star review though--it's still a great bra, I still find it comfortable and love the rounded shape. But I also still wish it had 3 hooks instead of 2 with a wider band, and now would prefer less room at the top of the cup.

product_title: NYDJ Women's Petite Darleen Cargo Legging Jeans
review_headline: Definitely Low Rise, same fit otherwise, Legging not jean, MLYDJ
review_body:
The descrption says the rise is 9.75, but my size 4 is 8.75\\" or 8+3/4 inches. It does make them slide down too far when sitting.,
One picture looks lo rise,but the rear looks truly hi-rise? I did not expect this brand to make a true lo-rise,(\\"not your daughter's jeans?\\") let alone, would at least describe it accordingly. Sure, the 9.75 probably would have been a sweet, perfect fit.
And, if I size up these would simply fall down, as all low-rises do, if they are loose, since there is nothing along my hips to hold jeans up if they are too loose. They do fit, I just dont want to be bothered with the slip and slide in any lo-rise. These ride down in the back as soon as I sat down in them. Have to pull them up when I stand. Kind of need to wear shirt out to prevent drafts!!
I would say these fit 'Not like NYDJ, More /LIKE Your Daughter's Jeans./'
I DONT WANT MOMMY JEANS, and NYDJ /had made a nice smooth, inch higher or so above commoner low hips in girls cut. /Except for these!
I am five feet tall. I weigh 104, have skinny legs, 13\\" calves, still, these are skin-tight fitting calves? And all over! Tight fit on my 34,5\\" hips, along with the also skin-tight upper leg.
I was even further confused by my previous purchases of this brand. Out of three jeans style pants, none turned out low rise, and no leggings-type of tight fit either.
Nothing made me suspect jeggings or legging surprise.
Three stars..because the description, and the pictures. And the dreaded return now..3 is kind.
The fabric is a lite canvas fabric, not thick, but not lite cotton sheeting, or 'summer weight.' The various double seams, including at the knee make them a nice looking typical jegging/legging! Not jean!
Update May 29: Just noticed the paper label over the waistband,in bold print, says LEGGGINGS. Wish I knew and that this description called them leggings and.. not jeans. !!nicely made slit pocket, with no cargo flap. Its too flat to use,it wont hold anything without discomfort on the leg. I actually like and use cargo-leg pockets for my phone. It wont be comfy to have a phone in these flat, tight pockets.
I have several NYDJ cords, +2 faux leathers, + ponte knits purchased this season from NYDJ. They are all size 4, none are lo rise or suprise lo rise, and I did get my same size four here, and they all fit similar in a four.
The fabric is a lite canvas fabric, its not thick, bu not sheer or very 'summer' thin. The various double seams, including at the knee make them an otherwise nice casual lowrise. I truly hope NYDJ labels better in the future, because I really, really dont like returns. All misleading info just does not merit a four star for me. Three stars is plenty for this hot mess. Update May 29: Just noticed the paper label over the waistband,in bold print, says LEGGGINGS. Wish I knew, I wanted skinny LEG jeans.

review_headline: As good as its going to get
review_body: I measure 34.5 inches at my narrowest (right under my bust where the band sits) Which usually makes me a 34/36 band in most bras, I'm an F or FF cup depending on brand. I sized up to a 38F in this because many comments said that the band was small. It was incredibly hard to pull down over my chest but once pulled down it fits great. The easiest way to get this on for me is to unhook both sets of hooks and have my husband fasten it once i slip it over my head. I can run without a lot of jiggle but still have some movement during jumping jacks or Insanity but when paired with a straight shelf/tank sports bra I have no movement. I didnt take off a star for this because at my size NO sports bra (not even my Panache) stops all movement. I'd say get your regular size, I sized up and it does fit but I have to wear it on the smallest hook, so when it eventually stretches I will have no smaller to go to. I reordered in a 36 and will just use a band extender until it stretches out enough to wear on the farthest hook

review_headline: Avoid buying True Religion Jeans from Webzom - total fakes
review_body:
I purchased a pair of True Religion Brand Men's Ricky Super T Jeans w/Kelly Green Bartacks-38 and they turned out to be fake.

The fit was not authentic and was not comparable to my other TRBJ jeans. The button rivets were smaller than the original jeans and unlike the original the inside fasteners were the same size and not different sizes like the orginial. The fake Super T stitching was poor quality and had threads coming loose and the ultimate area of fake fail was the stitching in the crotch area which was unlike the original Super T's that I have. I left negative feedback for the seller (should be zero stars really) but for some reason the seller was able to get it removed. However there was similar feedback from just before my feedback from another buyer who had the same problem and magically that negative was removed as well.

So Zero Stars for Webzom the seller of Fake True Religion Jeans at full retail price!

In the meantime avoid buying this and other listed jeans to avoid fakes as the seller is clever in getting negative feedback removed.

The pants are a bit long but since they are cuffed at the ankle they don't drag, so no problem.  The shirt fits great, not too tight.  These are so cute we bought another pair for a friend who loves garbage trucks and a fire truck pair for my son.  They are soft cotton (much better than Carters or Oshkosh material) and great price.  We normally wear the organic cotton jammies from Hanna Andersen, but if you've ever tried those they retail for $38 or more dollars a pair and we buy outlet for $28, which I still think is a bit of a rip off for kids pajamas. But in our house softness and cotton reign as the best way to sleep and stay warm but not overheat. definitely recommend these, but BUY BIG! (2 sizes probably)

However, upon closer inspection one will find the fabric has a synthetic smell to it and for me personally, when I tried it on, it immediately gave me a rash!! In addition, I was utterly disgusted with the way amazon and the seller PattyBoutik attempted to handle my request for a return.  Basically I initiated the return process and was promptly instructed to pay for the postage when it clearly stated prior to purchasing that the sale guaranteed FREE RETURNS along with Amazon Prime!!  When I called Amazon, the rep told me that the free return applied to certain sizes only! Are you kidding?!!! That is so NOT true.  I am 1000%  certain that when I added my size ( Small)  it stated Prime and Free Returns.  Anyway I am refusing to pay for the shipping despite Amazon promising a refund.  This happened to me once before with an item purchased from UK and Amazon ended up refunding me my postage  costs via Amazon money.  We settled on Amazon contacting the seller and requesting a return label sent to me with postage included.  this remains to be seen.  Anyway, I don't think this blouse is worth the money and I doubt this fabric will last passed one year.  Thankfully, I am not waiting around with it to find out.

review_body:
[[VIDEOID:moODM5TZ7JOH7Q]]These sunnies offer up UV 400 protection and definitely cut out the glare with style, Elvis's that is. The frame is a hard plastic while the temples (sides) are made from metal with graduating size holes from the spring hinges down to the rubberized tips. The sunglasses are approximately 5 1/4\\" across the face, 5\\" from temple to ear.

There are spring hinges that seem fairly solid, but naturally will not hold up to the wear and tear regular eyewear will. product_title: Jessica Simpson Women's Yoke Bodice Dress With Back Cut Out
review_headline: Great dress but needs a few improvements
review_body:
This is a super cute dress, and it fits as expected. I can wear it on dates or to the office. Great length, great colors, thick material... good stuff.

However, the slip within the dress has seams that don't match up with the outer part. Basically, there are lines down the boobs that make it look like there's a seam on my bra. It's not a *bad* look, but... I could live without it. Also, the section covering where the cleavage would be pops out a little. It's probably just the way they cut the fabric (not my boobs, as I've never had this issue before). It's so minor that I'll probably keep the dress and see if some creative spraying/ironing can fix it.

Last point: the open back is great, but the top part doesn't unbutton, so it's definitely a pull-over-your-head dress, not a step-in dress. Oh and the back opening is a tiny bit wider than my other open-back dresses, so I have to pick a bra where the straps in back are the farthest apart so they don't show. Not a big deal.

review_body:
Alright, not only did this shirt arrive in two days time on a regular shipping method, i wore it the exact same day that I would be working a full shift and also going grocery shopping. I live in Charlotte, NC, where the humidity is at least 80% + at this time of the year and the temperature now ranges between 80 degrees+ during the early afternoon to evening. I don't work an office job. I work a job where I am constantly moving around, stocking, pulling huge loads of stock around between outside and inside conditions where the a/c is only somewhat efficient.

When i took the shirt off, the inside of the underarm area was wet as expected, but the outside of it was not, as was my shirt, a thin blouse, was neither wet. I can say that I am truly impressed. I have suffered with hyperhydrosis since I can remember. Just sitting at my computer playing a game got me these huge wet sweat spots going down my arm. Intense gamer? haha.

All i can say is that this works and has and will continue to improve my confidence in social situations. So expensive, but worth it. I'll be buying more in the future!

side note: I'm a bit more built/taller and prefer a shirt that can be tucked in, so I prefer men shirts. For any women, go a shirt size smaller than what you normally wear in women size.

review_body: The costume itself is just OK, and the quality is what you would expect - fairly cheap materials,which is fine for a Halloween costume. I gotta tell ya, it friggin' hurt my ears, as the elastic band is simply too tight. I'm averaged-sized (6' tall) and have a "normally" shaped/sized head. If they could only make the quality of the beard straps better and, most importantly, make the strap length adjustable, I would have had a better experience. Also, you really cannot talk (not to mention eat or drink) while wearing the beard, as the opening between beard and mustache is just a thin slit. It's very clear, looking back now, that they heavily altered the appearance/functionality of the costume itself to make it look a lot more natural. Again, if the beard situation were not so poor, I would have probably rated this as a 4 star-costume. Next time I will spend more money and get a beard/fake hair that I can actually adhere to my skin, which would make it look a lot more realistic. More time, but also a better effect.

review_body:
I recently moved out of country, and was surprised at the price of decent wallets being above $100 or so. My alternative was to buy it from Amazon, with a risk that (1) it may be fake and (2) return could be hard from another country. When I emailed the seller about having it shipped overseas, I was told that they couldn't do it given the contract with the provider. My wishful thinking was that if this is fake, they wouldn't have a problem shipping it overseas. So I bought it.

I had a friend to ship it to me instead, and I like it a lot. I actually ordered two of them, one black and another brown. The leather looks real, smells real, and feels real. I've used it for about one month, and unlike many other wallets of which leather would be scratched or at least show some wear after use, this one still looks new. Given its condition, I don't think I would have to worry about buying another wallet.

p.s. Some other currencies are bigger than us dollars, but this wallet is big enough to store them just fine. You can actually store two currencies without having them mixed because this wallet has two sections(?) for paper money, nicely seperating them without adding much bulk at all.

By all means, I highly recommend this!

product_title: Tommy John Men's Cool Cotton Trunk
review_body: After all the hype and the Google ads about how great Tommy John underwear is, I decided to try a pair.  The fit is good, the fabric seems to be high quality and the fabrication looks very good.  So, overall, this is a quality product and the price is comparable to similar products.  But, even the Cool Cotton fabric relies on a good deal of spandex for the fit rather than the careful construction that an all cotton fabric would require to achieve the same fit.  For me, it was just a bit too much spandex, which I don't find to increase cooling, but rather the opposite.  For me, spandex is always just a tiny bit wet and I don't like that.  As an athletic garment that's fine, but not an everyday trunk.  The fabric also gets its light and cool feel from being very thin.  Again, I don't like that next to nothing fabric weight.  I prefer a heavier weight, mostly or all cotton trunk or brief, well cut and constructed.  Flint and Tinder, Tommy Hilfiger, and Mack Weldon for me work better than Tommy John.  I do like the top loading fly, but not enough to overcome the other issues.  These are personal choice issues and do not reflect the quality of this trunk, which is very good.  Just know what you are choosing.

product_title: Viosi Mens Genuine Kingston Leather Bi-fold Center Flip ID Wallet
review_headline: Thin Leather and Small Seam Allowance Affects Quality
review_body:
This could be a great wallet if the leather was just a bit heavier and the seam allowance wasn't quite so miserly. I understand that in high production, being able to get a few more wallets out of the hide makes a difference, but in terms of customer satisfaction, the extra millimeter in seam allowance makes the difference in customer loyalty.

This is a nice size wallet. There are a lot of slots for credit cards and business cards and a place for cash. So far, so good.

The problem with this wallet is that the leather is very thin and the stitching is very close to the edge with very little seam allowance. This wallet doesn't look like it will actually stand up to the wear and tear a wallet takes...in the pocket, out of the pocket, sat on, tossed on the dresser, etc. It would be nice if we were all perfect in our care of things, but wallets take a lot of handling and a lot of beating and while this wallet has a lot of nice features, I just don't expect it to last longer than six months and that is a generous estimate. When I know that a much nicer wallet could be bought for just twice the price at one of the discount clothing stores or on a sale table in a department store, this wallet really begins to pale. It is a nice size - it just needs a heavier leather. Not for daily use - perhaps dress use only, but it doesn't seem to be designed for that - it is designed to be a daily wallet. review_headline: Stylish and Affordable, but the sizing is a bit confusing
review_body:
It is no secret that US sizes are bigger than Asian (Korean) sizes. The H2H (Have 2 Have) shirts are a case in point. I ordered an XXL (US L, based on the conversion chart) for my 6'3", 200lb frame. The garment I received shows "US XL" on the tag! US XL wasn't one of the choices when ordering online. I would say that the tag is correct based on how it fits, but the size conversion chart may be off.

I can't say whether 1) I ordered the wrong size based on the chart; 2) I received the wrong item; or 3) the conversion chart is just wrong. Since these items are not easily returned and take longer to receive than other Amazon deliveries, it's important to get the correct size right the first time. So, I would say, based on this experience, that if you want a US L (US Large), then order a H2H (Asian) XL.

The garment itself is decent enough for the price. It is fitted although not as fitted as the image on Amazon. On the US XL, the bottom flares a little (more than shown). I think you should ALWAYS see shirts/clothes on people [not headless mannequins or on hangers] so I would've benefitted from seeing the back of the shirt over a pair of jeans. A key consideration is whether you can wear the shirt NOT tucked in and not look like a slouch. The design is borderline: you could where it out, but it has a bit of the extra fabric in the rear; or you could tuck it in, and you may not have enough fabric when sitting. The perfect shirt would have a straight seem (for leaving untucked) and cut off about an inch or two below the belt line when seated (similar to polo shirts).

The fabric is very thin, which isn't necessarily a criticism, just don't expect a sturdy cotton. It is certainly for a summer. The (short sleeve) arms are snug even on someone without big biceps, so if you have an athletic build (muscular, but not huge) the arms will be a little tight, but that can also accentuate a fit build.

The color is not as bright or vibrant in reality as the Amazon photo. For the Dark Blue shirt, the image shows a deep inky blue but the actual shirt is more classic navy blue. Not a huge deal, but if you want a navy blue shirt, it's pretty easy to find. The shirt could also benefit from collar stays for additional support. Without them, you may have to keep the highest button closed so the shirt doesn't flare near the neck. Again, not a huge problem, but an easy design fix.

- Stylish (not a lot of short sleeve, fitted shirts for men that are not plaid or polo shirts)
- Inexpensive for the style (there's no tag indicating the fabric but it's not cotton or silk)
- Wide arrangement of colors
- Accentuates a slender or athletic build

CONs:
- Too much guesswork in selecting the correct size (know that 2XL is US XL, and XL is US L)
- Mediocre construction (not made to last, but good for a season or two)
- A few design flaws (no collar stays, no extra buttons - if you lose one, you have to buy one)

product_title: Goorin Bros. Men's Manhattan Ivy Newsboy Cap
review_body:
OK, that may be an exaggeration, but this was a gift for my husband who is always saying that no hat will fit him because his head is too big. It's true- I've seen it. Which is weird because it looks normal to me, he's just over 6 foot, I think it's pretty normal for a tall guy, they should make hats for men larger, anyway... Even on Amazon, many of the sizes only went up to large. But this seller had an XL! And it really fits him well. Which I am stoked about because the man's beanies and ball caps are WAY worn out (and too small).

Goorin Brothers has a great reputation and this hat lives up to it. I've seen other caps like this style around, but this one stands out as authentic in a sea of imitations. Even when he's walking around you can tell it's not your average cheap trendy hat. It's lined with a striped fabric, including under the brim. I like the shaping created by the seams, the fabric has a nice hand and a subtle pattern. He says it's really comfortable for a somewhat structured hat.

The man was worried that wearing a hat like this might make people think that he is bald, or worse- a hipster, and told him to think of it as baseball cap that is encased in low-pro fabric. But when he wears it, he his really proud of how much nicer his hat is than everyone else.

Bottom-line: It fits, it's comfortable and it looks good. Came fast, well packaged, great price!

review_headline: Read the size chart guys. Its as accurate as ...

product_title: Nanette Lepore Women's Morocaan Medallion Goddess One-Piece Swimsuit
review_headline: Beautiful, bright, well made suit. Perfect for ladies that carry their curves only on the bottom.
review_body:
Fits my sz8 body well. (Would probably fit a 6 just fine). I'm definitely curvier on the bottom, and smaller through the chest. I WOULD NOT recommend this suit for anyone with much up top. The top triangles are quite a bit more revealing than pictured, as well as the cutout on the upper ribs, and offers no support. Anyone larger than a B-cup would be in danger of having their girls pop out the side when turning. As well the tummy panel is quite narrow. It covers completely across the from and curves around the sides, and accommodates a bit of tummy, but if that is where you carry most of your weight you might want to size accordingly.
The pattern is beautiful, though the darker patched sections aren't as district from the rest of the pattern as they appear in the picture. The pattern is darker and more vibrant than shown as well. The colour are white, black, bright med. pink, bright medium blue, and orange. (On my screen pre-purchase it had appeared to be neon pink and lime accents with an ivory base- but still is a beautiful pattern. I'm only lightly tanned, and it looks great against my skin, but looking at the fabric- it would pop against a dark tan, or pale white. It might get a little lost on the darkest of skin because the overall background of the suit is quite dark, and the bright pieces so small.
Comes with light triangular padding that is removable. The strap under the bust area cannot be adjusted, so you are stuck with as much exposure as it comes with, an you can't move the cups around to suit your girls. The back tie helps some with this. Fabric seems to be surprisingly nice and strong (for a fashion suit, not on the same level as an athletic suit) yet still smooth, and is fully lined in an bright blue fabric. The edges of the suit hug your body without cutting into your curves (if your a little softer through the bottom and hips as I am, in this suit you can get away with a little less backside coverage without it creating any kind of 'muffin' along the seam edges- which is hard to find, and a suit quality I majorly appreciate!), and for a low backed suit it doesn't have that annoying gap above the small of your back that many suits do. And because of the back tie, it brings in the gap that often occurs with backless suits on the sides of the ribs.
Really quite pleased with this suit, would definitely recommend for other girls that are curvy on the bottom. It's hard to get a suit that actually looks beautiful and flattering on my type, and this suit does that. Would definitely buy again!

product_title: Anemone Strapless Seamless Bandeau Removable Padding
review_headline: This probably works for someone who isn't shaped like I am
review_body:
I'm sure I'm not the only one with this problem, but I'm also sure others will be just fine with this. I am between 5'5" and 5'6", wear size 12 or large, 38C... you get the idea - I'm fairly average, but not small. I didn't realize muffin tops could show up next to my armpits, but that's what these do. They cut in so badly along the top that the bulge it creates is clearly visible through clothes and is rather unsightly. Obviously if you have no fat right there it won't be an issue, but if you do, it may not look cute. I wanted to like them, as they're fun colors and I wouldn't mind being able to wear tops with skinny straps during summer, but these aren't the solution I wanted them to be. I might wear them to bed, but they aren't terribly comfortable for that, either.

The removable cups have some pretty definite shape to them, moreso than most removable padding that comes in sports bras. That may be good or bad for some, but didn't really matter much to me.

product_title: Doublju Mens Raglan Baseball V-Neck 3/4 Sleeve T-shirt
review_body:
It's no optical illusion, folks; the neck hole on this thing is rather large. This led to some trepidation in me that turned out to be 100% legitimate, because I always have trouble getting such shirts to look good when pulled over top of an undershirt. You put it on, and you've got a big wad of your undershirt shoved up against one side of your neck, so you reach up inside and pull that out only to find that everything is sitting crooked now...long story short, I spent > 5 minutes getting it to look right. If my time doesn't improve on this the garment will be relegated to undershirt duty. I'm not deducting stars for that, though, because the neck hole size is plain as day in the picture.

On to sizing. I stand 6'1", weight 190 lbs, 32"-34" pants and 34-35" sleeve dress shirt. In tshirts I often need a large for length/shoulder space, but the medium fits much better around my waist region, so I often buy those. I ordered this shirt in the X-Large/US Large and found, luckily, that it is long enough for me! This is rare, especially in the arms, because I have a 6'5" wing span. Straight out of the package, it squeezed a bit around the shoulders and upper back. Not enough to be a problem, because the material is ribbed and made to stretch, but it was vaguely uncomfortable. But after 20 minutes it had stretched to the form fitting point, and now it's quite comfortable.

Other than that, it's perfect. The wine color is spot on with the picture, it's cut for those of us who don't have beer guts, It barely rides up when I raise my arms because the sleeve actually comes all the way back to the arm pit instead of triangling 4" down the torso like most shirts do, it's 100% cotton and quite soft, and from what little I know about stitching I think it's well-made.

I'll probably order a couple more Doublju shirts. If anything changes my mind, I'll update this.

product_title: BOSS Hugo Boss Men's Saurio
review_headline: Skip it if you use business cards
review_body:
I received the same version of this card wallet as a gift, but mine was without the big \\"HUGO BOSS\\" wording impressed into the leather. It's otherwise the same item, sizing, style, stitching but with a flat finish and a very small \\"Hugo Boss\\" tag on the lower right.

Unless you are using undersized business cards, this thing is too small. It will dog-ear and wrinkle your cards as you get them in-out of ANY of the available pockets on either side. The fit is much too tight. Even then, if I had slightly undersized cards, you could really only fit 3-4 cards in any of the pockets.

This is a highly impractical item and I was sorely disappointed, since it was otherwise a nice looking gift and I usually love Huge Boss stuff.

My recommendation is to avoid this one.

EDIT:
It should be noted that this card wallet, while undersized for business cards, appears to hold standard ID/credit cards just fine. Perhaps for many, if there is no intention to carry a business card, or wish to store one if handed to you, this card wallet could be suitable. I just want to clarify that my main issue is that with just a millimeter or two of additional tolerance on the card width size, there would be zero issues.

I need to carry a few cards in my business, so my experience with this was frustrating.

review_body: I own this Sorella swimsuit, though it wasn't purchased here. It has the softest material, a real luxury in a swimsuit. I swim in both lake water and in a warm saltwater pool (with minimal chlorine). This suit retains its shape, though I don't put it in the washing machine. There isn't underwire but a wired \\"U\\" between the cups that helps hold shape, and provides a sexy look while staying appropriate and covered up. The band around the belly also helps flatter a plus-size figure. The wide straps are probably the best feature - there's no digging in, which is not only uncomfortable but unflattering. It slims you without being difficult to get on or not feeling like a swimsuit. It's expensive but definitely worth the money, especially if you take excellent care of it. I highly recommend this brand, and especially this suit, to all plus-size women. It also comes in white but I think the black is cuter.

product_title: Business Card Holder - Vertical Flip Top - Braden, with kilofly Mini Gift Card
review_headline: Great looks, solidly built, less room than you'd expect and a real bi*ch to open!
review_body:
My title says it all. It's a really sturdy, well-built case that looks great, but because of how they designed it, there are two flaws that may or may not bother you. (They do me!)

First, for a case this thick, it should hold more cards. However, due to the 'recessed lid' design with the faux-wrapped leather, the actual 'lip' under which the cards go is much less than one would think!

The other thing is the lid as I said is recessed, meaning it actually folds down between the metal sides. While this is great protection for the lid itself and will keep it looking great, the two 'notches' on the side where you're supposed to be able to grab the lid to open it aren't deep enough meaning more times than not, you'll struggle to open it.

Truthfully, I can even excuse them for the girth-to-cards ratio of this thing, but the fact it's soo difficult to open makes this a 3.5 out of 5 rating. (Because they don't do halves, they got a bump to four, but if this was school, there would be a teachers note next to that grade!)

review_body:
I was so excited to find eShakti a few months back...customized clothes in a range of sizes sound great, right? So, so wrong! I ordered a bunch of items, including a skirt like this one. Everything went back because everything was very poorly made. Nothing fit well and the fabrics felt cheap. The clothes all felt like some sort of high school home ec project. So of course I have to pay to return everything. And when they were way late in processing the return, I emailed customer service and got no response. I called, and they have one of those automated messages, that after about 30 seconds, goes to \\"all of our rep are busy, leave a message.\\" click. I finally get the return processed and I receive a $40 bill from DHL for the US customs charges! According to the voicemail the customer service rep left (because, again, you can't reach a live person when you call), it's noted somewhere on their website that if you order over $200, you'll be charged a fee by US customs for an international purchase. Really? Maybe you want to raise the profile of that bit of info a little. Like, when you basket gets to $200, you're prompted with a screen that says, \\"hey the price of your order is now going to get jacked up 20%, but you won't get the bill until weeks after our poorly-made clothes arrive...are you sure you want to proceed?\\"

Honestly - just not worth it.

product_title: Brassada Duster Ranger Saddle Coat Satin Lined
review_headline: As good as a longcoat gets, but could be even better.
review_body:
Recently, I've contrived to grow out a full beard and moustache, in the interest of putting on the airs of a rancher, a cattleman, or a cowboy. I can't say that I'm certain whether this impulse toward a preening faux-masculinity - an impulse that had heretofore eluded me for over 30 years - represents a desire to regress into a child-like state of wish-fulfillment and inner living when faced with the blistering, frostbitten harshness of today's world, or an inverse demand for validation and recognition from the people I meet as the embittered, sandblasted old man I'm fast becoming (they'll never think to check under the coat to see what a tender heart it hides).

Obviously, in consideration of the above facial growths, mental roil, and psychological churn, I required a longcoat, to show myself to the world in mystery and concealment. On the coin's other face, I wanted the world hidden from me and my own deep strangeness (although the coat likely has only accentuated any perception of abnormalcy on others' behalves, but I really couldn't give a damn less, since I've never looked so cool being so strange). After browsing around various cuts and contraventions of good coat corners and conventions, and feeling myself increasingly doomed to wear a cheap Chinese knockoff akin to sackcloth, I was piqued to discover Brassada on one of many expeditions to Amazon. Classy and classic, all at once? And I could even be some kind of freaky frontier priest if I ordered the white saddlecoat (though I did settle for a lovely dark brown)? I'm not sure if the coat or I was sold quicker.

The canvas, compared to most fabric of our frankly cheap and cheapening day and age, is thick and insulative enough on its own, even without either variety of lining. It is stitched with admirable solidity, in short, strong tracks that wend up the ridged seams, joining the fabric tightly together on itself. The lining is held in place with great tightness and permanence, and will likely not wear out before even I do - a rarity in modern clothes-fashioning. The fabric lining, though not traditionally "satiny" by expectation, is light enough to not be stifling in warmer climes, and enough of a windbreak to have served me reliably through a New England October and November's chill.

Now, my disappointments with the garment are comparatively few, but are punctuated by the overall superior quality of the coat's workmanship - as a result, they seem more opaque and glaring than they would on outerwear of traditionally low-quality manufacture in today's economy of unequivocal lessness (for the common man, at least). For one, the lining only extends from the coat's upper body to the waist. Now, I know fully that having the rear flaps of the coat fully lined would weigh them flatter, which might impair mobility some when your average fictional, idealized ranger's chips (cow or otherwise) were down. Still, especially for the harsh New England winters of the shortly foreseeable future, having the lining encompass the entire interior of the duster would help keep the body not only covered, but well-heated, even when plunged into the face of snow drifts and battered by freezing rain.

Secondly, the zippers' machining feels very cheap. I can certainly appreciate the double vertical zip for matters of shaping the coat (not to mention when your average ranger-priest finds himself in dire need to draw from beneath the bulky vestment), but the clearly nylon-plastic construction does a disservice to the overall superb workmanship of the garment itself. The solidity of this coat, and the classy brassed-off look of its buttons, demands a similarly metallic zipper and sliding mechanism.

I have not chanced to use the small drawstring mechanisms below the coat's waist, but again, the coiled ropes and plastic tension sliders feel equally cheap, and could do with some better-quality source materials.

Overall, though, I have been very much satisfied with my purchase. I would gladly pay any additional cost to Brassada in order to have the company source (or themselves contrive) high-quality metallic zippers, attach more solid drawstrings, and have quilting or satin lining sewn into the coat's lower half. Maybe then, the crazed ranger-priest can ride proud and high through driving snow and sheeted rain, bringing his light of justice to the dark and cold of winters future.

review_headline: LOVE THIS BRA, Fit is spot on. followed the other reviews and ordered a 34F when my actual size is 32F.
review_body:
LOVE THIS SPORTS BRA! I don't fall out anywhere. No way i could come out of the bottom, not spilling over the sides, not a lot of underarm fat going on at all. I really love this sports bra. I went along with the reviews (i was so scared about it being the wrong size or not fitting as i hate/ probably would not go through the whole "return process" thing just based on laziness) and ordered a size up from my everyday bra size (32F/32DDD). Therefore, i ordered a 34F. This fits great, fits comfortably, it holds in the girls. I'm happy. which is a hard place to get me for any type of bra considering my gigantic (but small backed) size.

My only issue with this is what some others had mentioned --- it is difficult to put on by yourself. I mean i can do it.. (not sure if the hooks are totally lined up, lol) but it is a feat since there are the two separate hooks, and i will say i am fairly flexible. on days like today when my arms are sore from workouts, it hurts a little lol. Often i have my boyfriend fasten the top one or both. With that being said, i do really like the way it looks style wise because of the two hooks/circle in back. lol.
Another issue i saw on the reviews mentioned that the seams on the front were easily seen through clothing or shirts... i haven't really found this to be the case AT ALL.... It could be because i got the black bra and not one of the colorful ones... maybe the colorful ones have different seams... although the bra is so amazing in terms of fit and hold that i will probably buy one (or two, down the line) in the other more fun colors. I do like my neon and bright colored sports bras :]

This sports bra is sleek, well fitting. overall i'm just very happy with my purchase.

P.S. i also ordered the purple "La Isla Women's High Impact Ultra Supportive Control Mesh Back Sports Bra" ordered it in 32F (my actual bra size) and it fits just as wonderfully... actually makes me think that this bramay have worked fine in the 32F as well... or maybe there wasn't too much difference between the 32F and 34F but as it is i'm quite happy with the sizing i picked. Additionally I can and have worn this bra and the other 32F one on all 3 hooks and still they feel comfortable to me. SO in short, if you are worried (like i certainly was), i'd def go a size up (while still picking your accurate cup size) and i think the bra would work.

Happy work outs & sports bra hunting :]

review_headline: Fraction of the cost of a Moving Comfort Fiona - Worth the try
review_body:
I had two Moving Comfort Fiona sports bras and really liked them (I'm 38DDD). They weren't perfect but close enough, but boy are they expensive! I saw that these looked almost exactly the same as the Fionas and reading the reviews there were some people who confirmed that they were. For a FRACTION of the cost, it really wasn't a huge risk to try them out. So I've worked out in these for around 5 months now and am back to submit hopefully a useful review for those not sure whether or not to purchase these sports bras.

I feel like these quality-wise are 90% like the Fionas. I would say material used is pretty much the same if not 100% the same by feel and reading of the material make up on the tag. What I would say makes it only 90% of the Fionas is that some of the stitching isn't perfect but not shoddy. They haven't fallen apart or anything. I purchased a smaller sized bra to keep the girls in, and I feel that's what you need to do for sports bras. You can't order the size of regular bras you wear in sports bra size because it wouldn't rein in your boobs. I read some reviews that say that they wouldn't trust the manufacturer of this sports bra line because they're an imitation of Fionas made in China, therefore, the cheaper perceived quality and cheaper price. Well sorry to burst any bubbles but I checked my Fiona bras and they were made in China as well with the same design, so basically you're just paying a whole lot more for someone to keep their profit margins high. As for knockoff claim - probably true, but quality is pretty much the same to me so I'm ok with paying only $17 vs $65 for a bra that just doesn't have the same branding.

I got my bra in about a week so I didn't have to wait for weeks like some purchasers so it probably had to do with supply on hand. I was unsure of the size so bought a 38 DD just in case the 36DD was too small. Ended up not really wearing the 38DD but once since it's a little looser than I would want for high impact (running), but probably fine for low impact like strength training. Hope this helps!

product_title: HuMn Aluminum, Slim, RIFD Shielding, Double Carbon Fiber Plated Men's Wallet 2 / Money Clip / Card Holder - Up to 6 cards!
review_headline: Takes some getting used to, but its nice!
review_body:
At first when I picked up the HuMn 2, I thought "Should've gotten the mini..." The 2 is about 1" taller than a credit card. This larger size, however, comes in handy when you're trying to go minimalist, but aren't quite ready to fully commit to bare necessities...

When I replaced my broken-down billfold, I was carrying 4 CC's, 3 Insurance Cards, 1 frequent buyer's cards, 2 business cards, 2 picture IDs, a gym membership card, a transit card, an arcade gamer's card, and cash. Cramming ALL of that into a HuMn, I experienced the 'card ejection' problem that's mentioned on youTube. I was about ready to return it, but I figured I would give it a week.

After day two, I realized that I could consolidate... Over those next few days:
- Why carry business cards when I have a smartphone? Photos taken, contact information added into the phone, cards went bye-bye...
- I transferred insurance info into business card sized piece of paper. Policy Names/ Numbers & Support line. Even had room for Emergency Contact Info and Allergy Information (Don't have any, but couldn't hurt to have on there!)
- My gym is in the same building as my office. My work ID is on my backpack. Clipped those two together, now I never forget either...
- My transit card is the most often used card, so that went to the outside rubber band. Cash on the other face...
- One of the 4 CC's got the boot, since its seldom used (Gotta keep it though, Amazon points! ;) )
- One frequent buyer's card was thrown out, since they can search me by email address or phone number...
- Gamer's card got placed in the glove compartment of the car, as I have to drive to get to the nearest arcade...

In the end, I'm down to carrying a total of 7 plastic cards, a laminated slip and cash. Not minimalist, but pretty slim from where I was!

As far as looks, its a simple design, but has gotten several compliments already, because its so different. Is it pricey? Yes, but a quality (and fashionable) wallet typically runs in this range anyway, and many of those don't have RFID protection..

Overall, for what it is, its pricey, but

product_title: Carole Hochman Women's Nightgown
review_headline: Must wear it inside out because of seams
review_body:
The seams are scratchy because an interface is used on all of the seams and its construction doesn't use a second seam to put that seam away from our bodies. That's a real shame, because the fabric is soft and should wear well with time. So until (and unless) the sizing in the seams breaks-down by wearing and many washes, I'll wear the gown inside out. I \\"inherited\\" a nightgown by this label and I love it; it is comfortable, well-made, soft inside, as well as outside, and that's why I bought this one (on sale -- I can't see spending more than 30 bucks for a gown). Is this a question of the company changing sewing techniques, or is it a case of, \\"they don't make 'em like they used to?\\" I compared the gowns. The old one was made in Oman and the new one in Malaysia. The amount of seam allowance in the older one is twice the fabric of the new one.

May 25, 2014 Okay, a year later, and the seams have softened and I can wear it either way, inside out or regular. I also notice that this (lavender) print has applied white, instead of fabric white.... Odd.... this month, I got a short Carol Hochman gown with \\"cocktail glasses\\" printed all over and its fabric is soft and smooth all over -- for all of the colors.
