review_body: I admired these scarves at art museum gift shops in Paris, but never bought one because of the exorbitant price.  So I was thrilled to find this scarf on Amazon, at a tiny fraction of the cost. Don't be put off by the broken-English product description - or the warning of unbelievably-long shipping estimates. Mine arrived within three weeks, not several months, and yes, it did come all the way from China. This product is exactly like the much more expensive silk scarves you'll find in art museum gift shops, just without the fancy packaging.  (Mine came wrapped in a simple cellophane bag.)  The colors are rich and vibrant, and the quality is excellent. It drapes beautifully, and looks great with cashmere turtlenecks, especially as contrast against light colors, like pale turquoise.  (I normally can't wear aqua or pale turquoise, but this scarf adds plenty of bright/rich blue near my face, so I can actually pull it off.). Just don't expect to wear it against dark blues or greens;  the colors will completely blend in. As you can tell, I couldn't be happier with my purchase. Only a little above average at his last Dr's appt. We were looking for 6 month size clothing but we got 9 month just to be safe. Thanks goodness we did. He will probably be able to wear them for a week, maybe two. That's right, he's 3 months and the 9 months size fits him right now. We are going to get some snap extenders and hope that helps but I wanted people to know that Carhartt onesies, while super cute, run very small. Especially if you have a long baby then make sure to get a bigger size.
Other than the size I definitely recommend them. They are so cute on our little guy. I will definitely be getting more in the future but will make sure to purchase larger sizes so he can wear them longer.

product_title: elope Plague Doctor Mask
review_headline: Fairly good creep factor for the money
review_body: I had my fingers crossed waiting for this to show up. I thought, for the price point, it would be junk. I was pleasantly surprised. It's of fairly good quality, fit's well and has the creep factor I was looking for. It went with the rest of my costume very well. I will say that the clear(ish) thick plastic eye coverings are hard to see out of and when you breath through your mouth they tend to fog up leaving you helplessly blind for a minute. My solution was to buy some cheap welders goggles (on Amazon, search for black welding goggles 50mm), carefully cut out the plastic eyes in the mask, slice some small relief cuts around the eyes to accommodate the goggles (the goggles are slightly bigger than the eye holes,and install them in the mask. This solved my cheesy view from the mask and now my plague mask looks much cooler. Tip on the goggles use: disassemble the goggles and use only the eye cups in the mask. Unscrew the lenses, push the eye cup through the eye hole from the inside of the mask and then screw the lens back on the protruding threads from the front of the mask. Adjust the inside of the eye cup so it's comfortable when wearing.

product_title: Skagen Classic Two Tone Mesh Women's Watch
review_body: I have always revered Skagen as an upscale brand of simplistic Danish design at affordable prices. Unfortunately I never owned one because I felt they were a boring. Finally they have added a bit of modest bling and it was well worth the wait. This is a gorgeous work of art. First, the two-tone, yellow gold and silver is lovely and versatile. The silver dial (face) is very refined and sophisticated with the crystals at the hour marks. But the faceted bezel is the icing on the cake! Absolutely unique and exquisite! A refreshing change from the crystal-encrusted bezels that are everywhere nowadays. I have those too and they are beautiful but this is for a woman who likes to lead, not follow. Finally, the mesh bracelet is a strong trend and Skagen is the leader of fine mesh. It is not a dull grayish silver. It has a nice sheen to it and oh so silky feeling. Easily adjustable to any size (read your instruction booklet or go to a jeweler but don't force it if you're not sure). This watch is very light and slim. You will forget you are wearing it. It keeps exact time. The diameter measures 35 mm or 1 inch and 6/16 (just a tad over 1 1/4 inches). The band width is 18 mm. A delicate watch yet substantial enough to make a statement. I can wear mine as an everyday watch because I am very gentle and aware of my jewelry. If you are rough or bump things easily, then save this for a dressier occasion. It is a gorgeous timepiece.

review_body:

If you've ever owned any other Dickies pants, you'll know this is pretty typical. As far as fit goes, they're definitely less skinny in the legs than the Skinny Fit 5-Pocket version (which might be a good or a bad thing depending on what you're looking for). Waist seems to be pretty regular to me. I found my other Dickies to get a bit shorter than I like after washing so I went for a little extra length than I usually get with jeans.

Incredible artwork

I got this for a gift rather than keeping it for myself

review_headline: Mine fits perfectly - want to add to the discussion
review_body: Hi, I did not order the genie bra through Amazon; I bought mine at the pharmacy.  I followed the guide and my bras fit perfectly.  I'm 5'2", weigh 125 pounds and am a 34C. In these bras my breasts look natural, in the right place, not too saggy, and not at full attention.  It seems to me that the discussion about not fitting properly revolves around larger women who perhaps are not buying the right size to begin with, as others have said.  I have added my review so that women who are petite or medium-sized aren't scared off to try this bra.  I am going to buy another set, and only use my other bras when I wear tanks or tops where the straps are going to show.  But when I have to wear my other bras, I still wish I were wearing these comfy ones!!

product_title: Southpole Men's Lock Hoodie Track
review_headline: Nice hoodie to wear at any time.
review_body:
Ordered this hoodie on the 6th Sept 2013, received it on the 21st Sept 2013.
For a 1.77m tall, 60kg guy I didn't know what size to order but I went for the M anyway, based on the size guide.
Nothing fancy about the packaging. It came wrapped in plastic in a big plastic Amazon mailing envelope.
I know a lot of people are skeptical about buying China-made products but I can only say good things about this hoodie.

1. Size - The Medium size fits me perfectly. I have long arms and the sleeves are long enough to cover my wristwatch.

2. Material - Not too thick and not too thin. Great for everyday use.

3. Looks - The black with 2 white stripes look great. The rear stripe is wider than the front one. Pockets are deep enough to keep your hands off the cold weather outside. Zipper is of good quality which can withstand average abuse.

4. Stitching - All the seams are nicely stitched. No loose threads or anything of that kind.

So all in all, I'm very pleased with this purchase.

product_title: Motherhood Maternity: Lace Trimmed Nursing Sleep Bra
review_headline: Great nursing bra - heck, I would wear it even if I wasn't nursing!
review_body:
I wish I had this bra with my first child. I struggled with mastitis and any bra too tight in any area, with a wire, to thick (warm), or even a large seam aggravated the situation. I've tried many nursing bras in search of one that met my needs. My quest at long last has ended!

This bra has a lot going for it:
No wires, tags, or even a seam that I notice.

The black lace:
Comfortable, not itchy, and well positioned to let my boobs breath. Sexy - which is nice in a nursing bra - my hubby appreciates it.

Support:
This is by no means a bra I would wear to go running but for sleeping and puttering around the house (and I confess, even going outside the house...) it offers moderate support without being restrictive. It wears like a favorite, comfy sports bra.

The low cut front:
Besides my husband appreciating this artistic feature it is also works well if you want to do skin to skin (i.e. kangaroo care) with your newborn after your milk comes in (I'm one of those ladies who leaks A LOT and MUST wear a bra). It is also great for ease of access when nursing your little one frequently.

Sizing:
My boobs swell up to 3 times their usual size when my milk comes in but I know it may be different for everyone. I went to the store and tried on bra's at about 37 weeks (because I learned that the ribs tend to expand the further along you are) and then bought the size up with room to grow cup-wise. I wanted something comfortable for the hospital stay. I definitely recommend trying on in the store before purchasing. The store also is the same price without the S&H.

Durability:
My second baby is only 3 weeks old but the one bra I have has held up in the wash so far. I'll try to update this review in a few months after a few more washes.

Overall this is a thoughtfully designed, comfortable, visually pleasant bra for a great price.

review_headline: YOU GET WHAT YOU PAY FOR
review_body: No one can say  that Fruit of the loom makes top of the line underwear.  They are nice looking, fit well, and are comfortable. However, the material is thin enough to read a newspaper through and they won't last as long as more expensive undershorts.  The question is does their low price justify buying them more often because they wear out faster?  Being a Scotsman, I appreciate the initial low price and have this opinion.  Undershorts from a well known trading company named for a Great Lakes port have a wonderful product; well made with a superior fit.  The fabric can be scrubbed with a steel brush for about ten years before they fray.  They also cost about 25 bucks each in a set of four.  The Fruit of the Loom were about 18 bucks for four ($6.50 each) with free shipping for a Prime member.  That means the Fruit shorts can be repurchased four times before the cost of the expensive shorts is reached.  The thinner material also make them cooler, much appreciated by my personal fruit during the hot weather here.  So I'll keep buying Fruit of the Loom underwear.

This dress was cute. It looked reasonably similar to the photo online. It fit a bit tight but I was okay with that. If you do not want a clingy dress, then buy a different dress instead. Also, this dress may not expand enough to get you all the way through your third trimester.

One problem I had with this dress was that on only the second wear, before I had even washed it, I got a hole. The dress caught on a small pin-sized obstacle, but I think that if the fabric had been thicker or higher quality, then the dress would not have gotten a hole. The hole is not fixable by simply sewing it up, in part because the dress's thin stripes make it impossible to hide thread (since the thread will naturally either match the light pink or the darker pink stripes, but not both). Additionally, the fabric is a low quality knit, so it was very difficult to sew the hole without unraveling this dress even more.

For the price, I thought this would be a good dress to wear for the next few months. However, I expected to get more than two wearings out of it. Therefore, I generally regret buying this dress.

product_title: Aurorae Yoga "The Ultimate"" Racer Back Tank Top
review_headline: LOVED IT - but not so sure now - Great Customer Service!
review_body:
This is my new favorite yoga tank. I don't know why it's so difficult for others to just make them fit this well and the price isn't too bad. This is fitted without cutting off circulation, long without riding up, and not too low cut in the chest which I find a bonus. Too bad they're sold out of my size in all colors. Hope they restock soon.

**UPDATE**

So I just ordered another one in purple (the first one was black) and the new one is different! The material is not as smooth but more cottony, it is way looser at the bottom so doesn't fit as well, and most shocking of all, the seams are different! It actually appears that it is a very similar but different shirt. I don't like this one nearly as much - definitely not worth $35. I'm shocked that this could happen and am extremely disappointed as I wanted to order more of these but won't risk it again.

**UPDATE #2**

Shortly after I wrote the update above I was contacted by the seller apologizing for my dissatisfaction with the purple shirt. He explained the following:

\\"The process used to achieve the colors other then black is called garment dying. During this dye process we have to allow for shrinkage and every once in awhile a garment will not shrink as much as it should. In addition to achieve the high saturation of color it is possible that the hand feel can change slightly. On the black item you received the seams are sewn with polyester tread which is already dyed black. However on the colors since we dye them after they are sewn we have to use cotton tread so that they will be the same color as the garment. This is because polyester thread does not take the color at the same heat levels as the Lenzing Modal and Spandex.\\"

He then offered to send me another shirt free of charge! This company really cares about their customers and I commend them for taking this step to ensure I was satisfied.

I requested the green shirt, the color is a little lighter and more of a seafoam green in real life than in the picture but it's a nice color. The fabric and fit are much more like the black one so it does appear that the fabric feel and fit of the purple were an unfortunate side effect of the dying process. I have now worn all three to yoga and the black and green shirt stay put during most poses but the purple rode up even during downward dog.

Overall I would recommend this shirt and certainly commend the company for their exceptional customer service, but you may take some risk when ordering a color.

product_title: Tea Collection Little Girls' Sea Life Twirl Mini Dress
review_headline: Cute but a bit too bright
review_body:
I really wanted to like this dress. The colors are too bright though, the print not as nice as others in the line. Nothing really would make you think of sea life other than the blue/ green color combo. It does have a vintage look to it if that's what you are after - it looks very 60's with what appears to be suns or dandelions, with aqua and navy polka dots all over. When worn over an ivory top (such as a Gap Smocked raglan top in \\"milk\\"), it becomes a bit more subdued.

The dress runs large as it is wider than other twirl styles, so base it on weight for best fit around the neckline and arms - as a reference, my daughter, almost 3, is 30 lbs and 36\\" and the size 2 fits better, even though she normally uses size 3T in this line. If you order a size down it is like a tunic on the short side, falling about an inch above the knee, so bike shorts, cropped leggins or capris are a must. This particular dress is difficult to match with leggings or tops from other manufacturers because the dark aqua on top is so prominent - however, light aqua and ivory work for a lighter summer look, sold at either Gap or Target ($7-$12).

There are two other dresses in this mini twirl style which are beautiful and can be matched far more easily with tops and bottoms - the [[ASIN:B00B1S9D08 Tea Collection Girls 2-6X Surf Floral Twirl Mini Dress]] with milk/ ivory bike shorts or leggings or with dark coral ones (\\"red pepper\\"), as in the [[ASIN:B00B18M9HM Tea Collection Girls 2-6X French Terry Play Short]], [[ASIN:B00B18M9IG Tea Collection Girls 2-6X Mini Stripe Capri Legging]], [[ASIN:B00B1S9DOO Tea Collection Girls 2-6X Side-Tab Pedal Pusher Legging]].

The other dress is the [[ASIN:B00B2009Q2 Tea Collection Girls 7-16 Jewel Floral Twirl Mini Dress]], my daughter's favorite, which matches the [[ASIN:B007XODRHY Tea Collection Girls Ribbed Purity Tee]] in \\"Bouquet\\" (magenta) and the [[ASIN:B00B18M9I6 Tea Collection Girls 2-6X Stretch Capri Legging]]in Regal Purple.

These clothes in general will not fade and remain looking new if washed inside out, in cold water, gentle cycle, with a mild laundry soap such as [[ASIN:B003A4I6ZY Eco-Me Laundry Soap, Emma, 32-Fluid Ounce Bottle]] and drip dried on a hanger (it can be tumbled dry on low as well but the friction tends to fade fibers). For tougher stains, [[ASIN:B005UX2KU0 Tide Free and Gentle High Efficiency Unscented Detergent, 50 Ounce (Pack of 2)]] works well, though it may fade clothes slightly over time. I do this with all my kids' clothes and they stay looking new from one child to the next.

product_title: Brixton Men's Fiddler Cap
review_body:
First off, I adore hats. My favorite part of the spring when I was a kid was going shopping for my Easter hat. That was in the 60s and I couldn't wait until I was grown and could wear a pill-box or a velvet one with the cool mini veil like my mom and her friends. I figured I was the only American woman who was saddened by the fact that hats lost favor. And then I heard about the Red Hat Society. Turns out there must a whole bunch of us and some of them even banded together when reaching the age where we don't really care if it is trendy or not.

I am not quite ready to go all 'wide brimmed, floppy hat with purple feathers', but I was looking for a couple of hats that were NOT made of wool for the spring. Upon first sight, I really liked this hat. When shopping for non-essentials, I try to buy only goods made in North America or Europe and over the years it has been increasingly difficult to find these. I delayed on this purchase because I didn't know its origin. My research of Brixton wasn't much help because I found they do sell hats manufactured US-- but also hats from all over, including China. *sigh* Since I couldn't come up with any other source for a hat I liked produced in a SMALL or 6-7/8 (I am pointing at you, Stetson) without spending $100 or more I eventually decided to just go for it. Turns out, it was made in China. But because it fits me so perfectly and is not what one typically finds in quality when inspecting (or would that be "...what one *does not* find..."?) I am happy to call it MINE--My New Hat!

I am going to attempt to post a couple of photos showing the inside detail for those who may be interested. It is lined and the inner band is finished nicely. It is worth the $35 and if I were to lose this one I would most likely buy another just like it. I might even get the grey fiddler by Brixton for when I am wearing black.

product_title: maxandcleo Women's Printed Sheath Dress
review_headline: So, So, Sooo beautiful. Just doesn't work as well as hoped for the bubble-butt body type. LOVE this brand - have other dresses!
review_body:
I'm hesitant to give this dress any stars because - it is a BEAUTIFUL dress, definitely well-made, it just didn't work for my body shape. I would describe myself as a pear, although the issue isn't even so much wide hips as it is a bubble-butt (haha). I used to be a gymnast, so perhaps that will provide a little extra insight as to the body type that this dress could have trouble with.

So that said, I actually thought the flowy nature of this dress would work well. I did order 1 size up from what I would normally get, per other reviews, but that wasn't enough for me. My hips are about 41'', but my waist is about 27''... dress shopping can get very difficult.

The dress fit, but it just looked awkward because it wound up being fitted around the hips, whereas the waist was loose and flowy as I expected. I know the size 10 says 41'' for hips in chart, but I assumed since the style of the dress seemed flowy - that the actual circumference of the dress itself wasn't 41'', but that it would fit someone with the 41'' hip size. Also - the dress is a little bit shorter than I expected, although that really wouldn't have been a problem if it was just built better for the "pear" shape.

My plan was to have an elegant, flowy, feminine, slightly-artsy loose-fitting dress that I could belt and wear with pearls. This fit the bill in every way except for the bubble-butt issue, so I'll have to return it for that one reason. If you don't have a bubble butt, go for it - I highly recommend the dress itself! :)

product_title: Sportty 6 in 1 Thermal Fleece Balaclava Hood Police Swat Ski Bike Wind Stopper Mask
review_body:
The design is ok, not perfect, good but the size is probably \\"medium\\". It fits on my head well, but the \\"face mask\\" part ends up at eye level. I would consider my head size Large and this balaclava hood just barely fits while it does obstruct the lower portion of my view.
Another con is that the style completely leaves your forehead exposed. If it was larger I could wear a layer of head protection underneath and that would solve the exposed forehead problem. As it stands though wearing a hat underneath would not only be too snug, but it would raise the face mask well above eye level
Also the neck piece is shorter than you would expect. It protects the back of my neck but just hangs off my chin as opposed to wresting on my shoulders and completely covering my neck as the picture implies.

All in all, it is a good face mask, but I will have to make adjustments to it in order to make is usable. And I will still have to wear a scarf to completely insulate my neck area. I will also have to see how cold my forehead gets.

I've now tested the item in a blizzard.
As I suspected, my forehead gets very cold in this, while it does protect my face below my eyes. I managed to tuck the mask part down a bit so I can see. All in all it works ok. If you have a small-medium head get it, but if you have a large head or extra large head, or if you are a tall person you should definitely skip it and look elsewhere.

review_body:
I've been wearing Hanes underware for almost 50 years....and have always been happy with the stuff. This time around, I note specific sizes have disappeared, to be replaced with S/M/L. Seems like a method to save manufacturing costs at the expense of bettter customer fit. Also, a BIG significant change is the amount of \\"rise\\" in these new underpants. I am 6'2\\" and these underpants still have significantly TOO MUCH rise. If one pulls the pants up, not tight ala wedgey...but just comfortably high so that no excess underpant fabric is lying in rolls, then the elastic waist-band is positioned much higher than my hips....most unnatural. Coincidentally, I have lately also tried Jockey underpants, and found the same high rise phenomenon. It seems that manufacturers of goods should evolve to a \\"highest state\\" over time...whereas these underpants (and competitors too) have degraded over time.

Update 11/19/2013: After wearing and washing at least two or more times, these underpants have now shrunk to a very acceptable size. I have directly compared these new style underware to many of my \\"old style\\" Hanes underware, and can state the two are comparable. I'll actually be buying more of the new style...which has now generated four starts versus my previous three star rating.

The material is light-weight; airy and it has also held up well -- no fraying; no worn areas. None of the stitching has come undone and the elastic around the waist (actually just under the bust line) is comfortable and it has not stretched. product_title: Double Layered Comfort Cotton Chemo Sleep Cap & Headband Beanie Hat Turban for Cancer
review_headline: Exactly what I was looking for!
review_body:
Our old New England home has no heat in the bedroom so I have been searching for a nightcap for years and am so happy I came across this one. Simple, thin and comfortable while so many others expect you to be able to sleep with a pompom rolling around at the end of a long cone. No thanks. Thin as stated, you can even use this as a further hat-liner if needed. I use it without the headband that came included since I tend to get sinus headaches and want to avoid any further pressure between temples and pillow. It is another reason so many further nightcaps did not work, they were either thick as a normal knit hat or had a sewn on rim. Luckily even with my thin hair my head is small enough so just the 'stretch-material' aspect of the cap is enough to keep it in place and on throughout the night. Snug, but not so much that it keeps me from dismissing it after a short while to fall asleep comfortably. Fact that I can pull it down flat to cover my ears is also nice. Lastly, the material itself is soft and anything but scratchy on the forehead.

This nightcap is perfect for me and my needs and has help increase the sleeping experience whereas I have just enough added warmth on top to simply tuck in instead of completely burying myself under the covers.

Cheers, MJV

product_title: Columbia Men's Watertight Packable Rain Jacket
review_headline: Works really well in wet and cool environments.
review_body:
A bought two of these jackets for my spouse and I for our trip to Alaska in June, and they worked really well in that environment.

The Columbia jacket is very lightweight, but manages to trap a decent amount of body heat. The temperatures we used them in ranged from the high 50’s to low 60’s F, and I was okay wearing just a t-shirt underneath if I was moving around bit or a t-shirt and a sweater if I was more sedentary.

Besides the cool temperatures we also used the jackets in a lot of rain. One day it was pretty much a continual shower and both of the jackets lasted for hours without letting any water in, save a small dime sized spot I noticed by my chest that didn’t spread, so it was probably a one time fluke. The built in hoods have a locking mechanism and a decent bill to keep rain out of your face, while the waist is able to cinch up as well.

We used the jackets for general hiking, horseback riding, and ocean kayaking. They held up well in all these environments and didn’t have any issues. I also washed them in my front load washing machine on the gentle cycle and they came out great.

There are lots of pockets scattered throughout. There are two large packets on the sides that are zippered, a small zippered pocket over the left-hand chest, and a large pocket on the inside. I used one of the lower pockets to store my camera, and the chest pocket for my wallet and other small personal items. The inside pocket is not only meant to pack the jacket into for traveling, but when empty makes a huge pocket that you can carry a moderately sized book in!

As far as sizing is concerned they run just a touch big, which is great for layering. I am 5’6” and 135 lbs and wore a small. My spouse is 6’4” and 190 lbs and wore a large.

All in all… excellent rain jackets at a great price.

product_title: Columbia Men's Watertight Packable Rain Jacket
review_headline: EXCELLENT JACKET FOR THE MONEY. WELL MADE! GOOD LOOKING!
review_body:
Love the color, rich and beautiful, and the way the fabric feels.. Looks like a great deal for the money. It says it is waterproof, certainly you can bundle yourself up well in this jacket to protect yourself from the elements. I am a female who normally wears men's 2XL but this one is a little bigger than usual. I could have been way better served with a 1X. I had read reviews that said that it runs large. Decided to keep it though because the sleeves tighten at the wrist enough for me (I have small wrists), and I love the adjustability of the hood both around your face and also in the back the tab that makes the hood itself smaller. I would think for men or women with short hair that would be a huge plus..I couldnt figure how to get it in its " self-pack" so will just roll it when I pack luggage for trips, and put it in a gallon ziplock bag to contain it. It isn't too heavy, I think the weight of it is just perfect for a variety of temperatures.
Because it wasn't obvious how to pack it, and I spent a good bit of time trying to figure it out, I gave it a rating of 4 instead of 5 stars.The self pocket for packaging is on the side inside at the front near the zipper with a couple of small velcro type closures. Also when you get this jacket, go on and adjust the stretchy black cording to fit as you like it, on the hood. Cinch the stretchy cording in the little groove on the black plastic thing on each side of the hood, so you dont have to figure that out when it starts raining on you (like if you are wearing it riding a bicycle or something and a shower happens. This is a good buy for the money, the quality is there without paying 300 bucks for one of the high tech ones.. I wish I had had it for my AK trip last month!!!

review_body:
Background - I've purchased a lot of t shirts looking for the right one, e.g Jockey, Apt 9 which both sell stretch undershirts. I have been dissatisfied with every one till now.

Note: This shirt runs small. I am normally a M and I purchased a S. It fits perfectly.

Fit - perfect. Snug but not tight. If a shirt fits too loose, material bunches up under your business shirt. If it's too tight, you look like a stuffed sausage.

Material - Just right thickness. Not sheer like so many manufacturers are going with. This is a problem with most stretch T's.

Construction - seams lay flat and don't pucker.

Comfort - Every bit as comfortable as a 100% cotton shirt. The shirt moves with you, which is where the stretch feature really comes in handy. Some arm holes can be constraining (e.g. riding a sport bike, you have to extend your arms forward). This shirt does not have that problem.

Collar - it's a bit on the wide side, but it lays flat.

This is my favorite shirt since the discontinued Merona stretch shirt, which had quite a following on the Internet by people who pay attention to these things.

This is my new undershirt!

product_title: Panache Veronica SW0640 Lagoon One Piece Swimsuit NWT Available Size 30D
review_headline: I have never felt this good in a swimsuit in my life.
review_body:
I am 5'3", a size eight, 30HH, with a 30" waist and a butt that would give Kim Kardashian a run for her money, and very little muscle definition. In general, I like my body. I wouldn't trade my shape for a smaller one. But I do not enjoy swimsuits. They almost never fit properly: either I'm spilling out at the top, or they're cutting into my thighs and hips, both of which make my frame lumpy instead of sexy. This suit does none of that.

I did order a 30H, because I'd rather have the top be too small than too large, because if it's a choice between being risque or looking unsupported, I'll choose risque every time.

The lagoon color is so, so, so much prettier than it is in the picture. It's shimmery, but very, very subtly so - it just manages to give the color a very vivid depth to it. There's something so deliciously feminine about it. It emphasizes curves in such a way that when you wear this suit, you feel like you're a thousand times sexier than a size four. It's eye catching and regal, and the fit is divine. I feel *beautiful* in it.

Seriously, if you have an hourglass shape, buy this. Buy fifty of them. Every woman in the world should feel as good as this suit makes me feel.

I was NOT a fan of the interior wiring, on mine, it did not seem to hold a "stiffness" pose very well as depicted in the picture. This wasn't a huge deal for me and I just opened it up and removed the wire (the wire itself is actually a decent, insulated piece so if someone DOES have luck with theirs working the way I assume it is intended, it should last for awhile and should not cause any "sharpness" or "poking through" issues). I thought removing the wire would necessitate more stuffing, but this ended up not being the case for me and it holds it shape just fine. Color is good, fabric is good and the exterior of the hat itself is QUITE large.

My only complaint MIGHT be the interior size for the head. As most Elope hats, there is a good quality Velcro extension, however I don't have a particularly large head and I find I need to leave it open to wear the hat all the way on my head. You might need some experimenting on positioning to wear it for a larger head. The weight of the stuffed part of the hat meant that if I wasn't wearing it pulled down over my forehead, it felt like it could fall off (and this was both before and after removing the wire).

Because the fabric is a reasonably good quality mix of softness and stiffness to hold a shape, it's not very breathable and will get warm pretty quickly, which is not so bad for an inside, air-conditioned costume event, but less comfortable for an outdoor summer ren-fair, for example. With a wig AND the hat, you are probably going to be sweating a lot.

Previous to starting my alterations, I have worn the hat in public several times to test it's durability and how it wears, and gotten lots of compliments.

product_title: Hanes Silk Reflections Women's Blackout Tight With Comfort Stretch Panty
review_body:
Hanes Silk Reflections - Convert-A-Tight is the latest in new hosiery for Fall 2012. If you want a versatile look for your wardrobe, this tight can easily become a legging, creating two different looks with the same item.

I love wearing leggings and tights in the Fall and Winter seasons. They keep my legs warm, and make my outfits look stylish. This new style that converts a tight to a legging has me really excited because now I can use the same pair to create two different looks.

It is also really very easy to change from the tight to the legging, and when wearing it either way, nobody would ever know your little convert-a-tight secret, unless you tell them of course.

When wearing it as a tight, you just slide it on like any other tights. Put your toes into the toe pocket and they look like normal tights. When wearing as a legging, you put your toes through the opening in the foot. You then fold the toe pocket under and adjust the legging to the length you want it at.

This style is available in black that is actually a \\"blackout\\" look which provides maximum opacity for your legs. I really like this because it is warmer, and it also makes the legs look slimmer. The Comfort Stretch(tm) Panty with no bind waistband is also slimming while still being comfortable.

I love this Convert-A-Tight. It is fashionable, comfortable, and affordable. My only wish is that they come out with options for other colors for this style one day. I highly recommend it.

* Thank you to Hanes for providing me with the product for review. All opinions and experiences expressed are my own.

product_title: American Apparel Cotton Solid Thigh-High Socks - Kelly Green / One Size
review_headline: Someone who's never had thigh-high socks before
review_body:
I bought these thigh-high socks (in Kelly Green) because I wanted to see what it was like to have some socks that actually go above my knee. See, awhile ago I had found some "above the knee" socks in a store. After buying them, I'd found that they did not actually go above the knee. They stopped right on top of my knees, where I can't wear them. (but they did make a nice, loose-fitting knee high sock)
I'm around 5'8" or 5'9", and my legs are thicker than most girls I've seen. But these socks actually cover almost my whole leg. Maybe three inches from the top (though I may be able to pull them up a little higher if I try. I'm not sure). They also don't cause the 'muffin top' that I've heard about. They're slightly tight, and leave an impression on my legs after I wear them, but they don't cause a bulge where they stop on my thighs, and they're tight enough to stay up. I don’t know yet what will happen after washing or after a lot of use.
They're different from normal socks. There's something about the fabric that isn't like my other socks. I can feel where they bunch up at my ankles and my knees if I move my foot or leg. I probably wouldn’t be able to sit on my legs when wearing these socks. It's less noticeable when I'm actually walking and not paying attention. But I don't think I've ever had socks that felt like that. I suppose it’s a rougher and less stretchy material than other socks. They’re not as soft as the average crew socks, and aren’t unfilled-balloon-like like knee-socks. They’re large socks even when not on your legs.
After wearing them for a couple hours or so, they were a little lower on my legs than when I had put them on. Perhaps three or four inches lower. I think it's just because the fabric was needed at my knees. I doubt they would have lowered much more than that.
About the Kelly Green color, I usually only see knee high socks in blue, red, gray, and beige. Green is my favorite color, so I wantedsome green socks. They're a bit on the yellow side of green, and bright. I like the blue side of green, but this isn't a bad color (doesn't quite match anything of mine, though).

Oh, one thing about the shipping. It said it was being shipped with ConsumerBGT. ...There is no ConsumerBGT shipping company? It gave a tracking number, though, and I eventually figured out that it was coming through UPS (I had tried checking USPS and Fedex, but had forgotten about UPS). There was a review I had found by someone who said they found their package on the Fedex site, so I guess it could be either company.

product_title: Dan Post Women's Cowgirl Certified Black Over the Calf Socks
review_headline: I was skeptical, but these won me over!
review_body:
I'm disabled and my budget is TIGHT, so to pay so much for SOCKS? Still, there were enough mention of having good boot socks that I'd come across looking for good cowboy boots that I decided after trying several pairs of BOOTS to try the socks and just see what the big deal is!

At first I thought they were just lovely sturdy socks with cushioning where you want it and support where you need it and a snug fit all the way up. And those are a lot of nice things for a pair of socks, but what really won me was being able to pull a bit of extra fabric looser at the toes and pretty much STILL have it there after wrestling on my boots! (Rather than having it stock to the boot in passage and be pulled too tight for your toes once the boots are finally on! THEN after a bit I noticed that they just plain stay where you put them everywhere! Meaning that they don't fall down after a while either!

Just a note tho, especially in my new boots the socks made my right foot too big, but the smaller left foot feel wonderful! So, tho I don't quite remember why I first bought them, I'd picked up a pair of Miracle Socks, they are anti fatigue compression socks and about what I paid for these. I think I grabbed them as thinner boot socks since I was having trouble finding black boot socks at anything like reasonable...And they are just like thinner versions of these! So I wear a Miracle Sock on my right foot and my boot sock on the left foot that would slide around a bit without the cushion of the boot socks!

Most likely by next winter my right foot will have finished breaking in the boot so I can wear my Dan Posts on both feet for warmth. For now both feet and legs are very happy!

It may be a knockoff, but I absolutely love it! It was worth every penny and I do not regret buying it. It is so fun to go around and fool with friends. product_title: OOOUSE Black Magic Touch Screen Texting Gloves, iPhone, Tablets, & GPS.
review_body:
If I spent any more money than I did on these gloves, I would be extremely disappointed. Even with the money that I did spend, I am still let down. I go to college in an environment that consists of an average of 20 degrees in the winter during the day, but it frequently drops to below 0 also. Just this last week, we had a big cold front that came through and dropped the temperature to about 30 degrees, and these gloves helped, but my hands were still cold. If they can't even keep my hands warm in 30 degrees, how are they going to hold up in the winter?

Additionally, the gloves don't even fit that well. I'm a guy and I've never considered myself someone with big hands and one of my friends who is a girl actually has the same pair and her hands don't fit it either. The wrists fit fine, the fingers just aren't long enough so you almost have some sort of webbing in-between the fingers.

They also came with lose fabric and I can tell that in about a month or 2 they'll probably fall apart with frequent use. My friend's already has a hole on one of the fingertips and mine will probably follow shortly.

The only real use that I can see for these is if you're going to be using them in an environment that's only somewhat cold in the winter and for light use, which probably won't be too many people. I wouldn't recommend them to anyone and would rather recommend getting a more expensive pair that will fit better and actually last a while.

review_body:
Ordered the Purple Sarong.

The actual measurements are 61"x43.5" - a significant difference than what was advertized 70"x50".

Right off the bat, the reason I ordered this sarong vs others was for it's advertized size of 70"x50" as I'm a plus-sized woman and wanted to be sure there was enough material for a variety of wrap styles. As soon as it arrived (well packaged, clean, no wrinkles, no loose beads in the box), I measured it on a yard stick.

The color is a match to what I see on screen. Reading reviews that complain of loose beads...I can see right away where I'm going to have problems on fringe...they are inconsistently secured to the fringe...some are hanging on one or two threads with the fabric knotting somewhat above the string itself, while other strings are completely wrapped/protected by the fabric itself. I surmise that regular and normal wear would eventually cause issues, particularly if used frequently with the clip.

As for the bleeding, being forewarned from other posters (and being stuck without the ability to return the item because I needed/purchased it for an outing the same period it was delivered), I simply handwashed item three times...all with a small white baby's tee...just to see what it would pick up...absolutely no color transfer.

product_title: Lily of France Women's Yoga Sports Bra 2151720
review_headline: So comfy, but not that great support.
review_body: All these positive reviews are right. This is one of the most comfortable sports bras ever. I bike to get groceries and to do other shopping, so I try to wear normal clothes and this doesn't have noticeable seams which show in the front like many other sports bras do. The only thing is it's lacking is enough support via the straps - this bra feels slightly too slack in the straps to me (I'm petite) and there's no way to adjust them. I'm not sure if a smaller size will help because it feels just right to me for the cups (34C, and I bought a medium). So, while this would not be my first choice for 8 mile runs or HIIT training where things need to be held in, I do think it's a comfortable bra for low impact stuff like bike riding, walking, pilates, or yoga. It is very comfortable bra, so if you want to want a bra that's comfy to just lounge around the house in, this can fit that bill too. I like it enough to buy another, but am still looking for something else for those jogging and HIIT days.

product_title: Outback Jacket
review_body:
Sorry Scott,

I'm definitely a SCOTTEVEST fan. I have one other jacket, and a vest. The products are very well designed, including the Outback. As soon as I opened the package I loved this jacket. It fits well, and is warm in the winter. The pockets are great and are so much like my other jacket that I know where everything goes. I love consistency.

However, there are 2 things that are driving the poor rating for the Outback jacket. The first is the most important. The zipper has a very poor design. After only wearing it a few days, the bottom portion of the zipper broke inexplicably. It didn't take any force. The bottom simply broke during normal wear. Now, the great news here is that the company honors their warranty. They are letting me send it back. But the poor zipper design seems to be part of this jacket. There are other reviews and articles on the web that describe similar issues for others.

The second issue is minor, but still affects my review. The jacket ships with an X-Ray view that shows all the pockets. There was a special pocket labeled \\"Hidden Key Pocket\\" in the guide. I couldn't find it anywhere. So, I emailed customer service and received this exact reply: \\"In the x-ray view, you will see it is connected to the keychain. This hidden key pocket just means your keys will not fall out of your pocket connected to the key chain.\\"

You're kidding me, right? There is no hidden pocket, but they put it on the guide. So, why bother adding a \\"hidden pocket\\" to the x-ray view if there is no pocket. Don't get me wrong. The jacket has enough actual pockets that you don't have to make up any more. But I do count points off for exaggeration.

Don't buy the Outback. But do buy a SCOTTEVEST. The revolution is great. The light-weight tropical is great. The products are overall great. This one jacket is the exception.

product_title: Glamorise Women's No-Bounce Full-Support Sport Bra
review_body:
Ordered this bra because of the great price-point. I have two Glamorise sports bras already. One, purchased in my regular size a few years ago, is workable, even though I've gotten larger, but I needed another bra in the rotation. So, about 2 months ago, I purchased another Glamorise in the same size - that left me with my old 'full-figure sports bra" style 1006 (http://www.amazon.com/Glamorise-Womens-Full-Figure-Sports-1006/dp/B000VK9ZJG) and the new 'Double layer Custom-Control' sports bra (http://www.amazon.com/Glamorise-Womens-Double-Layer-Custom-Control-Sport/dp/B00553XFN6/ref=cts_ap_2_fbt). The new Custom-Control bra was not wearable, as it was way too small, so when I ordered this bra, I ordered up a full back size with the same cup size. It fits perfectly, but I kind of wish that I had ordered down a cup size because it is rated as less supportive than the other bras, and I think that if I had ordered a cup size down, it would help with the bounce. That's not to say that this isn't a supportive bra - it is, and it drastically reduces bounce and serves my purposes with perhaps the exception that I could use a bit more support for jumping jacks. Again, I knew when I ordered it that it wasn't Glamorise's most supportive sports bra, but I couldn't resist the low price given that I hope not to be in this size too much longer. I will say that others' complaints about heat and sweating are accurate, but isn't that the case with most sports bras?

Bottom line - for more active sports and a more breathable fit, I would go with style #1006 instead. For extreme support, I would go with the double-layer custom control bra. Consider purchasing up a band size and down a cup size from your ideal fit street bra.

From other reviews I've read on other leather jackets I've seen, I notice a lot of people complaining that their jacket is too heavy. I'm not sure how heavy a leather jacket "should be," however I have no problem with this jacket's weight, not too heavy not too light.
All-in-all, I rate this an excellent buy.

product_title: Neushop Women's Rand 100% Cotton Short Sleeve T-shirt
review_body:
In case you aren't aware, cotton is one of the major exports from Peru (along with sugar) and they are particularly known for the fine threads created by Tanguis cotton which was first introduced in 1911. This cotton produces a longer and stronger fiber than traditional cotton. These shirts are made from this cotton and are made in Peru.

These t-shirts have what they call "short sleeves" and what I might call "cap sleeves." They are designed for women and are fitted. So if you are looking for a loose fit, you need to buy these a size larger. If you are comfortable with a form fitting look, you will love these.

Like microfiber sheets, these are thin and silky, yet tough. You would think by feeling and wearing them that they had something besides cotton (they stretch), and I found mine extremely comfortable to wear. In the winter, I wear t-shirts under my tops for warmth, and the lightweight nature of these combined with being 100% cotton means these work nicely for both exterior (summer) wear and under tops or layered for cooler times.

I was given a complimentary sample of this (in the deep claret color) to check out and test so that I could do my review. As a result, I gave this an extra look. I don't recommend products unless I believe in them. (And yes, that is WHY I know about the Peruvian Cotton - I looked it up to know what I was talking about)

There were no variations in the color in the shirt - it was uniform and even. Turning the shirt inside out, I inspected the seams and hems. All were sewn evenly and to last. There are NO tags inside, contributing to both the comfort and style as you wear these. My only comment would be that the size stamp on the fabric could be visible in certain colors.

I wouldn't hesitate to recommend this to my friends or to purchase this on my own, and am giving this five stars.

product_title: Trick or Treat Studios Halloween II Michael Myers Mask, One Size
review_body:
For the price of this mask, you can't go wrong buying it. There are pros and cons, though.

Pros:
1. It looks authentic
2. The hair looks good (but does need touching up.)
3. The price is right.

Cons:
1. Too big (I'm only 5' 8" so I wear a beanie under it to help fit better.
2. There will be a tiny bit of loose hair shedding. (As with any other mask with hair.)
3. The whole bottom half is unpainted, but is VERY fixable.

I give it a 4 out of 5 simply because it is too big. There needs to be maybe a choice in size, but like I said, I wear a beanie underneath and this helps flawlessly. All in all this is the most authentic looking mask for the price. I love it.

review_headline: Look no further, this is your jacket.
review_body:

The north face was also rather bulky and boxy and I had trouble moving my arms freely.

Not with this jacket! This jacket is so comfy and fits my curves nicely. It gives a nice feminine look. I'm 5'2" and 158 lbs, with most of my junk in the trunk so to speak. I fit in both the large and the medium, but went with the medium as it had a more feminine look. This jacket actually looks nice on me and is very easy to move around in. I wore it all day yesterday and I can't get over how warm I was in such a thin jacket. It is also SO soft! I can't stop touching it.

While I found one or two fly always, this jacket didn't shed or leave evidence everywhere, which I was worried about. Although the hand pockets do not zip, they are deep and have a ledge side so that your items don't slide out. There are also two deep inside pockets on each side.

I bought one in black and I like that while it looks sporty, it doesn't scream active wear. I wore it with a thin sweater and jeans with boots yesterday.

If you are looking for a warm, thin, easy to move around in jacket that is so comfy you don't want to take it off... This is it.

product_title: Mission Belt Men's Leather Ratchet Belt
review_body:
I'm a huge fan of ratchet belts after I bought my first one from Mission belt website. Really love the adjustable ratchet buckle. I now owned this kind of belts from Mission, SlideBelt and a few from Mooniva. Here is my 2 cents comparing belts from these three vendors:

Commonalities:
- Very Similar ratchet mechanism, which is the main reason I liked ratchet belts. So easy, so flexible!
- Great quality leather for a reasonable price

Here is the rough comparison of belts from the three brands:

Mission Belt (the earliest vendor selling ratchet belt):
- Its buckles are rather simple and plain. Not many other textures and designs. I liked its black on black basic version.
- Leather quality appears to be great. My first ratchet belt was a Mission bought from its website. It's still working fine.
- Mission offers different belt colors, but its leather texture is rather plain and traditional. Not much of choice even with the newer edition I purchased
- Width of the buckle and belts are slightly smaller. Most traditional men's buckles and belts are of same width as SlideBelt/Mooniva. I need a slimmer one for a few pants that I own. For others, I use SlideBelt/Mooniva.

Mooniva Belt:
- Mooniva is one of the best vendors that I bought from in terms of buckles. Its website also sells separate buckles that you can hookup with the belts you bought. Their choices of buckles are really amazing.
- Leather quality appears to be great. It also have premium leather option, which will cost more. So far, my Mooniva belts still look great.
- Different Mooniva belts has different leather texture. I picked the traditional ones. It has many other options.
- Mooniva's belt and buckles appears to be the same width as SlideBelt, but slightly wider than Mission.

SlideBelt:
- SlideBelt buckles are a little bit different from Mission and Mooniva. The switch is not using the small tab, but an flipper.
- Leather quality appears to be ok. Surface texture is a bit rough. Just bought it not long ago. Will see how long it will last.
- SlideBelt offers not only different belt colors, but it also has some texture variations that you can pick.
- Belt and buckle width is about the same as Mooniva, but slightly larger than Mission.

review_body: I was very happy to find this coat here on Amazon...and at this price, it was hard to pass on it. G-Star is a bit tricky, coat-wise. Well, this coat runs a tad big. The XL is a bit roomy, so it works fine if you're wearing a sweater under it. I know from experience while visiting the G-Star stores here in NYC, that the large would be ok around the chest (if you want to keep warm, you don't really want an over-sized coat), but the sleeves are not long enough. So, I go up to the XL for that. This coat, in XL, fits fine at the shoulders, and the sleeves are plenty long enough. It doesn't look as if I'm swimming in it, either. It is plenty warm, too...a great coat for the NYC winters. So, if you are wearing a t-shirt, shirt over that, a sweater and then put on this coat, go for it. I'm very happy with it, and the color makes it possible to wear with a lot of color variations in shirts, sweaters, pants, etc.

I've been wearing mine several hours a day since I got it - practically living in it on days when I don't need to put on pants. I'm considering getting a number of them for gifts! I have the bright pink and it lifts my spirits every time I put it on. In fact I want another one in dark blue to wear when this one is in the wash! review_headline: It is perfect for hot weather or LA
review_body: It is perfect for hot weather or LA.  I have read review saying the material is cheap, but if the individual had lived in the tropical or Asia the individual would feel differently.  Asia is humid and hot, you need materials that allows your skin to breath. If you wear cotton that's thick, you get over heated or soaking wet from perspiration.  Thin cotton dries quickly and allows you to stay cool.  It's not humid in LA, so it's perfect.  It is a lot longer for me (5' 1"), it reaches my knee.  To make it short, I just tie the belt higher.  I am a size 10-12 on top and 8-10 at the bottom.  The top is loose, I like it that way.  Depending on where I tie the belt, it's short enough to wear with leggings or as a short dress (not mini.)  It also makes you look skinnier.  What I like does not mean others will like it.  It all depends on the look and versability you want.

review_body: I bought these pajamas based on other reviews. When they arrived, I thought there a bit thin. These have fun designs on them, softer and I like the feel of them. My son enjoys the characters on them. They are definetely thinner than the organic cotton pajamas from costco (which in my opinion are a bit stiff). They are of the same kind of material 190 GSM cotton. I would definetely buy them again. I usually put a sleeveless onesie underneath these since my son doesnt like to be covered when sleeping and I am sure these pajamas wouldnt keep him warm during Houston winters.

review_headline: a unique and stunning top coat
review_body: The top coat looks stunning in the picture, and it looks even better up close and personal.  It seems almost unfair to it, to call it a top coat. According to its appearance in the picture, it certainly works with the sweater, but one could also wear it with a matching shirt and tie, as if it were a 'winter' sport coat, so to speak. review_headline: Geoffrey Beene really gives a shirt!!!!
review_body:
I had bought a few of these shirts previously at a local major department store and loved them. They are comfortable, stylish, and remain looking new after many washings and wearings. The \\"cranberry\\" color is a strong red, and I bought two of these several years ago because it is our union color (National Union of Healthcare Workers). I am a psychologist, and a shop steward, and my employer has been fighting our union since its inception several years ago, refusing to provide adequate staffing to provide what our patients need and also trying to cut our benefits while they continue to make huge profits. From the time we first did a one day strike and the employer has continued to stonewall at the bargaining table, I pledged to wear red shirts every day until we get a contract. It has now been over 800 days, and I have been wearing red ever since. I bought a few more a year later at the same department store so that I would not have to do laundry every few days. These Geoffrey Beene shirts are great, and they generally do not need ironing as long as you hang them straight our of the dryer. They come with plastic collar stays, which are fine, but I prefer metal ones and have gotten some (also on Amazon).

I will have a wardrobe problem when the employer finally gets reasonable and settles a contract with us, but I think it may be simply solved by just getting some more Geoffrey Beene shirts in different colors.

product_title: Twelfth Street by Cynthia Vincent Women's Drop Back Embellished Shift Dress
review_headline: Beautiful dress...I just wish it had fit!
review_body:
This photos of this dress don't do it justice. It is even more beautiful in person. The beading and attention to detail are reminiscent of the ultra-feminine dresses from the 50s and 60s. This dress represents Cynthia Vincent's modern take on those styles, and it is spot on. The dress is made from a substantial-feeling crepe and lined in a lighter hand of the same fabric.

Unfortunately for me, the sizing seemed to be more "modern" or "contemporary" (you've seen those size charts on the Neircus Marmon website and on those of its competitors). Where I had hoped the size L would mean a 12/14, it fit more like a size 10. To get a more accurate idea of the sizing, I had my sister, who normally wears a 6/8 in dresses, try it on. While she probably could have pulled this off in a pinch, the dress was noticeably too large on her, confirming my guess that the sizing on this dress runs at least a size smaller.

With the sizing in mind, this is nevertheless a gorgeous dress. If you're eyeing it, go for it! When you receive it, you'll be in LOVE with it.

product_title: uxcell Front Pocket Zip Fly Skirt Hippie Pants for Mens
review_body:
After a very patient wait, I finally have these pants! And I just couldn't escape my duty to write the review that I wished was already here before my purchase...

I purchased these pants on a whim, so waiting almost 5 weeks to get them shipped [from Hong Kong] was not really a big deal. However, with the very little detailed information that exists for these pants, I was still nervous. The seller provides measurements, but honestly they are very unclear- especially since these pants have a dropped inseam.

The good news is that the \\"W30\\" in the description (indicating a size 30 waist) proved accurate. I am 5'11\\", 165 pounds and, besides being just the tiniest bit too short, these pants fit perfectly! My experience in retail would have me say that if you wear a 30x30, 30x32, 31x30, or 31x32 in American sizing, these pants will probably fit you.

In a nutshell this product is made with decent material and medium-quality construction: They resemble more closely a dress pant, and are a jet black. The seam stitching across the garment is solid, with the only issue being stray fibers at any of the button holes. Also, in case it is unclear in the picture, the section across the front is actually a removable/adjustable flap with a stitched pocket... I've kept the flap, as the pockets along the leg are too small to hold anything, and the assymetry of it helps to both balance the look and to hide the excess material that occasionally pulls out through the leg.

These are a comfortable, affordable pair of harem pants. One day out with them has already received a fair share of conversation and inquisitve looks! I've shopped other internet retailers, but did not want to spend the high dollar for something I wasn't sure I could pull off... I can't guarantee everyone will get as lucky as I did buying these pants, but hopefully this review helps. Happy shopping!

product_title: Rubie's Costume Adult Glitter Vamp Wig
review_body:
I want to clarify something: this is not a high-quality wig. If you are seeking something durable and long lasting, look elsewhere. If, however, you need only a one-time use, this product deserves four stars.

- The color is just like the picture, a vibrant berry purple.

- You may feel differently about the cut. I needed a bob. My hairstylist friend cut it into a cuter shape for me. Honestly, you should have darn near every wig tailored to your face, even one-night uses.

- The netting was very stretchy and comfortable. Again *for the price* it stayed on pretty well with the help of bobby pins. But it did ride up a few times over the night, requiring a couple trips to the bathroom.

- By the end of the night, it was pretty tangled, and if you try to brush it, use a wide tooth comb, otherwise locks of purple hair will fall out.

- Finally, I was cursed with kind of a large head for a woman. This fit comfortably. I don't think it would sit well on children or women with exceptionally small heads.

- Happy wigging! (And remember, this is a great wig for one night. Don't expect much more out of it.)

-Exceptionally narrow -- especially in the arms.
-Very heavy / durable fabric compared to other coats we've had
-Warmer/ more windproof than other puffer coats
-Looks great

Negatives:
-Exceptionally narrow -- especially in the arms...
-Zipper sometimes pulls open from the bottom while zipped up -- perhaps because the coat is so narrow and there is extra stress on it? My son is about as skinny as a four-year old comes, so if it's a fit issue then it would be a problem for most kids. I think it's quality.

product_title: Insta Slim Mens Compression Muscle Tank  (INT)
review_body:
This is a really great product. It does what it says it will. I was very impressed with the results.
I would recommend this to anyone looking for this type of product.

The only trick might be getting the sizing right. I ordered one slightly on the small side for what would fit me in regular shirt sizes (if you comfortably wear an XL shirt try a L compression shirt). I am not sure that will work for everyone, but a comment posted by another reviewer clued me into doing this. The results were perfect.

Putting it on is harder than taking it off. I found that a little surprising, but I'm not complaining.

The material is slick feeling, but also breathable. It's cool against the skin and seems to wick sweat away. It is a slightly thicker spandex, and it seems pretty tough/strong. It does what it is supposed to very well, and it is comfortable.

Side note: Choose your pants carefully. You will be a little slimmer, the material is slick feeling, and it's length goes down pretty far; you will need to wear a belt, and have it tight. Otherwise your pants will have a tendency to slip/ride/slide down a lot as you move. You will not be able to rely on what you normally do to keep your pants riding at where you're used to. Just keep that in mind so as to avoid possible embarrassment.

product_title: WonderWink Women's Scrubs Golf Top
review_headline: Ridiculously good quality for the price!
review_body:
I bought these scrubs for the first time online after reading many many reviews. I must say that the fabric is definitely high quality. They are a bit on the warm side but that is a good thing for how cold most hospitals are kept. The material is quick drying and acceptably soft even before the first wash. After the first wash they do soften up a bit more. I was able to grab these straight out of the dryer and wear them. I am also in love with how many pockets are on the top and bottom of this scrub set. The loops for ID are a very nice touch. There is also a tiny security pocket inside the waistband. It's just big enough to fit a house key or some cash folded over twice. It wouldn't be practical to keep anything you need to produce with people around. It would be pretty awkward looking to get into that pocket in front of other people, given that it's not very easy to get into.

SIZING
I bought a small top and a small bottom and they both fit closely without being clingy or tight.

In pants I am normally a size 4 and sometimes a size 6. 31" inseams just barley touched the ground on me, so my smalls appear to fit like a 31" or 32" inseam. For some reason my black pants were a hair longer than my pewter pants...?

In tops, it varies greatly for me because I have a size 4 physique with a size 34DDDD chest and slightly larger bicep muscles. As for the top, I'm really glad that the sleeves aren't big and flappy like some scrub tops. The sleeves are actually nicely fitted. My chest doesn't feel awkward in a small. However, since I had to buy my top to fit my chest, my waist is not very fitted in this top.

product_title: Larry Levine Women's Luxurious Double Breasted Coat
review_body:
I was looking for a comfortable, soft, coat with a bit of a different style from the usual fitted wool coat. This is great; its a loose swingy fit, as expected, and is comfortable to throw on to get in the car or to walk. I'm 5'8\\" and the coat hits me like it does on the model and the sleeves are even a bit long (which I like), so it would fit you differently if you're shorter. The size 6 is plenty roomy- don't size up. The fabric is really nice- soft, not too heavy, but warm enough. Almost like a mohair.
It doesn't button all the way down- there are two black buttons at the collar and one snap a little lower down, so when its windy the coat blows open. The color is a bit darker than the picture shows- its more of a tan/beige, but i think its better in terms of showing dirt than the stone color in the picture.
I think its cute and trendy, but when an older gentleman complimented me on the coat \\"that was just like one his wife had\\", I wasn't so sure...

review_headline: My favorite jacket and probably the only one I will ever own.
review_body:
I got this jacket last year some time and let me tell you, it is the best jacket I've ever owned. It's the only one I wore all winter (I'm outside quite a bit during all seasons), during which time it got down close to zero degrees; and yet, my torso was very rarely cold. When it was, I usually wasn't wearing my jacket. Of course, the rest of me got cold pretty quick, especially the hands... Getting off topic. So this jacket is beautiful and looks absolutely bad-ass, with the added benefit of keeping you very warm. My only problem with it is I can't wear it during summer as it would be way too hot. This of course, is not a flaw of the jacket, but just due to the fact that I enjoy it. It is recommended by me to anybody, although I'm sure my recommendation doesn't matter a whole lot to strangers. If you don't buy this, you are missing out on a great jacket.

PS: I just realized that I lied a little bit, the only problem I have with the jacket is the button on the left pocket came off a couple months after I got it. I was probably at fault for that, but just thought I'd be 100% truthful.

product_title: PattyBoutik Women's V Neck Short Sleeve Knit Jumper Tunic Top
review_body:
This is the fifth item I have ordered from Patty Women. I am a size 6 and ordered the medium (in burgundy). The sizing has been consistent across all the items I have ordered. I characterize this top as a light sweater, as the fabric is a stretchy knit, rather than a 'blouse tunic' as it's described (although it is on the longer side, as seen in the picture). Expect the fabric- as with most PW items-to be slightly thin, but definitely not see-through.

Something I find remarkable about Patty Women is that the pictures are generally very accurate in terms of quality, fit, and color. As someone who does a lot of online clothing shopping, I find this to be somewhat unusual. The styling is as represented, and is distinctive and feminine. The buttons are plastic, but I like them; they really work on this piece and match the fabric very well. Another nice touch is that they send all of their items in the smallest possible box, well packed in tissue paper with a nice gold seal and a little note. All in all, I am very pleased with Patty Women. I think they are a company that cares about making its customers happy, and this is reflected in their clothing and shipping methods.

product_title: London Fog Men's Vista 3-In-1 Convertible Systems Parka Coat
review_headline: A comfy, cozy parka, but not quite as pictured
review_body:
The quality of this parka is excellent, in some regards. It's quite heavy, cozy, and warm. The material seems to be of a good quality. The price, of course, is fantastic. It only costs $75, and I purchased mine on sale for $55.

But the fit is a bit odd- as others have mentioned in their reviews, the coat runs large, and in a rather strange way. I wear a Medium, and that's what I purchased. Yet, the parka is rather tight across the shoulders, and it sort of balloons out toward the bottom to the point where it gets way too big. It's almost like it's shaped a bit like a bell, or for people who might be "pear" shaped in stature. It does not have that "fitted" look (at least as far as parkas go) that appears in the photos for the product. It's not what I was expecting, based on what's pictured.

Additionally, the color is not quite as pictured (and I viewed the page from two separate computers; work and home). I ordered the graphite color, yet this parka is black, for all intents and purposes. If I hold it directly under a light, I might be able to say that it's dark, dark gray, but what's the point of that? As I said- for all intents and purposes, the color is actually black. I did not want a black parka, so I unfortunately had to return mine, despite its excellent price and other good features.

product_title: Kenneth Cole Men's Pea Coat With Bib
review_body:
I'm 5'10" and 140lbs. I usually only buy fitted clothes as everything else feels baggy. But I needed a new peacoat and this was on sale for $70. The construction is as nice as you'd expect from Kenneth Cole. The coat is midweight but keeps you warm if you layer it with a sweater. I removed the bib since I normally wear a scarf in the winter. Not sure how much use I'll get out of it, but it is nice to have the option. The color is a great dark blue that goes with everything.

The only other issue I have is that the collar doesn't really look right if you want to flip it up. I like the upturned look on a pea coat usually and it's useful if you're walking in the cold wind of a NYC winter. With the bib though I guess you don't really need to worry about the back of your neck as much.

If the coat had been a little more tailored at the waist and had a smaller stiffer collar it would be a 5 star.

review_headline: Perfect for what I needed it for
review_body: So after months of searching for an ewok costume I decided to improvise with a bear kigurumi. That was easier said than done. This was the only reasonably priced one I could find in brown. Once it arrived I tried it on and it fit just how I thought, a bit baggy but over all perfectly. I will say that the only downsides are that the nose on the hood is too heavy for the hood makes it cover the face too much, that is more annoying than anything but it is okay. The front is all done up with snaps and the fur around them is too long to do up with ease. I trimmed the fur around it so I could do it up quicker. The only other thing is that it is pretty cheaply made but I wasn't expecting super high quality because it was 30-50 bucks cheaper than the others I had found on other sites. I have already torn the cuff on the leg but it is easily fixed and this costume is worth buying for a warm comfy fun costume party or even if you just want something warm for around the house. I will say wearing something under it is a must because the super furry patches are very scratchy plus if you're like me you will get hot and want to take it off after a fun night of dancing.

product_title: ToBeInStyle Women's Ankle Length Jeggings
review_headline: Super Comfortable and Flattering - Looks like Jeans
review_body:
These inexspensive leggings are much nicer and more flattering than I expected! I'm extremely pleased! The screen print does in fact look just like denim, and they look great with my knee boots and tunic tops. They are SUPER comfortable. Looks like trendy super-skinny jeans, but feels like pajamas! The back of the black \\"faux denim\\" does not have as much screen print detail beneath the \\"pockets\\" as the front - they are more of a solid black on the back of the leg. (This company also sells a \\"blue\\" denim pair, which I also ordered and like).

I am 5'8\\" with a 30\\" natural waist and these leggings fit me fine. They would strectch to fit a larger person as well, though I would say that if your thigh circumference is more than 23\\" the thigh area may strectch to the point that they appear sheer, which would take away from the \\"faux denim\\" look. But on me they look just like jeans. They would also fit a much smaller person - they are extremely stretchy and forgiving.

The waist itself is extremely stretchy (no muffin top!) and smooth, would be virtually invisible underneath a fitted top (I hate when you can see the button on the fly poking through your shirt - not an issue with these!). While the pockets are simply printed on (not functional) they do look realistic unless you're right up close - though for me they'll be covered by a tunic length top when I wear them anyway.

I will definitely be ordering other styles of these \\"jeggings.\\"

product_title: Levi's Boys' 514 Straight Fit Jeans
review_body:
Sure, Levi's may cost a bit more than Walmart or Sears jeans, but the value is in the long run. These just last and last. I used to buy Gymboree for my son because those seemed well made, but the seams were rough, and while their adjustable waist was nice, the buttons frequently broke,rendering the 'adjustable' part useless.

Levi's can be had for less than Gymboree, and the seams are nicer, softer...these are still little guys and not men. Their clothes should be comfy. The adjustable waist has a huge variance, which helps with a long and skinny five year old who can wear a 3 shorts but is too tall. He's in a six slim and I can adjust them to the smallest and they are still comfy withOUT too much bulk.

Plus, little Levi butts are just the cutest. The knees last in these, and they wash nicely (fabric softener does help). We have three of the colors, my son likes the darkest best.

One gripe: the snap for the jeans is pretty hard for little hands. I usually have to help but he does okay at school so it must not be that much of a difference.

Great product! We like the 549's too.

product_title: Calvin Klein Men's Rip Stop Bomber Jacket
review_body:
Beautiful jacket. Just got this on a whim and am thoroughly impressed [thank you Amazon Prime and Amazon's stellar return policy]. I was looking for an everyday jacket that was "cool" looking but not crossing over to trendy. This totally fit the bill. Also, I was looking for a synthetic jacket to avoid pet fur clinging to it. I've found the pet fur STILL sticks to it, but I can brush it off more or less with my just hand - leagues better than what you'd expect with a wool jacket where you are forced to use a lint brush or bring out the tweezers.

The shell material is Rip Stop as described. What this apparently means is if the shell ever rips, the hole will in theory not get bigger without sufficient trauma - Don't know how well that works but I've never torn a jacket anyway. That said, the shell feels very durable. Wouldn't have reservations taking this jacket through some light branches outdoors - not that you could - the fit is constrictive in the shoulders, sort of like a suit jacket so it's not a very active jacket, but I'm just making a comment about the shell material - feels more durable than some "technical" jackets I have for a fraction of the price! Also heavier of course.

7 pockets: Two zipped handwarmers, two chest pockets, two internal hook and loop pockets and a mini pocket for your phone or something? Love all the pockets, can stash and divide up my credit cards, cash, beanie, scarf, phone - awesome. Love pockets.

I'm 5'8" 160 lbs. Got the small. I can fit a thick wool sweater underneath the jacket - the arms get a little tight when bent but it works.With a thick wool sweater underneath, it feels comfortable to about 40 F [I run cool] just sitting around or light walking. With just a button up on and no sweater, probably good down to 50 F with light walking, not feeling very warm but doable.

The liner is attached to the jacket and has it's own zipper, if that makes sense - so you zip up the liner all the way up the neck, then you zip up the "shell" up - The jacket is meant to look like you are wearing a zip up sweater underneath your jacket? Is this is a fashion thing or is there a reason to have two set of zippers? I'm not sure. I noticed this trend start a few years ago and thought it was silly fashion thing but actually I'm finding I don't mind.

The only external branding is "Calvin Klein" on the zippers [very small] and a small tab behind the collar. I'd rather there be no branding at all, but compared to some other brands, this is no big deal. In a pinch, would look good over shirt and tie for dress-casual, in my opinion, when you want to sport a tie but not do the suit jacket thing. A lot of versatility fashion-wise here.

All in all, great looking, warm, seemingly durable jacket at a very good price - I would possibly pay twice for this jacket. Might buy a second spare.
