product_title: True Religion Men's Ricky Straight Leg Super T Jean in Brown
review_headline: Appearance identical to photo and size is actually correct for once
review_body:
Great pair of jeans!!!!

When I purchase jeans, I have to buy a size larger in the waist because my thighs and legs are a little bigger than the avg. man. I normally have to purchase 36's although my true size is about 33-34'. I tried them on, the waist appeared true to the size indicated on the label and there was more than ample room in the legs. No option is given for the inseam when ordering. The length is a tad long though...about a 34' inseam on the 36's I would say. I am returning for the 34's, and because the sizes are correct and the pictures on Amazon accurately display what you are buying, I am ordering additional pairs in different colors. I believe they will fit perfectly. For those men who have difficulty buying jeans that fit properly because their proportions are not the average of what most consumers purchase, these are probably the ones for you. I have been limited to Nautica jeans for years because of their larger legs. If your waist is smaller in relation to the size of the thighs that most manufacturer's use when fabricating pants to fit the typical person with the most common waist to leg ratio, then I would think these are a good choice you. Those individuals who can wear the standard template produced jeans in most all brands, these will also look good without appearing too baggy. Its likely that the appearance will reflect a loose or relaxed fit on those individuals.

The price is steep, but you truely are getting what you pay for. Quality denim fabric is used...the weight and thickness are great. Because they appeared distressed, I feared the denim might be thin like those jeans that Areopostale or Ambercrombie and Fitch sell. The rarely fitting distressed jeans that I have purchased from them have not stood up to time, repeated wear, and the typical washing. The distressed areas typically become more frayed, become larger, and eventually tear after 6 months to a year if they're worn once a week. I still have jeans from high school that are over 20 yrs old which have not fallen apart. These True Religion jean's fabric are obviously pre-washed, so shrinking is not much of a concern, and the distressed look is not done by actually destroying areas of the material but is achieved through the actual dyes themselves. The feel of them denim is just like the above material description. They are not so soft that they would wrinkle easily, but are not so thick when compared to the original Levi's that used to be sold in my childhood.

Watch the pricing! I have noticed sales of True Religion Jeans on Amazon where the price has dropped almost a $100. I called Amazon's customer service when the prices dropped and they applied the differnce back to my credit card, as long as there has not been a substancial time gap. I have not noticed any price reductions on the TR website.

Overall, if you want jeans that are headturners and you do not mind spending the 6-700% price increase over the typical $40 blue jeans, then these are likely the greatest jeans you will ever own. I highly recommend this brand and the 'Ricky Super Jean' catagory pants of TR.

Dr. G

product_title: Maidenform Flexees Women's Shapewear Hi-Waist Brief Firm Control
review_body:
This hi-waist shaper brief is much nicer than I expected. It's not like a girdle at all but has a nice bit of control. I wasn't sure what size to get, so I got both L and XL. (Going by the size chart, I'd wear an XL, but I have a short torso and I'm losing weight and expect to be smaller soon.) The L is perfect.

I hadn't realized that the reason I hate wearing things like this is because I don't like how tight they feel on the tops of my thighs—I've always gotten the lower-cut brief or boy-short type—but that's not an issue with these. Because of the high-cut legs, the only tightness is where I want it: across my hips and up the length of my tummy and midriff. The tummy control is a reminder to tighten my stomach muscles and straighten my posture when I'm walking and exercising, and I really like that I don't have to worry about my booty jiggling. Of course, this is black, so it's not going to be the best thing to wear under lighter and more sheer clothing, but for most things I wear it's fine. As cold as it is with this polar vortex now, it's even a bit of added warmth.

The inside top band has two rows of what looks like a sticky \\"holder-upper,\\" but it's not sticky on and is not uncomfortable. The bands do work to keep the briefs in place when you pull them up. I would think these would be fantastic under leggings in a yoga class.

product_title: Weston Wear Women's Jillian Top
review_headline: Very sheer, not particularly long, only pay deep discount price
review_body:
I'm 5'5" and the length of this top reaches slightly passed my waistband on mid-rise jeans. It's not particularly long and it is very sheer. Sheer enough that you would have to plan on wearing a camisole underneath or being okay with your bra being easily seen in more than just outline. It is a pretty top though. I personally bought it on sale for around $30.00 dollars here, allegedly marked way down. For thirty dollars it is a nice, sheer silk top that can be worn under a light jacket, or over a camisole and it's not a bad buy at all. If it was it's original price, I would be returning it without question. For a low price it's a nice enough top, although probably not suitable for an office, because it is exceptionally sheer.

It will probably work great for a night out on a warm summer night. Due to it's sheerness, it's going to be better suited to smaller frames, in all likelihood. For an office setting you will need something to go over it and in all instances, a nude or black bra would be necessary. Also, the primary color is olive and the length is essentially regular, not longer as it appears to be on the model. Sizing is fairly standard, maybe running a tad small. I am keeping the blouse, but that is because it was a sale item and worth the sale price.

Having shot highpower for years, I can say this makes a difference in how easily your rifle will clean after you've applied it. (and using it with Glocks and 1911 platform pistols it is also wonderful)  Being a woman, I can also give a review about how neat it is in that the company packaged it in a bottle with some common sense - you don't have a jar lid that spills or drips.  And it's not caustic - you can't set solvent-based cleaners on the kitchen table, but this you can!(IMO)  FireClean makes cleaning guns in the kitchen something your wife might not freak out over...is that a review or what?  ;-)

So i just kept - it wasn't that expensive to begin with, it was just the principle that the item did not fit at all like it did on the model in the picture.

The shirt is a cool design, i love the pockets, and it looks OK with a belt to cinch in the non-form-fitting waist, but if you wanted to wear this by itself, or already have a chunky waist/hips, this will probably not be flattering.

review_body:
* Why did Amazon delete my pics showing the loose threads?

Size: I'm 5'10\\" 180lbs 36\\" waist with an athletic build (I lift weights and workout regularly). When trying the jacket on, I wore an undershirt and a long sleeve top beneath the jacket - typical winter wear - and size Large was more comfortable than Medium. Warmth: Felt very warm. It is currently fall with low 70 degree(F) weather so I can't comment on this just yet. Edit:I wore this on a 60 degree day, and I felt too hot. You don't need to layer unless you're going to the Arctic (seriously). I bought this for an upcoming trip to Norway.

Quality: It doesn't seem like Alpha pays attention to quality control. All the jackets on display at Dave's had issues with them like loose threads so I asked to get one still in factory packaging. Despite this, the jacket that I got had many problems. The stitching was horribly done around the sleeves and the pockets. There were many loose threads and the sleeve even had a slight tear. Alpha really needs to work on standardizing the workmanship of their products.

This jacket is not that expensive, relative to Canada Goose & Fjallraven, but unfortunately, it shows!

But it is a good bargain, especially if you can buy it for $135 or below. The wholesale price for this jacket is around $65 we're seeing above a 100% mark-up. Not cool!

review_body:
When I opened this up and took a look at them I though 'there is no way I'm going to fit in that'... but the material is a very flexible. These are basically like wearing a little nylon sack over your bits, and the material pretty much feels like a good pair of women's nylons. The only problem I could really see with these is that while they have to upwards support, there is so much give to the material that there isn't any way your going to keep an erection under control. Don't expect to have any secrets if your wearing these.

The only problem -I- have with these is that because the material is so flexible, I don't see why they needed to put in such a generous seem up the middle of the pouch, If Mr. Homme could find a way to make these with a seamless pouch I'd pay another 5 dollars for a pair like this.

I love this pair of underwear though, they are very comfortable, they are damn sexy, they lift you up just the right amount, and I could just shower in them if I wanted they dry so fast. They also seem to stay cleaner and smell less than other underwear I've owned. I don't own many things like this, but I'm really glad I spent the money.

I will say though that they seemed bigger overall than I was expecting, if your in between sizes I would recommend going one down for these. I think I would have better support if I had gotten a small instead of the medium, but I guess I can't say for sure.

review_body:
I really like the Softbums system. It was a 4 day trip so I didn't want to wait to do laundry.
I love the feel of the shells, the material is soft and once you get the legs sized properly, you can avoid any red marks. I like the aplix and these really are a much trimmer diaper even if you double up the pods or pair a bamboo with a stay dry. You can also lay in most any other kind of insert or diaper. I have even used this around a fitted. All in all, I really like this system. I am still playing with some of the options but was most impressed with the FST/Echo shell combo and will use it again for camping!!!

review_body: I purchased this jacket roughly a month ago and wanted to give it time to really break in before writing a review for it. It is a very well put together coat and in terms of functionality, it keeps you incredibly warm and cozy. All the pockets are legitimate and useable, none are sealed and cosmetic on a side note! The inside has a nice silky lining which feels great. Given how heavy the coat is, it doesn't necessarily allow for full movement in the shoulders and arms. Overall I would recommend the coat to just about anyone, but if you have broad shoulders you may find it snug fitting. The coat did break in a bit after a month and is only getting more comfortable the more I wear it.

product_title: Dr. Comfort Transmet Crew Socks for Partial Foot Amputation (Small (Men's 6.5-8/Women's 7.5-9), White)
review_body:
Please be aware that the package contains one transmet sock and one standard full size sock. If you are a double amputee, you have to buy two packages. I returned the package I ordered through Amazon.

UPDATE 2014: I called the company (Dr. Comfort) directly and spoke to their sales department. They are unable to repackage the product to contain two transmet socks per package. However, they very kindly offered to sell me 12 pair of sock packages at half price so in the end, I paid the same to get 6 pairs of transmet socks that I needed, as if each package contained two transmet socks at full price. The sales department asked me to donate the unneeded 6 pairs of full sized socks to charity, which I did.

These fitted Dr. Comfort socks are far superior to the tubular stump socks I've used in the past. A lot more cushiony and better fitting, no wrinkles and I like the choice of colors. When I'm sitting around shoeless in public, I feel less self-conscious about my feet because the toe and heel color differential somehow make my feet look more normal - the shortness of my foot is disguised.

Although I would rate the Dr. Comfort transmet socks as 5 star by themselves (I love them), I decided to leave my Amazon rating at 2 until the item description is changed to reflect the true contents of the package. I will happily upgrade my rating when the item description is changed.

UPDATE January 16th 2015: The description now says \\"Includes 1 Transmet Sock and one Full Size Sock\\", so I have changed my rating to 5 stars. These socks really are far, FAR superior to the usual \\"stump sock\\" that is supplied by orthotic technicians. However, the only way that double-amputees can get a pair of transmet socks at a reasonable price is to buy the package directly from Dr. Comfort, explain your situation and ask for two standard packages at half price so you can get the two transmet socks you really need. Maybe if enough double-amputees call, they will provide a double-amputee package or start selling the transmet socks individually.

I have now purchased directly from Dr. Comfort on three occasions, and after some discussion with the sales staff, I have always been able to get the half price deal.call, they will provide a double-amputee package or start selling the transmet socks individually.

product_title: Lindy Bop 'Audrey' Vintage 50's Style Swing Party Rockabilly Evening Dress
review_body: I ordered this dress and the "Grace" style dress and petticoats from Lindy Bop for a Mediterranean cruise.  These dresses are perfect for "elegant" or formal nights on the ship, and are wonderful dresses to go dancing in.  In reviewing the sizing, it's obvious that British sizes are different than American, so you'll need to take your measurements and order appropriately.  I wear a 14/16, so ordered a 4X to be safe.  The dress is a bit big, so I could have ordered a 3X and think it would have been better, but will keep the 4X and wear it.  The dress looks fine without the petticoat, but the petticoat really makes a difference, and I'll always wear the petticoat when I wear the dress.  I also purchased a shrug sweater since my standard cardigans don't really look right with the style, and I wear my pearls to really complete the whole Audrey Hepburn "Breakfast at Tiffany's" look.  I received so many compliments from strangers who said they loved my dress and asked where I got it, especially from older ladies who wore these fashions years ago, and people who love the show Mad Men. product_title: Woolrich Men's Wool Alaskan Shirt
review_body:
I purchased this shirt for camping in cold weather, and since it's made from significantly thick wool material it does a great job of keeping you warm. But, you should know that this shirt is uncomfortable without an undergarment of some kind. Against your skin it's scratcy and irritating, which can be the case with wool, but I have other shirts that are similar blends of wool and nylon that aren't as 'scratchy' as this one. That's why I rated 4 stars and not 5. Nevertheless, this shirt is a great cold weather asset. The snap closures are easier to use than buttons when your hands are cold, or you're wearing gloves. The double snaps on the cuff are a quality addition that allows you to wear this shirt over other shirts and still snap the cuffs.

It works well as a shirt-jac or as the only shirt you wear, which makes it valuable over a range of temperatures. It's my 'must have' shirt for trips into the outdoors.

product_title: Beverly Hills Basics Jr. Paris Bistro Scene 2pc Tank and Capri Pajama Set
review_headline: Very cute, but note that sizing runs very small
review_body:
These pajamas were adorable, and as it turned out, the cuffs on the pants I have are pink, not brown. But note that I had to exchange my original order to get the sizing right. The key words to note here are \\"junior sizing\\": this means that a size small is actually tiny. I ordered a size small, which is my regular size in women's clothing, and I found the pajama bottoms to fit really tight and didn't even bother trying on the tank top, which was clearly going to be too small based on holding it up to my chest. So I returned these to the seller and we agreed that a large would fit me better. I have now received the large, and the capri bottoms fit me the same as a size small capri pant that I bought from Old Navy several years back.

So, if you regularly wear a medium in misses sizing, you might want to try large or extra-large, and if you're ordinarily large, then these pajamas are probably not meant for you. And extra-small and small would have to be for someone extra petite and slender, the sort who shops in the boys' department for jeans.

I just wanted to clear this up so that you can get the correct size first time around. \\"Junior sizing\\" doesn't seem to be used as much as it used to be, so there can be some confusion as to what it means.

Incidentally,even those double belt loops have come in handy.I followed the advise of some people who reviewed other Orion belts,and said to get a size larger than recommended,because these belts run short. Not so! This belt is way too long.I could cut it off,I guess,but with the thoughtfully provided extra belt loop,I just move it out to the end of the belt to keep it from flopping around.

product_title: Carhartt Men's Full Cushion Steel-Toe Synthetic Work Boot Socks
review_body:
I have very mixed feelings about these socks for multiple reasons. I absolutely love Carhartt and their items and, prior to these, have never had any issues or disappointments.
In absolute truth these are, without any doubt, the most comfortable socks I have ever worn. They fit perfectly, they are soft and warm without making my feet uncomfortably hot and the cushioning helped immensely as I spend hours on my feet in steel toe work boots. That said; you can imagine my disappointment when, in less than a month after having been worn only a few times without being put through any extraordinary or particularly strenuous activity, one of them developed a hole in the back of the heel where the cushioning meets the rest of the sock and the other split wide open in the same spot.

Now, being the diehard Carhartt fan I am, I'm giving this 3 stars because of the aforementioned comfort and I'm giving them the benefit of the doubt for the following reasons:

1. It is entirely possible my pair had flawed stitching or something to that effect.

2. That particular spot has been a problem with socks for me due to the heel of my boots.(However it's never worn through socks so rapidly or severely)

3. With that knowledge, my experience may be a completely isolated incident and could possibly be due to an unfortunate combination of variables that leading to this particular outcome.

I'm currently waiting on my replacement pair so we'll see if they do any better.
I'd also like to mention that the cotton counterpart of this particular sock, while not quite as comfortable, is quite a good product and well worth the purchase.

product_title: Doublju Mens V-Neck T-shirts with Long Sleeve
review_body: So I have ordered a few of these shirts over the past 6 months or so, and for the most part I really like them.    First I want to say that I only choose certain shirts when I order these ones. If you scroll over the shirt colors you will see that the ones like \\"brown\\", \\"green\\", \\"dark blue\\", \\"sky\\", etc.. are different in material from the \\"black\\", \\"navy\\", \\"red\\", and \\"wine\\" shirts. The colors of the latter shirts are more flat and vibrant. My rule is to AVOID those vibrant ones. The material is more scratchy, the cut is shorter and more boxy, and the sleeves are tighter.  However, just a warning, I recently ordered another \\"green\\" shirt in size L (US M) and it was that same kind of flat/vibrant material. I sent an email about it and I will update this when I get a response about whether the problem can be fixed.    Edit: I was unable to get a \\"green\\" shirt in the type I like, but I did order a \\"khaki\\" as a replacement and it is actually the color of the \\"green\\" shirt pictured.  Edit 2: Would like to update that when I sent in an email about the shirt I received, they were very friendly and refunded my whole order (I had ordered 2 shirts from that for that order). I was also offered the option to select 1 day shipping on my next Amazon order, no matter what it was, and Amazon Customer Service would waive the price of shipping for me. I never did take them up on the 1 day shipping, and Amazon Customer Service added a month to my current Amazon Prime membership. They were really great about making sure I was satisfied with my order. I ordered more shirts (Dark Blue and Khaki) with the refund and was quite happy with them both. Happy shopping guys!      For reference, I am about 5'11\\", about 160 lbs, and wear pants (with a belt) that are a 30 waist. I am slim and fairly toned. A size L (US M) fits me perfectly.  There was a review not far down that says that this isn't actually a slim fit and doesn't fit if you are in shape, which I find to be very untrue. I would say Iam in pretty good shape, and these shirts are my favorite.  I like my shirts to be pretty form fitting. These shirts fit my chest comfortably and lay flat to my stomach, much like it shows in the picture. A lot of the time I roll the sleeves to just below my elbow, and after I pull them from the dryer they can be a bit tight there, but they loosen up over time. The good thing about that though is that the sleeves aren't always slipping down.  I find that the sleeves of the vibrant colored shirts that I mentioned earlier fit too tightly when I pull them up and it is uncomfortable to wear that way. They are also shorter, so the sleeves don't go beyond the wrist. If I reach my hands above my head while wearing one of the vibrant shirts about an inch of my waist and a couple inches of my wrist are exposed.  The good shirts (like the \\"sky\\" and \\"brown\\") are a good length all around and are a very comfortable material. The colors are also pretty true to the pictures.  It might also be important to say that I have been wearing these shirts regularly for several months and the material and colors are holding up strong. I use a washer with a central agitator and dry them on regular heat with no issues.  All in all, a very good purchase. I will continue to buy these shirts, and I recommend them to anyone who likes a slim fit shirt.

This way THE CHILDREN CAN ROLL THEIR OWN SUITCASES, which eases the parent burden of packing and unpacking. Their little stuff got all mixed up and lost in my big suitcase the moment it was tipped or rolled, this keeps each child's items perfectly separate. It has just enough zipper pouches for small underwear, socks, hair bows, etc.
The suitcases held up perfectly during our month-long trip with lots of packing, unpacking and child handling.

product_title: Columbia Men’s Steens Mountain Full Zip Fleece 2.0
review_headline: Manufacturing defect and poor customer service experience leave a bad taste
review_body: I bought the black and gray version of this fleece sweater in November to prepare for Winter.  I liked it, but I did notice that the laces attached to the zippers are simply tied by hand and keep coming off (I lost one, but recovered it).  Two weeks after wearing the jacket I noticed a manufacturing defect under the left arm pit in the back, something hard to notice when you look at the mirror but that other people would notice when you turn around (approx. one inch before the end of the seam, the sewing machine left a bulky array of threads coming out).  I mailed it to Columbia ($10 bucks more!) in mid November and never heard back.  In the mean time I bought a C9 fleece for $15+ less in Target.  In January I started receiving emails, saying they couldn't repair the fleece and were going to send me a new one.  1 week later I still hadn't received it.  I emailed asking for a tracking number and four days later they replied saying they were just going to ship it.  I received about a week later, in mid January and was surprised to see it wasn't even the same color I had originally ordered (it was totally gray, it was OK though).  I'm giving it one star, because this was a manufacturing defect that should have never gone through Columbia's QA.  Also, because I had to pay extra to make up for their QA process deficiency.  Lastly, I ended up wearing a fleece which was not of my original choosing and I still have to (almost on a daily basis when I wear it) re-do the laces in the end of the zippers lest they get lost.  By contrast, the C9 fleece has these zipper "handles" permanently attached, and is as warm and light for $15 less.  I like the look and feel of the Columbia fleece, but I find it over priced and the customer service was a huge disappointment.

The tie behaved very well, to begin with and held its place while we shook hands. We were shown to our seats and the tie had no objections to the napkin being spread out on my lap. Champagne was served and the tie did its best not to giggle with the bubbles so close to its upward pointed tips. Then came the soup. Five bowls of soup were served and the tie and I wondered where our soup was. We were not left soup less for long as the server soon came with a single bowl of soup for the tie and I. Once more this tie behaved in a most respectable manner. The tie did not unwind and dip its tips in the soup, nor did it offer itself up as a mouth wipe. I took my properly placed soup spoon and dove into the bowl and brought the contents of my first scoop to my mouth. Among the wafting aroma of delicious broth was a slightly sour smell. The tie did not object so I poured the soup into my mouth. The soup was mostly like soup, liquid in every description except for a hard sinewy, acetous tasting object which as soon as it hit my tongue I knew would be trouble. I held this chunk with the tip of my tongues so I would not taste it with my entire tongue. I looked at my napkin so nicely placed and spread on my lap by a professional napkin spreader and immediately knew I could not disturb it. Then I turned to the tie. Holding  the chunk of unknown fetid close to my mouth opening gave the tie a good whiff and it flatly refused to accept the offering. Against my better judgment I swallowed. Yes, I swallowed and as soon as I swallowed I realized this decision would be reversed in a hurry. Now this is where the review of the tie comes in. Before the forced reversal of my decision to swallow my face turned blue. My wife remarked that my face was as blue as my bow tie. That's right this tie has a lovely shade of blue

product_title: Hurley Men's BP Solid Boardshort Phantom Boardshort
review_body:
These boardshorts got a lot of hype, but I was not overly-impressed. I'm 6'2'' and I feel like these shorts are at least an inch too short to be a proper length for taller men. I've seen a lot of shorter guys wearing this style and they seem to sit much more naturally on them. Also, I would order the waist an inch smaller than you think. They seem a bit large.

I live in Hawaii and basically live in boardshorts when I'm not at work. My friends and I seem to be divided into schools of thought for boardshorts: comfort and performance. I tend to like boardshorts that are extremely comfortable, and would gladly forsake having them dry more quickly to have a pair that I'd like to wear from sun-up to sun-down (which I often do). These are more of a performance short, which seems to mean they are stretchy and dry quickly. The material is so thin and papery in almost doesn't seem to get wet, and hence it dries almost immediately. It's not the most comfortable in my opinion. A lot of the colors are a good deal, and I would buy them again, but they definitely aren't my top choice.

product_title: SHARKK® Aluminum Wallet Credit Card Holder With RFID Protection Made By SHARKK Brands
review_headline: Why did I wait so long......perfect!
review_body:
After transferring the items over from my old leather wallet, I wonder why I waited so long to take the plunge into aluminum. The quality and fit of this Sharkk wallet is perfect. This wallet slips perfectly into my front left pocket (I'm a lefty). Size-wise it's no bigger than my leather wallet it replaced, and it is actually easier to insert/remove because of the slick aluminum case. The corners are rounded and it doesn't show from the outside. Feels more comfortable than my leather wallet which used to stick in my pocket whenever it was warmer out.

The latch is better than what I expected. A single push opens the case. When closing, it has a satisfying click with the latch popping back out to confirm it is locked securely.

Inside, the case has an accordion-like holder for cards. I decided to put just about everything I had in my old wallet to see what I could get away with. I was able to fit everything, including a $20 bill (which I pretty much hold for some place that doesn't take a card......a rare event).

What's in my Sharkk:

- 2 credit cards
- Insurance card
- Eye/Vision discount card
- State drivers license
- Library card
- Grocery discount card
- Club card
- Membership card
- Coupon
- $20 bill folded in thirds

The case color I picked was blue. It's on the darker side of blue and the look is excellent. A clean professional-looking wallet that I wouldn't feel embarrassed pulling out. Looking over the whole thing; the quality of the latch, hinge, and finish is very good. If this Shark did break in a couple years, I would definitely buy another one. Highly recommended.

UPDATE 5/25/2013: My teen-age son liked my Sharkk wallet so much, I ordered him one also.

review_body:
The reason why I chose to purchase this wallet was for the hard shell, which protects against the elements of nature. It has held up good for a year now, and it shows some wear in different areas, but it is worth the money I paid for it.

The pros to this wallet far outweigh the cons. The Sharkk has done a great job of keeping water from penetrating my bills and cards that are inside the shell ( I work outside where there is no cover from rain or snow). For this specific purpose the wallet is worth the purchase. Or if you are an avid outdoor man/woman who needs something to keep your cards, bills, etc. from water damage.

The cons to this product do not outweigh the pros for the application this wallet was made for. The inside card slots are more on the cheap side, and they over time will fall apart, because they are made of a flimsy material. That is about it for cons on this item.

Overall, I would say this is a great product and if you are looking for protection because of nature's unexpected snowfalls, rainfalls, etc. this little wallet can allow you to keep your billfold items protected. The only reason I gave four stars instead of five is the flimsy card slots on the inside. But everything else on this miniature canister is awesome!

product_title: Levi's Women's Plus-Size 580 Bootcut Jean
review_body:
I wore Levi's my whole life before having children... then , for some strange reason, Levi's didn't fit me anymore!

Well.... I found a pair at a thrift store that were cheap and gave 'em a whirl... Now i'm on Amazon, buying 'em new and blabbing about how great they are.

These are now my second favorite jeans -- (#1 is Gloria Vanderbilt/ Amanda) I now own 5 pairs of these (well, 6, if you include the thrift shop pair)

Sizing: I will try to be as specific as possible.

These are a normal, traditional rise. No low-rise, no hip hugger, no hanging down around your butt crack. Nice mom-waist jeans. Jeans. Jeans for women who remember what jeans are supposed to be like. Thank you Levi's for making jeans that mom-waist women can wear.

I have these jeans in both the size 16 and this size, 18. Normally I am a size 16 in GV Amanda jeans. I have a very small waist and very large thighs/saddlebags/butt. I am 5'8" and weigh about 190. The size 16 DO fit but they are a little tighter in the saddle bag area than I would like. **This is why my rating is a 4 star, not a 5 star** I do believe these jeans run a little small, but that is MY experience with what I believe a size 16 should fit like.

I then grabbed up a size 18 and decided they were perfect -- no clinging to my thighs... but oh so very long.

Wearing a belt helps a bit, but I'll be clear: I am 5'8" and these are very long.... drag on the ground long. However, that actually works a little bit to the advantage -- as the long length makes me appear taller and two women asked me if I had lost weight the first day I wore these!

The lighter color is less becoming than the dark, but having a light pair that looks a bit worn is a nice wardrobe change -- normally I always wear the darker colors to minimize my larger assets.

If you carry your weight higher up -- like in your tummy and not so much in your legs ... these may not work for you.

I am very pleased to have Levi's back in my closet.t work for you.

I am very pleased to have Levi's back in my closet.

review_headline: Quality garment for the money, but runs small and doesn't fit as depicted.
review_body: I bought this garment in purple, and was going to buy one in black later. It is light and airy, and the stud details look great. My only complaint is that the sizing runs smaller than I expected. According to the sizing chart, I should have ordered an 18/20 to fit my bust size, since the hip area is open. I bought a size UP, 22/24, in order to make sure that the neck area fell low enough. I like to show a little cleavage (hey, if you got flaunt it!), and it has been my experience when buying online that the sizing charts don't reflect how the item is falling on the model/mannequin...it's better to get a size up, especially with a knit-type item that may shrink. However, the 22/24 did not fit as I expected it to. The neckline was still way too high, showed very little cleavage, and it caused the straps to set further in. Because the straps were setting further in towards my neck, I couldn't wear the top without my bra straps showing on the outside of the top straps. And when I tried using a halter bra instead of a conventional 2-strap shoulder bra, the strap showed on the inside around my neck. So now, I won't wear it because of my bra showing, and it's just hanging in my closet unworn ...very disappointing, because otherwise it's a lovely and sexy top. The top simply does NOT hang on me the way it does on the mannequin in the photos, which was exactly the look I was going for. The mannequin is busty, and so am I, so it should have fit that way with the larger size, but didn't. I can't return the item, because I threw away the tags. I was SO SURE that it would fit that I didn't save them. I also don't like to return items I buy online, because it is a huge pain to go through the entire packaging and mailing process. I'd rather give it to someone else who can use it, than to go to all that bother. ~ SO, if you're able to get this 2 sizes up from your size, so it will fit as depicted, it is a beautiful top. If you can't, you may want to pass it up unless you WANT it tofall shorter than shown and don't mind your bra straps showing. I gave it three stars for the simple fact that the sizing chart is off, and I can't wear the top due to the sizing problem.

review_headline: A Hat I am Proud to Wear!

When John Kennedy became President in 1960 he took the oath of office sans hat. He was the first American President in a very long time to give up headgear. I gave up hats that same year and while I have tried from time to time to wear one I never found one I really liked until today. The Barmah hat fits perfectly , looks good and the brim is big enough to keep the sun from doing damage to my skin. This is a real man's hat.

From the time the little box came and I laughingly said, "Well, it can't be my hat," I was enamored of it. The box was far too small for what was inside. The Barmah was kind of crumpled up in a quart size lunch baggie but when I opened it, it sprang into life as though by magic and has retained its shape perfectly.

Since that first day I have worn it every day and will continue to do so. It is so lightweight and cool yoiu don't even know it is there and, i get lots of compliments.

I am a heart transplant recipient and the anti rejection drugs I take cause me to be susceptible to skin cancer. The docs insist on our wearing sunscreen and wide brimmed hats but I hated every hat I tried. This one, I wear with pride. It is exactly what I wanted and needed. Thank you Barmah, thank you Australia and thank you mates.

product_title: Fred Perry Women's High Waisted Pencil Skirt
review_body:
This is the most perfect black skirt. Hands down.

I'm 5'4\\" and wear a US4. The skirt falls perfectly half-way between knee and thigh. Because it is high-waisted, and not as nearly as high as I anticipated, it gives a long and lean look to the body, without feeling or looking like you're wearing 'mom' jeans/skirt. There is some stretch to the fabric, but not overly done. Hugs curves just right, and camouflages those warrior thighs and hips. Did I mention how great it makes my butt look? If I could have purchased 3 at the sale price, I would have. I was nervous about the fit beforehand, being that it is from the Amy Winehouse collection and I definitely do not have a 'junkie fit' shape. The lining material is soft and comfortable, while the skirt itself is made from some otherworldly material blend, most likely conceived in a lab for Ms. Winehouse, as spilled alcohol or beverages seem to magically roll right off of it and back into my glass.

The only detractor for me was the gingham detailing on the front pocket. While it is very cute and looks adorable paired with a gingham shirt, it's strange when paired with anything else because of that detailing. But,hey, that's what stitch rippers are for!

Being a \\"Made In China\\" Fred Perry item, I was sure that after the first wash there would be stitching/seam issues and lo and behold, I was correct. Again, glad I purchased it on-sale, as M-I-C Fred Perry products, while priced the same, just do not hold up to their counterparts manufactured elsewhere. This is the only reason I did not give it a 5-star rating. If I purchase something new, I should not have to go back and tack hem seams after cleaning exactly as per manufacturer instructions.

Shipping was lightning fast, it arrived overnight, even though I chose standard shipping. Fan-freakin'-tastic!

product_title: Orion Leather 1 1/2 Natural Tan Harness Leather Belt Double Hole
review_body:
This would be the second belt I've ordered from Orion belts -- more or less the same quality as the Chestnut Show Harness Belt With Double Hole that I've ordered previously, but in a natural leather color with antique silver buckle finish.

Very thick, one piece leather -- buckle is held on by screwed down buttons -- nice and makes a buckle change easy.

For $38.00, you're getting a high quality, made in the USA belt. This is full grain leather, about a 1/4" in thickness (maybe slightly more), and will likely last a very, very long time, especially if alternating various belts.

You can easily find a cheaper belt, which will also be made of leather (probably not full/top grain leather), but I doubt the quality will match these...you can also, with a bit of internet hunting, find very high quality, full grain leather belts, made & stitched by hand, etc. -- good luck finding those for under $50.00 -- if you do, please drop me a line so I can order one!

Again, for the money honey, you'd be hard pressed to find better quality. I order 2 sizes up from my pant size and that worked perfectly for me -- some maybe happy with only one size up.

Happy belting!

review_body:
Okay, so I received this shirt the day after I ordered it (BONUS!!!), and I am pleased with it. For me, this will just be a work shirt, since I normally hate collared shirts (especially button-ups). That being said, this shirt is super comfortable. Initially, when I first took it out of the packaging and felt the material, I thought it would be too thick... It actually breathes quite well. I ordered a size up from my normal size, and was glad I did. Not that I don't think my normal size would have fit, I'm sure it would, I just wanted the extra room to move around (lots of reaching up, bending over, etc. at work). It's roomy without looking bulky. Some customer reviews suggested the sleeves were horrible... They're not. If the ends being folded up bug you that much, it'd be very easy to take a seam ripper to the two little spots on each sleeve where they're attached. They don't bother me. Seriously, my only complaint is that the buttons aren't black (I ordered the black shirt), and that's not really a big deal.

So, for someone who normally hates to wear this type of shirt, I am very pleased with my purchase. Would definitely recommend!
And props to the company for getting it shipped out with the quickness! More likely to order from them in the future.

review_headline: Blue lenses with a very rose color profile.
review_body:
Pros:
1. They fit.

Cons:

2. This rose effect is less towards the very top of the lenses, which means if you're looking out of the top of the lens, you'll see less pink. I find it a little disorienting at times, but it's not the end of the world.
3. They have a couple of lens flare issues. I'll occasionally see little lens flare circles -- I never got those with the stock Oakley lenses.
4. The soft case is really thin -- noticeably thinner than the stock Oakley soft case.

Pro/Con

2. They are much brighter blue.

Overall: I won't buy these again. I'll spend the extra money and buy the Oakley ones.

product_title: Michael Kors Watches Gold Chronograph with Stones
review_headline: Gorgeous, the stones give it understated glitz
review_body: I had been wanting a MK chronograph watch for a year now but couldn't justify spending such a whopping price on it, however we recently had a sale at the store I work at so I immediately had to get one. I had settled on another one but when I tried it on the size was a bit off. When I tried this though it was perfect. The face is boyfriend sized but it doesn't dwarf your wrist, or look too bulky. A year ago I had tried one and it was HUGE. I have an itty bitty wrist, so that's a problem when choosing a boyfriend watch. This one though, left about a half an inch (maybe less) on either side.   The watch has some heft. I ordered a look a like from another store but it felt cheesy (as it should it wasn't the real deal) but this one is heavy, so keep that in mind. The description lists it as being a pound, it probably includes the box weight, but the watch itself does weigh you down a bit. I have other MK watches but it took me a while to get used to weight.  Also there are little diamond-esque stones where the numbers would be. I didn't notice them when I bought the watch, but later when I was examining it a little more closely I saw them. They're really cute and give it some glitz. I'm not a fan of diamond bezels, so I probably wouldn't have been sold if it had listed it as having \\"stones\\", however this is glam but understated, not in your face \\"bling\\".  The only problem I had with the watch is that it was too big. I need to take like 3 links out. My other MK watch (a tortoise shell one) had links that came out without needing to take it into a watch place. It was convenient and you get extra so if you ever need it to go up a size you can do that on your own. I was a bit sad that this didn't have something similar. I couldn't wear it right away because I had to have it sized.  Other than that, it really is a beautiful watch and looks, and feels, a lot more expensive than it is.

review_headline: Higher quality than expected, but a little uncomfortable
review_body:
This mask is really heavy duty. It is definitely a much higher quality than I expected for the money. And it looks sharp! I think there was a mix-up when mine was shipped, because my swans were black on the black background of the mask rather than white swans. I didn't return it or anything, because I was so very excited about how awesome it looked. So if that version is listed here somewhere, it is definitely worth checking out. I really like that the glitter of the mask seemed to stay on the mask- I didn't end up with glitter everywhere, which was a very welcome surprise. The mask is really sturdy. A little heavier than I expected.

The only reason why I didn't give it five stars is because it is a little uncomfortable to wear. The contours of the mask around the eye-holes press right up against your face. It feels like the mask is holding your eyes wide open. Looks awesome, but it feels a little disconcerting.

review_body: I am just getting started snowshoeing this year. I tried some rentals and borrowed some from friends. After a lot of research I chose the Atlas 1025. I weigh near the top of the range for the 25's but the 30's I had borrowed seemed to long when maneuvering off trail. I have been very happy with this selection. They are easy to put on and get off. The neoprene padding makes for a very comfortable fit. The straps over the foot are very easy to tighten an loosen making entry and exit quite simple. Traction on packed, icy snow is very good and I experience very little slipping on steep terrain. I always have a pack on  and even in moderately deep snow I don't sink too much. I find these snowshoes very stable. I am able to make quick decent on steep hills (not quite running) and feel very confident in the ability to maintain control. The only drawback I have found is the heel strap coming loose, especially while going downhill. I think if I just tighten this up some more I won't have an issue.

product_title: Condor Men's Summit Soft Shell Tactical Jacket
review_body:
This is an awesome jacket. That said, if you are looking for windproof and waterproof you won't find that here. It is a soft shell jacket that is decently water repellant, but needs to be worn with layering beneath in cold or windy weather, and with a poncho or rain shell over in very rainy conditions.

I am particularly impressed by the many zippered pockets. I discovered that the two zippered pockets in the left sleeve are perfect for my wallet and cell phone (Samsung Galaxy S II). The latter fits perfectly in the forearm pocket and the wallet fits perfectly in the bicep pocket. (Anything larger than a Galaxy S II won't fit in the forearm pocket). The chest pockets comfortably hold gloves, an extra 9mm mag or two, a pen, car keys, and hands. I've not used the back pocket/pouch. The inside breast pocket is perfect for a 3x5 spiral notebook. Also impressive is the hood's drawstring that terminates in the chest pockets so that you can tighten the hood with your hands inside.

Some have commented about the fact that the hood is not detachable. If you really want a collar that folds flat then this isn't your jacket. I don't mind the bulky, stand-up collar, and I have a short neck. With the jacket unzipped above my collar-bone, the collar's wings provide good wind protection. With the jacket fully zipped I can hide my nose behind the collar and still breathe comfortably. Since I normally wear an \\"Indiana Jones\\" style hat, it all works together to keep me comfortable and the jacket doesn't fight the hat.

The material is comfortable and pretty quiet, the stitching is quite good, the zippers are very easy to pull while being quite tight to keep the weather out.

All in all, I can't imagine a better designed and built every day 3 season soft shell. And at a very decent price.

product_title: Totes Raines Children's Rain Poncho
review_body:
This poncho was purchased for my ten year old to take to camp. If you are looking for something heavy weight, this isn't the poncho for you. If you want something that is going to fold up easily and go back in the storage bag and look pretty much like it did when you bought it, start running from this poncho now. If you are looking an inexpensive poncho that your kid will like and will serve the purpose of keeping them dry, this is perfect.

My son liked the color and it was plenty big for is ten year old average frame. You might want to remind them that the storage bag is reusable. I didn't do this and the bag didn't make it home from camp. Our bad, not Isotoners.

I suggested that he trash it after bringing it home bagless, but he insisted that we keep it and it is currently wadded up in a cubby in his room, waiting on a rainy day. :-) It does wrinkle pretty terribly, though the only one bothered by this will most likely be a mom and not a child. product_title: Panache Women's Underwire Sports Bra
review_headline: Comparison by a new mom - Anita, Enell, Panache
review_body:
I recently had a baby and needed to get some sports bras for \\"large-breasted\\" women. After doing some research and asking friends, I wound up purchasing one Anita Momentum in 34G, 3 Panache Sport in 34F (UK sizing is slightly different, 34F UK = 34G USA), and one Enell in size 1.

Initially I liked the Panache bras the best (that's why I ended up with 3). While the Enell provides the very best support (your girls are not going ANYWHERE in an Enell), it's fugly. The Panache and the Anita provide similar support to one another, and are both more attractive than the Enell. I found the support of the Panache bras slightly better than the Anita bra. The Panache bras are also somewhat padded, which gives a nice smooth look (no nipple outlines when you're cold).

Over time, though, as my milk supply evened out, my breasts dropped several sizes, and the Panache and Anita bras no longer fit, while the Enell did. The Enell has so much compression that it can accommodate fluctuating breast sizes. That means it ended up being the only bra that I am still using.

In summary - I consider the Enell to be the best bra of the bunch. Too bad it's so unattractive. :/

P.S. All 3 bras are roughly the same price, unless you can find one of them on sale.

review_body: It's impossible for me to find an appropriate bra in "regular" stores, so for years I've settled for terrible fit and discomfort. I've had salespeople roll their eyes and disbelieve that I needed a bra with such a small band size and large cup. I finally broke down and went to Nordstrom's to be properly fitted--they matched what I thought, 30 H / 32 GG ish, depending on brand, and made a lot of suggestions about brands--both ones they carried and ones they didn't. They brought me a few bras that I purchased, went home, and promptly decided were not comfortable due to the sides coming up to high under my armpit (I am petite with a short torso). Sooo, back to Nordstrom's, and tried this bra on. Hmm, not bad, and is smaller on the side. I took a chance, purchased it, and now after three wearings and one wash (cold water, no dryer), it is quite comfortable, provides terrific support, and little bounce. I can't say that about other bras. I pretty much wear it as a regular bra (I don't wear tops showing cleavage or that are tight), but I have fitness-walked in it (not much of an athlete). The Amazon price is about what it is in Nordstrom's, so I don't know if I'll purchase here in the future, but I'm definitely going to order this again in another color.

Edit 1/18/13
After reading the other review, I suppose I should have specified that the hat is thin. That's my preference for a beanie though. I like them to fit tight to my skull and I don't like a bunch of excess material bulking up my already large head. product_title: Magellan's Adventure Travel Convertible Jacket
review_body:
The Supplex nylon material is light, breathable and very comfy even in warmish (70s-80s) weather, though mine being black, it will certainly heat up in direct sunlight.

I found that it has just the right number of pockets: when I fly, I like to use it to carry my passport, boarding passes and itinerary, wallet, MP3 player with headphones, earbuds with airline adapter jack, and cellphone. While walking around in a new place, I like to slip a compact digital camera into one of the pockets, quickly accessible. This leaves my pants pockets empty which is a great blessing on long flights and hot days, and also there is less of a need to wear cargo pants.

Gripes:

1. The velcro on one of the front pockets came off almost immediately...it's pretty much just glued onto the pocket flap rather than sewn in...NOT good build quality there.

2. Kind of wish they simply had buttons instead of velcro for the pockets, this would be more durable and also more functional IMO. But the glued-on version is clearly a cost-cutting measure.

3. Wish they didn't have the cheesy-looking faux-leather circular accents on the front velcro pockets...luckily since the accents are the same color as the fabric, it's not that noticeable.

4. Wish the bottom interior pockets, especially the zippered one on the left, was a bit wider. Don't understand why the one on the right doesn't have a zipper too...probably another instance of them cheaping out.

5. The zip-on sleeves could be roomier and looser around the shoulders---however I do have a more muscular build than average (weightlifter) so that's probably why. I brought the sleeves to wear on the plane instead of using a blanket, but they were too tight to be comfortable, plus they were just kind of ugly-looking...out of proportion with the roomy vest.

If I had to do it over again, I would just buy the vest not the jacket version. But overall am pretty happy with this product, it's functional and certainly looks better than the cheaper multi-pocket travel vests which are too military-looking for my liking.

My main beef is that for the price that this darn jacket sells for, they could have provided far better construction quality...Lands End and LL Bean both provide far better construction for about the same (if not slightly lower) price levels, too bad they don't make something like this too! product_title: Regular Show Oooooohh T-Shirt
review_headline: There's Nothing REGULAR about The Regular Show!
review_body:
I bought this t-shirt for my daughter's boyfriend for Christmas, after I bought one for myself in Hot Topic. I have to say, this is one of my all time favorite shirts. It washes well, it's soft, and it is a little oversized, which I really like. When my daughter's boyfriend saw the shirt, he said, \\"Siiiiiiiccccccckkkkkkk!\\" (which is the new word for \\"cool\\" or \\"groovy\\", apparently lol). That was when I realized I needed to get him a shirt, as well.
The show itself requires a little getting used to; talking raccoons and talking blue jays have been seen before, and that dates back to when Saturday Morning Cartoons were cool (ie., Bugs Bunny). But the best part of this show is the originality of the characters; there is a large Yeti dude who meditates, a boss with a bubble gum machine for a head, a friend who is large, green, and obnoxious, a floating white ghost that goes by the name of \\"High Five\\", and a very endearing gentlemanly like fellow with a blown up bubble gum bubble for a head. The other characters are the love interests for the blue jay, Mordacai; a smart cardinal who works in a diner, and her friend, who has a huge crush on the raccoon, Rigby. Original story lines abound in this program, which is really more for the teenaged and adult crowd than for young children (hence the prevalence of the items in Hot Topic). They drink coffee, sometimes they appear sloth-like in their attitudes towards work, and their favorite phrase, of course, is, \\"Oooooooooooooooo!\\" So, if you want to impress someone in your life who is in their late teens or early twenties, and you know they are a fan of the new cartoons on Cartoon Network, I'd have to say that going with the irregular, or in this case, the regular, is the way to go!

product_title: Calvin Klein Men's Short-Sleeve Solid Polo Shirt
review_headline: Stylish and built for the man who doesn't have too much in the middle
review_body:
I'm finding a general pattern in men's clothing: if you buy shirts to accommodate a muscular frame, you'll wind up with enough billowing fabric to make a spinnaker. If you buy pants to accommodate muscular legs, you'll get a waist size big enough for two. The fact is that much of what is sold for men is sold for the sedentary male, not the active, fit ones.

Fortunately, Calvin Klein has been very reliable for those who don't model themselves after Jabba the Hut, making stylish clothing out of comfortable materials with a flattering fit. I've found the same is true again for this short sleeve Polo. I'm not tucking a wad of extra material in, leaving folds and creases at the waist. There's no unusual tightness in odd places, and the material is breathable and soft.

Further kudos to CK for being very subtle in the logo placement. I steer away from brands that expect me to be a walking billboard and not pay me for the privilege.

product_title: Ingrid & Isabel Women's Maternity Everyday Bellaband
review_body: Got a black one (and eventually got a white one from a local baby store, too). At 27 weeks pregnant, I'm using these every day and still wearing all my pre-pregnancy pants and loving having this option. I'm hoping they carry me the full way thru, and it's looking promising. Sometimes it's a little tough to keep it just below the bottom edge of the zipper line (have to check after standing up from sitting, and find myself kind of unconsciously constantly checking it), but overall it's been a great solution. I'm 5'7'' and currently ~155lb at this point in my pregnancy (pre-pregnancy size: ~133lbs, size 4 in Gap pants, size 6 in LOFT) and bought a size 2 when I first got it several months ago. Still seems to be the right size as the sizing notes you'll be the same size throughout your pregnancy. With some pants they don't seem to stay up as well and the butt can get a little droopy since the BellaBand is the only thing holding them up. In these cases, I'm trying to use the BellyBelt underneath (just the part that connects the button/tab to the buttonhole/tab slot, but not also the cover-flap part of that system) so these pants actually have a bit more support to stay up. I agree w/another reviewer that the rubber grip seems to be important. I noticed the cheaper BellaBand I found at a local Target store doesn't have this strip and it made me wonder how effective it would be in helping keep your pants up.

product_title: EAC1D01 Excellent Gift Giving Various of Colors Mens Fine Silk Necktie By Epoint
review_headline: Thick material, stiff to work with, and the tail is way too wide
review_body:
Black Polka Dots Woven Silk Tie, Pointe Tie PH1105

This necktie is the typical length, but the thickness of the material and the width of the tail end made it difficult to tie a double Windsor. It ends up being too short unless you make the knot really tight or try to stretch out the material a bit. The width of the tail makes it difficult to fit underneath all of my dress shirt collars.

The saving grace is that after half a dozen tries, the double Windsor looks perfect and the material glimmers almost like a carbon fiber weave. It definitely looks sharp in a classic way. With my normal silk ties, they are thinner at the tail and a thinner overall material and I can get a perfect double Windsor usually on the first or second try.

Overall: 4/5 stars, the material is too thick and stiff, and the tail is too wide.

Until now, its been impossible to find a bra that doesn't make me feel like I can't breath. My experience has been that with most bras the band around the ribcage bears a lot of the \\"weight\\" of the breasts, and thus it needs to be tight in order to do this job. And this is what has made me feel like I can't breath. But with the torso trim the weight is distributed throughout my midriff and is much more comfortable. I wear the XL Torso Trim Underwire and it is incredibly comfortable. One thing is that the underwires don't quite rest against my sternum but fit fine everywhere else without rubbing or bruising. One would think that this would create a \\"uni-boob\\" effect but it doesn't because of the cut of the fabric. I wear the underwire version when I'm out and about and when I'm home I wear the version that doesn't have underwires.

product_title: Leg Avenue Women's Tea Time Alice Set
review_body: I was a little skeptical about ordering my Halloween costume online, but now I am very glad I did. I have been wanting to dress up as Alice in Wonderland for years and after browsing the selection of costumes on Amazon, I decided on this one. It just came in the mail today and after trying it on, I can't wait for Halloween! I was very pleased with the quality, fit, and overall appearance of this costume. I am a smaller framed pear-shaped young woman, so I ordered a Medium size to be on the safe side and because it was cheaper than the small. I found that it fit perfectly fine. The only exception being that it is a little loose arond my waist but that tends to be the case with most of my clothes. I have a small chest area though and it it pretty form fitting there so if you are busty you may want to opt for a larger size. The flared skirt is great for girls with larger hips (like myself). The skirt hits just above the knee on me (I'm 5'5\\"). I decided to purchase a white petticoat to accompany the costume and I am very glad I did. Although it looks fine without the petticoat, it looks a lot cuter with the extra volume under the skirt. Also, adding black gloves adds a special touch. The headpiece is comfortable and the bow is silky and pliable (you can bend it)and it makes the bow on the dress. The costume itself it actually quite silky and comfortable (the sleeves are a bit itchy) and the quality of the sewing and fabric is a lot better than most of the Alice costumes I have seen out there. This is a great Alice costume for ladies looking for something that is adorable and respectably sexy without being too over-the-top and sleazy. I highly recommend it!

product_title: True Religion Women's Emily Sherpa Lined Denim Jacket
review_headline: On sale, it is worth the price . . .
review_body: Via Amazon, I'm now buying this AGAIN - even though I already bought one last year with a 25% discount coupon at Bloomingdale's - because it has been a great item to own for the SF area, and half-price for True Religion is a rare bird. I wear a Petite 2, 34A, with thin arms and semi-athletic shoulders - and the XS is an okay-but-very-snug fit (the sherpa \\"stuffing\\"), which helps keep me warm, which is why I bought this. But this has been with a tank top or VERY thin sleeve; I don't think a sweater would fit underneath for me! The jacket sleeves are not noticeably overly-long on me (in the XS), nor does the jacket look as militaristic on me as it does on the Amazon model, who \\"buttons\\" up more than I do. I'm not really a denim jacket person, but noticed how my basic Eddie Bauer denim petite jacket is such a go-to wardrobe item, these days! But denim never keeps me warm enough when it's cold. I searched for fashionable warm lined denim jackets, but this was the only one I could find that could go beyond hunting in the deep backwoods (fashion-wise) . . . but, despite great quality, I could not digest True Religion's full retail price:/ I caved when Bloomingdales.com offered 25%-off just about everything . . . and am glad I did. It looks a tad silly, but when I'm out with a little dress and the summer night gets cold, I can throw this thick thermal winter thing on and stay warm! If you're wondering about the sizing, you might find it to try on at a True Religion retail store . . . but move quickly . . . ! And, with regard to the other reviewer's comments, I vaguely recall (?) that the two tags can fall off easily . . . one was loop-strung onto a button and the other attached with the standard plastic threading, which breaks off easily because of how thick the denim/sherpa is if the tag/thread is pulled at.

product_title: Hart Schaffner Marx Men's Sandhurst Coat
review_body:
I would like to add my experience regarding this coat and I would say it is not very pleasant as I would have expected.

Price not worth - Retail Cost $495 (I did not pay that price but one third) - Even at one third the purchase price I find this coat not worth that price. You would expect good wool and it says 10% cashmere, where is it?
Heavy - I read some reviews that this is a light coat. To be honest I have had other coats that were cheaper and this coat is on the heavy side. I am a tall and strong man and can handle the weight but am sure others would feel it heavier.
Too wide - I bought the 42 Large (it said in the description as slim fit) and found it to be too wide fit like actually someone who is 46" or 48" might fit easily. This is even the case when I wear the suit.
Itchy - When the collar rubs the back of the neck it tends to get itchy. This could probably be due to the build quality(most likely) or simply since the coat is new. I have not had an issue with other coats that I bought in the past.
Usable - using for short times is ok. I used to for travel 20-25 mins (and take it off). Avoid longer wear as the weight, itchy feeling may get discomforting.

Look for other alternatives for this price if you can find one.

Update: We bought these (in size medium) when my son had a 29\\" waist, and they probably would have still fit even if he'd been a bit slimmer. He is now at just under 31\\" and they still fit, although he couldn't get too much bigger. I saw another post by a man who has a 38\\" waist who said the large was too small. product_title: Wrangler RIGGS WORKWEAR Men's Ranger Pant
review_headline: These are "the hard to find work pants".
review_body:
These pants are awesome! I'm a boiler tech and they are a professional yet laid back look.
My Thoughts:

MATERIAL FEEL
-The fabric is a thin yet strong feel and it doesn't seem as if just anything will tear at it. The thinner feel will be great for spring and hotter days when I'm stuck in a boiler room.
DOUBLE KNEE
-I will definitely need knee inserts as the thinner feel is very apparent when working on the knees. The knee is holding up so far.
POCKETS
-Pocket fabric is very rugged and that is one of the reasons I went for this brand. My previous work pants would eventually tear a hole in the front pant pockets leaving the pants useless or needing repair (I never repair so I don't know if it is easy). This is mostly caused by my keys.
-I carry my galaxy note 2 and my android max work phone in the same front pant pocket. Very roomy.
-I am very impressed with the right side pocket leather/leatherette patch. This works great to secure my pocket knife and measuring tape. It also makes clipping to it really easy.
LEG POCKET/CARGO POCKETS
-The leg pockets are more of a cargo pants feel but that isn't a bad thing since these don't sag with things in them as standard cargo pants would. They fit my needs but may not be a good fit for others that are used to the Carhartt setup.
PANT/HAMMER LOOP
-I don't often use the pant loop so I cannot comment on it on a daily use perspective. I have read that it doesn't fit many pipe wrenches though. I haven't tried that but will and update.
BELT LOOP
-Belt loops are roomy, for those that use larger than standard they should work.
LENGTH
-Sometimes when I order pants with my inseam measurements they come a bit longer or shorter. These came perfect and work very well with my work boots and even tennis shoes when I change after work.
FIT
-They are more of a loose comfort fit. Just use a belt to keep them secure when loaded down.

CONCLUSION
-I typically wear Carhartts and Carhartts are good pants but I don't always like the feel and fit of them. I wanted more of a comfortable yet durable pair of pants but I found out quickly that it's hard to find all the features you want from work pants. When I ordered the Riggs Workwear pants I expected everything as described and got exactly that. The material, build and fit won me over and I will be transitioning my work pants to RIGGS. I love Carhartt and will continue to buy their bibs but as far as work pants I am now a RIGGS man. I say try a pair and I think you will agree that they are great pants.

product_title: Batman The Dark Knight Grand Heritage Deluxe Costume And Mask, The Joker
review_body:
Overall, I'm pretty happy with this costume compared to other cheap ones I have fallen victim to in the past. However, for the quality and the amount of modifications I will need, it still seems a bit costly.

For reference, I am 6' 150 lbs. and I ordered a Medium size.
THE PANTS are too long (better than too short), and HUGE in the waist. (I have a 29"-30" waist and these pants are probably 36"-plus) I will have to pin them and hem them to make them usable. They have no belt loops but have elastic sewn in, which is cool but does me no good since the waist is so big on me.
THE GLOVES are a pretty standard size, but I have rather long fingers, so they are on the borderline of not fitting at all.
THE VEST is too small, due to the elastic band sewn in the back. It also had one button hole that was sewn shut.
THE SHIRT fits perfect, but the sleeves are longer than the jacket sleeves.
THE JACKET is pretty nice and will need quite a bit of ironing.
THE TIE...just throw the tie away. It is a really lightweight material and impossible to keep tied properly to where it looks like a normal tie.
THE WIG fits perfectly, but looks nothing like the one in the picture. It has a HUGE widow's peak that looks rather silly for this version of the Joker that the costume is emulating.
THE MAKEUP KIT is pretty cheesy and I will probably use some more professional makeup, but I'm sure the included kit could be used so long as you're not as anal-retentive as I am when it comes to Halloween and art projects in general.
THE PACKAGING: I LOVE LOVE LOVE that it comes in a zippered garment bag with a hanger. However, this arrived folded in half and crumpled up on itself, shoved in a simple plastic mailer bag so I will be spending a lot of time carefully ironing.
THE DELIVERY was shipped to me via FedEx. I have a certain bitterness for FedEx from past experiences, but this definitely put me over the edge. I witnessed them drive up to my house and, without even getting out of the truck, threw the package up onto my porch and then drove off. No F**ks were given. Obviously, they didn't even knock to let me know a package was out in the open by my front door.
THE OVERALL QUALITY is not something that can survive years of constant use and it will take some minor tailoring to include trimming hundreds of stray strings and a bunch of time spent ironing to make it look presentable. The material is nice quality and it is comfortable to wear. It's a really good looking costume for Halloween, but I wouldn't consider this for cosplay or even say it's close to screen accurate, especially with the wacky clown wig with thinning hair and odd widow's peak.

PROS:
-Included Garment Bag and hanger
-Comfortable
-Complete set (with the exception of shoes)
-Only minor modifications required to make it usable for my body size

CONS:
-Small vest
-Large pants
-Everything about the tie
-Cheap Wig and Makeup Kit

PURCHASE HISTORY

-- 3rd Purchase: $89: January 2013: Covert Green is olive.
-- 2nd Purchase: $110: December 2012: Black.
-- 1st Purchase: $150: March 2012: British Khaki is like wet khaki. To me, it looks better than regular khaki.

REVIEW 4 OF 4: THIRD PURCHASE REVIEW ON 1.4.2013: 5 STARS

We all strive to do the best with our money. When it comes to buying, I'd be willing to spend a little bit more for a high-quality product. That may not be the top-of-the-line, but one that nonetheless provides a great value for the price. This London Fog has been one of those worthy products. I bought it the first time out of taking a risk, the second from its positive experience, and this third out of admiration for the raincoat.
.
.
.
REVIEW 3 OF 4: SECOND PURCHASE REVIEW ON 12.24.2012: 5 STARS

Impressed with the first purchase, I eventually bought a second in a different color. Unlike the first, this second raincoat has strongly stitched buttons. So now I have nothing to complain about anymore. As a result, I proudly promote it to a 5-star review from its former four stars.

I especially like how suave it looks with formal or casual clothing. Plus, the loose fit is comfortable. And of course, this London Fog is warm. The lining is soft, quilted, color coordinated, and zippered to the raincoat. I also dig the below-the-knee coverage and the conservative close-to-the-neck notched collar. Along with the lining, that full length and enclosing collar shielded me peacefully from a cold and rainy night. (A wide-brim wool hat and cold-weather gloves helped, too.)

Then, there are other positive psychological effects: it shrouds you in a presence of mystique, and it makes you feel exclusive and smart for using such a protective and refined apparel. So as you wear this excellent and affordable London Fog raincoat, you'll have more than bad-weather protection in a comfortable fit.You'll be showcased in it.
.
.
.
REVIEW 2 OF 4: LONG-TERM REVIEW ON 12.21.2012: 4 STARS

I'm deducting a star from my initial 5-star review because of the weakly sewn buttons that are hanging from flimsy threads. Otherwise, this raincoat has been tailored more meticulously. Plus, it has a traditional handsome look that's still in vogue even in these modern times.

Performance-wise, I feel this London Fog reaches its limit in providing warmth in temperatures of about 35 degrees Fahrenheit (about 1.7 degrees Celsius). Anything colder than that and you'd have to resort to a cold-weather coat. Still, this raincoat has been helpful to me this December 2012. It's been unusually cold here in San Diego, California, USA. Evening-to-morning temperatures have been anywhere from 35 to 45 degrees Fahrenheit (-1.7 to 7.2 degrees Celsius).

Another comforting feature is the low price. Purchasing it back in March 2012, I bought it for $150. Eventually, Amazon increased it to $160. Now that it's chilly December, the raincoat is surprisingly selling for only $110. That's bewildering because today, December 21st, is the start of winter. It's a time when cold-weather apparel is usually sold at a premium, not a discount.

Good-looking, warm, and reduced in price. In spite of the poorly sewn buttons, this is a high-quality product that's made even better with a rare great deal.
.
.

REVIEW 1 OF 4: INITIAL REVIEW ON 3.25.2012: 5 STARS

Size bought and color: 40S and British Khaki

Best features:

- Warm
- Conservative, traditional style (if you're into that)
- British khaki looks old-Western: no nonsense and rugged
- High-quality materials and craftsmanship
- Comfortable, loose fit without being baggy. A variety of body types can fit into this raincoat.
- Looking nicer than a typical raincoat, this can be worn over casual clothes or formal attire. In either case, you'll look dashing in it.
- Hassle-free fashion because there are no epaulets, no sleeve tabs, and no belt.

Undesirable features:

- None as far as I can see.

Summary

The lining for the torso looks like a comforter and feels like a blanket. Then, from the waist down to almost my knees, that lining becomes a thin, felt-type of cloth. Furthermore, the sumptuous outside garment, which covers below my knees, is suede-like. And although I'm neither a garment expert nor a tailor, I still experience what I see and feel to be a premium product. This is one of my best purchases in life, and I'd rate it more than five stars if I could.

review_body:

This outfit does nothing to conceal my proud, angry, girthiness nor does the included diploma seem to boost my smartishness.

My work here is done.

1. Were soft and comfortable
2. Provided support in the right areas
3. DID NOT become lose at the leg ends and ride up
4. DID NOT have huge elastic rings at the end that were visible through pants

review_headline: If this bra was advertised as a sleep bra
review_body: or a leisure bra, I would up the rating by a star or two. I did not get the \\"uniboob\\" look as some others here have, and mine fits comfortably in the back and on the sides. In fact, one good feature is that unlike most leisure bras, it did not ride up in the back. I bought a nude-colored bra, and mine is not transparent. The material does not appear to be breathable, and I anticipate that I am going to feel noticeably warmer wearing this bra in the summer heat. As a regular bra I would wear once I step foot out of the house ... no way, unless it is a dire emergency and I have no time to change my clothes. There is not nearly enough support to wear this bra under normal circumstances, and if the weather is chilly and I am not wearing a sweatshirt or sweater, people would see a little more of me than I would  like. And under normal circumstances, I would certainly not run or walk briskly in public wearing this!    Another reviewer wrote that the manufacturer claims the bras sold on Amazon are counterfeits. I did not buy this one from Amazon, and am sure it is the real thing, yet my review is not that dissimilar from the other one-stars. Good thing I got this bra on sale. If I paid full price for this and expected to treat this like a normal bra, per the advertiser's implications, I would be rather annoyed.
