product_title: PUMA Men's 3-Pack Volume Boxer Brief
review_headline: Blah material, bad leg fit, but good style
review_body:
These are comfortable, but not especially notable boxer briefs that happen to be made by a name brand. The style and coloring where nice, but some of the fit was significantly lacking. I wouldn't recommend these unless you're looking for a fit to transition between regular boxers and boxer briefs.

Pouch
---------------
Having had some bad experiences with different brands, one of the first things I notice about the fit of boxer briefs is that of the pouch. I'm about average sized for a guy in this regard, so I assume my experiences are about the same as everyone elses. Some brands decide to leave so much room that the pouch feels like true boxers rather than boxer briefs, others have a flat compressed pouch, and still others seem to forget that these are designed for men. Luckily the Pumas do a good job of providing ample pouch space without leaving things to flap around like regular boxers.

Rear
---------------
The rear is occasionally a problem for me since I have a muscular build. The Pumas however are too large in this regard relative to the waist size. I purchased the mediums since I have a 31" waist, and the rear is a little too large even for me. This is likely related to the leg sizes which are described below.

Waist
---------------
The waist on these fits quite well. I'm 5' 7" with a 31" waist and the waist sits rather well relative to the length for size medium. I don't feel like I have to pull them up to my belly button to get the length to sit right, nor do I feel like they're going to slip off because they're so low. The waistband itself is made of decent elastic material that's not so wide it adds to the overall height of the fit significantly.

Legs
--------------
The legs are where these boxer briefs break down. Trying them on as soon as I received them, the legs were a little loose and the leg openings flared out slightly rather than staying consistent diameter such that they'd stay in place when worn. After a few washings, this problem got even worse, so now they fit like regular boxers that have a slightly tighter fit in the crotch and across the top of the rear. Because there's not much particularly special about these, the legs are a deal breaker that makes them fall outside my regular wear requirements.

Style
--------------
The red highlighting on these is great, and they look pretty nice in general. The waistband and piping along the flap on the pouch draw the attention in the right ways, making a statement without being ostentatious. The terrible fit in the legs however becomes increasingly shoddy over time, and the slight red highlighting along the bottom of the legs just draws attention to the fact that the poor fit causes the hems to get permanently wrinkled and twisted looking.

product_title: Wrightsock Men's Coolmesh Qtr 4 Pair Pack
review_body: These socks are great for running; especially for long distance.  The two layer sock does help with blistering.  Basically, there is an extra layer that will rub up against the shoe and the interior layer will stay fit with your feet.  With that said, it doesn't stop blistering.  Please don't buy this sock thinking it will stop blistering while running.  For short distance of up to 3 miles, these socks are overkill.  In my opinion, they are expensive for a reason, they are meant for long runs!  Short runs, any synthetic sock will do.    The wicking of sweat is the best I found so far.  Smartsocks work, but the wool doesn't wick as well.  Nike's sock is too thin and doesn't prevent blisters as well as the wrightsocks.  North Face socks offer a nice sock, but nothing out of the ordinary.  No extra protection or wicking.    The one issue I have with this sock is washing.  After a few washings, the two layer sock system will separate a bit.  That leads to a little less protection against blistering and not as nice of a fit.  It doesn't wick as well when the sock starts to separate.    Bottom line: great sock worth the price if you run long distances.  For short distances, makes no difference.  Also works well if you wear socks all day long.  They will not bunch up as much as cotton sock.

product_title: 20 Stainless Steel Collar Stays in a Box - 4 Sizes - Deluxe Edition
review_body:
I was tired of those stupid plastic ones that come with the shirt. They always get lost. So, I went looking for something more durable and found these. For what they are, I didn't think the price was too bad; though I was concerned about some of the reviews saying the box they came in was flimsy. I have to say, though, that I'm very happy with these. When I first ordered them, I figured I wouldn't actually be using all 4 sizes, but quickly discovered that I do have shirts that fit each size. The box that I got is not flimsy. It's great. I just keep it on top of my dresser, and when I come home, just take the stays out, put them back in their spots, and toss the shirt in the dry-clean pile. Before taking shirts into dry cleaning, I just check the collar stays box to make sure they're all accounted for.

I have not had a problem with them tearing through the collar. Though, I do have about 25 dress shirts in my rotation, and don't wear one every day. I imagine if you have a small number of shirts and wear them everyday, they may tear through. Although, what I also think is possible for those who do have a problem with them tearing through, is that perhaps they're using too large of one. You can't use one that puts pressure on each end of the collar. Use one that is just slightly shorter than the available space for the collar stay. It keeps your collar pointed and stiff, without placing any pressure inside the stay area.

If you're looking for a solution to your plastic collar stay problem, get these.

review_headline: Beautiful Coat Nice and Warm and Rich Looking!
review_body: I just want to start out by saying that this is a very rich looking coat. When you walk down the street people will know that this is not a cheap quality coat. I read the other reviews regarding the lining and I did not have that problem. When my coat arrived I went over it inch by inch. The coat and lining was perfect. I did not find the lining to be cheap at all. No loose threads either. The zipper goes all the way up providing you with a kind of turtleneck. You have the high quality buttons and you also have a few snap buttons. The snap buttons are located by the neck and at the bottom of the coat. There are 2 huge pockets on the front of the coat, and 2 pockets on the side of the bigger pockets. Further up you also have 2 hand warmer pockets which I will more than likely use most of the time. You also have the classic hood that is attached to the coat and is not removable. I already own a navy peacoat, but I wanted a coat that has a bit more style to it. I can still wear my pea coat, but now I have a coat that I can dress up a bit when I go out for a date or someplace semi dressy. The one thing I will agree about that another reviewer mentioned is the small chain on the inside of the coat by the neck. It does not seem strong enough to support a heavy winter coat, but that was not enough to make me take a star away. I bought a large and the coat fits like a dream. I'm 5'10\\" and 190 lbs, and the coat fits great. I love this coat.  Update 2/12/2012, I just want to take back what I said about the small chain to hang this  coat with. The chain is much stronger than I thought. I hang up my coat by the chain whenever I wear it to work and it is very strong. I love this coat. the lining is great and the coat is very warm.

product_title: Secret Wishes Womens DC Comics Ame-comi Heroine Series Catwoman Costume
review_body:
Came in the mail in under a week.
Bring a whip and sexy shoes. As it says in the description, \\"whip sold separately\\" so buy one. They're pretty cheap: You can purchase your prop for $3-$10. My descriptions below are for the Extra Small. I have addressed each piece separately.

The boot covers form to the upper leg well. The bottom bit that covers the shoe is made for heels. You'll find it a little awkward and bunchy if you intend on wearing flats.

The chaps/cat tail are attached to each other. If you have a smaller caboose and don't stretch out the fabric in the rear enough, the weight of the tail pulls the back down a little. I plan on fixing this by using a safety pin.

The body suit. There is elastic bungy lining the leg holes. If you have a larger behind, size up. I believe this part of the costume was designed for a reverse pear shape. This being said, the bust of the Extra Small was designed for a 34/36 C and the cut in the back is too low to wear any support, unless you don't mind it being seen. I am not well endowed enough in this area to pull it off without the use of deception, so I plan on wearing a skin tight top underneath. Paired with black leggings, I believe I can make this outfit PG enough to wear out, but boost my bosom at the same time. Previous review states that it is difficult to put on, this is very true. If you are flexible, it is easier. If you're not: the fabric gives a little bit, don't be afraid to give it a little stretch.

The gloves are a good fit if you have average sized hands. My hands are on the small side, so I think I am just going to convert these bad boys into fingerless gloves through the power of scissors. You might end up wanting to take scissors to the buckle tabs as well. The none buckle side tab is very long. The holes in the buckles were punched small, like with a needle. I'm not too sure, but don't be afraid to repierce the fabric. (There are a ton of buckles on this costume. Almost each piece has 3 buckles on it)

The hat is huge and weird. Definitely recommend buying/making your own cat ears. The goggles however are super cute.

This costume is a costume: A previous review focused on the poor quality of this costume, which made me cautious in purchasing it. Upon arrival though and after a good inspection and fitting, I would have to say that they were mistaken. For the price, the quality of construction is pretty decent. Of course I would not recommend this COSTUME if you desire to model your actual life after Cat Woman or if you want it for a Comic con. But if you just want to go on a few sexy soirees and escapades, this is purrfect.

product_title: InCharacter Costumes Men's Prince Charming
review_headline: A little pricier for a lot more value!
review_body: This is the best of the best of the four prince costumes I bought, all the rest of which were returned.  I give it a solid A.  1. The fabric is the best of any of the other costumes, and the workmanship was solid.    2. The construction of the jacket was not the best pattern I've seen, but it was still sewn well and resulted in a good fit.  It also ran very true to size (XL).  The epaulettes were very professionally done, lay flat, and the fringe is as full as shown in the photo.  3. The pants were well made and the most comfortable fit of any costume pant I ever have tried on.  Not as good as a suit trouser, but superb for a costume.  4. The accessories were good.  The belt buckle was the only one out of four costumes I tried that was actually shiny and nice.  The medal is a little roundy and cartoonish, but of a good size and visual heft to play well against the vast sea of white fabric it has to sit on.  The sash is made out of a very nice, rich-looking material and is well made, so it hangs well and lays flat.  If I had to temper my satisfaction at all, I wouldn't have used the same material for the sash as for the trim on the jacket.  But, that's forgiveable on a costume.  I definitely recommend this line of costumes.

product_title: Zac Snyder's Sucker Punch Secret Wishes Babydoll Costume
review_body:
Ok, so I'm a huge geek I go to convetions dress up all that fun stuff. So due to my lazyness this year I decided to buy my cosplays instead of making them. I cosplayed as rocket a few years ago but really wanted to do babydoll and toally afraid to wear something so revealing. So on a hunch I bought this costume on sale just to try it out.
Let me say I couldn't be more pleased with this costume. I read all the reviews and pretty much what to expect with this costume and honestly I think it's better than what some people were saying and other parts were right on the mark. I will first say this. I am not a small skinny mini thing. I'm 5'8 and probably a little bit too chubby for something so skimpy but i must say I couldn't be happier with how flattering this costume is.
I bought a Large and the top fits great. I even think it's a little big aroung the bust and while some reviewers said the top was shorter than the picture, but on me it covered my rib cage which is exactly what I wanted because I have some rolls right there lol. Ok the belt did not fit at all which I figured it wouldn't That doesn't bother me I was going to buy a belt and even make the harness thing for the actual convention.
The Skirt is actually a little on the small side for me. Ok correction the skirt fits fine I just have bigger hips/butt and had a little squeeze to get it over them. I also liked the longer length of the skirt too because I can pull it up to my waist so I have a modest amount of midsection showing and the length is at the desired shortness too. The thigh Hi's were crap. They were very thin and Kept rolling down. Thank goodness I have extra pairs and The head band was really really small. I can't wear it so I will make my own.
So overall this costume isn't perfect. It has it's flaws but It was made well and comfortable and even for a slightly bigger girl like myself I don't feel like everything's hanging out. So I say if you want to cosplay on a budget and wannabe cute and sexy. Get this costume. It was totally worth the price I paid. So keep an eye out for a sexy chubby BabyDoll at AnimeExpo this year ;)

product_title: Cole Haan Men's Plush Duffle Coat with Toggles
review_headline: Beware - Sizing on site is incorrect
review_body: Like the other reviewers, I purchased this jacket while it was on special during the Cyber Monday \\"week\\" - it was $173, about $110 less than than Amazon's \\"regular\\" price.  It was a great deal anda really nice jacket but unfortunately the sizing information on the jacket is completely wrong on the site.  I fit into every category of what should be a \\"large\\" per the sizing information, but like the other reviewers, I was swimming in this jacket.  This would not have been a big deal if I was able to exchange the item for a Medium.  However, Amazon's return policy is completely different from what you would expect.  It turns out that despite this being a matter that the website's sizing description was wrong, Amazon would not exchange the Large jacket for a Medium at the same price.  They told me I can return the item and go ahead and purchase the medium at the current price... since this was 2 days later and the promotion had ended, that would have meant paying an extra $110 just to get a smaller version of the exact same jacket.  I spoke with several customer service agents and the customer service manager to no avail of rationality.  (Litte side-note here: The most humorous interaction was with the customer service manager who apparently has an auto-response on the instant chat features which expresses 'how sorry they are for the inconvenience and that they know you have a choice in retailers and that they hope you will choose Amazon for your future needs, etc...' nice touch for a \\"heart-felt\\" script guys... I was getting riled up by this point so in my passion I told them they must have to use that one a lot...).  So my lesson here - Amazon doesn't care about customer satisfaction and will not take an action which would not put them out any money just to satisfy a long-time customer who spends way too much with them in the first place - but that's my problem clearly.   The lesson you should take away is this minus the emotion of having it happen to you - If you purchase a clothing item from Amazon while its on a fire sale, buy three... buy the item which should fit you per the website sizing description and then buy the size larger and the size smaller.  Once you figure out which one actually fits you, return the other two.  (yes, that is tongue in cheek, but my advice is beware of sizing and be prepared for disappointment if it doesn't match what they descrive on the site).  Get it together, Amazon.

product_title: Assets by Sara Blakely High-Waist Mid-Thigh Super Control (871B)
review_body:
This shaper is very comfortable and effective for medium-level control. I bought it to wear under a fairly clingy dress, and the difference was immediately noticeable -- I looked like I'd lost ten pounds instantly. Even though it's only medium-control, this shaper does a really nice job of holding everything in place and giving a nice, smooth shape, especially around the stomach and thighs. Also, the top does indeed reach all the way up to right under the bra (and I say this being 5' 10\\" and having a pretty long torso). One note: I went up one size over what the Assets size chart suggested, and I'm glad I did: I think the smaller one would have rolled down on the top and up on my legs. As it was, the larger size stayed in place really well through eight hours at a wedding, but it was still relatively easy to pull down and back up when I had to use the ladies' room.

The one drawback to this shaper is that it has a seam down the front which is slightly visible depending what you wear. It's not terribly obvious, but it's something to consider if you're picky and are looking for something to wear under fitted clothes. :) Otherwise, it's a great buy!

product_title: Carhartt Women's Denim Bib Overall Unlined
review_headline: Overalls are big: fact! All women are not the same height: also fact!
review_body:
I knew these would be "somewhat large" when I ordered them -- because overalls are large by design. Unless you buy a fitted bib/designer one, they will be large in the waist for women.

My issues with these overalls are two: one slightly more irritating than the first. The clasps are just horrible. Why not just a plain button/hook like every other overall on the planet? These come unclasped far too easily, despite my working the overall part to fit.

Apparently anyone over a size 16 is the same height -- this will come as a shock to most people, since we have all seen evidence that disputes it. My overalls are ridiculously long and as such they drag along getting dirty and wet and sometimes even tripping me! Unless I sew them to be shorter, this is going to be a problem forever. I was given the option of going one size smaller and getting to chose a length, or going with overall size and apparently being over 7 feet tall. Many women will love this, but more will be highly irritated that their height is assumed.

I should have sent them back and tried the smaller size, I suppose, but they are just work overalls. However, if I wanted to wear them otherwise, I would have returned them or just not ordered in the first place.

product_title: 100% Cotton New Blue Seersucker Self-Tie Bow Tie
review_body: I was very happy to get my hands on a seersucker bow tie, at last!  During the Summer months, you'll see guys wearing seersucker ties in Virginia and down through the Carolinas, but it's a rarity here in Texas.  This bow tie is nicely made and first class in every way.  You'll pay a lot more for the same tie elsewhere - The Tie Bar people are the best.  This tie is made of cotton as the description points out.  Since it's not made of silk, as are most ties, I should point out that you'll likely have to experiment with where you'll need to set the length of this tie.  Usually with a bow tie made of cotton or wool, you'll have to adjust the length - longer than you would for a regular, silk tie.  The material is thicker and more coarse than silk so you'll have to use a little more surface area of the tie to make the knot and final adjustments.  For any bow tie, the numbers on the inside to adjust the length are only an approximation to get you in the ball park for the length you'll need.  It's not an exact science because there are so many variables:  thickness and material from which the tie is made, the thickness of the shirt you're wearing, and how you tie your bow tie.  Some guys like to tie them loosely and have a large, relaxed knot.  Some of us cinch the tie up snugly and opt for a small knot.  All of these things affect the needed length and require a little practice and experimentation on your part.  Enjoy it!  That's one of the best things about a bow tie.  You get to customize it every time since it's not a case of \\"Plug it in.-Turn it on.-Boot it up and it's the same stuff everyone else has.  Thanks for your kind attention as I rambled on so much!

review_body: I just bought this bra (not on Amazon), at a price comparable to what it's selling for here, and though it's more money than I'm used to paying for bras, I decided the money is worth it. I have spent countless frustrating hours in stores like Kohls trying to find bras that fit my wide bust, no support, sides bulging, giving me an unflattering silhouette... nothing, and I mean nothing fit. In the Le Mystere line, I am a 34F, which translates to a 34DDD in other bra styles, but try to find a 34DDD in your local Kohls or even Macy's, it is rare. I now own about 5 Le Mystere bras and will not use any other. They are sexy and durable and I appreciate finally finding a plunge bra that holds me in without my breasts bouncing from lack of support. This bra also converts to a cross back so now I can wear it under cut out tank tops (it does not convert to a halter however... I am still searching for that...) The Le Mystere line is quality all the way, but they are not lightweight bras... you definitely know they are there holding you in. I read somewhere that this line is most flattering to women with wide or augmented breasts. I am not augmented, but my breasts are wide, so it is true, this bra is flattering and comfortable for the most part, except on really hot days, it feels like wearing a corset. I will definitely stick to this line and stop frustrating myself by trying other brands. If your girlz are wide and hard to fit, give this line a try. product_title: Bravado Men's Avenged Sevenfold Killing Moon T-shirt
review_body:
I'd been eyeing this T-shirt for a while until I finally decided to purchase it a couple of weeks ago. The reason I didn't buy it sooner is that I was not sure what size to order. The size chart on the product page is useless, and both Amazon and Bravado were courteous, but not helpful. I finally decided to buy three different sizes; I kept the one that fitted and returned the other two.

The T-shirt is made of thick, heavy pure cotton. The base color is soft black rather than jet black. The other colors--yellows, greens, and browns--are somewhat blended and muted, which I like. Were the colors any brighter, the shirt would be too flashy, in my opinion. The product picture on my computer screen is fairly true to the actual look, but your monitor may differ.

I measured all three T-shirts, and here is the size chart for Medium-Large-Extra Large, in inches, respectively: Chest 39-42-45, Length 28.5-29.0-30.5. I ended up keeping size Medium. This is the size I normally wear in adult women's.

I love this T-shirt and recommend it to any A7X fan.

Update (11/11/2013): I've worn and laundered the T-shirt quite a few times now, and it hasn't lost its shape and brightness. In the very first warm-water wash and medium-heat dry, it shrunk a teensy bit--half an inch or so, nothing to worry about--but the dies didn't run. I am happy to report that today the shirt looks exactly the same as it did the day I got it. A great tee at a bargain price--still five stars.

product_title: Tru-Spec 24-7 Long Sleeve Tactical Shirt, Navy Blue
review_body:
This is an interesting shirt. It isn't as good as their pants but this is a good 2nd. There are a lot of features in this shirt that I have yet to understand. I think this would benefit for its casual-formal appearance with buttons instead of the zipper-Velcro.

My first impressions that they just combined features of a jacket and a shirt. The back has a flap for increase range of movement, which is mu biggest problem for nicer shirts since I carry a lot of weight in my chest and back. It looks awkward but it is quite a nice feature. The chest pockets are Velcro and have a pen pocket on the left side. There is an opening on top of both of the pocket flaps for putting pens in.

Beneath that are 2 mesh pockets They're pretty well hidden. My only problem is that the zipper teeth are really fine which is a personal peeve of mine. On the upside all zippers are YKK zippers which have a good reputation associated with them.

Its true about the flap on the inside of the sleeve that helps tie up with a loop on the outside of the sleeve. Both are really discrete. The loop on the outside is fairly unnoticeable. If someone just happens to see it, they might point it out, but that's it. I had to look for the loop inside the sleeve because i couldn't feel it when i first tried it on. It is something I'd thought it would have bugged me, but it dosen't. +1 for tru-spec on that one.

Sewing is top-notch. There is very little excess stitching which is a huge plus for formal wear. While it is not all double stitched, the single stitching is purposeful and top-notched.

product_title: Forum Novelties Women's Deluxe Adult Mermaid Costume
review_headline: Best Mermaid costume I have seen in person!
review_body:
Pros:
-designed well to fit multiple sizes
-tail is more colorful than pictured and looks amazing, better than pictured
-there is a stretchy panel in the back of the corset which allows it to adjust from size 2-6 and still have a fitted look
-the best mermaid top I have seen that covers your midriff but still looks sexy and cohesive with the costume
-the base of the tail part is very full and made with nice material(each layer is a different shade giving it visual texture and a translucent fish like quality)

Sizing:
I was very worried about sizing I am usually a small/medium and a 6/8 depending on the brand and wasn't sure what to with xs/s and M/L sizes. I am also fairly busty and curvy.(D) My measurements matched the xs/s and I wanted a fitted look so I went with xs/s. It fits great and doesn't feel uncomfortable I did have a mishap with the top (See below). There is still plenty of room in the boob part or not a lot of support which leads me to believe most of us will need a strapless bra underneath. I love how it fits me, fitted but I think if I was 5-10 lbs heavier it probably would be too tight.(I currently weigh 140 at 5'5\\" I am also hourglass shaped so not sure if that makes a difference) I can sit comfortably, touch my toes, and squat without worrying about overstretching or splitting a seam.

Cons:
-sea shell accent on hip is a little mushed when you take it out of the package;(to be expected after shipping) easily fixed by hanging and fluffing
-WARNING: DO Not Pull Corset Over Your Head, like I did. While the seams are well sewn and the top stretchy, the translucent overlay material in the bodice pulls out of the seams easily and unravels. I highly recommend taking the time to undo the laces and put it on the slow way. (fairly confident this is because the translucent overlay unravels easily at the ends, I am right on the verge of either size- but I wasn't any rougher in pulling it over my head than I would be with a shirt or nightgown.)
If The Delicate Corset Overlay Does Split or Pull From The Seam, I fixed this by pulling all of the translucent layer off of the blue part of the corset. The blue underneath is very pretty by itself and would accent the tail and big shells nicely. I wanted it to sparkle so I covered the newly exposed blue section with one of those $1 cans of silver sparkly glitter hair spray they sell at halloween and covered that with a thick layer of normal hair spray to keep the glitter from flaking everywhere.
-the sea shells are quite large which might be problematic if you are small busted.

Other notes:
-the shells do stand out as pictured
-what you cant really see in the pic is that one side has a blue/green strap on the left side- that matches the tail poof. the other side has a clear strap. If you aren't into the asymmetrical straps you can easily remove the green part of the left strap (its material over a clear strap)

Overall I am very happy with the costume despite the mishap.d than I would be with a shirt or nightgown.)

product_title: Cowl-Back Satin Long Prom Dress Crystal Pin
review_body: I purchased both the [[ASIN:B004HN2X1A Beaded Strapless Satin Full Length Formal Gown With Side Ruffle Prom Dress Junior Plus Size]] and the [[ASIN:B004QKO7HW Cowl-Back Satin Long Gown with Crystal Pin Junior Plus Size]] in size 3X and IVORY as potential wedding dresses. I refuse to spend thousands on a dress that I will only wear once.  About me: I'm about 5'1\\" and 253 pounds.  Being a short as I am, I'm not afraid of needing dresses tailored.  So I knew that was going to be a given.  With my weight, though losing, I wasn't sure how forgiving the fabric would be.  Both dresses are beautiful and are less puffy and fluffy than traditional wedding dresses.  SIDE RUFFLE DRESS: The slit under the ruffle goes about mid-thigh on me. The dress has two layers of material (sorta like an inner liner). There is a zipper and the lacing does come apart. Also the material behind the lacing is removable, if you want to show more skin.  And as has been said before, the beading is beautiful on the top and goes all the way around to the back closure in lacing.  (My fiance loves corsets so this is definitely the dress I will be wearing on our summer cruise wedding.) A few things to note, the side view of the dress isn't very forgiving.  Nothing a nice girdle or SPANX can't fix, but something to think about if you have a belly.  Also because of my shorter torso and hips, I'll have to have the dress altered so that the band along the front with the big jewel is planar along the rear. Either way, this dress is definitely is definitely sassy.  COWL-BACK DRESS: This dress also has the two layers of material with the inner lining.  I was worried about the ruffles in the belly area.  The nice thing is that the ruffles are very forgiving if you have a belly.  I also noticed with the construction of the dress, you can keep the both shoulder look or you could pull down the smaller strap and make it a one shoulder look (Note: you would loose the cowl-back and it would be more like a fabric sashin the back).  The bling is removable and there is some side rouching.  The zipper is located on the left side under the armpit. It's definitely a nice dress; but it's a little too boring for my wedding being the bride. I felt very Statue of Liberty-ish.  If I were having bridesmaids, I might consider having them in it.  OVERALL: Both dresses were well made and came with an extra fabric scarf.

product_title: Rubie's Adult Stay Puft Costume
review_body:
First of all, I wish shipping info had been more clear. Before I ordered it, it said we should get it by the 27th or 28th. Once I placed the order, feeling confident we'd have it before Halloween, I received a notification that it would arrive between October 30th and November 4th. I debated canceling since I had no idea if I had just spent $45 on something we might not even get to use. But it ended up getting here just in the nick of time, late in the afternoon on Halloween.

Right out of the package, it looks pretty disappointing. Cheap material, everything is crumpled and wrinkled, and our mask looked really discolored and yellowish in some areas.

Inflating it with the fan provided works miracles. The costume looks much more impressive when it's "puft." We had a lot of fun with it, it looked great in pictures, and it was an amazing addition to our 3-year-old's ghostbusters costume.

I really debated between giving it 3 or 4 stars. It's a great costume but with the added shipping cost (because I couldn't find one that was prime eligible), it seemed a bit overpriced. Especially given the quality of the materials and the discoloration on the one we received.

review_body:

I had an unplanned c section so was unable to wear it for a week until I got my staples out, but wore it as much as possible during the day for 6 weeks after that. Three weeks post baby I was in those old jeans (with muffin tops and long shirts lol) and 2 mo post baby my hips were 2 inches smaller than they were before I got pregnant! I was worried about my jeans not fitting and they don't- they're all too big. If it's on tight enough it stays exactly where you put it when sitting and it's not the most comfortable thing, but you're not wearing it for comfort.
When I was still in maternity clothes I could wear the belt under, but it was pretty unrealistic to wear it under jeans that are just fitting. That's the only drawback but I was pretty much a homebody trying to get my naps in those first few weeks. I recommend this product to all of my friends!

The other reviewer is definitely correct when he says that they'll stretch and pill when you wash them (cold delicate wash, low heat dry).

I went to re-stock my dresser and found that the Brownsmead had been changed to the Brownsmead II, so I ordered a couple of those. the biggest change is that the back pockets are now ridiculously shallow, and no longer have the velcro closure on them that lent a bit of security. product_title: Wrightsock Men's Coolmesh II Quarter Single Pack Socks
review_body:
For some reason, my feet became callused over a year ago. I tried changing socks and shoes, which helped my right foot somewhat, but not my left foot. I saw these and thought $8.50 was pricey for a pair of socks - normally I'd spend that or less for three pair - but I saw the reviews and thought I'd give them a shot. Glad I did. After less than two weeks of wear, the calluses disappeared, while wearing the same pairs of shoes I been using.

I'm not a runner, so use was just for regular day-to-day walking. I wore these on 100+ degree days, with no issues. Now, I don't remember ever thinking my feet were unusually hot with other socks, but at least the Coolmesh didn't do the opposite of what it was meant to. After washing (they do shrink quite a bit), the socks SEEMED a little too snug on my 10.5 foot when I put them on for the day. However, wearing them has not felt uncomfortable at all, and they did get rid of the calluses. Since they did what I wanted and there were no comfort issues, I put "fit as expected", I just wonder if an 11.5 foot (the largest shoe size recommended for the size large sock) would be alright in these. I've had these socks for about two months and so far, they are holding up well - so no durability issues yet.

product_title: Leg Avenue Women's Woodland Fairy Costume
review_headline: Cute dress, cheap accessories, overall - very nice.
review_body:
Overall, I really liked this costume. It came with three pieces: dress, flower "belt" pin, and flower clip.

The forest green color was as pictured. It came really wrinkled, however, I used an iron without it ruining the dress at all. The straps were not sewn at the same angle, so one side kept slipping off my shoulder, but it wasn't bad. I'm on the shorter side, so the length was perfect for me. I didn't need to use a petticoat, however I was definitely glad I wore shorts underneath. The dress was very light-weight so the wind was able to pick it up very easy.

The flower "belt" was actually a huge piece with a pin to attach it to the dress. It was not really to my liking, only because the "leaves" part were not like the little ones pictures. Insteady of tiny, individual leaves, it was more like those huge (one piece on both sides) bright green glittered branches you might use for a Christmas reindeet antler craft project. It stuck out about 7" on either side. It wasn't so horrible once I wrapped it around my waist and pinned them down. However, since it was so long and brittle, it broke within an hour of my having it on. The actual flowers were a bit cheap looking, but at least they came in different hues of people, and gave the dress a nice pop of color. The glue was cheap, so the small bunch of flowers fell off. After pinning it to the dress, it left noticible pin holes.

The flower head piece was made of the same cheap flower and bright green glittered branch. It was about 6" long. I had to bobby pin it down to make the leaf/branch lay on my head like a headband.

Sure there were some issues with the accessories, however, I really like the costume as a whole. I received a lot of compliments.

review_headline: even though the Rapunzel dress was tripped on more than once (it's pretty long). Even though the bulk of the dress ...
review_body: I bought both this dress and the Belle dress from the same company for a trip to Disney.  Both held up well to getting into and out of strollers, riding on rides, etc, even though the Rapunzel dress was tripped on more than once (it's pretty long).  Even though the bulk of the dress is the same thin satiny material you find on most costume dresses, it's sewn together better than most.  What sets this company apart in my opinion is the detailing on the dresses. The silver edging is of good quality and makes the whole dress look higher quality than it is.  The skirt itself is pretty plain, but overall, it's still nice.  It's the dress my daughter wanted.  It seemed soft and my daughter didn't complain (her sister who is picker had no complaints about the Belle dress).  It appears to be true to size.  It did come pretty wrinkled.  I assumed since the material was thin, I could steam it.  No such luck.  I did have to iron the old fashion way to make it look nice and it was a pain because of the gathers in the bustle, but rolling it up in my suitcase for a few hours did not make it overly wrinkled so I didn't have to iron again.  I have machine washed it on delicate and it came out just fine.  Overall, I'm very pleased.  It's a nice dress that held up well and was comfortable for my daughter to wear.  It was much less expensive than the Disney dresses and my daughter was very happy to wear it.  I would definitely buy from this company again.

product_title: 40 Metal Collar Stays in a Clear Plastic Box - 5 Sizes
review_body:
This item is amongst the best values you can give your wardrobe for under $20 (along with a Tide stick pen, a pocket square or a simple tie bar).

Unfortunately, many of the shirts I purchase come paired with those flimsy plastic collar stays. Select bespoke shirt makers still issue metal collar stays and that is how I learned that I need not use the plastic ones that are standard issue.

The metal collar stays reviewed here do just the trick. They come in 4 different sizes (all of varying lengths, but all in the same width and thickness). Both ends are nicely rounded so as to avoid puncturing the pointed end of your shirt. For the same reason you don't want to run any collar stay through the wash or dry cleaner, I've made it a habit to remove them each evening (i.e., dont want to leave an imprint of the collar stay on the shirt).

I've found that the torsional rigidity of the collar stays is sufficient to use one as an impromptu screwdriver.

Finally, to those who are considering the Werkin' Stiffs collar stays - save your money and invest in the tiny magnets only -- these stays work with the little magnets so you can position your collar as you wish.

*I am not authorized to make any representations on behalf of the Transportation Security Administration (TSA), so I dont know it they're really \\"TSA Approved\\" (does the TSA even approve collar stays?) The point of my subject line is to convey the message that these collar stays will not set off the metal detectors at the airport.

product_title: BOB Sport Utility Stroller Single
review_headline: Excellent for walking, but not as much for 'real' running
review_body:
I am writing this review about the older model purchased in late 2008, but as far as I can tell from the pictures the stroller has not changed much. I started to use the stroller when my daughter was about one year old and used it continuously for over three years, running and walking between 20 and 60 miles per week. The stroller is great for walking, but I would not recommend it for running.

The main issue I had and still have with it, is that it is a pain in the butt to adjust the front wheel in a way that the stroller won't pull to one side. Yes, I have read the instructions, I talked to the service center, and I had it at a bike shop. A not perfectly adjusted front wheel is not that much of an issue if you use the stroller for walking or slow jogging only. However, if you occasionally like to run at 6 min/mile speeds the slightest pull to one side can be very annoying. As a comparison, I never had the issue with the Baby Jogger.

Pros:
*My daughter never complained and fell asleep in it frequently, so I assume it must be pretty comfortable.
*Great for walking, even on uneven grounds. I had it at the beach, on the snow and trails.
*Canopy gives plenty of protection against the sun and light-medium rain.

Cons:
*Hard to adjust front wheel (it annoyed me so much that I only give it 3 stars)
*Basket at the bottom looks larger than it is (I used it frequently for shopping trips but could not fit much in it)
*Not recommended for frequent runners (admittedly, it is not really meant for frequent runners).

My resume after three years of frequent use: I would highly recommend it for walking, but not for jogging. I initially chose the Bob Sport Utility over the Bob Ironman (or other 'real' jogging strollers), because I prefer to run on trails over pavement. However, jogging with a stroller is much more exhausting than jogging without a stroller and I soon limited my jogging rounds to paved roads.

A final word to users complaining about the fixed wheel. A fixed wheel makes the stroller run smoother and straighter - essential for jogging and fast walking - but it makes it harder to maneuver. It's an individual decision, whatever the user finds more important. I would not recommend the Bob Sport Utility for trips to the mall or other crowded places as it is just to bulky - an additional inexpensive umbrella stroller is a good investment.

review_headline: Gets the job done, You Get What You Pay For!
review_body: As expected, although somewhat smaller than other beanies. If you didn't know that, you might've been disappointed, but you get what you pay for. It isn't the nicest or most expensive beanie but it certainly does the job. Since I live in Las Vegas, this beanie is great because it doesn't necessarily keep me too warm, and works perfectly for me in the Spring/Fall during those intermediate 70 degree temps.  I wouldn't recommenced it if you live somewhere cold enough to get snow (something Las Vegas isn't) and are looking for a beanie to help keep you warm, because you will likely be disappointed. I've actually been wearing it over the summer too because I'm trying to grow my hair out and need something to cover up the awkward mullet, until my hair gets long enough to look good long.  It's 100% cotton, so as you might guess it breathes (which is why it works well in warmer temps). Because it's cotton, if you're trying to clean it just put in the washing machine and either put it in the dryer on low temp for not too long, or simply air dry it to avoid it shrinking. I made the mistake of drying it first time like I normally do all my other clothes and it shrunk to even smaller than it was, but fortunately stretched back out. Basically, it's a good beanie and you get what you pay for

The hood can be neatly hidden away, sizing holds true to it's description.  I don't really know a whole lot about quality among the other competitor brands, but if you're looking for a jacket that's lightweight, durable, reputable, and under $100, this is the jacket for you. review_headline: Now I Need Some Bleachers: A Fred Perry Men's Twin Tipped Polo Review
review_body:
I don't normally purchase clothing off the internet unless it's something like Levi jeans where trying it on in the store won't benefit me. I've been eying the Fred Perry polos for awhile, and Amazon had the best price especially when combined with a 20% off coupon.

The Fred Perry Twin Tipped polo, made in China from 100% cotton, is similar to the [[ASIN:B003U9V3ZY bomber tipped polo]] except the collar and armband stripes are thinner with the shirt color showing in between. Otherwise the quality and construction adhere to the same standards.

As a tall and slender guy who wears a 42R jacket, the large fits me well, even in the arms where other brands have been a little tight around the biceps. The piqué fabric is thick and a little on the course side and tends to look a bit wrinkled and the collar tends to curl after machine washing, but a quick ironing cleans it right up.

Overall, this polo shirt looks good and is comfortable to wear. If you're looking for a great looking comfortable polo, Fred Perry polos are a great option.

100% cotton
Machine washable
High quality
Good fit

CONS:
A little pricy (but worth it for me)

product_title: Resistol Men's Beaumont Hat
review_headline: Fits and feels exactly like my original Resistol Beaumont
review_body:
The first version of this hat I bought at a well known western store in Dallas, TX about 6 years ago. Since moving to Michigan, I've been afraid to wear it, because I thought I could never find another excellent hat to replace it, especially here where cowboy culture is almost nonexistent.

Finally, Resistol came back on the market with this style and I love it! Cowboy gear is my life's uniform, I've worn boots, jeans and the ubiquitous cowboy shirt most of my life and find it suits me, and this hat is no exception. The first hat I bought in Dallas was true to size, shape and fit, and has been perfect. Now, I have a replacement that's made to the same exacting standards of finery.

I love the new fur hat band, my first one had a studded leather one, which was equally masculine and refined. This new fur one is just as elegant. You can't find a better hat for the money, and the Amazon vendor I bought this hat from had the best price anywhere in the U.S.

As with all hats, your face shape, size and personal tastes all dictate how well a hat wears on your head, so each person is an individual and so is each hat. Each one has to be "fitted" to the other, so to find this hat was a perfect match unseen and untouched through e-commerce was a risk, but one I would take again with this hat. To find that this design is so precisely matched to my previous one in fit, style and branding, I would swear they were cloned.

This is not a faux hat, this is the real thing, so if you just wanna look like a dime store cowboy, get one of the cheapies, but a real cowboy wears a one just like this Resistol Beaumont.

review_headline: Could be a great product, but dies with its battery

My wife later chose to ditch her Polar monitor in favor of the new ePulse2 and loved it -- for a while.  After a couple of months, the battery refused to take a charge reliably.  I e-mailed Impact Technologies, but never got a response.  Loving my wife more than the $130 replacement, I got her a new one.  I toyed around with the swapping the batteries from the old one to the new and found that the old battery could be recharged in the new monitor, indicating that there is somethiing amiss in the circuitry, rather than the battery.  Now the new unit also is dead, and my wife is presently composing a letter (I suspect tersely worded) to accompany returning both monitors.    Perhaps we were unlucky and suffered from two strikes of lightening and got two defective samples.  Maybe your results will be better.  For us, I'm sticking with my old ePulse with the clucky AA battery compartment, and my wife is going back to her Polar.  Good luck.

product_title: Vedette Latex Waist Cincher Fajas Colombianas 102
review_body:
I purchased this to sleep in, as I'm having to modify my waist from one corset to another and it's always faster training to sleep in one's corset. It's extremely comfortable and surprisingly, long enough for my very long torso.

It also gives enough compression to redistribute the fat pads and is already defining the rib area and is strong enough to hold my floater ribs in place, preventing them from pushing back into their original positions. This is a very important thing, as my new corsets won't be completed for another couple of weeks.

The stays are not "tipped" (coated), however, and I can see that flossing will be needed, which is something to take into consideration if you plan on wearing this during any real activity. Flossing is done by simple embroidery in a chevron shape (minimal) over the ends of the stays to reinforce them and to prevent them from pushing through the fabric/latex. Detailed instructions can be found by Googling the term "corset flossing".

I highly recommend this product for anyone doing night waist training, or if you just want a sleeker look under a fitted garment.

Keep in mind, since it's latex on the outside, it smells like rubber. This may be offputting to some, especially if you're planning to wear it at a formal event. The 103 may be better for social settings but the 102 is perfect for what I needed and I realized that my husband didn't know I was wearing it under my nightgown! The latex feels like (something like) natural skin under clothing.

product_title: b.ella Style 5139, Mens Classic Rib Merino Wool Crew Socks
review_body:
This is a blend of 66% merino wool, with the rest consisting of man-made materials (mainly nylon). While it does not have that luxurious feeling of a pure or mostly merino wool sock, it lasts a lot longer.

I rate it very high in comfort, and I especially like the top ribbing that holds its shape and grip after many washings. I've had four pairs of these socks for almost five years and they are still very wearable without holes or sagging tops.

Despite the fact that they are only 66% wool, they are extremely comfortable, and even with 34% man-made fibers, these socks still breathe on the hot, humid summer days we get in Central Florida.

Personally, I think they are a tad overpriced with shipping factored in, but since mine have lasted nearly five years my opinion does not greatly diminish their value. And when mine do wear out I will definitely replace them with more.

review_body: This bag is basically everything it claims: a highly functional bag, suitable for sports and short travels, where everything has its place, from the charger of your mobile phone to your extra pair of shoes. The bag is lined with neoprene which gives it a soft, padded feel. Its pockets layout is very well thought out, and it has a number of handy features such as the retractable external drink pocket.    So why the bad review? Because they forgot what may be the most important element in such a bag: the zippers. They are thin and weak. I broke the first one when playing with my bag on the day I received it, without even straining it. I have the habit of big, sturdy zippers like those used on Freitag or DaKine bags, which give basically the impression that your bag is dependable. This is not the impression this bag gives, at all.    And it is a very important fact. I would have been willing to pay more, or to tolerate a poorer fabric, just to have decent zippers. Overall it is rather disappointing.

review_body:
I had read some reviews mentioning the strange sizing. Word of advice: order up one size. If you are between sizes, you may want to order up 2x. I always wear a S in US sizes. So, fearing it might be too tight if I went for the M, I chose L. I am glad that I did. To provide a point of reference, I stand a hair under 6 ft., 36 inch chest, 30 inch waist. A friend of mine commented on how the top looks like it was tailored to my proportions. Take that for what it's worth.

As other reviewers have mentioned, the arms on this are on the small side. They were not clingy on me, but there was definitely not any extra material flapping around. The waist was spot-on, as was the chest. The length, surprisingly, was long enough to cover my torso and hit a tad below hip line. I usually have a rough time finding shirts with the right torso length and sleeve length. Both fit perfectly. I am very pleased with this purchase (for now). Let's see how happy I am post-washing. :-)

It's important to mention that the material on mine was well stitched. Some others have been displeased with the quality of their garments. I'm not sure what may have happened to their products, but mine was well made. Its quality was comparable to any mainline US clothing brand (Gap, AE, and so forth). I will be purchasing more items from this company.

product_title: Wizard Of Oz Cowardly Lion Costume
review_headline: Worked in a pinch, but definitely could be way better!
review_body:
Every year, I dress my family in a theme for Halloween. This year we are going as Wizard of Oz. I am very picky, so I always search way ahead of time for the best looking and highest end costumes I can find. I had one HECK of a time finding my husband a lion costume. I must have searched every costume website during the past year, unfortunately I found there just really aren't any decent choices.
I could tell from the photos that this was not going to be awesome, and I was right.
It looks cheap and flimsy and it is. The mane is thin and flimsy- just goofy looking. My husband is not tall (between 5'8-5'9) muscular build, and it was rather small on him. Usually I have to worry about costumes fitting his broad shoulders, but never in length- this costume was short in the crotch area for him- to the point of being uncomfortable. I asked if he wanted me to take it to the tailor, he didn't want to hassle it since he didn't feel it was worth it for this costume. He just decided to \\"deal with it for one night.\\" Most of our costumes, we look forward to knowing that we might wear them again someday, but I know he will be glad to see one in his rear view mirror.
When in a group he looked great (completing our theme) but sadly standing alone not so much- his costume- not him :) I think he felt a little dorky in it too, since he didn't like the quality. Luckily he is a great sport with a good sense of humor!
Our little ones were Dorothy and the Tin Man, I was a scarecrow so this did the trick in the pinch. We still received a great reaction with lots of compliments on our theme and we had a lot of fun.
I would definitely not recommend this unless you are completing a couples or family/group look, in which case there just aren't any good options.

product_title: Womens Active Multi Sports Support Sports Bra
review_headline: No bounce but beware of sizing differences
review_body:
I bought this particular model of sports bra on eBay a while back, when I was still 34D. I ordered according to that size, and it was not even close.
When I first tried it on, I could not even put it on without a major struggle, and the cups were way too small. The label on the bra clearly said 34D but it was an UK 34D (/EUR 75D/FR 90D), which seems to be a full cup smaller than the US 34D. So, unable to use the bra, I put it away until now. I lost 20 lbs, and a full bra cup to go with it... I am now a 34C, and now the bra fits perfectly.

About the bra's performance: it is truly a no-bounce (for me) bra, and I use it for my workouts, elliptical, and jogging. I wish the straps were padded (they are not at all!) the same way the hook and eye closure in the back is. Also, for the ladies with more pronounced nipples: there is no padding whatsoever to prevent \\"headlights\\"! I suppose, we could try pasties, but I normally wear this bra under a tank, or a tee. Other than that, I like this bra. It washes well and dries quickly.

If you are contemplating buying this particular bra for your sporty adventures, see if you can find it at the store and try it on first. It might save you the hassle of returns due to sizing difference.

product_title: Champion Women's Absolute Workout Capri Legging
review_headline: I sound like a paid reviewer!
review_body:
So I have GAP body capris, lulelemon capris and some other FILA and NIKE capris that I got from TJMAXX and Marshalls etc. I bought these capris on a whim after reading all the good reviews. But man those reviews were right! These Champion Capris are by FAR my favorite Capris! I don't know whats different about these versus the champion capris I see at Target but definitely something different. Here are the reasons I love these:

(1) these capris don't give me camel toe- they provide great coverage but dont accentuate the crotch area.
(2) they don't slowwwly slide down when I run
(3) they are just the right shiny, I don't like flat back- I like a bit of shiny in my work out capris or they start looking very old after only washing them a few times
(4) they hit just at the right level in my waist line and tuck in all the unsightly bits.
(5) they are fabulously priced

As I am writing this review I have decided I shall get some more! Get them if you are on the fence.

Based on the reviews, I was envisioning an actual \\"hive\\" of hair; the wig I received is more of a larger pompadour with the hair pinned in the back. Another issue that I noticed in the beehive is that some of the hair isn't quite long enough to stay pinned, therefore, pieces of it fell forward when I initially tried on the wig. Nothing a few extra bobby pins and some hairspray didn't fix! Other than that, the wig is awesome and was such a good purchase for the small amount that I paid. product_title: Shock Absorber Women's Active D+ Classc Support Sports Bra
review_headline: This does exactly what it says, I use this to run!!!
review_body:
I began my weight-loss journey a few months ago and while I have always been fairly active (I have been doing spin, yoga, TRX, Ballet Burn, Walking, Tae Bo, Hip Hop Abs, ect) I always stayed away from running because I thought my breasts were too large to find a supportive bra. Well when I began my running challenge (about 9 weeks ago) I wore a 34H/HH and I got this bra and I was so impressed. I won't lie it took a little bit of time to get into but I think that is mainly because there is no stretch. Meaning you have to physically place the girls where you want them to be.

Well after 6 weeks of running and 28 pounds down (it was a beginner's program so at that point we were alternating running with walking) I have went down a few cups already. I am down wearing a snug 32FF (I got it a bit snug so it can last me a little longer as I lose some more.)Now I must admit it is much easier getting into the smaller 32FF much more like a regular bra. But I still am getting great support and no BOUNCE. ZERO! This hands down is the best sports bra and I highly recommend it to all women who have D cups or more. It's comfortable, separates, lifts, and doesn't have an under-wire...I don't know what else you could want...Oh, it's under 50 bucks!

Wins all around the way I say!

product_title: Bravado! Designs Women's Body Silk Seamless Nursing Bra
review_body:
I am a bra snob, and cheap. Those two things don't go well together. However, after reading reviews, I did one of the stupidest things you can do: I bought a bra online, without ever trying it on.

It. Is. Awesome. It doesn't cut into me! It doesn't feel like I'm binding up The Girls over the course of the day. (Seriously, is any nursing mother the same size at night as in the morning?) Use the fit guide on the Bravado site to make sure you get the right size, and go for it. (I wear a 36DD, and ordered a medium. It's perfect.)

The only odd thing about the bra is the (removable) foam inserts. They are there to hide any evidence of nursing pads/stiff nipples, I guess, but the insert was too flat for my shape, and ended up just looking like a really, really large nursing pad that showed through my shirt. Weird. The edges of the insert didn't lay flat against me.

The packing slip it came with gave me a 10% off code for my next purchase from the shipping company..I'm going to order another one!

(Oh, and Bravado, can I make a suggestion?? A pure white option would be just icing on the cake. Ivory is as close as I could get, and that's ok...but white would be better.)

Recap:
PROS: Stretchy, comfortable, supportive. (Husband corroborated: \\"They look higher!\\")
CONS: Doesn't come in white, weird foam inserts, and I think re-doing the clips after nursing will be a two handed job.

product_title: The Wolfman Movie Snarling Face Men's T-shirt, Black
review_body:
I've been a fan of the Wolfman since I first laid eyes on the 1941 Lon Chaney portrayal of the beast. He's one of the few classic Universal Monsters who has no exact basis in literature as does Dracula and Frankenstein's Monster. When I learned that Universal was remaking the classic 1941 tale, I was fearful that they would destroy the legacy of the creature.

Benicio del Toro was selected to portray Lawrence Talbot in the new version, and I was actually very pleased with him as a choice. While I have mixed feelings about the remake overall, I was very pleased with the fact that make-up master Rick Baker stayed true to Lon Chaney's version of the beast instead of making him a full-on wolf.

When I saw this t-shirt featuring the updated Wolfman in all of his snarling glory, I had to get it.

On this t-shirt, we get a wonderful headshot of del Toro in full Wolfman make-up. He's growling at you like the big bad daddy that he is and the film's title is place across his forehead (but not in a distracting way). The picture is tinted a darkish tan color that hearkens back to the old days of cinema, adding to the overall \\"cool factor\\" of this tee.

If you're a fan of the classic 1941 \\"The Wolf Man\\" or of the 2010 released remake, \\"The Wolfman,\\" you can't go wrong owning this shirt. It's sure to attract a few looks from folks who are more accustomed to seeing their \\"werewolf\\" as Taylor Lautner with his shirt missing. This is the real Wolf Man kiddies, empasis on the \\"Man!\\"

product_title: FULL TILT Essential Urban Womens Hoodie
review_body:
I just received this item today. The fabric is very, very thin, you can basically see right through it. Not when you wear it, but when you hold it ut to the light. Nothing for cold weather, that's for sure! The v-neck on this shirt is cut extremely low; not just for my standard, but for any low cut shirt out there. It is LOW. It didn't look that low to me, from looking at the picture. So I was surprised.
If you study the picture carefully, you'll see that there are several seams where the material is cut on the outside of the seam, which looks cool, and unraveling shouldn't be a problem since there is in fact a seam there to stop it. BUT, on the sides of the pocket (where it angles), the material has simply been cut and not finished in any way; there is no seam to stop the fabric from unraveling. And it WILL, I tested it by pulling a little bit on it, and it will unravel quite quickly looks like. It cannot possibly hold up for long. This is hard to see from looking at the picture.
Positives: The color, Magenta, is a little bit more purple than expected, but looks pretty good. The shape of it looks fine, fairly form fitting and stretchy. Feels pretty comfortable to wear. The looks of the material (other than being so thin) matches the picture pretty well, and looks good.
This was going to be a gift, but it feels too cheap for me to be comfortable with that, plus I could never encourage an item that shows so much of a girl's chest that she's barely dressed.
I decided I would return it, but then discovered that since it was on sale, Tilly will only give a gift card or do an exchange. There is nothing else I want from that store, and after paying to ship it back to them plus shipping for new item, there won't be hardly any money left. What a waste of money! I don't know yet what Amazon's policy is on this. I have good experiences from Amazon, but will not be purchasing from Tilly again.

product_title: Carefix Women's "Bella" Front Closure Comfort Sleep Bra
review_headline: a good option, but a few flaws
review_body:
I decided to go with carefix because that was what I was given in the hospital following a double mastectomy with reconstruction direct to implant. However they gave me the "Mary" design. I wish I had ordered that instead of the Bella. The Bella is fairly comfortable (as some have noted there are some issues with the stitching), but the Mary is a bit more substantial and has side pockets for a breast form. This is a great place to add extra padding right after surgery. I also put padding I them after the drains were removed to help absorb additional leakage.

If you still have drains I recommend the cami made by aomena. They have pockets on the inside that drains can be put in. I would even wear mine just that to go on walks around the block before my drains were removed.

I am now considering ordering another Mary style Carefix because I am really happy with it and continue to wear it at night to help keep swelling down now that I am a month out of surgery. Another advantage of the Mary over the Bella are the upper straps. You can completely undo them which makes applying lotion or ointment possible without having to remove the entire bra. This is a plus when you have limited mobility. So while the Bella is a good bra the Mary is my first choice, despite the substantially higher price.

review_body:
I have been looking for a front pocket wallet and finally found one that fits the "bill". The wallet itself is a darker brown than what is shown almost black-brown color, which is what I prefer. The length of the wallet is a barely a little bit longer than a credit card, which I really like because the cards fit in it perfectly.

Pros: (1) There is a clear view slip to put one's ID - without having to take out the ID. You can put other cards behind your ID. I put a credit card and few business cards and it's a good snug fit. The Id or cards do not fall out. (2) There are 3 slits to put your credit cards or whatever cards you want. There is opening along this area where you can put in money or more credit cards. However, I bought this wallet to downsize on credit cards. (3) There are also 2 opening on the top of the wallet where you can folded money in it or a receipt if you like.

Overall, a very ingenious design to have a lot of openings. And it's very compact.

This product did NOT qualify for free shipping from Amazon Prime, but for $10.00 including shipping and tax it was worth it.

Price; color; function; that's why 5 stars.

product_title: Aero Tech Designs Padded Bicycling Underwear
review_body:
I bought these liner shorts to wear while mountain biking and bike touring. I'll compare these liners to the [[ASIN:B00ACH3SOQ Pearl Izumi Men's Liner Shorts]] which I also purchased here on Amazon. The Aero Tech liners have a thinner chamois pad than the Pearl Izumi (PI) liners and other regular cycling shorts I own. It's about 1/4\\" at its thickest and appears to have small holes all throughout the foam pad, probably for better ventilation. New cyclists might prefer a thicker chamois pad, but experienced cyclists who have \\"hardened\\" their butt should be fine. And if you don't want to feel like you're wearing a diaper, the thinner chamois will be a bonus. I'm about 5'9\\" and 160 lbs and the medium fits well.

I've only used these liners once so far on a two hour ride, but I think they'll be comfortable enough for all day rides. One aspect of these liners that is better than the PI liners is that the back of the waistband is a little higher. The PI liners feel a little low and I'm worried I might have some exposed skin on my lower back if I wear a short shirt. Cycling shorts should have a slightly taller waistband in the back and I'm disappointed the PI liners are a little low.

Both the Aero Tech and PI liners do not have silicon or rubber \\"grabbers\\" inside the leg elastic bands. This causes the legs to ride up a little more than with typical stretchy cycling shorts (the kind road riders wear). But since you'll be wearing these liners under shorts or pants, this shouldn't be a problem for either brand. I didn't notice any discomfort from this although I did occasionally pull down the legs with both brands.

The only negative I can say about the Aero Tech liners is that edge of the chamois pad isn't quite as clean cut as the PI liners, but the sewing seems to be adequate. If any problems arise after long-term use I'll update this review.

product_title: Saddleback Leather Card Sleeve Wallet - 100 Year Warranty
review_body: Picked this up as I was looking for a slim alternative to the fat back pocket Dockers wallet I had been carrying for 2 years.  First, the quality of this piece is amazing. It's ONE small piece of top of the line full grain leather that is folded over on itself and stitched into a sleeve with heavy duty double zero (ie thick) thread.  The result is a basic but extremely tough little sleeve wallet with one pocket for credit cards and cash.  At first the leather was VERY stiff (all saddleback products start this way, they leave it up to you to break them in) which kind of put me off but I've been using it for nearly a month now and the leather has really nicely loosened up to fit more in the sleeve.  Initially I could only slide 3 cards (ID + ATM + credit) into it without any cash but 4 weeks later the leather has now relaxed to the point I now have 5 cards in there + 5 bills folder over in two and its all secure and slides in and out nicely without a problem.  There's a little slot on the bottom of the sleeve that lets you push up the cards and cash (this is how you get all the cards/cash out). There's no plastic here, no cloth or zipper, just one piece of high quality leather sewn together with heavy duty stitching.  There is nothing that will fail in the years to come.  I got mine in chestnut and it's toning a bit more each day as the oils on my skin rub onto the leather, I absolutely love it.  If you are like me and are looking for a wallet that will just let you carry your ID, a few cards and a few bills of cash this is it. I love just sliding it into my front pocket and walking out the door.  One thing to note though is that this wallet will not work for you if you need to carry a lot of cash as I have to crease my bills with 2 folds to get the the bills in (doesn't work with just one fold).  Also, if you're worried about not having a dedicated ID slot, I made up for the lack of a dedicated ID slot by just placing my ID in between the credit cards in the wallet to keep it even more protected.  Before my purchase I agonized between getting this wallet and the \\"ID wallet\\" that saddleback also offers but went with this one because though that one has a separate pocket for the ID, it leaves your ID uncovered and I was worried it'd be exposed to scratches. In this sleeve it's all protected. The only trade off is not having the separate card slots the way you do in a traditional wallet but for me at least its just helps me keep it simple and only carry what's absolutely necessary.  This piece was my gateway drug piece into Saddleback, I was so taken back by the quality of the leather and craftsmanship that I checked out their website and ended up ordering a satchel bag + a few other pieces in the month following the purchase. All their stuff is pricey but so worth it if you love real, truly high quality leather. I couldn't be happier with this purchase, it's a steal at this price for all the years you'll be able to get out of this piece.  Whether you get it as your sleeve wallet or just to hold some business cards, you won't be disappointed.

product_title: Charades Women's Lacey Ladies Costume Hat, Black, One Size
review_headline: Not your run~of~the~mill halloween costume accessory. Worth the money to get 'better than usual' quality costume/theatre piece.
review_body:
Arrived about three days earlier than expected, and packed well. Not crushed or misshapen.

'Peak' at front is stitched to bottom of brim to hold the shape w/o wires. I plan on removing the lace and bows, and possibly the gold trim in order to modify this for a semi~historic pirate cosplay, and it will be easy to do that if you've got some decent sewing skill. The bows and the 'peak' are both whip stitched, but not poorly, so it's ideal for removing or keeping them attached. The 'peak' stitching will have to be cut if you wanted to add more lace w/o losing your mind, but could easily be re~attached to the brim, and it would be possible to hide a thin wire beneath the new lace to shape the front w/o stitching the peak back down. I feel confident that this hat will hold up to what I'll be adding, since the material is thick.

The lace and trim are both sewn all the way around ~ the trim on the outside, the lace on the inside, with black thread that disappears into the hat. There is a pair of feathers tucked into one side that can easily be visible with some adjustment.
The cap of the hat is deep enough to accommodate my 22" diameter head, and there's enough space to also accommodate the 'straight hair' wig I'll be wearing underneath. The brim in the back actually comes down as far as it does in the picture, and the velvet looks good.

I spent at least 2 hours looking at every pirate hat available on Amazon, and this is the one I felt was the best value/quality for the price for something that looks reasonably authentic. Pay the extra $10 or so bucks for this one, it's worth it, especially considering the original listed price.

I bought these for when I have to walk and wait at the bus stop. I am usually listening podcasts with earbuds, and I was worried at first that these ear warmers would apply too much pressure to my ears. This turns out not to be the case, and I can wear earbuds (and glasses) comfortably, while keeping my ears warm and hair intact.

The ear warmers seem to block wind well, and they twist into a mini-hamburger shape that fits into my coat pocket nicely.

They are adjustable--the part that goes around the back of the head has a sort of plastic stretching mechanism. My only complaint is that it feels like the ear parts are always pulling back a little bit on my ears by trying to unstretch. This slight tightness isn't really a problem--the ear warmers stay on, but my mind often thinks that they are sliding off my head.

Overall, if you want to keep your head from getting hat hair while keeping your ears from freezing off, these ear warmers are a great buy.

product_title: Star Wars Deluxe Hooded Jedi Robe Costume
review_body:
Considering the Star Wars name jacks up the price of anything sold using it, this robe is OK for casual use. The material is rather thin and rough, probably not meant to represent formal Jedi wear. You'll want to trim off some thread ends hanging from some seams. Deluxe is not a word I'd use to describe this robe, unless, to paraphrase Arthur Dent in \\"Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy, \\"Ah, this is obviously some strange usage of the word deluxe that I wasn't previously aware of.\\"

If I really was expecting deluxe, I'd probably be making a trip to the post office now to return this and this would be at best a two-star review. But I'm using it for a costume for the character Rincewind from Discworld (Sorry, Obi Wan). Non-deluxe fits my needs. Strictly speaking it should be red, but the modified Harry Potter Sorting Hat that is going with the robe is also brown. I have removed some patches from the hat to put on the robe. Before the robe arrived, I was thinking of adding some nice trim, but given the plainness of it, trim would be overkill.

If you really want a deluxe robe, you'll probably have better luck with the Adult Authentic Jedi Robe from Rubie's Costume Co. also sold here by 7th Avenue Store. It's twice the price, but it's probably much better according to reviews for it.

This review is not meant to reflect badly on the seller, 7th Avenue Store. Their shipping was quite prompt, with the item arriving on the first day of Amazon's delivery estimate.

review_body:

In addition, the straps of the apron were clearly sewn on backwards.  The neck hole in the white collar is approximately 4" in diameter.  If you are 4' 8" or less with a very small neck and long arms then this will be perfect for you.  I gave it two stars instead of one because the fabric is actually much better quality than many costumes.  They just need to work on improving sizing and workmanship.
