review_headline: the fit variations are not Amazon's fault, buy these at a store
review_body: I've been shopping Amazon since before they were set up to take online payments, so I know they sell quality itmes & have a great return policy.  I would give these jeans 5 stars, but as others have stated, the sizing & even the styling vary greatly.  I have about 5 pair I bought in local stores (Tractor Supply, Beall's, Academy) & each is different.  I usually wear an 8 short but with these jeans you can't go by the size marked.  I have some 8 medium, 8 short, & 10 short.  The waist size is close on each pair, some are slightly tight & some are looser.  My waist varies, unfortunately, so I have kept them all.  My height doesn't vary, fortunately, so I bought jeans that fit, whether marked medium or short.  The darker ones do seem a little tighter.  There is some variation in the bagginess of the legs, too.  Also, there are 2 different style labels.  Most of my jeans are made in Mexico & one was made in Cambodia.  I can't see any consistency among the sources or the label styles.  My advice - do as I do.  Button your favorite pair of jeans & measure from one side to the other.  Take a tape measure with you to a store & measure the waists of several pairs, including sizes smaller & larger that you would usually wear to find jeans that will fit you.  I just eyeball the length because I don't mind a little difference there as long as they aren't too short.  You might try the 525 or 526 styles since the waist control stretchiness accommodates tummy variations.  I only have one pair of the 526, so I can't testify as to their consistency, but I'm likely to try ordering a pair from Amazon after buying them at a local store recently.

product_title: ROTHCO MILITARY WEB BELTS / 64"
review_headline: Good for the price, but one flaw
review_body:
The belt arrived timely and as advertised. It's decent quality, a little thinner but stiffer material than other belts I have of this kind, but seems like it should hold up fine. The buckle seems decent quality and holds the belt snugly (though I've only worn it two days so far).

My only complaint, and the reason I downgraded it 1 star, is that there's no metal tab on the non-buckle end. Other comparable belts have a metal tab (that matches the buckle) on the non-buckle end of the belt, so after you cut it to size the material won't fray. Typically the tab overlaps the belt end by 1/4\\" or so, and you can pry it off or squeeze it on to keep the end from fraying. You can see what I'm talking about by looking at similar belts on Amazon, in photos of the non-buckle end. This product photo didn't show that end so I wasn't aware the clip isn't there. It's no big deal -- I'll probably put a dab of glue on the end to keep the stitching tight -- but I would have preferred to have the tab.

Otherwise the belt seems fine and a decent value at that price.

review_body: I've been wearing these style of underwear for at least 8 years now.  Pricey, yes, but do they \\"hold me in place\\" in all the right places with comfort, YES!  I've tried other brands and styles, but nothing comes close to these (really just a waste of money).  I think it really has to do with the \\"pouch\\" as I've come to call it.  The other brands and styles always left the most important part of my body pressed up in weird angles and such.  I was constantly having to \\"rewire the plumbing\\" so to speak. One thing I will say is that leg holes kinda ride up on you a bit after sitting behind a desk for several hours (this is why I switched to the trunks rather than the brief...but also because I found them more comfortable).  But on the flip side of that, all the other brands and styles I tried did the same.  Perhaps its because I shift around in my seat quite a bit when I'm working, idk.  One thing I will point out is I believe these guys run a bit on the small side when you look at the sizing chart.  I'm a 34 waist, 175 lbs and about 6'1\\" so I always bought the Med size after reading the sizing chart.  After the first wash/dry they noticeably shrink down.  On a whim I bought a Large size just to try and I find that these fit perfect!  So only large for me now on.   Calvin Klein has a sale on these guys every year right after Xmas and I believe up to NYE, so stock up then, that's what I always do.  Do yourself a favor, give these guys a try and you'll never look back.  If anyone reading this had similar problems as me being comfortable all day and has found something better after trying these, the please, please, add a comment and let me know and I'll give them the Pepsi Cola challenge.

As for the problem of the side elastic waist pinching on these shorts, I carefully adjust the side elastic, on both sides of shorts, by snipping, with scissors, the seam where the side elastic meets the solid waistband.  Then I sew in a 1\\" wide piece of black heavy elastic band, when finished it looks like a black elastic \\"V\\" in both sides of the shorts' elastic waist.  This solves the problem of my sides feeling \\"pinched\\" and gives me the ease in the waist I need to be active in life. product_title: Anita Maternity Women's Soft Cup Nursing Bra #5062
review_body:
This bra was a suggestion from my sister to me. She used it and then me and I am gonna pass this suggestion to my little sister too. This bra not only fits well but the added wide shoulder straps give you a comfort I cannot describe. Trust me on this.... when you have heavy milky boobs,you obviously cannot rely on your already painful shoulder joints and already achy upper back from breastfeeding nights n days. What you really want is a bra that supports! Its light on the shoulders and nice and easy on your skin too.
The material is a little thin so you might wanna add some beast pads as you dont wish to show off you nips. so this is one con and the reason i take away one star!!
It does gets a little loose when you wear.... normal wear n tear i believe! For those who want a tight fit on the upper back and loose on the cups, this might not be the best bra....and I think when you are nursing you don't wish to wear tight fitting stuff!!
So this bra worked out pretty well for me and for my sis... I would recommend it to every other mom-to-be :)
I am also using the motherhood maternity bra ...
http://www.amazon.com/Motherhood-Maternity-Underwire-Coverage-Nursing/dp/B004ZXHZUG/ref=sr_1_3?ie=UTF8&qid=1368051475&sr=8-3&keywords=motherhood+maternity+nursing+bra
This one works well when I dress up a bit and I dont want to wear something loose on the breast itself! Just for the dress' sake. I dont wish to end up wearing a nice dress if the shape does not come out well.

review_body:
I waited almost a year to post this review to see if my initial conclusion was correct. Essentially it was. The bottom line is the Polo Ralph Lauren French Rib pants fit and feel the best of any pants. Unfortunately, they’re expensive and not available on Amazon. However, there are some pairs available on auction sites for reasonable prices. The next best is between the U.S. Polo Assn. Men's Fleece Cargo Pant and the Champion Men's Champion Eco Open Bottom Pant. The problem with the U.S. Polo Assn. Men's Fleece Cargo is that they pill a lot and because they’re made of nylon they don’t breathe well if at all. The problem with the Champion is they’re a bit long, a bit baggy and the waist is a bit big. The rest of them aren’t even worth trying. I’m looking forward to some affordable, high quality, great fitting sweat pants. Unfortunately, they don’t exist at the moment. Interesting note, I initially bought all the pants in size large, but they all seemed to fit a bit too tight not only in the waist but throughout the whole let as well. I like my sweatpants loose fitting so I reordered them all in XL and made my conclusions based on that.

Polo Ralph Lauren French Rib
They are 100% cotton, which is extremely hard to find. They may be the heaviest of all the pants (not necessarily good or bad), the most naturally soft (cotton soft compared to nylon “fleece” soft), and the best fit (loose, but not too loose, definitely not tight) throughout the waist and legs, and a good length (long enough that you may walk on the back of them when you’re not wearing shoes). The inseam is very low however. That is the one thing I would change. I’d raise the inseam up by 2 inches.

U.S. Polo Assn. Men's Fleece Cargo Pant, Black, Large
NOT AFFILIATED WITH POLO RALPH LAUREN CORP.
[[ASIN:B00CXMY89M U.S. Polo Assn. Men's Fleece Cargo Pant]]
Nice fitting pants, but they’re 100% nylon “fleece” which have pilled horribly over a year and static cling often. Also, nylon pants don’t breathe well and cause an uncomfortable and unnecessary sweat.

U.S. Polo Assn. Men's Classic Fleece Pant, Dark Grey Heather, Large
NOT AFFILIATED WITH POLO RALPH LAUREN CORP.
[[ASIN:B00CXMY86U U.S. Polo Assn. Men's Classic Fleece Pant]]
Compared to the cargo version of these they fit much tighter.

Champion Men's Champion Eco Open Bottom Pant, Oxford Gray, Large
[[ASIN:B005FOCNSS Champion Men's Champion Eco Open Bottom Pant]]
A bit too long and a bit too loose in the waist.

Champion Men's Champion Eco Relaxed Band Pant, Oxford Gray, Large
[[ASIN:B005FOCNRO Champion Men's Champion Eco Relaxed Band Pant]]
Tighter than the open bottom version and I dislike the band at the bottom of the leg.

Jerzees 974MP 8 oz. 50/50 Open Bottom Fleece Pant-Large-Oxford
[[ASIN:B003H8TM6U NuBlend Open Bottom Sweatpant with Pocket]]
I kept these. They are a nice loose fit, but the material hasn’t held up as well as the Champion.

Russell Athletic Men's Athletic Open-Bottom Pant, Black Heather, Large
[[ASIN:B000M9N0LA Russell Athletic Men's Cotton Performance Open Bottom Pant]]
These are very light pants. In fact, I kept them because they were so light. The size large fits like an XL compared to all the other pants. I rarely wear these because they’re so light.

Russell Athletic Men's Heavyweight Fleece Open-Bottom Pant - CD1 - L
[[ASIN:B00FFBG4S6 Russell Athletic Men's Heavyweight Fleece Open-Bottom Pant]]
The waist band of even the XXL is unbelievable tight. This must be a design flaw. It’s unfortunate too because the material was nice and heavy.

Russell Athletic Men's Dri-Power Open Bottom Fleece Pocket Pant, Black Heather, Large
[[ASIN:B000U6AF1S Russell Athletic Men's Dr-Power Fleece Open Bottom Pocket Pant]]
These fit tight compared to the others. The inseam is higher up as well. Also, it’s an odd feeling material that I don’t care for.

Fruit of the Loom 8 oz 50/50 Adult Open Bottom Sweatpants in Athletic Heather – Large
[[ASIN:B005L3NVVG Fruit of the Loom 51300R 50/50 Fleece Pant with Mesh Pockets]]
These also fit tight compared to the others. The pockets were oddly short. In person you can tell they’re low quality.t’s an odd feeling material that I don’t care for.

Fruit of the Loom 8 oz 50/50 Adult Open Bottom Sweatpants in Athletic Heather – Large
[[ASIN:B005L3NVVG Fruit of the Loom 51300R 50/50 Fleece Pant with Mesh Pockets]]
These also fit tight compared to the others. The pockets were oddly short. In person you can tell they’re low quality.

review_body:
This is my first pea coat, and I have to admit that I'm quite pleased.

The overall quality of the jacket is high; strong, double-stitched seams and thick buttons that don't feel \\"plastic-e\\" are great features that show this coat is made to be worn, not just admired. The cashmere is fine and soft, if a little thin, but not objectionably so. If anything, it's probably a matter of personnel taste, but now that I've worn it a few times, I think I prefer this jacket to other cashmeres I've worn that were a little thicker.

I bought a 46, and like most jackets, it \\"belled\\" around the waist. Definitely not a knock against, but definitely a plus if you need a little extra room. When I took it in to my favorite Asian lady, she was able to adjust it pretty quickly due to what she called \\"friendly\\" seams so it only cost me $30 for the alteration, which is pretty darn cheap.

As far as I can tell, there's no downside to this coat. Especially the price! I would have paid $400 for this, no questions asked!

Bottom Line: Highly recommended, wear right out of the box!

It could definitely use a lot more structure at the bottom of the cups since there is no wire. The bra fits VERY high up on the chest, so I can't wear it with many of my tops without some creative taping/pinning. (I do not wear low cut, revealing tops and I still have problems with it, so if you DO wear low cut tops, this is not the bra for you.) Wearing it with anything but a frumpy men's T-shirt is almost impossible.

But my biggest complaint is the seam running across each boob. Why is there a seam in the most obvious place? It shows through EVERYTHING. And since the material of the cups are so flimsy and unsupported, the seam puckers terribly, which...as my gay BFF so bluntly informed me the second he saw me..."makes it look like you have a row of 8 nipples on each boob."

This is a very VERY unflattering bra that definitely won't make you feel sexy OR functional. Don't waste your money.

product_title: Original V for Vendetta Mask
review_body:
Death came to me that night drinking a glass of [[ASIN:B00032G1S0 Tuscan Whole Milk, 1 Gallon, 128 fl oz]] and taunting me with visions of my parents' death at the hands of the No-armed man. I twisted and turned in bed all night with fevered dreams plaguing my worried soul. Another year had passed since our encounter at the Castle in the artic tundra of Greenland where I had followed the woman in the [[ASIN:B003G4IM4S Accoutrements Horse Head Mask]] without bringing me any closer to finding the No-armed man. The faces of my parents, my wife, my ex-wife, John W. Trimmer, and my dog Skippy all faded in and out of the darkest recesses of my tortured brain.

I startled awake in a cold sweat. My sheets were soaked, thankfully, only in sweat. My heart pounded like the beat of an African drum in the Mojave dessert, calling to arms a nation of Spartan soldiers ready to do battle. In my hand I gripped the [[ASIN:B001DZTJRQ Wenger 16999 Giant Swiss Army Knife]] I had taken from the No-armed man at the Castle. I looked over at my bedside where I saw my copy of [[ASIN:0870334336 How to Avoid Huge Ships]] sitting on top of my copy of the King James Bible. But on top of both gripping tales of fiction, sat the letter from my ex-wife that came with the tin of [[ASIN:B000796XXM Uranium Ore]] she sent to me via Fed Ex. Maybe here I would find the clue I desperately needed? How could I use this to find the No-armed man, as she had instructed me in the letter. And why was it signed and dated a year after her murder? Little did I know both questions were about to be answered for my eye was drawn to my desk in the corner, where propped up was a V For Vendetta Mask.

The same mask I wore to a party with my ex-wife on October 2nd, 1987. The day before she died! I knew where I had to go now! I packed my bags, I was heading to Johanngeorgenstadt, Germany.

product_title: Geier Glove Men's Bison Leather Gloves
review_body: Great gloves and very durable, but size varies. I initially bought a size 8 (despite the warning on the website), and I felt like OJ at his trial. No, the glove did not fit. Luckily they fit my wife perfectly, so she became the proud owner of some fantastic work gloves. The website states that sizes 8 and lower should be sized up one size, and sizes 10 1/2 and up should be sized down a half size. What that tells me is that if you are between a size 9-10, you are good to go. But if a size 8 is really sized as size 9, then what is the size 9 sized for? Your guess is as good as mine as to what size to get.    I did re-order one size up and they fit well, but the color of the size 9 was completely different than the size 8. They were so different that I had to check to be sure I was sent the right gloves. Either way, the new gloves have been holding up well, and much better than my prior Chinese made $20 cowhide gloves which were never comfortable and came apart quickly.    These gloves are certainly well made, and made in the U.S.A. They were comfortable and soft right from the start. They exude quality and even the guy at the lumber yard took notice when I pulled them out of the truck to load up some lumber. They are not cheap, but I would rather buy one pair now that will last me a long time, or buy several Chinese made gloves over time that will have to be constantly replaced. It was an easy choice for me.      Two Year Update - Just over two years in and I'm now looking to replace these. My thoughts haven't changed, but the gloves have not held up as I have worn holes in two of the finger tips. All of the seams have held up which are usually the first to go on gloves. I wish they lasted longer but I am pretty hard on gloves, so not knocking the quality. Now I'm on the fence between buying another pair, or trying out Midwest gloves (a bit cheaper price).

product_title: Landing Leathers Men's Air Force A-2 Flight Leather Bomber Jacket
review_body:

This is a beautiful jacket! I'm 6 foot 5 and half at 220 pounds. I ordered the size XL Tall and it fits me like a glove! This is a very fine jacket made in the style of the proud pilots and airmen of the Army Air Force of WWII. I'm proud to display the heritage and the wings and American flag in the inside is a wonderful touch! The inside of the pockets is a fleece material to keep your hands warm. The jacket's inside cotton lining is another plus! The ONLY (and I say only) thing that gives me pause is the acrylic cuffs and waistband. That material will pill up and wear rather quickly. The wool or cotton blend cuffs would have made it more rugged.

That is the only reason I did not give it 5 stars. The verdict? This is a great leather A-2 flight jacket and I give it a thumbs up! If you want a nice WWII fly boy look for Spring, Fall, and maybe a bit into winter and summer, GET THIS JACKET!!

The new leather smell is quite strong, but that is new leather for you. It's supposed to smell like that.

GREAT JACKET, buy it before they are gone and you kick yourself later for missing out on this deal! :)

product_title: Ogon Designs Blue Aluminum Metal Credit Card Case Wallet
review_headline: For those who like to be different
review_body:
I like this wallet. One neat trick is that if you open it and set it down on a hard surface, it'll stand there with your cards fanned out for easy retrieval and replacement.

I've had mine for several months now, and it's holding up well. I was concerned that the latch would wear out, but that hasn't happened. It has gotten a few scratches from being in my pocket with my keys.

You should be aware that you can't carry as much in it as you can in a fat leather wallet. Money has to be folded into quarters to fit. And if you drop this wallet on a hard surface, the contents will scatter.

Still, I like this wallet for it's small size, sleekness and refusal to absorb sweat and odors.

Update: Be sure you are getting a genuine Ogon and not a knock-off. Mine is about three years old now. The clasp is still as firm as the first time I used it. I've dropped this wallet, overstuffed it and generally abused it and it has held up well. Much of the finish has worn off from scraping against my car keys, but otherwise this wallet's been great.

review_headline: Cute idea for a costume, but not well executed.

While the price of this costume was excellent, and the service I received in receiving the item was fantastic, unfortunately, the quality is lacking.

The idea of a retro stewardess costume is fun idea--however, the fabric is extremely lightweight and limp, and the hem isn't finished: it's simply cut off at the bottom. The fabric is so lightweight to be nearly see-through. I could have still used the dress, but I would have worn it with a khaki skirt instead of as a dress.

Additionally, on the outfit I received, the flight wing emblem appears to have been re-glued to the uniform--and there is glue residue on the front of the uniform as well.

The flight cap was totally crushed, but a little bit of pressing did help retain its shape a bit. The scarf adds quite a bit to the look. I did find the sizing to be accurate as well. Keep in mind that there are no boots or gloves included with this outfit.

I don't think I'd recommend purchasing this outfit--I wouldn't purchase it again, though the idea is a cute one. I just picture a stewardess uniform to be crisp and clean, and this outfit isn't it.

review_body:
My band size is 34, however since so many reviewers said this item ran small I decided to take a chance on a 36. I'm glad I did because the 36 is SNUG. The front fastening is a single row of seven eyelets so \\"letting it out\\" or using a bra extender is not option. The 36 is comfortable under the bust so I wouldn't go to a 38, but ideally I'd have ordered up one cup size too. The bra runs small allover, not just in the band.

I find the bra comfortable: the front darts and center closure keep The Ladies where they should be with minimal adjustments over the course of the day. My single gripe is the material: the 80% Nylon, 20% Lycra Spandex blend can start to feel like scratchy pantyhose if you work up a sweat. A touch of cotton for breathability would have edged this closer to 5-stars.

At full retail price I might drop this to 3-stars, however for 40% (or more) off the value overshadows the shortcomings.

product_title: Wacoal Women's Bodysuede Underwire Bra
review_body:
I have difficulty finding comfortable bras in my size. I am between a DDD and DDDD in a 36. I have been "fitted" with mixed results: I am usually steered toward a 38, which is too large, but more common.

I had bought a Wacoal bra years ago, but it had plastic rings on the straps that deteriorated and broke within 6 months. I bought more in recent years that were better made, had great cup size and separation, but narrow straps and band. The weight of my breasts would eventually shift the band up in back and down in front, pressing the underwires into my skin. By the end of the day the pain was excruciating.

I finally found this style, which is very comfortable: The straps are wider and slightly padded over the shoulder, the back band is wider with four closures, and it doesn't shift. Unfortunately, the cups are not designed to separate the breasts, which is my personal preference because of sweating, so I liberally employ body powder.

I gave this bra 4 stars because it has one problem: The support panels on the sides have come loose from the top on some of them and folded over inside the cup...negating the extra support. So, I have hand-tacked them back in place...a job that shouldn't have to be done.

I also learned a valuable lesson about laundering. You might want to throw these in the washing machine and dryer, but be careful: The elastic in these bras will be damaged by heat. After ruining three other Wacoal bras in the past, I now fasten the hooks, turn them inside out and place in a mesh laundry bag. I wash them with my other lingerie in warm water (cuts body oils better) on the gentle cycle and dry on the delicate cycle. Do not over dry.

I called again, getting another anonymous 'customer service' representative who said she saw that they were going to credit my account.  Unfortunately, my purchase was for $76.10 and this person on the phone said they were only crediting me $57 and change.    More than a month later, still I have not seen a refund or the merchandise.  I called again today.  ShapeFX obviously uses some mass-phone bank type of 'customer service' center.  The girl on the other end of the phone had no clue how to help me.  She said she would 'pass my information along'.  She also indicated that it would take one or two BILLING cycles before I see he credit on my account.  Not to mention - she didn't know why there would be a discrepancy in the dollar amount that was being refunded, but she couldn't see any information on my account anyway.  I offered SEVERAL times to give her my order number.  She didn't want it.  She took my phone number and my name and said she would escalate this to ... someone.    I'm finding it very shady that I cannot directly contact someone that would be interested in my order number,account information, or would be able to tell me (directly) what was going on with my account. product_title: Kenneth Cole REACTION Men's Waldorf Reversible Leather Belt
review_headline: Hands down the cheapest quality belt I've ever owned
review_body:
I bought a kenneth cole belt several months ago at macys and cannot beleive how cheap the belt is. My first thoughts on the belt were that the leather was a little stiff and would eventually flatten out but it never did. The leather is so hard and unflexible its almost like its made out of 99% plastic and 1% leather. After wearing the belt ONE TIME. I take it off and it looked like my 4 year old dolce and gabbana belt that i've been wearing every day for the past 4 years, old and wornout. The black finish was wiping off revealing a light tan color around the hole i buckled it into. I then look at the back of the belt after i took it off and the leather was tearing in half by the hole. I am not a big guy (125lbs) and i do not wear my belts tight at all for them to do this. I always wear my belts not to hold my pants up but really just as an ornament to accent the pants im wearing. The last thing you want to happen is to be on a date etc.. and your Brand new kenneth cole belt just split in half all of a sudden. Hands down the poorest quality leather(plastic) i have ever seen in my life. If you want a good belt, go to a high end department store (i.e. saks, neiman marcus) and buy one there. They may cost $200-400 but are going to last you forever. You get what you pay for.

Note: reversible belts are reversible because the leather quality is so cheap that if they where to thread it through a normal buckle and sew it over, the leather would split immediately. THATS WHY THEY ARE REVERSIBLE, because they are cheap.

review_body:
The pant material is JERSEY not FLEECE. Order the fleece sweat pants, if you want something heavy to keep warm outdoors in cold climates. Order these jersey pants, if you want a light workout pant that allows maximum freedom of movement with some ability to wick the perspiration from your skin. I wear these while exercising at the health club. The texture of the fabric is difficult to describe. It is the weight of a heavy t-shirt cotton, but with a hard finish for durability. These pants are better at keeping one dry during an intense workout then the old fashion heavy weight fleece sweat pants.

I have ordered these pants from Amazon on three separate occasions. Yes the pants are a little large, but they are suppose to be for freedom of movement.

May 2013 UPDATE:

product_title: Summoning The Storm T-shirt 100% Cotton TEENS and ADULTS Short Sleeve Indian Shirt
review_body: It's impossible to see in the graphic on this T-Shirt, but the Native American storm-summoner is wearing this EXACT T-shirt under his feathered jacket. That's right, he's wearing a t-shirt with himself wearing the same t-shirt. That's not just the wind... it's your mind that's blown.    By wearing this t-shirt, you harness the power of infinity and become the summoner. It helps if you stand over the Grand Canyon and have a feathered headdress, but is not necessary. I was able to summon lightning and three giant white horses on my first try, right in my back yard. The horses wreaked havoc on our neighborhood, causing some to think it was the apocalypse. I summoned them into three white ice cream cones to show that it wasn't. Then I gave the ice cream cones to three kids in our neighborhood who are nice to old people. There were no survivors.     It's important if you buy this shirt not to let it fall into the wrong hands. I'd advise summoning a couple hundred thousand lightning horses to gallop in a lightning horse hurricane with this shirt at it's center. That way only you can use the shirt and all others will be trampled when they try to get it. Unless they have a helicopter, in which case you need to make your lightning horse hurricane into a hemisphere of sorts. Also that way orbitting Russians can't see your shirt and use lasers.

product_title: Coal Crest Flap Men's Beanie - Brown
review_body:
I wanted a solid color knitted hat that would keep my head warm, especially my ears, during the cold Adirondack winters and that would also match my new goose down coat. What I didn't want was a knitted cap that was too small (a concern when ordering online), or a loosely and poorly knitted, as with many knitted caps that is designed for women.
So, I bought this knowing it read for men, hoping that the construction would be larger and heavier.

Upon arrival, I found that:

* The knitted yarn was heavy much like a mohair fabric, but coarser.
* The material may be too coarse for some people, but I personally like it---not a flimsy hat that will fall apart after one winter.
* It was well-constructed to last.
* It did fit and with room to spare, unlike alot of caps that have to be stretched to the max.

Nevertheless, with the unsually freezing weather in the Adirondacks recently between -10 and 0, this cap has kept my head warm, while enduring this tempature to and from work or out doing necessary errands.

I would recommend this cap to anyone wanting a quality hat for warmth in the winter months. I would even buy another one in blue if offered for sale.

product_title: Quiksilver 3 O'Clock High Backpack
review_body: So far in my life, this backpack has been my favorite in my life. However, as a victim of a break in to my car, this bag was stolen, and now I realize just how much I miss it. To my dismay, I've discovered that in the 1 year that I've owned it, Quicksilver seems to have discontinued the model... even though it's sold out everywhere.    What sets this bag aside is the excellent balance of design features and versatility. I use this bag for general storage, for vacation travel, for picnicking with the family, for holding my wife and kids stuff at disneyland, etc.    CAPACITY - This is a medium sized backpack with excellent capacity. I can't find dimensions but it's larger than the typical school back pack but not as large as the backpackers bags. It has a large main compartment for sweatshirts/jackets/etc, a middle large compartment which held my laptop/books/pens/etc, and a 3rd compartment that is an insulated \\"cooler\\" that held bottle drinks. On the side are two zippered pockets which can hold a typical plastic water bottle or sunscreen bottle. The body of the bag expands to roughly a boxy shape to nicely accommodate books/laptop and just maximize capacity. In addition, the are TWO zippered top pockets, one to hold an MP3/CD player and another just for convenience!    STRAPS - the straps are the modern flat straps with the venting padding on the straps and the back to reduce sweating. The strap has a stretchie pocket for a cell phone, which is perfect when in a noisy place like Disneyland or skiing when you need the phone as close to your ear as possible and easy to quickly reach. A thick handle at the top can be used to grab the bag easily.    COOLER - as mentioned, the front compartment is actually an insulated cooler. Insulation is thin, so it doesn't work as well as a full blown Igloo, but it does work and it keeps bottled drinks cool. It even comes with a BlueIce pack and mesh pocket inside the cooler to hold it.    I *loved* this bag and am very angry at the people who stole it. I wish I could replace it, but Quicksilver no longer makes them. HEAR THAT QUICKSILVER?!????

Across the back, shoulder to shoulder is 26 inches.

product_title: Rubie's Women's Star Wars Princess Leia Deluxe Costume
review_body:
I bought each of the Princess Leia costumes for sale on Amazon and this one is the winner. The reasons:
1. It's a \\"traditional\\" Leia costume, basically a white robe with a mock turtle-neck collar, and a nice little hood attached to the back. It's just the right size, not too big when it's down, but big enough that when it's on it looks like Leia
2. Material is pretty hefty compared to some of the others
3. Arms flair but not too much

It comes with white boot covers that I can't imagine anyone wearing, the wig isn't great, and the belt is pretty cheap, so I ended up getting cheap white gogo boots and I'm going to make my own belt. I also bought the Princess Leia headband [[ASIN:B003IISRXI Adult Princess Leia Headband]] and some brown hairspray to make my own Leia hair. So I ended up spending a lot on a Halloween costume, but I wanted it to be pretty authentic.

Here's a breakdown of the other two Leia costume options:

1. Star Wars Secret Wishes Princess Leia Costume by Rubie's Costume Co - a.k.a. the \\"Sexy Leia\\"
[[ASIN:B002JTX90I Star Wars Secret Wishes Princess Leia Costume]]
Cheap material, two slits going up both thighs, the bottom half is tight, top half a little looser. Sleeves are very flared. You will have to wear something underneath, it's completely see-through. But if you want to be sexy Leia this is your best option

2. Star Wars Princess Leia Adult Costume by Rubie's - Traditional Leia costume
[...]
This is very similar to the one that I kept, but it's not the \\"deluxe\\" version. The big difference is that this one does not have a hood on the dress, and no booty covers (which you wouldn't use anyways). And the belt is a piece of cloth instead of the cheap plastic that comes with the other two. So if price is most important to you then this is a good option for buying the basic Leia dress.

Hope this helps! And thank goodness for Amazon's return policy which let me do this research.me do this research.

product_title: Berkshire Women's Plus-Size Queen All Day Sheer Non-Control Top Pantyhose - Reinforced Toe 4404
review_headline: Not the prettiest, but they get the job done
review_body:
For reference, I'm 5'9, 333 lbs, very long torso (my inseam is only 30/31 inches), with a more or less hourglass shape.

I ordered a 7x and these hose fit perfectly. It's amazing to find hose that are this long. They actually come up right below the bra.

The nude tone blended with my skin and the hose appeared invisible. Waistband was very comfortable, even after wearing for 12-16 hours at a time. The \\"pana fit panty\\" makes a difference; it doesn't bind or restrict at all. Cotton crotch is breathable.

They lasted about four wearings, but though I washed them in the sink twice, I found that the ankle/top of foot area got a bit baggy. The 100% nylon is both looser and not as durable as the nylon/spandex blends.

If you're looking for a nylon/spandex blend, I highly recommend the 4489s or the 4411s if you fit within the weight range (5x - 6x tops out at 280 and size chart is firm). Though, of course, the nylon/spandex are control top, which these are NOT.

However, they are a good value for the money, and will buy again. Also, I appreciate that they are manufactured in the United States. For under $5, what more can you ask for?

Seller Essential Apparel is solid. No affiliation, but I've ordered all my Berkshire hose from them and they arrive quickly and as described, with free shipping.

product_title: Hanes Silk Reflections Women's Lace Top Thigh High
review_body:
I like to wear thigh highs in the summer time because my legs get really cold inside the office. I don't like pantyhose because they're not comfortable around my middle. (Is it just me, or are black tights much more comfortable and flattering around the tummy than pantyhose??)

DURABILITY: Anyhow, I have purchased about 8 pairs of these. I've tried some other brands, but I find that these Hanes are the best in terms of staying up. I have only once had a problem with the thigh high sliding down my leg as I walked down the street (which was incredibly embarrassing!!), and I realized that what happened was the top of the stocking was folded inside itself, so the silicone wasn't touching my leg.

Otherwise, I've been able to wear these stockings out. I wash them in a mesh bag and then hang dry. I wear each pair about once a week, and they last forever. I have only had a few stockings that ripped to the point that I couldn't wear them. I do not have problems with runs, and I'm a little surprised by that. My desk at work has a little nail protruding, and I know that I hit it a few times as I'm crossing my leg -- but the stockings just get a little hole, and it does not spread out into a run.

COLORS: I am fair skinned, and I like to get either the "Barely There" (which looks like lightly tanned skin) or "Travel Buff" (which looks like untanned skin. I tried the "Little Color" but was very disappointed. That shade is too white (and again, I'm fair skinned to begin with), and it looked too unnatural. I wouldn't recommend that shade if you're trying to have the stocking blend into your skin, because if it looks too white on my pasty skin, I can't imagine that it would look natural on anyone!

product_title: Carhartt Men's Double Front Work Dungaree Washed Duck B136
review_body: These are the pants that are recommended for use on the Mountain Rescue team that I am on.  These are very heavy duty pants, that have held up very well.  They also offer great protection from tough, thorny desert plants when hiking off-trail.  We also do a lot of kneeling on the ground in the desert while we work on our anchor and rope systems, so the knees take a real beating.  The double front really improves the lifespan of these pants, and adds a little bit of padding for your knees.  And if you are really spending a lot of time kneeling, especially on uneven ground, you will really want to add some foam pads to these pants.  The double front knees also functions as a pocket that will hold specially designed knee pads to ease the pressure points on kneeling on rocks.  I bought and inserted "Armed Work Wear HD6x9 High Density Foam Knee Pad Replacement" from Amazon and inserted them into my pants.  It makes kneeling MUCH more comfortable.  The only downside is that it makes hiking long distances, especially anything with high step-ups, somewhat uncomfortable as the bending foam increases friction/rubbing on your knees.

product_title: Panache Women's Tango Balconette
review_body:
I have been wearing panache tangos for several years now (first a 34J and now the 36J). It's amazing support. I could feel the tension sliding out of my neck and shoulders the first time I put one on. Having the proper fit matters! (I do not add inches to the measurement for the band like some bra companies tell you to. That just means it's going to slide in the back and I'll sag in the front. If my measurement is 36, then I order 36 as the band size. Trust me, my back and neck and shoulders thank me for this).

The bra shapes nicely, not giving you a uni-boob. The underwires never cut into me (until the bra gets old and it's time to be replaced). It's affordable compared to the other bras out there for my size. I don't feel like I \\"jiggle\\" just by walking, like some other less sturdy bras of the same size I had made me feel (Freya). It's not the most beautiful bra, but it's beautiful enough not to feel like Granny (I'm in my 30s). I have small shoulders, so if I don't have the straps adjusted right, they will slide since this is a balconette (straps are maybe a little farther apart on those), but as long as they're adjusted, it's a comfortable day. It's not a posture bra, but just having the right fit corrects my posture and helps with the pain I previously had with the wrong fit.

product_title: Rubie's Costume Star Wars Deluxe Injection Molded Adult Jango Fett Mask
review_body:
I've been wanting to add a Jango Fett replica helmet to my prop collection ever since Rubies started making them. I did a lot of googling and searching online a week ago to find out which one was the best to go with on a limited budget. I got this one for $25.99 shipped to my house right here on Amazon.

I had originally wanted to get the 'Collectors Edition' seeing that it was a one-piece model but upon further inspection and reviews found out it's just hard rubber and customers were very disappointed with how badly it would warped and the T-visor only had small cutouts instead of it being a complete open T-visor.

I searched on Youtube for reviews as well and came across J.J. Medrano's review [...] of the Two-piece model and instantly knew this is the one I wanted!

It arrived today and I'm super excited with how it looks! Some people have commented on how it's a bit flimsy, but to be honest, it's made of durable plastic and definitely not going to crack like other cheap helmet's I've had in the past. the black T-visor is all a semi-tinted plastic so you have a huge view range. I plan on adding a darker piece of tinting over it to make my identity more concealed from the outside.

it did take me a couple mintues to assemble, but once I got both pieces lined up, it went together quite easily. It's actually quite spaceous on the inside, so I'll be adding some more padding to it as well, to keep it from spinning around on my head.

J.J. also mentioned he was a part of the 'Mandalorian Mercs' which specialize in Jango/Boba helmets and costumes, so I checked out their site and it gives a ton of info and tutorials on how to make this certain model a better helmet [...], but for now I like mine how it is!

Hope this review helps you a bit on your decision to purchase this helmet! if you have questions or comments feel free to let me know! I took a lot of photos of mine from various angles to give you a better idea of what it looks like, as the stock photo Amazon uses shows the 1-peice, but it's actually the 2-piece.

product_title: Exquisite Form Fully Women's Cotton Soft Cup Bra With Lace #5100535
review_body:
I live in the southeastern part of Louisiana and summers get pretty steamy here. I wanted a bra to work around the house and yard in and not have it become as uncomfortable as nylon bras. I think this bra is going to work out well. I brought this and the one that opened in the front and I much preferred this one. The one that opened in the front kept coming unhooked and the metal hooks would dig into my skin.

This bra is mostly cotton with the back being made of a more nylon or spandex type material. So, it does have some give with your movements and makes it more comfortable for me personally. The cups, straps, and front band are cotton and more "breathable" and I hope will not allow pools of sweat to collect next to my skin like the nylon does. I do not like sports bras and did not want to pay some of the ridiculous prices some are sold for. I really like this bra for what I will use it for. I do have to adjust the straps a little looser than I normally wear so that I can have some movement with them since they are cotton and do not stretch.

I would not recommend this bra for dressy clothes or someone who has to have full support at all times. While it supports my size C or D cup figure well enough for working at home or running a few local errands I would not wear it under tight t-shirts or dress clothes where a good support bra is important for proper fit.

product_title: Derek Alexander Leather Mens Breast Pocket Wallet - Black
review_headline: Excellent product; just the dimensions aren't ideal
review_body:
First of all, the quality and feel of this wallet is absolutely superb. Its generally taller shape evokes thoughts of dinner jackets and elegant dining, and suggests class and distinction. I also like the generous spacing between each card pocket compared to many wallets that stuff in so many slots that it becomes very difficult for you to remove the one that you want due to the lack of sufficiently exposed card surface for your fingers to grip and pull.

Here's where my anal side comes out: this wallet is almost exactly 6.75\\" x 4\\", which is unfortunately just a little bit too short for USD-sized bills to easily fit into one of the side pockets, and why I am deducting a point from this otherwise 5-star wallet. USD bills are about 6.25\\" and you need about 1/3\\" to 1/2\\" extra play on either side of a bill to make up for the necessary slight bending (and thus shortening) of the wallet as you open it up to accept bills, as well as the fact that usually the bills are not all perfectly stacked one on top of another. I have found myself having to neatly stack my bills by tapping them together on a countertop before carefully inserting them back in this wallet, whereas usually after a purchase I would just roughly and easily cram my bills back into my wallet and move on. For US currency 7\\" is just about exactly the length required for a wallet to comfortably accept bills (into side-type pockets) without becoming unnecessarily longer (plus you have some extra breathing room if you travel abroad and encounter larger bill sizes). You could possibly get away with a shorter wallet, even as short as 6.5\\", if at least one end of a side pocket is open-ended for you to more easily replace your bills back into the wallet. But for side pockets closed with stitching on both ends, you need a 7\\" total wallet length. As for the width, 4\\" is a bit wider than needed for my tastes. 3.5\\" would have been perfect. This would result in a design with slots that are all vertically aligned on either side of the wallet, but still have enough room for about 11 or 13 total cards that are spaced apart enough to get to each card easily, as well as 4 side pockets for bills and receipts, 2 on each side.

My ideal breast pocket-type wallet is exactly 7.0\\" x 3.5\\" inches, has 13 or 15 vertical card slots with one side having a transparent slot for ID's (thus the uneven number of card slots), and 2 side pockets on each side for currency and receipts. These dimensions would be the ideal blend of compactness and ease of use, IMHO.

review_body: I bought this item on sale, and I think I paid exactly what it was worth. The sleeves are slightly too short, while the trunk is slightly too large; in essence, it fits like two sweaters-- a small and a large-- had their separate components sewn together, and the end result is not a medium.  Also, as mentioned in an earlier review, the snaps are loosely/poorly attached.  That said, the sweater does come with extra thread and an additional snap, so this can easily be rectified should the need arise.  (Also, I think you'd have to handle it fairly brusquely to cause a snap to detach entirely.)  To counterbalance some of those negatives, the colors are true to the pictures and the yarn is soft and wearable; it's an easy sweater to dress up or down.  Essentially, it's the type of sweater you'd find for $19.99 at TJ Maxx/Ross/Marshall's, and you should set your standards accordingly.

product_title: Panache Women's Tango Balconette
review_body:
First off, a couple of the common complaints I found to be true. One, the material is scratchy upon first wearing. Two, there is extra material at the top of the cup that is plainly not enough to warrant going down a cup size. It does not show under nicely-draped clothing, but it might on tight tops.

I think in my mind I was conflating the terms balconette, which this may well be, and demi-cup, which of course it isn't. I think a similar confusion may be powering some of the other reviewers' disappointment.

The underwire does indeed go up quite high. This is as it should be. The lace material is opaque, but doesn't show everything; there is a sort of tulle-like material behind the lace to help obscure. I'm actually a bit disappointed by this, since I was buying it mainly to catch my husband's eye. (Which it actually did!) It reminds me nicely of the Cacique bras I used to buy before my latest pregnancy caused me to outgrow them, at least as far as looks go, but I do believe this is better made.

product_title: Bill Blass Men's Dress Shirt with Fashion Pointed Collar
review_headline: Don't be fooled by the brand name or the supposed list price: These shirts are junk
review_body:
First thing you have to know about clothes: There are certain names the are your guarantee of quality (think something like Ralph Lauren), because these designers impose a certain quality level on the clothes that have their label attached.

Then there are certain names that mean...nothing. That's because these \\"designers\\" are simply labels available for license to whatever comes down the pike. Bill Blass is one of these, at least for cheaper clothes.

These shirts represent the very worst of the kinds of clothes that come down that aforementioned pike. Slap a Bill Blass label on them, claim a high list price, and pawn them off on unsuspecting customers via mail order (where you can't see them first, because if you saw them first it wouldn't take you two seconds to realize they stink).

These shirts are extremely thin, as has been mentioned before. Beyond that, they are not particularly well made. If you care at all about your clothes, you'll regret buying these at ANY price (including the extremely cheap price at which they are currently available from Amazon) and, if you have any self resepct, you'll immediately toss them in that bag you keep for clothes to be donated to the local Goodwill store.

Is it worth even a few dollars to confirm what I'm telling you is true? I say not. Why toss your money in the street?

product_title: Santa Suit Ultra Velvet
review_headline: Ho. . . Ho. . . Ho. . . Just Like the Real Santa's Suit
review_body: This is a very good, high quality Santa Claus suit.  When I was a child my grandfather wore an excellent Santa suit each Christmas, which was handmade by my mother in the 1950's; so I really expected, by comparison, to be disappointed when this product arrived.  On opening the box I was happily surprised to find that the quality of the fabrics and the workmanship put into its construction made this an excellent Santa suit that I will be confident using for the rest of my natural life at parties and with my own grandchildren someday.  The velvet was a good color and very plush.  The fur trim is also quite good.  Nothing was skimpy about this suit.  I'm six feet tall, weigh in the 200-pound range and had no trouble with fit.  I still need to use a pillow, albeit a small one, to fill the suit out.  I have very large hands and the white gloves still fit.  The pants pockets were very helpful; so I didn't have to leave anything unattended at the agency Christmas party.  The lining made the suit warm enough to make the walk outdoors between worksites comfortably; but indoors you'll need to wear very light clothing underneath to prevent over-heating.  I suspect that this authentic reproduction is very much like the real Santa's suit.  It's a shame that you can only wear it during the Christmas season.  You will need to buy a wig and beard separately to make the outfit complete.  I wore an \\"Adult Albus Dumbledore Wig and Beard Set\\" this year.  It worked; but I may try a more traditional Santa wig and beard at some point.  I will also try to find a pair of black boots over the next year that might round out my Santa accessories set.

review_headline: Good shirts for the money, but order one size smaller than normal!
review_body:
I picked up 6 of these shirts using a crazy coupon code for a total of $12.66, free shipping. I'm over 300 pounds, 6'1\\" tall, I usually wear a 2X in any other brand polo shirt, some cheaper shirts 2X is even small on me. I ordered 4 2X, 1 1X and 1 3X shirts. After washing in hot water the 1X and the 2X, the 1X shirt is the one that fits, and it is still a bit big in the arms and very long! The 2X shirt, even after washing is still huge on my not so tiny torso. Seems the shoulders are way too big on 2X shirt, sleeves are also huge, I could fit 3 of my arms through the sleeve.

All that being said about the sizing, the material is actually very nice weight and quality. Now that I know that the 1X will fit my body, I went back and ordered 6 more of the 1X shirts, currently has almost all colors available in this size. The \\"crazy coupon code\\" is no longer available, but the current price of less than seven dollars is still a bargain. You would be hard pressed to find shirts of this quality for the current price at any store, even at their best \\"sale\\" price.

So, if you could use some new polo shirts, buy them now, just make sure you order one size smaller than normal!

product_title: Samsonite 5-Piece Travel Set
review_headline: Thoroughly satisfied with this luggage set, and at a great price too!
review_body:
My wife and I took this luggage set out for a try on a 10 day vacation to Florida. That totalled 4 plane flights, a rental car, and 2 condo transfers.

I'm delighted to report to you, that Samsonite truly lived up to all of my expectations. The luggage was durable, the wheels and handle apparatus proved to be durable and easy to use, the buckles were solid and well designed. Everything about the luggage proved to be excellent.

By comparison, we purchased a different brand of luggage for my wife, slightly less expensive than Samsonite, and boy were we sorry! The wheel covers on the largest piece of the non-Samsonite luggage came off right in the middle of the airport in Florida on our way to the rental car. This was awful. Imagine trying to tug 3 suitcases with no wheels, through a busy airport, after a long and exhausting trip. Needless to say, by comparison, I was completely thrilled with the quality of the Samsonite luggage.

This is a basic, no frills set, with a very affordable price tag. I must say that I am absolutely delighted with the idea of including a duffle case versus a day case. I love the duffle! I used it on a weekend trip down to Southern California, and it was perfect! Plenty of pockets, solidly built, and perfect for small trips.

All and all, I must say that I am absolutely delighted with the Samsonite 5 piece travel set. The quality, value, and engineering totally live up to the Samsonite name. If you are in the market for a luggage set, don't settle for something cheaper. Go with Samsonite. Go with this set. You'll love the duffle, and you won't be dissapointed.

review_headline: Not latex free - I can tell.  Terrible thick bumpy front seams.
review_body: Silvergirlsales's review pretty much sums up my experience.  The bra looks nothing like the picture.  In the picture it isn't obvious that it has 2 pieces of fabric in the cups that are sewed together at an enormous bumpy seam.  In person that's all you see.  Looks horrible under shirts.  They aren't even nicely rounded, so that people with generous oversized breasts stuffed in would smooth it out very well.  It's baggy and lumped up just at the tips. Update:  now in their website it says "certified latex free" again.  I thought they had changed that at the time of my review, but I could be wrong.  The fabric feels like cotton - like it should be soft.  But I immediately get the scratchy itchies (same as any latex) in it.  Is it really that hard to make a latex-free bra???  I can't even find a microlined bra like the good old barely-there's from a decade ago.  I'm actually considering wearing t-shirts under since there don't see to be many other options.  Update:  Yeah that hasn't been a good option either.  None are a good texture.  The best thing I've found is a one size fits all blue-canoe bra, but it's so thin that I may need to try wearing two at a time to not look pokey.

product_title: Travel Portfolio Bag
review_headline: Perfect for the Forgetful Person or Someone Who Needs One Free Hand
review_body:
I have very specific needs for a bag. I have systemic lupus with both minor mobility issues and minor cognitive issues. Translation: I walk with a cane, and I forget stuff. AND I have some peripheral nerve issues, so a heavy bag hanging off my shoulder hurts a lot and makes my arm go numb. I know. Poor me.

It's okay, though, because I have this little bag. It holds my iPhone, which I need in case my husband or my son need to reach me (and which also keeps my calendar for me so that I am where I need to be when I need to be there). It holds my GPS. I can get lost driving places to which I have driven for years. Same thing with walking. My GPS is my new best friend, but I need to have it with me in order for it to help me.

The pockets I use for the iPhone and GPS are big enough for each and secure - meaning that my expensive things don't fall out when I'm digging around for other stuff. But they're easy enough to access that I don't miss phone calls. And because this thing is very small and very well organized, there isn't a lot of digging around. Everything has a place. There's even room for a small bottle of water and a mini-umbrella. And everything is accessible with one hand. Which means I can keep the other on my cane.

The bag weighs next to nothing, and it sits flat against my waist, even when I am sitting down. This means that once I put it on to go, I can wear it all day. No leaving it in restaurants or in my car or on the roof of my car or any of the other places I have managed to leave more traditional purses.

Very useful. Very helpful.

review_body:
I wanted a pair of shoes to wear for light hiking, mud, uneven terrain, and any situation where good traction and a little protection would be welcome. The Merrell Chameleon Stretch turned out to be the perfect shoe. They are tough, lightweight, good-looking, and without extra bulk.

My pair of Chameleons weighs 1 pound. The upper is nubuck leather over breathable mesh. Mine are \\"Sky Blue\\", which goes nicely with faded blue jeans. The nubuck part of the shoe is a gray-blue. The mesh is an extremely light gray or pearl color, close to white. The Vibram Octogrip soles are brighter and nearly live up to their \\"sky blue\\" name. The nubuck part of the shoe has 11 teardrop-shaped \\"bumpers\\" on it for added protection. These raised molded areas also anchor the mesh....and they look neat. Laces are elastic and do not tie. You adjust the fit by pulling the laces through a plastic cordlock. Any excess lace can be tucked out of the way underneath the crossed laces. The shoe doesn't have a tongue. In its place is a solid piece of stretchy neoprene. This avoids the annoyance of the tongue slipping to one side or the other. I wondered at first if this would make the shoe difficult to put on, but found that the Chameleons are easy to slip on as long as you grip the loop on the heel and pull. The soles of the shoes are wider and more rigid than than a running shoe would be, for increased traction and protection. But these Chameleons are less bulky -and therefore more versatile- than any lightweight hikers I've had in the past. The Chameleons truly are form-fitting. And they were exceptionally comfortable the minute I put them on.

I occasionally have trouble loosening the laces. The shoes can easily be removed without loosening the laces, but would be difficult to put back on with tight laces. There is a small knob on the back on the plastic cordlock that can be used to lock the laces in place. The laces stay in place without locking, so I ignore it. But the knob sometimes works its way into the locked position. If your laces are stuck, that's the culprit. product_title: Le Mystere Tisha Bra - Full Figure Renaissance (9955)
review_headline: Tough to please? Then try this bra
review_body:
Given the fact that I have not been able to EVER find a comfortable bra that also supported my D size chest (and my picky posture and displeasure for underwire), this bra has won the battle. There's just a couple of quirks, but that could just be me. When I tighten the straps, they eventually give way and losen up a bit. I find myself adjusting them every 3-4 wears. I'm considering sewing the straps permanently at that adjustment.

I hand wash it in cold water with mild soap and hang to dry. Sometimes tumble on low heat or air tumble and the shape and size stay consistent. I lost just a hair of weight in my breats and the bra fitted a little loser. Because of this, vertical \\"waves\\" in the cup material appeared, but that was because there wasn't enough to fill the bra. Once I gained that size back (unfortunately!) and filled the cup fully, the ridges disappeared.

I've had this one for 10 months and wear it every day, and it's still in great shape! When this one finally gives in, I'm definitely spending the money to buy another one!

review_headline: Be very aware if you need to return an item
review_body: I placed an order for 14 shirts (7 Small and 7 Medium) and had to return the Small directly to TXSHIRTS in the beginning of April. 5 weeks later I still had not gotten a credit back to my credit card so I called TXSHIRTS to see why it was taking so long.  TXSHIRTS told me they did not receive my package and as a result I am out of luck. I had followed all the steps of obtaining and writing the RMA# on the returned package and have done a lot of online ordering and returning in the last few years. Never has the U.S. Postal Service lost or damaged a package in the last 6 years with the large volume of internet orders and returns I have placed through the USPS. When talking with TXSHIRTS on the phone, I got the sense that they are very disorganized as far as their return processing goes, sort of hit or miss, perhaps they are primarily catered to wholesalers who normally don't send anything back so if you're an individual customer such as myself, be cautious with anything you need to return. I place an average of 40-70 online orders and return 20-30 of them a year and have never had a returned package gotten 'lost' before, that is, until now.

review_body: This item took a long time to arrive - about 12 days from date of order.  There was small defect in a zipper. Also, having read the reviews which indicated that the item was on the large side I ordered a medium.  It was too small.  Customer support replaced quickly without any problem or additional cost!  This was great!  The jacket itself is good for the $24 price.  Interesting point - 1st day I looked at the item it was listed for $24, next day I went to order and it was $49.  So I waited, 2 days later it was $24 again!  Go figure.  It's worth $24 - probably not $49.  I have yet to test the waterproof qualities - it would be better with more pockets and some air venting - but then it would cost more.  On balance - a good jacket for the price - I got it for travel and think it will work & pack well.

product_title: Bravado nursing bra
review_body: I purchased just one Bravado bra in this style to try it out.  The cup size was fine but being that I never wear tight fitting clothes (for me it's comfort over style) even the one size up wasn't enough to allow me to breath comfortably.  I returned the product to the vendor requesting another size and they immediately exchanged it. The product is made of nice soft fabric that is light and thin but durable.  When you are pregnant, you need as much comfort as possible.  Being the very particular consumer I am, I chose this product because I wanted a maternity bra that I could snap off easily to bear the entire breast, not just the nipple. Babies will drool and the milk will leak when you breastfeed.  This bra would have been perfect if it had snaps in the back to remove the bra.  The back is elastic like all the other maternity bras out there and you have to remove it as if you were taking off a t-shirt.  I give 5 stars for the very well thought out design of the bra.  I ended up purchasing a second bra in this style.  By the way...I did handwash these bras.  I decided not to machine wash.

review_headline: Essential for serious rain or sharing
review_body: Most umbrellas handle a light rain well, but leave you with wet pants during heavy rains.  This umbrella is essential equipment for keeping you dry during downpours.  I use it for the walking part of my commute through Washington, DC thunderstorms and it performs like a champ.  It's also big enough to cover two, allowing you to share your dry haven with a child, spouse, or co-worker.  The auto-close is great for letting you close the umbrella in a heavy rain from the shelter of your car or cab.  An auto open/close umbrella this size is very hard to find...in fact this is the only one I know of.  Quality is good...I've had one for four years that travels with me regularly on my commute.  Price at Amazon is great.
